Retrofit your backcountry repertoire with the HalfGen, the world's first modular, expandable basecamp cooking system. Use the HalfGen as a standalone stove, or couple it to other JetLink-compatible stoves to create an outdoor cooking range. A beastly 10,000 BTU heating system boils water in just over three minutes—perfect for melting snow or making coffee. Jetboil's proprietary regulator technology offers incremental heat adjustments from light simmer to full boil. The system's 9-inch ceramic-coated fry pan offers nonstick performance for eggs, pancakes, burgers, and more. Compatible with 5-liter FluxPot (not included); regulated for consistent performance to 20 degrees F (-6 degrees C); weighs 3.5 pounds. One-year limited warranty. For any adventure—from alpine expedition to a weekend trek—Jetboil offers a stove that will keep you fueled. When exploring the backcountry, a compact and efficient stove is fundamental, no matter the level of cuisine you want to create.

Lightweight, compact canisters nest perfectly inside Jetboil systems, making your whole cook setup easier to pack, carry, and deploy.

MultiValue.Value: Constructed of puncture-resistant, polyurethane-coated 420 denier nylon with RF welding for maximum durability.
Super Cinch tank buckle system locks the tank in rock-solid for maximum stability at depth.
Fully adjustable cummerbund compensates for suit compression, maintaining a snug fit at varying depths.
Heavy-duty waist overstrap with stainless steel cam buckle provides additional security and helps achieve a snug fit.
Fast-drying padded backpack enhances comfort during long dives.
Quick-release integrated weight pouches ditch quickly and easily and secure with squeeze buckles.
Rear trim pouches allow you to achieve a well-balanced swimming position.
Two large Velcro pockets with knife attachment grommets, plus two additional zippered pockets, provide lots of cargo-carrying capability.
Four large pre-bent stainless steel D-rings, along with two smaller stainless D-rings, provide convenient clip-on points for additional gear.
Available with Balanced Power Inflator or AIR2 alternate air source.

Values.Value: Classic BCD, w/ BPI, Black, XS
BPI (Balanced Power Inflator)~Provides an efficient and reliable way to maintain perfect buoyancy control throughout your dive.

In 1978, SCUBAPRO introduced the Stabilizing Jacket. It revolutionized scuba diving. A direct descendant of the “Stab” Jacket, the CLASSIC combines the best design and construction features of past and present. Built with puncture-resistant polyurethane-coated 420 denier nylon, the CLASSIC's seams are RF welded for maximum durability. The BCD comes with a stainless-steel Super Cinch tank band system, a quality web waist belt with stainless steel cam buckle, large pre-bent stainless steel D-rings and one of the most secure and reliable integrated weight systems around. Built tough, armed with a first-class valve system and offering outstanding buoyant lift, the CLASSIC can handle any job, anytime. It’s the original, and still the best.

MultiValue.Value: Modular Design: Offers the same adaptable Monprene® shoulders and back pad popularized by the Hydros Pro back-inflation BCD.
Rotating Quick-Release Shoulder Buckles: Allow you to route your shoulder straps to optimize fit.
EndurTex Nylon Construction: High-tenacity 420 nylon fabric bladder is lightweight yet extremely durable.
Super Cinch Tank Buckle System: Securely locks the tank in solid for maximum stability at depth.
Integrated Front Weight System: Simple, safe and reliable quick-release front buckles offer a fixed location for easy one-hand operation.
Two Rear Trim Pouches: Help create a comfortable swimming position.
Monprene® Thermoplastic Shoulders & Back Pad: Extremely resistant to UV, chemicals and abrasion, plus it doesn’t absorb water to minimize drying time.
Two Big Zippered Cargo Pockets: Offer great gear-carrying capacity and are easily accessible even when the weight pouches are fully loaded.
Multi-Mount Accessory Matrix: Multiple D-Rings and mounting points for a knife + light + SMB + hoses + crotch strap and much more.

Values.Value: Hydros X BCD, w/BPI, Men, Black, S
BPI (Balanced Power Inflator)~Provides an efficient and reliable way to maintain perfect buoyancy control throughout your dive.

The Hydros X is a front adjustable BCD that offers a fully injection molded Monprene® thermoplastic shoulders and back pad. This unique feature allows the shoulders to conform to your body like a tailored fit. Its flat-buckled quick-release integrated weight system and rear trim weight pockets work together to offer a more comfortable and balanced ride when diving. Add the full-sized backpack and stainless steel Super Cinch tank band and you also get excellent stability both on the surface and at depth. The bladder, made out of EndurTex high-tenacity nylon fabric, is extremely lightweight and durable while offering generous lift capacity, aided by lower back bellows. In the event of damage, several components on the Hydros X are detachable and easily replaceable. The two big zippered cargo pockets offer great gear-carrying capacity and are easily accessible even when the weight pouches are fully loaded. Two stainless steel D-rings provide clip-on points for additional gear. In addition, the Hydros X features a Multi-Mount Accessory Matrix with multiple D-Ring and mounting points that easily attach various dive accessories.

Variant.title: Hydros X Tarierjacket, Herren, Schwarz, S
Variant.description: Das Hydros X ist ein vorne justierbares Tarierjacket, das eine vollständig spritzgegossene Monpren® Schulter- und Rückenpartie bietet. Dank dieser einzigartigen Ausstattung kann es optimal wie maßgeschneidert auf den Oberkörper abgestimmt werden und bietet so eine einzigartige Passform und höchsten Komfort. Das große Rückenteil und die Super-Cinch-Schnalle aus Edelstahl sorgen für zusätzliche Stabilität an der Oberfläche und unter Wasser. Die Blase besteht aus höchst robustem EndurTex Nylon, ist äußerst leicht und langlebig, und verfügt über eine großzügige Auftriebskapazität. Bei Beschädigung können diverse Komponenten des Hydros X separat ausgetauscht werden. Das schnell lösbare, integrierte Gewichtssystem mit flachen Schnallen und Trimmtaschen am Rücken ergänzt sich optimal, und sorgt für einen bequemen und perfekt austarierten Tauchgang. Die zwei großen Cargo Taschen mit Reißverschluss bieten viel Stauraum und sind selbst bei voll beladenen Gewichtstaschen leicht zugänglich. An zwei D-Ringen aus Edelstahl kann zusätzliche Ausrüstung angebracht werden. Darüber hinaus verfügt das Hydros X über eine Multi-Mount-Zubehörmatrix mit mehreren D-Ringen und Montagepunkten, an denen zahlreiches Tauchzubehör einfach befestigt werden kann. Hydros X Tarierjacket, Herren

Variant.title: Hydros X Equilibratore, con Alimentatore BPI, Uomo, S
Variant.description: Hydros X è un equilibratore regolabile frontale in grado di offrire spallacci e schienalino fatti completamente in termoplastica Monprene® stampati ad iniezione. Questa caratteristica esclusiva consente di personalizzare gli spallacci a seconda del tuo fisico, come cuciti su misura, garantendo un comfort di livello superiore. Con l’aggiunta dello schienalino in misura standard e della fascia per bombola Super Cinch in acciaio inossidabile, si può inoltre godere di un’eccellente stabilità sia in superficie che in profondità. La camera d’aria, realizzata in tessuto di nylon ad alta durabilità EndurTex, è estremamente leggera e resistente e offre un’eccellente capacità di spinta, sostenuta dal soffietto inferiore posteriore. In caso di danneggiamento, alcuni dei componenti di Hydros X sono separabili e sostituibili. Il sistema di zavorra integrata a sgancio rapido con fibbia piatta e le tasche contrappeso posteriori contribuiscono a offrire un’immersione più confortevole e bilanciata durante le tue immersioni. Le due grandi tasche porta-accessori con cerniera lampo offrono un’eccellente capacità di stivaggio dell’attrezzatura e sono facilmente accessibili anche quando gli scomparti con zavorra sono a pieno carico. Due anelli a D in acciaio inossidabile offrono comodi punti di aggancio a clip per ulteriore attrezzatura. Inoltre, Hydros X presenta una Matrice per Fissaggio Multiaccessorio con anelli a D e punti di fissaggio multipli per agganciare con facilità diversi accessori per immersioni. | Hydros X Equilibratore, con Alimentatore BPI, Uomo, S

Bei Beschädigung können diverse Komponenten des Hydros X separat ausgetauscht werden. Das schnell lösbare, integrierte Gewichtssystem mit flachen Schnallen und Trimmtaschen am Rücken ergänzt sich optimal, und sorgt für einen bequemen und perfekt austarierten Tauchgang. Die zwei großen Cargo Taschen mit Reißverschluss bieten viel Stauraum und sind selbst bei voll beladenen Gewichtstaschen leicht zugänglich. An zwei D-Ringen aus Edelstahl kann zusätzliche Ausrüstung angebracht werden. Darüber hinaus verfügt das Hydros X über eine Multi-Mount-Zubehörmatrix mit mehreren D-Ringen und Montagepunkten, an denen zahlreiches Tauchzubehör einfach befestigt werden kann. Hydros X Tarierjacket, Herren

Variant.title: Hydros X Equilibratore, con Alimentatore BPI, Uomo, M
Variant.description: Hydros X è un equilibratore regolabile frontale in grado di offrire spallacci e schienalino fatti completamente in termoplastica Monprene® stampati ad iniezione. Questa caratteristica esclusiva consente di personalizzare gli spallacci a seconda del tuo fisico, come cuciti su misura, garantendo un comfort di livello superiore. Con l’aggiunta dello schienalino in misura standard e della fascia per bombola Super Cinch in acciaio inossidabile, si può inoltre godere di un’eccellente stabilità sia in superficie che in profondità. La camera d’aria, realizzata in tessuto di nylon ad alta durabilità EndurTex, è estremamente leggera e resistente e offre un’eccellente capacità di spinta, sostenuta dal soffietto inferiore posteriore. In caso di danneggiamento, alcuni dei componenti di Hydros X sono separabili e sostituibili. Il sistema di zavorra integrata a sgancio rapido con fibbia piatta e le tasche contrappeso posteriori contribuiscono a offrire un’immersione più confortevole e bilanciata durante le tue immersioni. Le due grandi tasche porta-accessori con cerniera lampo offrono un’eccellente capacità di stivaggio dell’attrezzatura e sono facilmente accessibili anche quando gli scomparti con zavorra sono a pieno carico. Due anelli a D in acciaio inossidabile offrono comodi punti di aggancio a clip per ulteriore attrezzatura. Values.Value: Hydros X BCD, w/BPI, Men, Black, L
BPI (Balanced Power Inflator)~Provides an efficient and reliable way to maintain perfect buoyancy control throughout your dive.

The Hydros X is a front adjustable BCD that offers a fully injection molded Monprene® thermoplastic shoulders and back pad. This unique feature allows the shoulders to conform to your body like a tailored fit. Its flat-buckled quick-release integrated weight system and rear trim weight pockets work together to offer a more comfortable and balanced ride when diving. Add the full-sized backpack and stainless steel Super Cinch tank band and you also get excellent stability both on the surface and at depth. The bladder, made out of EndurTex high-tenacity nylon fabric, is extremely lightweight and durable while offering generous lift capacity, aided by lower back bellows. In the event of damage, several components on the Hydros X are detachable and easily replaceable. The two big zippered cargo pockets offer great gear-carrying capacity and are easily accessible even when the weight pouches are fully loaded. Two stainless steel D-rings provide clip-on points for additional gear. In addition, the Hydros X features a Multi-Mount Accessory Matrix with multiple D-Ring and mounting points that easily attach various dive accessories.

The Hydros X is a front adjustable BCD that offers a fully injection molded Monprene® thermoplastic shoulders and back pad. This unique feature allows the shoulders to conform to your body like a tailored fit. Its flat-buckled quick-release integrated weight system and rear trim weight pockets work together to offer a more comfortable and balanced ride when diving. Add the full-sized backpack and stainless steel Super Cinch tank band and you also get excellent stability both on the surface and at depth. The bladder, made out of EndurTex high-tenacity nylon fabric, is extremely lightweight and durable while offering generous lift capacity, aided by lower back bellows. In the event of damage, several components on the Hydros X are detachable and easily replaceable. The two big zippered cargo pockets offer great gear-carrying capacity and are easily accessible even when the weight pouches are fully loaded. Two stainless steel D-rings provide clip-on points for additional gear. In addition, the Hydros X features a Multi-Mount Accessory Matrix with multiple D-Ring and mounting points that easily attach various dive accessories.

Variant.title: Hydros X Tarierjacket, Damen, Schwarz, L
Variant.description: Das Hydros X ist ein vorne justierbares Tarierjacket, das eine vollständig spritzgegossene Monpren® Schulter- und Rückenpartie bietet. Dank dieser einzigartigen Ausstattung kann es optimal wie maßgeschneidert auf den Oberkörper abgestimmt werden und bietet so eine einzigartige Passform und höchsten Komfort. Das große Rückenteil und die Super-Cinch-Schnalle aus Edelstahl sorgen für zusätzliche Stabilität an der Oberfläche und unter Wasser. Die Blase besteht aus höchst robustem EndurTex Nylon, ist äußerst leicht und langlebig, und verfügt über eine großzügige Auftriebskapazität. Bei Beschädigung können diverse Komponenten des Hydros X separat ausgetauscht werden. Das schnell lösbare, integrierte Gewichtssystem mit flachen Schnallen und Trimmtaschen am Rücken ergänzt sich optimal, und sorgt für einen bequemen und perfekt austarierten Tauchgang. Die zwei großen Cargo Taschen mit Reißverschluss bieten viel Stauraum und sind selbst bei voll beladenen Gewichtstaschen leicht zugänglich. An zwei D-Ringen aus Edelstahl kann zusätzliche Ausrüstung angebracht werden. Darüber hinaus verfügt das Hydros X über eine Multi-Mount-Zubehörmatrix mit mehreren D-Ringen und Montagepunkten, an denen zahlreiches Tauchzubehör einfach befestigt werden kann. Hydros X Tarierjacket, Damen

Variant.title: Hydros X Equilibratore, con Alimentatore BPI, Donna, L
Variant.description: Hydros X è un equilibratore regolabile frontale in grado di offrire spallacci e schienalino fatti completamente in termoplastica Monprene® stampati ad iniezione. Questa caratteristica esclusiva consente di personalizzare gli spallacci a seconda del tuo fisico, come cuciti su misura, garantendo un comfort di livello superiore. Con l’aggiunta dello schienalino in misura standard e della fascia per bombola Super Cinch in acciaio inossidabile, si può inoltre godere di un’eccellente stabilità sia in superficie che in profondità. La camera d’aria, realizzata in tessuto di nylon ad alta durabilità EndurTex, è estremamente leggera e resistente e offre un’eccellente capacità di spinta, sostenuta dal soffietto inferiore posteriore. In caso di danneggiamento, alcuni dei componenti di Hydros X sono separabili e sostituibili. Il sistema di zavorra integrata a sgancio rapido con fibbia piatta e le tasche contrappeso posteriori contribuiscono a offrire un’immersione più confortevole e bilanciata durante le tue immersioni. Le due grandi tasche porta-accessori con cerniera lampo offrono un’eccellente capacità di stivaggio dell’attrezzatura e sono facilmente accessibili anche quando gli scomparti con zavorra sono a pieno carico. Due anelli a D in acciaio inossidabile offrono comodi punti di aggancio a clip per ulteriore attrezzatura. Inoltre, Hydros X presenta una Matrice per Fissaggio Multiaccessorio con anelli a D e punti di fissaggio multipli per agganciare con facilità diversi accessori per immersioni. | Hydros X Equilibratore, con Alimentatore BPI, Donna, L

Values.Value: BPI (Balanced Power Inflator)~Provides an efficient and reliable way to maintain perfect buoyancy control throughout your dive.

A fresh design incorporating eye-catching silver, blue and white graphics make the Level BCD stand out in any diving crowd. But beyond good looks, this front-adjustable BCD brings together all of the performance and comfort features you’ll need for any recreational diving scenario. The bladder, made of EndurTex high-tenacity 420 nylon fabric, is lightweight yet extremely rugged, and it’s designed to comfortably wrap around your body without squeeze. Rotating quick-release shoulder buckles allow you to optimize the routing of your shoulder straps for comfort, and a sternum strap and adjustable cummerbund with double-pull over-strap make for the perfect fit.

Variant.title: LEVEL Tarierjacket XS MIT BPI
Variant.description: Ein frisches Design mit silbernen, blauen und weißen Grafiken, machen das Level Jacket zu einem echten Hingucker. Nicht nur das Design, sondern auch die Leistung und der Komfort, den du dir beim Tauchen wünschst, sind bei diesem ADV-Jacket gegeben. Die Blase aus strapazierfähigem EndurTex 420-Nylon ist leicht und dennoch robust, und so konzipiert, dass sie sich perfekt dem Körper anpasst. Die drehbaren Schnellverschluss-Schulterschnallen ermöglichen optimalen Komfort. Der Brustgurt und ein verstellbarer Kummerbund mit doppeltem überziehgurt sorgen für eine perfekte Passform. LEVEL Tarierjacket XS MIT BPI
Variant.product_type: Home DE,Tarierjackets,LEVEL Tarierjacket XS MIT BPI

Variant.title: LEVEL Equilibratore XS, con BPI
Variant.description: Un design rinnovato dotato di serigrafie accattivanti argentate, blu e bianche, rendono il Level immediatamente riconoscibile. Ma oltre ad essere bello, questo equilibratore regolabile frontalmente riunisce tutte le caratteristiche di prestazioni e comfort di cui hai bisogno per qualsiasi scenario di immersione ricreativa. Leggero ma estremamente resistente (la camera d’aria è realizzata in tessuto di nylon 420 ad alta durabilità EndurTex), la sua vera peculiarità è il comfort. Le fibbie ruotanti a rilascio rapido a livello delle spalle ti consentono di ottimizzare il posizionamento degli strap sulle spalle per un migliore comfort, mentre uno strap a livello dello sterno e un fascione regolabile con doppio strap migliorano ulteriormente la vestibilità. | LEVEL Equilibratore XS, con BPI

MultiValue.Value: Lightweight design folds easily & compactly into your included travel bag
Wraparound bladder made of durable Nylon 210 denier fabric with a polyurethane layer & RF soldering for maximum wear resistance
Rotating quick-release shoulder buckles allow you to optimize the routing of your shoulder straps to maximize comfort & fit
Patented Quick Cinch tank buckle requires minimal effort to buckle & easily adjusts to fit any tank. Additional upper band helps secure the tank for maximum stability at depth.
Quick release integrated weight pouches ditch easily & secure with low profile buckles
Airnet padded backpack is water-draining, easy to fold, and enhances comfort during long dives
Two large low profile zippered pockets, one fitted with stainless steel knife attachment grommets, provide lots of cargo-carrying capability
Five aluminum D-rings, including two large, pre-bent D-rings on the shoulder pads, provide convenient clip-on points for additional gear
Two octopus pockets are provided for storing octopus and console hoses.

Values.Value: Go BCD, Quick Cinch, Air2, XS
Air2 (Alternate Inflator Regulator)~Combines a backup Regulator with a BCD's buoyancy control system in one compact, at-the-ready-unit.

A true travel BCD, the GO is lightweight and foldable yet is loaded with features like integrated front weight pockets, two huge quick-draining cargo pockets, two octo pockets and SCUBAPRO’s user-friendly Quick Cinch tank buckle system. This innovative, patented tank strap assembly adjusts easily and will fit any tank size in case you find yourself renting different tanks at different dive destinations. The air-net ergonomic backpack is lightweight and soft, so it can be easily folded in your travel bag, ready for your next dive adventure.

BPI (Balanced Power Inflator)~Provides an efficient and reliable way to maintain perfect buoyancy control throughout your dive.

The Bella is designed and tailored for female divers who prefer the comfort and security of a full-featured, front-adjustable BCD. This makes for a comfortable and secure ride while cruising the depths.

MultiValue.Value: Perfect for recreational travel divers who prefer back-flotation and enjoy color-customizing their dive gear.
Unique air cell covers come in three standard colors installed on the BCD (Black, Blue, and Coral), and three additional accessory colors (Navy Blue Camo, Army Green, and White).
Soft backpack is foldable for easy packing and convenient storage.
Modular design is fully adjustable and allows for the easy replacement of back padding, cummerbund, shoulder straps, tank cinches, air cell and pockets in case of damage or wear.
Air cell is made of durable 420D nylon with high frequency welds and generous lift capacity, with three flat bungee straps to maintain a streamlined profile.

Cummerbund features two detachable pockets, each with two soft D-rings. Pockets can be placed with the opening facing upwards (for carrying accessories) or downwards (providing quick-releasing ballast).
Quick Cinch tank buckle is teamed with a 50mm hook & loop tank strap for stabilization. Two rubber inserts guarantee optimal tank retention in all conditions.
Ergonomic shoulder pads and cummerbunds come in two expandable sizes, XXS to M and M to XXL, with a bit of overlapping to ensure a snug fit.
Available with either a BPI or AIR2.

Values.Value: Navigator Lite BCD, w/ BPI, Blue, M-XXL
BPI (Balanced Power Inflator)~Provides an efficient and reliable way to maintain perfect buoyancy control throughout your dive.

The Navigator Lite, SCUBAPRO’s new lightweight, back inflation BCD is perfect for the recreational travel diver who prefers black-flotation in a simple, yet durable form with the added benefit of showing off interesting color combinations. The Navigator Lite is built around a soft PU-coated backpack that helps it dry quickly and is durable, foldable, and travel-friendly. The Navigator Lite also offers a new feature that no other SCUBAPRO BCD has - replaceable air cell covers that come in a choice of six color options for color-customizing your dive gear. It is required that an authorized SCUBAPRO technician install the air cell covers. The BCD comes with an easy-adjust Quick Cinch tank buckle system that’s teamed with a 50mm hook & loop tank strap. Together they deliver rock-solid tank stabilization in all dive conditions. The cummerbund features two detachable pockets, each with two soft D-rings. These pockets can be either placed with the opening facing upwards for carrying accessories or downwards to provide quick-release ballast. The Navigator Lite comes in two expandable sizes, XXS to M and M to XXL, with a bit of overlapping so you can be sure to find the perfect fit for your next dive travel adventure.

Variant.title: Navigator Lite Tarierjacket M-2XL Blau Mit BPI
Variant.description: Das Navigator Lite ist das neue leichte Wing-Jacket von SCUBAPRO. Es ist perfekt für Sporttaucher, die ein einfaches aber robustes back-inflation Jacket bevorzugen und Interesse an wechselnden Farbkombinationen haben. Das Navigator Lite verfügt über einen Airnet® Softrucksack, wodurch es gut zu falten und damit sehr reisefreundlich ist. Das Navigator Lite bietet außerdem ein neues Feature, das kein anderes SCUBAPRO BCD hat: Die austauschbaren Luftblasenhüllen, die in sechs verschiedenen Farben erhältlich sind, damit die Tauchausrüstung farblich individuell gestaltet werden kann (austauschbar durch einen zertifizierten SCUBAPRO Techniker). Das Jacket ist mit dem einfach einstellbaren Quick-Cinch-Flaschengurt-System und zusätzlich einem 50-mm-Klett-Flaschengurt ausgestattet. Zusammen sorgen sie für eine stabile Befestigung der Flasche unter allen Tauchbedingungen. Der Kummerbund verfügt über zwei abnehmbare Taschen mit jeweils zwei weichen D-Ringen. Diese Taschen können entweder mit der öffnung nach oben für den Transport von Zubehör oder nach unten für schnell abwerfbare Gewichte angebracht werden. Das Navigator Lite ist in zwei Größen erhältlich, 2XS bis M und M bis 2XL, die sich leicht überschneiden, so dass du sicher sein kannst, die perfekte Passform für dein nächstes Tauchreiseabenteuer zu finden. Navigator Lite Tarierjacket M-2XL Blau Mit BPI
Variant.product_type: Home DE,Tarierjackets,Navigator Lite Tarierjacket M-2XL Blau Mit BPI

Variant.title: Equilibratore Navigator Lite con BPI, Blu, M-2XL
Variant.description: Navigator Lite è il nuovo equilibratore di SCUBAPRO: leggero, è il Gav perfetto per i sub amatoriali alla ricerca di un equipaggiamento ad assetto posteriore facile da trasportare, essenziale ma allo stesso tempo robusto e - perché no? - accattivante nei colori. La struttura di base del nuovo Navigator Lite è costituita da uno schienalino morbido Airnet®, che lo rende leggero, pieghevole e quindi perfetto per i viaggi. Navigator Lite offre infatti una nuova caratteristica, di cui nessun altro equilibratore SCUBAPRO è dotato: la possibilità di sostituire il rivestimento della cella d'aria, che è disponibile in sei colori a scelta per personalizzare la propria attrezzatura da immersione. Tale rivestimento deve essere installato da un tecnico autorizzato SCUBAPRO. L'equilibratore è dotato del sistema di fibbie di ancoraggio delle bombole Quick Cinch, a cui si collega una fascia di ritenzione per le bombole di tipo hook & loop da 50 mm. Grazie a questo sistema, le bombole rimangono estremamente stabili in tutte le condizioni di immersione. Il fascione ventrale è dotato di due tasche rimovibili con due anelli morbidi di tipo D-ring ciascuna. Tali tasche possono essere posizionate con l'apertura verso l'alto, per trasportare accessori, o verso il basso, per disporre della zavorra a sgancio rapido. | Equilibratore Navigator Lite con BPI, Blu, M-2XL
Variant.google_product_category: Sporting Goods > Outdoor Recreation > Boating & Water Sports > Diving & Snorkeling > Buoyancy Compensators

Variant.title: Navigator Lite Tarierjacket 2XS-M Coral Mit BPI
Variant.description: Das Navigator Lite ist das neue leichte Wing-Jacket von SCUBAPRO. Es ist perfekt für Sporttaucher, die ein einfaches aber robustes back-inflation Jacket bevorzugen und Interesse an wechselnden Farbkombinationen haben. Das Navigator Lite verfügt über einen Airnet® Softrucksack, wodurch es gut zu falten und damit sehr reisefreundlich ist. Das Navigator Lite bietet außerdem ein neues Feature, das kein anderes SCUBAPRO BCD hat: Die austauschbaren Luftblasenhüllen, die in sechs verschiedenen Farben erhältlich sind, damit die Tauchausrüstung farblich individuell gestaltet werden kann (austauschbar durch einen zertifizierten SCUBAPRO Techniker). Das Jacket ist mit dem einfach einstellbaren Quick-Cinch-Flaschengurt-System und zusätzlich einem 50-mm-Klett-Flaschengurt ausgestattet. Zusammen sorgen sie für eine stabile Befestigung der Flasche unter allen Tauchbedingungen. Der Kummerbund verfügt über zwei abnehmbare Taschen mit jeweils zwei weichen D-Ringen. Diese Taschen können entweder mit der öffnung nach oben für den Transport von Zubehör oder nach unten für schnell abwerfbare Gewichte angebracht werden. Das Navigator Lite ist in zwei Größen erhältlich, 2XS bis M und M bis 2XL, die sich leicht überschneiden, so dass du sicher sein kannst, die perfekte Passform für dein nächstes Tauchreiseabenteuer zu finden. Navigator Lite Tarierjacket 2XS-M Coral Mit BPI

Variant.title: Equilibratore Navigator Lite con BPI, Corallo, 2XS-M
Variant.description: Navigator Lite è il nuovo equilibratore di SCUBAPRO: leggero, è il Gav perfetto per i sub amatoriali alla ricerca di un equipaggiamento ad assetto posteriore facile da trasportare, essenziale ma allo stesso tempo robusto e - perché no? - accattivante nei colori. La struttura di base del nuovo Navigator Lite è costituita da uno schienalino morbido Airnet®, che lo rende leggero, pieghevole e quindi perfetto per i viaggi. Navigator Lite offre infatti una nuova caratteristica, di cui nessun altro equilibratore SCUBAPRO è dotato: la possibilità di sostituire il rivestimento della cella d'aria, che è disponibile in sei colori a scelta per personalizzare la propria attrezzatura da immersione. Tale rivestimento deve essere installato da un tecnico autorizzato SCUBAPRO. L'equilibratore è dotato del sistema di fibbie di ancoraggio delle bombole Quick Cinch, a cui si collega una fascia di ritenzione per le bombole di tipo hook & loop da 50 mm. Grazie a questo sistema, le bombole rimangono estremamente stabili in tutte le condizioni di immersione. Il fascione ventrale è dotato di due tasche rimovibili con due anelli morbidi di tipo D-ring ciascuna. Tali tasche possono essere posizionate con l'apertura verso l'alto, per trasportare accessori, o verso il basso, per disporre della zavorra a sgancio rapido. | Equilibratore Navigator Lite con BPI, Corallo, 2XS-M

MultiValue.Value: Weight pockets slide and lock in via a monorail system for easy single-handed operation. Simply pull the grey D-handle to release. Comes with Standard size weight pockets, Mini size available separately.
The heavy-duty quick dry bladder’s Instant Dry Technology enables the BCD to dry almost instantly, making it ideal for travel due to less water retention and lower post-dive weight.

Built to last with a fabric-free Monprene® gel harness and double-coated fabric bladder designed to resist abrasion and fading from pool chemicals, saltwater and sunlight. Anti-abrasion Cordura® fabric on the dorsal weight-wing adds further protection against abrasions.
Lightweight Ergo-Lite back plate is 25% lighter than the Hydros Pro’s back plate and provides a body-contoured shape, soft padding, and dual top/bottom handles for easy two-handed loading.

Body-contoured shape and 3D ergonomic design hug the body for a weightless feel. Torso flex zone automatically adjusts to your torso length for excellent comfort and freedom of movement. Unrestricted internal air-flow design reduces air trapping so you enjoy greater maneuverability and can easily deflate the BCD from any angle or position.

Super Cinch 2 tank band is simple, ultra-durable, and incredibly easy to use and adjust. Enables fast and easy tank switches whether you’re swapping out tanks between dives or switching between aluminum 80s and steel tanks when traveling.
Smart-Pack design enables the shoulder and waist straps to be folded flat against the backpack and wrapped in the wing for easy transport and storage.
Shoulder strap hinges lock in the open position for easy donning and then fold flat to allow the Hydros Pro 2 to pack up small for travel.
Body grip gel helps the BCD grip to your body, preventing shifting and riding up during the dive.
Tri-bungee retraction system with 2-stage inflation allows for a more streamlined and compact air-cell underwater, providing an even air distribution and higher lift capacity at the surface.
Near-zero inherent buoyancy means less lead and better control underwater.
Weight pockets are self-draining for an easy, hassle-free experience. Standard size holds up to 10 lbs per pocket.
With the BC-4-Life Modular Design, components are fully customizable and interchangeable, simplifying the repair process and extending the BCD’s lifespan.

Multi-Mount System on the BCD includes multiple D-rings and mounting points to easily configure your BCD. Optional Multi-Mount Accessory Plates and Hydros Bungee Sets sold separately to easily attach knives, lights, pockets, SMBs, hoses and more.
Stays in Place During the Dive

The heavy-duty quick dry bladder’s Instant Dry Technology enables the BCD to dry almost instantly, making it ideal for travel due to less water retention and lower post-dive weight.

Built to last with a fabric-free Monprene® gel harness and double-coated fabric bladder designed to resist abrasion and fading from pool chemicals, saltwater and sunlight. Anti-abrasion Cordura® fabric on the dorsal weight-wing adds further protection against abrasions.
Lightweight Ergo-Lite back plate is 25% lighter than the Hydros Pro’s back plate and provides a body-contoured shape, soft padding, and dual top/bottom handles for easy two-handed loading.

Body-contoured shape and 3D ergonomic design hug the body for a weightless feel. Torso flex zone automatically adjusts to your torso length for excellent comfort and freedom of movement. Unrestricted internal air-flow design reduces air trapping so you enjoy greater maneuverability and can easily deflate the BCD from any angle or position.

Super Cinch 2 tank band is simple, ultra-durable, and incredibly easy to use and adjust. Enables fast and easy tank switches whether you’re swapping out tanks between dives or switching between aluminum 80s and steel tanks when traveling.
Smart-Pack design enables the shoulder and waist straps to be folded flat against the backpack and wrapped in the wing for easy transport and storage.
Shoulder strap hinges lock in the open position for easy donning and then fold flat to allow the Hydros Pro 2 to pack up small for travel.
Body grip gel helps the BCD grip to your body, preventing shifting and riding up during the dive.
Tri-bungee retraction system with 2-stage inflation allows for a more streamlined and compact air-cell underwater, providing an even air distribution and higher lift capacity at the surface.
Near-zero inherent buoyancy means less lead and better control underwater.
Weight pockets are self-draining for an easy, hassle-free experience. Standard size holds up to 10 lbs per pocket.
With the BC-4-Life Modular Design, components are fully customizable and interchangeable, simplifying the repair process and extending the BCD’s lifespan.

Multi-Mount System on the BCD includes multiple D-rings and mounting points to easily configure your BCD. Optional Multi-Mount Accessory Plates and Hydros Bungee Sets sold separately to easily attach knives, lights, pockets, SMBs, hoses and more.

MultiValue.Value: Weight pockets slide and lock in via a monorail system for easy single-handed operation. Simply pull the grey D-handle to release. Comes with Standard size weight pockets, Mini size available separately.
The heavy-duty quick dry bladder’s Instant Dry Technology enables the BCD to dry almost instantly, making it ideal for travel due to less water retention and lower post-dive weight.

Built to last with a fabric-free Monprene® gel harness and double-coated fabric bladder designed to resist abrasion and fading from pool chemicals, saltwater and sunlight. Anti-abrasion Cordura® fabric on the dorsal weight-wing adds further protection against abrasions.
Lightweight Ergo-Lite back plate is 25% lighter than the Hydros Pro’s back plate and provides a body-contoured shape, soft padding, and dual top/bottom handles for easy two-handed loading.

Body-contoured shape and 3D ergonomic design hug the body for a weightless feel. Torso flex zone automatically adjusts to your torso length for excellent comfort and freedom of movement. Unrestricted internal air-flow design reduces air trapping so you enjoy greater maneuverability and can easily deflate the BCD from any angle or position.

Super Cinch 2 tank band is simple, ultra-durable, and incredibly easy to use and adjust. Enables fast and easy tank switches whether you’re swapping out tanks between dives or switching between aluminum 80s and steel tanks when traveling.
Smart-Pack design enables the shoulder and waist straps to be folded flat against the backpack and wrapped in the wing for easy transport and storage.
Shoulder strap hinges lock in the open position for easy donning and then fold flat to allow the Hydros Pro 2 to pack up small for travel.
Body grip gel helps the BCD grip to your body, preventing shifting and riding up during the dive.
Tri-bungee retraction system with 2-stage inflation allows for a more streamlined and compact air-cell underwater, providing an even air distribution and higher lift capacity at the surface.
Near-zero inherent buoyancy means less lead and better control underwater.
Weight pockets are self-draining for an easy, hassle-free experience. Standard size holds up to 10 lbs per pocket.
With the BC-4-Life Modular Design, components are fully customizable and interchangeable, simplifying the repair process and extending the BCD’s lifespan.

Multi-Mount System on the BCD includes multiple D-rings and mounting points to easily configure your BCD. Optional Multi-Mount Accessory Plates and Hydros Bungee Sets sold separately to easily attach knives, lights, pockets, SMBs, hoses and more.
Stays in Place During the Dive

MultiValue.Value: Weight pockets slide and lock in via a monorail system for easy single-handed operation. Simply pull the grey D-handle to release. Comes with Standard size weight pockets, Mini size available separately.
The heavy-duty quick dry bladder’s Instant Dry Technology enables the BCD to dry almost instantly, making it ideal for travel due to less water retention and lower post-dive weight.

Built to last with a fabric-free Monprene® gel harness and double-coated fabric bladder designed to resist abrasion and fading from pool chemicals, saltwater and sunlight. Anti-abrasion Cordura® fabric on the dorsal weight-wing adds further protection against abrasions.
Lightweight Ergo-Lite back plate is 25% lighter than the Hydros Pro’s back plate and provides a body-contoured shape, soft padding, and dual top/bottom handles for easy two-handed loading.

Body-contoured shape and 3D ergonomic design hug the body for a weightless feel. Torso flex zone automatically adjusts to your torso length for excellent comfort and freedom of movement. Unrestricted internal air-flow design reduces air trapping so you enjoy greater maneuverability and can easily deflate the BCD from any angle or position.

Super Cinch 2 tank band is simple, ultra-durable, and incredibly easy to use and adjust. Enables fast and easy tank switches whether you’re swapping out tanks between dives or switching between aluminum 80s and steel tanks when traveling.
Smart-Pack design enables the shoulder and waist straps to be folded flat against the backpack and wrapped in the wing for easy transport and storage.
Shoulder strap hinges lock in the open position for easy donning and then fold flat to allow the Hydros Pro 2 to pack up small for travel.
Body grip gel helps the BCD grip to your body, preventing shifting and riding up during the dive.
Tri-bungee retraction system with 2-stage inflation allows for a more streamlined and compact air-cell underwater, providing an even air distribution and higher lift capacity at the surface.
Near-zero inherent buoyancy means less lead and better control underwater.
Weight pockets are self-draining for an easy, hassle-free experience. Standard size holds up to 10 lbs per pocket.
With the BC-4-Life Modular Design, components are fully customizable and interchangeable, simplifying the repair process and extending the BCD’s lifespan.

Multi-Mount System on the BCD includes multiple D-rings and mounting points to easily configure your BCD. Optional Multi-Mount Accessory Plates and Hydros Bungee Sets sold separately to easily attach knives, lights, pockets, SMBs, hoses and more.
Stays in Place During the Dive

MultiValue.Value: Weight pockets slide and lock in via a monorail system for easy single-handed operation. Simply pull the grey D-handle to release. Comes with Standard size weight pockets, Mini size available separately.
The heavy-duty quick dry bladder’s Instant Dry Technology enables the BCD to dry almost instantly, making it ideal for travel due to less water retention and lower post-dive weight.

Built to last with a fabric-free Monprene® gel harness and double-coated fabric bladder designed to resist abrasion and fading from pool chemicals, saltwater and sunlight. Anti-abrasion Cordura® fabric on the dorsal weight-wing adds further protection against abrasions.
Lightweight Ergo-Lite back plate is 25% lighter than the Hydros Pro’s back plate and provides a body-contoured shape, soft padding, and dual top/bottom handles for easy two-handed loading.

Body-contoured shape and 3D ergonomic design hug the body for a weightless feel. Torso flex zone automatically adjusts to your torso length for excellent comfort and freedom of movement. Unrestricted internal air-flow design reduces air trapping so you enjoy greater maneuverability and can easily deflate the BCD from any angle or position.

Super Cinch 2 tank band is simple, ultra-durable, and incredibly easy to use and adjust. Enables fast and easy tank switches whether you’re swapping out tanks between dives or switching between aluminum 80s and steel tanks when traveling.
Smart-Pack design enables the shoulder and waist straps to be folded flat against the backpack and wrapped in the wing for easy transport and storage.
Shoulder strap hinges lock in the open position for easy donning and then fold flat to allow the Hydros Pro 2 to pack up small for travel.
Body grip gel helps the BCD grip to your body, preventing shifting and riding up during the dive.
Tri-bungee retraction system with 2-stage inflation allows for a more streamlined and compact air-cell underwater, providing an even air distribution and higher lift capacity at the surface.
Near-zero inherent buoyancy means less lead and better control underwater.
Weight pockets are self-draining for an easy, hassle-free experience. Standard size holds up to 10 lbs per pocket.
With the BC-4-Life Modular Design, components are fully customizable and interchangeable, simplifying the repair process and extending the BCD’s lifespan.

Multi-Mount System on the BCD includes multiple D-rings and mounting points to easily configure your BCD. Optional Multi-Mount Accessory Plates and Hydros Bungee Sets sold separately to easily attach knives, lights, pockets, SMBs, hoses and more.
Stays in Place During the Dive

Super Cinch 2 tank band is simple, ultra-durable, and incredibly easy to use and adjust. Enables fast and easy tank switches whether you’re swapping out tanks between dives or switching between aluminum 80s and steel tanks when traveling.
Smart-Pack design enables the shoulder and waist straps to be folded flat against the backpack and wrapped in the wing for easy transport and storage.
Shoulder strap hinges lock in the open position for easy donning and then fold flat to allow the Hydros Pro 2 to pack up small for travel.
Body grip gel helps the BCD grip to your body, preventing shifting and riding up during the dive.
Tri-bungee retraction system with 2-stage inflation allows for a more streamlined and compact air-cell underwater, providing an even air distribution and higher lift capacity at the surface.
Near-zero inherent buoyancy means less lead and better control underwater.
Weight pockets are self-draining for an easy, hassle-free experience. Standard size holds up to 10 lbs per pocket.
With the BC-4-Life Modular Design, components are fully customizable and interchangeable, simplifying the repair process and extending the BCD’s lifespan.

Multi-Mount System on the BCD includes multiple D-rings and mounting points to easily configure your BCD. Optional Multi-Mount Accessory Plates and Hydros Bungee Sets sold separately to easily attach knives, lights, pockets, SMBs, hoses and more.

The heavy-duty quick dry bladder’s Instant Dry Technology enables the BCD to dry almost instantly, making it ideal for travel due to less water retention and lower post-dive weight.

Built to last with a fabric-free Monprene® gel harness and double-coated fabric bladder designed to resist abrasion and fading from pool chemicals, saltwater and sunlight. Anti-abrasion Cordura® fabric on the dorsal weight-wing adds further protection against abrasions.
Lightweight Ergo-Lite back plate is 25% lighter than the Hydros Pro’s back plate and provides a body-contoured shape, soft padding, and dual top/bottom handles for easy two-handed loading.

Body-contoured shape and 3D ergonomic design hug the body for a weightless feel. Torso flex zone automatically adjusts to your torso length for excellent comfort and freedom of movement. Unrestricted internal air-flow design reduces air trapping so you enjoy greater maneuverability and can easily deflate the BCD from any angle or position.

Super Cinch 2 tank band is simple, ultra-durable, and incredibly easy to use and adjust. Enables fast and easy tank switches whether you’re swapping out tanks between dives or switching between aluminum 80s and steel tanks when traveling.
Smart-Pack design enables the shoulder and waist straps to be folded flat against the backpack and wrapped in the wing for easy transport and storage.
Shoulder strap hinges lock in the open position for easy donning and then fold flat to allow the Hydros Pro 2 to pack up small for travel.
Body grip gel helps the BCD grip to your body, preventing shifting and riding up during the dive.
Tri-bungee retraction system with 2-stage inflation allows for a more streamlined and compact air-cell underwater, providing an even air distribution and higher lift capacity at the surface.
Near-zero inherent buoyancy means less lead and better control underwater.
Weight pockets are self-draining for an easy, hassle-free experience. Standard size holds up to 10 lbs per pocket.
With the BC-4-Life Modular Design, components are fully customizable and interchangeable, simplifying the repair process and extending the BCD’s lifespan.

The heavy-duty quick dry bladder’s Instant Dry Technology enables the BCD to dry almost instantly, making it ideal for travel due to less water retention and lower post-dive weight.

Built to last with a fabric-free Monprene® gel harness and double-coated fabric bladder designed to resist abrasion and fading from pool chemicals, saltwater and sunlight. Anti-abrasion Cordura® fabric on the dorsal weight-wing adds further protection against abrasions.
Lightweight Ergo-Lite back plate is 25% lighter than the Hydros Pro’s back plate and provides a body-contoured shape, soft padding, and dual top/bottom handles for easy two-handed loading.

Body-contoured shape and 3D ergonomic design hug the body for a weightless feel. Torso flex zone automatically adjusts to your torso length for excellent comfort and freedom of movement. Unrestricted internal air-flow design reduces air trapping so you enjoy greater maneuverability and can easily deflate the BCD from any angle or position.

Super Cinch 2 tank band is simple, ultra-durable, and incredibly easy to use and adjust. Enables fast and easy tank switches whether you’re swapping out tanks between dives or switching between aluminum 80s and steel tanks when traveling.
Smart-Pack design enables the shoulder and waist straps to be folded flat against the backpack and wrapped in the wing for easy transport and storage.
Shoulder strap hinges lock in the open position for easy donning and then fold flat to allow the Hydros Pro 2 to pack up small for travel.
Body grip gel helps the BCD grip to your body, preventing shifting and riding up during the dive.
Tri-bungee retraction system with 2-stage inflation allows for a more streamlined and compact air-cell underwater, providing an even air distribution and higher lift capacity at the surface.
Near-zero inherent buoyancy means less lead and better control underwater.
Weight pockets are self-draining for an easy, hassle-free experience. Standard size holds up to 10 lbs per pocket.
With the BC-4-Life Modular Design, components are fully customizable and interchangeable, simplifying the repair process and extending the BCD’s lifespan.

Multi-Mount System on the BCD includes multiple D-rings and mounting points to easily configure your BCD. Optional Multi-Mount Accessory Plates and Hydros Bungee Sets sold separately to easily attach knives, lights, pockets, SMBs, hoses and more.

MultiValue.Value: Weight pockets slide and lock in via a monorail system for easy single-handed operation. Simply pull the grey D-handle to release. Comes with Standard size weight pockets, Mini size available separately.
The heavy-duty quick dry bladder’s Instant Dry Technology enables the BCD to dry almost instantly, making it ideal for travel due to less water retention and lower post-dive weight.

Built to last with a fabric-free Monprene® gel harness and double-coated fabric bladder designed to resist abrasion and fading from pool chemicals, saltwater and sunlight. Anti-abrasion Cordura® fabric on the dorsal weight-wing adds further protection against abrasions.
Lightweight Ergo-Lite back plate is 25% lighter than the Hydros Pro’s back plate and provides a body-contoured shape, soft padding, and dual top/bottom handles for easy two-handed loading.

Body-contoured shape and 3D ergonomic design hug the body for a weightless feel. Torso flex zone automatically adjusts to your torso length for excellent comfort and freedom of movement. Unrestricted internal air-flow design reduces air trapping so you enjoy greater maneuverability and can easily deflate the BCD from any angle or position.

Super Cinch 2 tank band is simple, ultra-durable, and incredibly easy to use and adjust. Enables fast and easy tank switches whether you’re swapping out tanks between dives or switching between aluminum 80s and steel tanks when traveling.
Smart-Pack design enables the shoulder and waist straps to be folded flat against the backpack and wrapped in the wing for easy transport and storage.
Shoulder strap hinges lock in the open position for easy donning and then fold flat to allow the Hydros Pro 2 to pack up small for travel.
Body grip gel helps the BCD grip to your body, preventing shifting and riding up during the dive.
Tri-bungee retraction system with 2-stage inflation allows for a more streamlined and compact air-cell underwater, providing an even air distribution and higher lift capacity at the surface.
Near-zero inherent buoyancy means less lead and better control underwater.
Weight pockets are self-draining for an easy, hassle-free experience. Standard size holds up to 10 lbs per pocket.
With the BC-4-Life Modular Design, components are fully customizable and interchangeable, simplifying the repair process and extending the BCD’s lifespan.

Multi-Mount System on the BCD includes multiple D-rings and mounting points to easily configure your BCD. Optional Multi-Mount Accessory Plates and Hydros Bungee Sets sold separately to easily attach knives, lights, pockets, SMBs, hoses and more.
Stays in Place During the Dive

Shoulder strap hinges lock in the open position for easy donning and then fold flat to allow the Hydros Pro 2 to pack up small for travel.
Body grip gel helps the BCD grip to your body, preventing shifting and riding up during the dive.
Tri-bungee retraction system with 2-stage inflation allows for a more streamlined and compact air-cell underwater, providing an even air distribution and higher lift capacity at the surface.
Near-zero inherent buoyancy means less lead and better control underwater.
Weight pockets are self-draining for an easy, hassle-free experience. Standard size holds up to 10 lbs per pocket.
With the BC-4-Life Modular Design, components are fully customizable and interchangeable, simplifying the repair process and extending the BCD’s lifespan.

Multi-Mount System on the BCD includes multiple D-rings and mounting points to easily configure your BCD. Optional Multi-Mount Accessory Plates and Hydros Bungee Sets sold separately to easily attach knives, lights, pockets, SMBs, hoses and more.
Stays in Place During the Dive

MultiValue.Value: Weight pockets slide and lock in via a monorail system for easy single-handed operation. Simply pull the grey D-handle to release. Comes with Standard size weight pockets, Mini size available separately.
The heavy-duty quick dry bladder’s Instant Dry Technology enables the BCD to dry almost instantly, making it ideal for travel due to less water retention and lower post-dive weight.

Built to last with a fabric-free Monprene® gel harness and double-coated fabric bladder designed to resist abrasion and fading from pool chemicals, saltwater and sunlight. Anti-abrasion Cordura® fabric on the dorsal weight-wing adds further protection against abrasions.
Lightweight Ergo-Lite back plate is 25% lighter than the Hydros Pro’s back plate and provides a body-contoured shape, soft padding, and dual top/bottom handles for easy two-handed loading.

Body-contoured shape and 3D ergonomic design hug the body for a weightless feel. Torso flex zone automatically adjusts to your torso length for excellent comfort and freedom of movement. Unrestricted internal air-flow design reduces air trapping so you enjoy greater maneuverability and can easily deflate the BCD from any angle or position.

Super Cinch 2 tank band is simple, ultra-durable, and incredibly easy to use and adjust. Enables fast and easy tank switches whether you’re swapping out tanks between dives or switching between aluminum 80s and steel tanks when traveling.
Smart-Pack design enables the shoulder and waist straps to be folded flat against the backpack and wrapped in the wing for easy transport and storage.
Shoulder strap hinges lock in the open position for easy donning and then fold flat to allow the Hydros Pro 2 to pack up small for travel.
Body grip gel helps the BCD grip to your body, preventing shifting and riding up during the dive.
Tri-bungee retraction system with 2-stage inflation allows for a more streamlined and compact air-cell underwater, providing an even air distribution and higher lift capacity at the surface.
Near-zero inherent buoyancy means less lead and better control underwater.
Weight pockets are self-draining for an easy, hassle-free experience. Standard size holds up to 10 lbs per pocket.
With the BC-4-Life Modular Design, components are fully customizable and interchangeable, simplifying the repair process and extending the BCD’s lifespan.

Multi-Mount System on the BCD includes multiple D-rings and mounting points to easily configure your BCD. Optional Multi-Mount Accessory Plates and Hydros Bungee Sets sold separately to easily attach knives, lights, pockets, SMBs, hoses and more.
Stays in Place During the Dive

MultiValue.Value: Weight pockets slide and lock in via a monorail system for easy single-handed operation. Simply pull the grey D-handle to release. Comes with Standard size weight pockets, Mini size available separately.
The heavy-duty quick dry bladder’s Instant Dry Technology enables the BCD to dry almost instantly, making it ideal for travel due to less water retention and lower post-dive weight.

Built to last with a fabric-free Monprene® gel harness and double-coated fabric bladder designed to resist abrasion and fading from pool chemicals, saltwater and sunlight. Anti-abrasion Cordura® fabric on the dorsal weight-wing adds further protection against abrasions.
Lightweight Ergo-Lite back plate is 25% lighter than the Hydros Pro’s back plate and provides a body-contoured shape, soft padding, and dual top/bottom handles for easy two-handed loading.

Body-contoured shape and 3D ergonomic design hug the body for a weightless feel. Torso flex zone automatically adjusts to your torso length for excellent comfort and freedom of movement. Unrestricted internal air-flow design reduces air trapping so you enjoy greater maneuverability and can easily deflate the BCD from any angle or position.

Super Cinch 2 tank band is simple, ultra-durable, and incredibly easy to use and adjust. Enables fast and easy tank switches whether you’re swapping out tanks between dives or switching between aluminum 80s and steel tanks when traveling.
Smart-Pack design enables the shoulder and waist straps to be folded flat against the backpack and wrapped in the wing for easy transport and storage.
Shoulder strap hinges lock in the open position for easy donning and then fold flat to allow the Hydros Pro 2 to pack up small for travel.
Body grip gel helps the BCD grip to your body, preventing shifting and riding up during the dive.
Tri-bungee retraction system with 2-stage inflation allows for a more streamlined and compact air-cell underwater, providing an even air distribution and higher lift capacity at the surface.
Near-zero inherent buoyancy means less lead and better control underwater.
Weight pockets are self-draining for an easy, hassle-free experience. Standard size holds up to 10 lbs per pocket.
With the BC-4-Life Modular Design, components are fully customizable and interchangeable, simplifying the repair process and extending the BCD’s lifespan.

Multi-Mount System on the BCD includes multiple D-rings and mounting points to easily configure your BCD. Optional Multi-Mount Accessory Plates and Hydros Bungee Sets sold separately to easily attach knives, lights, pockets, SMBs, hoses and more.
Stays in Place During the Dive

MultiValue.Value: Weight pockets slide and lock in via a monorail system for easy single-handed operation. Simply pull the grey D-handle to release. Comes with Standard size weight pockets, Mini size available separately.
The heavy-duty quick dry bladder’s Instant Dry Technology enables the BCD to dry almost instantly, making it ideal for travel due to less water retention and lower post-dive weight.

Built to last with a fabric-free Monprene® gel harness and double-coated fabric bladder designed to resist abrasion and fading from pool chemicals, saltwater and sunlight. Anti-abrasion Cordura® fabric on the dorsal weight-wing adds further protection against abrasions.
Lightweight Ergo-Lite back plate is 25% lighter than the Hydros Pro’s back plate and provides a body-contoured shape, soft padding, and dual top/bottom handles for easy two-handed loading.

Body-contoured shape and 3D ergonomic design hug the body for a weightless feel. Torso flex zone automatically adjusts to your torso length for excellent comfort and freedom of movement. Unrestricted internal air-flow design reduces air trapping so you enjoy greater maneuverability and can easily deflate the BCD from any angle or position.

Super Cinch 2 tank band is simple, ultra-durable, and incredibly easy to use and adjust. Enables fast and easy tank switches whether you’re swapping out tanks between dives or switching between aluminum 80s and steel tanks when traveling.
Smart-Pack design enables the shoulder and waist straps to be folded flat against the backpack and wrapped in the wing for easy transport and storage.
Shoulder strap hinges lock in the open position for easy donning and then fold flat to allow the Hydros Pro 2 to pack up small for travel.
Body grip gel helps the BCD grip to your body, preventing shifting and riding up during the dive.
Tri-bungee retraction system with 2-stage inflation allows for a more streamlined and compact air-cell underwater, providing an even air distribution and higher lift capacity at the surface.
Near-zero inherent buoyancy means less lead and better control underwater.
Weight pockets are self-draining for an easy, hassle-free experience. Standard size holds up to 10 lbs per pocket.
With the BC-4-Life Modular Design, components are fully customizable and interchangeable, simplifying the repair process and extending the BCD’s lifespan.

Multi-Mount System on the BCD includes multiple D-rings and mounting points to easily configure your BCD. Optional Multi-Mount Accessory Plates and Hydros Bungee Sets sold separately to easily attach knives, lights, pockets, SMBs, hoses and more.
Stays in Place During the Dive

Values.Value: The Aladin 100 dive computer keeps things simple so you can focus on what matters: your dive. This wrist unit computer features a large, easy-to-read 2.4-inch matrix display with large data fields displaying Depth, Time, No-Stop Time (NST), and one toggle field, each clearly labeled on the primary dive screen, delivering all of the essential dive data you need in a simple, straightforward format. An intuitive menu interface and two-button controls are designed for divers who want reliable performance without complexity. With more than 300 hours of battery life from a single, user-changeable AA battery, built-in Bluetooth for seamless dive log transfers, and a customizable home screen shortcut, the Aladin 100 was developed to deliver a smooth experience from set up to post-dive logging. Powered by the trusted Predictive Buhlmann ZH-L16 Adaptive Microbubble decompression model, it supports Nitrox up to 50% and reaches depths of 80m/260ft. Whether you’re logging your first open water dive or your hundredth reef exploration, the Aladin 100 is your no-fuss, go-anywhere dive companion.

Variant.title: Aladin 100 Computer Subacqueo
Variant.description: L'Aladin 100 è un computer subacqueo essenziale e senza fronzoli, che ti permetterà di focalizzarti su ciò che conta davvero: l'immersione. Questo computer da polso è facile da leggere, grazie al suo ampio display da 2,4 pollici a matrice di punti, e ai suoi campi dati di grandi dimensioni: Profondità, Durata, Tempo di Non Decompressione (NST), più un ulteriore campo personalizzabile. Tutti i campi sono facilmente accessibili dalla schermata principale, per un accesso semplice e immediato a tutte le informazioni essenziali. Il suo menu intuitivo e i due pulsanti di comando sono studiati per i subacquei che desiderano prestazioni affidabili senza complessità superflue. Con oltre 300 ore di autonomia garantite da una singola batteria AA – sostituibile dall'utente – , Bluetooth integrato per un trasferimento immediato del registro di immersione e un collegamento rapido personalizzabile sulla schermata principale, l'Aladin 100 è stato sviluppato per offrire un'esperienza d'uso fluida, dalla configurazione fino alla compilazione del registro post-immersione. Basato sul collaudato algoritmo predittivo di decompressione Bühlmann ZH-L16 Adaptive Microbubble, supporta miscele Nitrox fino al 50% e permette di scendere fino a 80 m di profondità. Sia che si tratti della tua prima immersione in acque libere o della tua centesima barriera corallina da esplorare, l'Aladin 100, versatile e senza fronzoli, è il compagno di immersione perfetto per la tua prossima avventura, qualunque essa sia. | Aladin 100 Computer Subacqueo

Variant.title: Aladin 100 Tauchcomputer
Variant.description: Der Tauchcomputer Aladin 100 setzt auf eine bewusst einfache Bedienung, damit Du dich ganz auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst: Deinen Tauchgang. Der am Handgelenk getragene Tauchcomputer verfügt über ein großes, leicht ablesbares 2, 4-Zoll-Matrix-Display mit großzügigen Datenfeldern für Tiefe, Zeit, Nullzeit und einem frei konfigurierbarem Anzeigefeld, wobei die einzelnen Anzeigen auf dem Hauptbildschirm klar beschriftet sind. Soerhältst du alle wesentlichen Tauchdaten in einem einfachen, übersichtlichen und leicht verständlichen Format. Die intuitive Menüführung und die Zwei-Tasten-Bedienung sind für Taucher konzipiert, die zuverlässige Leistung ohne Komplexität wünschen. Mit einer Batterielaufzeit von über 300 Stunden durch eine einzige, vom Benutzer austauschbare AA-Batterie, integriertem Bluetooth für die nahtlose übertragung von Tauchlogs und einer anpassbaren Verknüpfung für den Startbildschirm wurde der Aladin 100 entwickelt, um von der Einrichtung bis zur Protokollierung nach dem Tauchgang eine reibungslose Nutzung zu bieten. Basierend auf dem bewährten vorausplanenden Bühlmann ZH-L16 Adaptive Microbubble-Dekompressionsmodell unterstützt er Nitrox bis 50% und ist für Tauchtiefen bis 80m ausgelegt. Ob du deinen ersten Freiwassertauchgang absolvierst oder bereits deine hundertste Rifferkundung unternimmst – der Aladin 100 ist dein unkomplizierter und zuverlässiger Begleiter für Tauchabenteuer überall auf der Welt. MultiValue.Value: 4mm high-density neoprene resists compression so buoyancy variations are reduced at depth. Latex wrist and neck seals are thin yet durable and provide comfortable, watertight seals.
Orange plush interior is comfortable and enhances cold water protection.
Neoprene warm collar covers the latex neck seal to eliminate cold spots and increase comfort.
Shoulder and knee panels cover a lot of area for maximum anti-abrasion protection.

Heavy-duty rear shoulder-to-shoulder BDM metal drysuit zipper is covered by a neoprene overflap for added protection.
Si-Tech balanced side-activated inlet and adjustable outlet valves allow for pinpoint buoyancy control, increasing stability and control at depth.
I-Safe straps on both arms offer secure mounting spots for wrist instruments.
Blue suspender system is easy to see, enhances fit and provides convenient lower suit support between dives.
Handy right-thigh utility pocket with D-ring, bungee and zippered closure provides a secure spot for carrying accessories. A hook is provided on the cargo pocket for attaching a hood.
Includes hood, carry bag, low pressure hose, suspenders, repair kit and owner’s manual.

The premium-plus Exodry offers a unique approach to drysuit design by fusing 4mm high-density neoprene with latex wrist and neck seals. This hybrid design is extremely effective, delivering minimal inherent buoyancy, maximum range of motion and an excellent sealing system. This comfortable suit comes with protective shoulder and knee panels, a plush interior lining, blue-style suspenders and much more. For 2019, updated semi-rigid dive boots feature new soft yet protective soles and include fin strap retainers and Velcro straps to improve fit while preventing air from shifting when diving in the heads-down position. The Exodry is a smart choice for all types of diving and can be used with or without an undersuit.

Variant.title: Exodry Trockentauchanzug, Herren, 4mm, S
Variant.description: Der Exodry 4.0 setzt auf eine Kombination aus 4 mm hoch verdichtetem Neopren und Hals- und Handgelenkmanschetten aus Latex. Dieses hybride Design ist extrem effektiv, denn es bietet einen minimalen Eigenauftrieb, maximale Bewegungsfreiheit und ein hervorragendes Dichtsystem. Zu den Merkmalen gehören Schulter- und Knieschoner, ein weiches Innenfutter, Hosenträger und vieles mehr. Halbsteife Tauchstiefel mit Flossenbandhalterung bieten Klettverschlüsse, um die Passform zu verbessern, und verhindern beim Kopfübertauchen ein Eindringen von Luft in den Fußbereich. Der Exodry 4.0 ist die richtige Wahl für alle Taucharten und kann mit oder ohne Unterzieher getragen werden. Exodry Trockentauchanzug, Herren

Variant.title: Exodry Muta Stagna, Uomo, 4 mm, S
Variant.description: Con un approccio esclusivo al design delle mute stagne, il top di gamma Exodry fonde il neoprene 4 mm ad alta densità con tenute in lattice su polsini e collarino. Tale versione ibrida risulta estremamente efficace, poiché offre galleggiamento intrinseco minimo, massima libertà di movimento e un'eccellente sistema di tenuta stagna. Questa comoda muta è dotata di inserti rinforzati in corrispondenza delle spalle e delle ginocchia, rivestimento interno felpato, eleganti bretelle blu e molto altro ancora. I calzari da immersione semi-rigidi sono stati dotati di suole ancora più morbide ma ugualmente protettive, di ferma pinne a strap e di strap in hook & loop per migliorare la vestibilità e impedire allo stesso tempo la penetrazione dell'aria quando si nuota con la testa verso il basso. Exodry è una scelta brillante per tutti i tipi di immersione e può essere utilizzata con o senza sottomuta. | Exodry Muta Stagna, Uomo, 4 mm, S

Variant.title: Exodry Trockentauchanzug, Herren, 4mm, XL
Variant.description: Der Exodry 4.0 setzt auf eine Kombination aus 4 mm hoch verdichtetem Neopren und Hals- und Handgelenkmanschetten aus Latex. Variant.title: Exodry Muta Stagna, Uomo, 4 mm, XL

MultiValue.Value: Heavy-duty poly/butyl/poly trilaminate design stands up to years of aggressive diving
Trilaminate fabric blend has been independent laboratory tested and certified as fungous and bacterial resistant.
Seams are stitched, glued, and then double waterproof taped for maximum reliability
Front diagonal BDM metal dry zipper keeps water out and makes self-donning easy
Latex wrist and neck seals are durable, comfortable and efficient at blocking water entry
Neoprene neck collar keeps the hood in place, makes it easier to position the hood when wearing gloves, and helps preserve the latex neck seal
Quality Si-Tech valves mounted on stitched and glued pads ensure efficient and trouble-free airflow control.
Attached semi-rigid dive boots feature soft soles that improve their anti-slip capabilities while enabling you to comfortably walk on rough grounds
Boots include hook & loop straps to improve fit while preventing air from travelling to feet. Also included: Heel cap with fins strap retainer
Two large cargo pockets equipped with D-rings, easy-to-see blue bungee, high-security over-flaps and hook & loop closures
I-Safe straps on both arms offer a secure mounting spot for wrist instruments
Suspender system enhances fit and provides convenient lower suit support between dives
Hood features an air vent system and a hook for securing to the cargo pocket
Includes hood, carry bag, low pressure hose, repair kit, zipper wax and owners manual
Officially certified as fungus and bacteria resistant since 2018

Values.Value: Definition Dry HD Drysuit, Men, XL

Targeted to advanced divers looking for a quality mid-range fabric drysuit, the Definition Dry is a serious drysuit that’s built to last. It is made with a heavy-duty poly/butyl/poly trilaminate blend plus a stitch-glue-double waterproof taped seam assembly that’s able to withstand the rigors of diving. Though built tough, the Definition Dry is lightweight and offers a number of design features that enable you to achieve a comfortable, streamlined fit.

Variant.title: Definition Dry Heavy-Duty, Herren, XL
Variant.description: Der Definition Dry HD ist ein besonders haltbarer Trockentauchanzug für erfahrene Taucher, die nach einem hochwertigen Textilanzug im mittleren Preissegment suchen. Er ist aus einem neuartigen, strapazierfähigen Poly/Butyl/Poly-Trilaminat gefertigt und verfügt über eine gesteppte, geleimte und doppelt wasserdicht verklebte Nahtkonstruktion, die allen Tauchbedingungen standhält. Trotz seiner Robustheit bietet der Definition Dry HD eine Reihe von Eigenschaften, die für eine bequeme, schlanke Passform sorgen. Der Definition Dry HD wurde 2018 von einem unabhängigen Labor für Textiltests offiziell als pilz- und bakterienresistent zertifiziert. Dies trägt zu einer noch längeren Lebensdauer, sowie zur Minimierung von unangenehmen Gerüchen nach häufigem Einsatz bei. Definition Dry Heavy-Duty, Herren

Variant.title: Definition Dry HD Muta Stagna, Uomo, XL
Variant.description: La Definition Dry, pensata per subacquei esperti interessati a una muta in tessuto di qualità intermedia, è un prodotto di tutto rispetto, destinato a durare nel tempo. Grazie alla combinazione di resistenti tessuti (trilaminato poliestere/butile/poliestere) e alle cuciture incollate non passanti con nastro a doppia tenuta stagna, è un prodotto in grado di resistere alle situazioni di immersione più impegnative. Nonostante la sua robustezza, la muta Definition Dry rimane leggera e presenta numerose caratteristiche che la rendono confortevole e poco ingombrante. | Definition Dry HD Muta Stagna, Uomo, XL

MultiValue.Value: Heavy-duty poly/butyl/poly trilaminate design stands up to years of aggressive diving
Trilaminate fabric blend has been independent laboratory tested and certified as fungous and bacterial resistant.
Seams are stitched, glued, and then double waterproof taped for maximum reliability
Front diagonal BDM metal dry zipper keeps water out and makes self-donning easy
Latex wrist and neck seals are durable, comfortable and efficient at blocking water entry
Neoprene neck collar keeps the hood in place, makes it easier to position the hood when wearing gloves, and helps preserve the latex neck seal
Quality Si-Tech valves mounted on stitched and glued pads ensure efficient and trouble-free airflow control.
Attached semi-rigid dive boots feature soft soles that improve their anti-slip capabilities while enabling you to comfortably walk on rough grounds
Boots include hook & loop straps to improve fit while preventing air from travelling to feet. Also included: Heel cap with fins strap retainer
Two large cargo pockets equipped with D-rings, easy-to-see blue bungee, high-security over-flaps and hook & loop closures
I-Safe straps on both arms offer a secure mounting spot for wrist instruments
Suspender system enhances fit and provides convenient lower suit support between dives
Hood features an air vent system and a hook for securing to the cargo pocket
Includes hood, carry bag, low pressure hose, repair kit, zipper wax and owners manual
Officially certified as fungus and bacteria resistant since 2018

Values.Value: Targeted to advanced divers looking for a quality mid-range fabric drysuit, the Definition Dry is a serious drysuit that’s built to last. It is made with a heavy-duty poly/butyl/poly trilaminate blend plus a stitch-glue-double waterproof taped seam assembly that’s able to withstand the rigors of diving. Though built tough, the Definition Dry is lightweight and offers a number of design features that enable you to achieve a comfortable, streamlined fit.

Variant.title: Definition Dry Heavy-Duty, Herren, 4XL

Trotz seiner Robustheit bietet der Definition Dry HD eine Reihe von Eigenschaften, die für eine bequeme, schlanke Passform sorgen. Der Definition Dry HD wurde 2018 von einem unabhängigen Labor für Textiltests offiziell als pilz- und bakterienresistent zertifiziert. MultiValue.Value: Light grid plush material is breathable, warm and stretchy.
Compatible with both trilaminate and neoprene drysuits.
Pants and long sleeve tops can be worn separately or together.
Elastic wrist loops and heel straps prevent ride-up when pulling on a drysuit.
Both tops and pants are available in seven unisex sizes.

Values.Value: The undergarment of choice for temperate water thermal protection, the K2 Light Undersuit will keep you toasty warm while you’re diving dry. Sporting a modern eye-catching design and patterned after the Everflex 1.5mm line, the undersuit comes in long sleeve tops and pants that you can wear separately when conditions permit, or together for a total thermal insulating system. Both pants and long-sleeve tops are made with a light grid plush material that’s breathable, warm and very stretchy. Elastic wrist loops on the tops and heel straps on the pants enhance fit and prevent ride-up when donning a drysuit.

Variant.title: K2 Light Top, Herren, Schwarz, S
Variant.description: Als idealer Unterzieher für Wärmeschutz in mäßig und warm temperierten Gewässern hält dich der K2 Light beim Trockentauchen mollig warm. Mit seinem modernen und auffälligen Design besteht der Unterzieher aus einem langärmligen Oberteil und Hosen, die du je nach Bedingungen separat oder für einen vollständigen Wärmeschutz kombiniert tragen kannst. Sowohl die Hose als auch das langärmlige Oberteil besteht aus einem leichten Plüschmaterial, das atmungsaktiv, warm und sehr dehnbar ist. Elastische Handgelenkschlaufen am Oberteil und Fersenbänder an den Hosen erhöhen die Passform und verhindern ein Hochrollen beim Anziehen eines Trockentauchanzugs. K2 Light Top, Herren

Variant.title: K2 Sottomuta Leggera, Top, Uomo, S
Variant.description: La sottomuta K2 LIGHT (leggera) è la scelta perfetta per il isolamento termico in acque temperate, mantenendoti caldo e asciutto durante le immersioni. Con un design moderno e accattivante, la sottomuta è composta da top a manica lunga e pantaloni che possono essere indossati separatamente in condizioni più miti, oppure insieme per un sistema di isolamento termico completo. Sia i pantaloni sia i top a manica lunga sono realizzati con un materiale leggero felpato a rete che è traspirante, caldo e particolarmente elastico. I polsini elastici del top e gli strap per i talloni dei pantaloni migliorano la vestibilità e ne evitano la risalita quando si indossa una muta stagna. | K2 Sottomuta Leggera, Top, Uomo, S

Elastische Handgelenkschlaufen am Oberteil und Fersenbänder an den Hosen erhöhen die Passform und verhindern ein Hochrollen beim Anziehen eines Trockentauchanzugs. K2 Light Hose, Herren

15.75 in x 0.79 in | 40 cm x 2 cm

MultiValue.Value: HD Plush material 629g/m2 (+/-5%) is breathable, warm and stretchy.
Compatible with both trilaminate and neoprene drysuits.
Pants and long sleeve tops can be worn separately or together.
Elastic wrist loops and heel straps prevent ride-up when pulling on a drysuit.

Values.Value: K2 Midweight Pant Undergarment, Men, Black, L

The undergarment of choice for cold water thermal protection, the K2 Midweight Undersuit will keep you toasty warm while you’re diving dry. Sporting a modern eye-catching design and patterned after the Everflex 1.5mm line, the K2 Midweight comes in long sleeve tops and pants that you can wear separately when conditions permit, or together for a total thermal insulating system. Both pants and long-sleeve tops are made with a breathable HD plush material that’s warm and very stretchy. Elastic wrist loops on the tops and heel straps on the pants enhance fit and prevent ride-up when donning a drysuit.

Variant.title: K2 Medium Hose, Herren, Schwarz, L
Variant.description: Als idealer Unterzieher für Wärmeschutz in kalten Gewässern hält dich der K2 Medium beim Trockentauchen mollig warm. Mit seinem modernen und auffälligen Design der K2 Medium aus einem langärmligen Oberteil und Hosen, die du je nach Bedingung separat oder für einen vollständigen Wärmeschutz kombiniert tragen kannst. Sowohl die Hose als auch das langärmlige Oberteil besteht aus einem atmungsaktiven HD-Plüschmaterial, das warm und sehr dehnbar ist. Elastische Handgelenkschlaufen am Oberteil und Fersenbänder an den Hosen erhöhen die Passform und verhindern ein Hochrollen beim Anziehen eines Trockentauchanzugs. K2 Medium Hose, Herren

Variant.title: K2 Pantaloni Sottomuta Medium, Uomo, L
Variant.description: La sottomuta K2 Medium è la scelta perfetta per la protezione termica in acque fredde, mantenendoti caldo e asciutto durante le immersioni. Con un design moderno e accattivante, la K2 Medium è composta da top a manica lunga e pantaloni che possono essere indossati separatamente in condizioni più miti, oppure insieme per un sistema di isolamento termico completo. Sia i pantaloni sia i top a manica lunga sono realizzati con un materiale felpato HD che è caldo e particolarmente elastico. I polsini elastici del top e gli strap per i talloni dei pantaloni migliorano la vestibilità e ne evitano la risalita quando si indossa una muta stagna. | K2 Pantaloni Sottomuta Medium, Uomo, L
