Product.Name: K2 EXTREME STMR DSU MN S

Values.Value: 17.5 in x 1 in | 44.45 cm x 2.54 cm

MultiValue.Value: Dual fleece material is breathable and stretchy, delivering maximum thermal protection.
Steamer design includes anti-squeeze protection padding on shoulders, chest and knees.
Storage pockets with zippers are located on both hips.
Elastic wrist loops and heel straps prevent ride-up when pulling on a drysuit.
Convenient front double slider zipper ensures easy donning and doffing.
Holes on legs can be adapted to P valves.

Values.Value: The undergarment of choice for drysuit diving, the K2 Extreme is the ultimate in cold-water thermal protection. Sporting a modern eye-catching design and one-piece steamer styling, this undergarment is patterned after the Everflex 1.5mm line. For maximum thermal protection, the undersuit is made of a breathable and stretchy dual fleece material. It includes compression padding on the shoulders, chest and knees for both comfort and protection. The roomy hip pockets secure with zippers, and elastic wrist loops and heel straps enhance fit and prevent ride-up when donning a drysuit. The K2 Extreme can be counted on to always keep you warm and dry.

Variant.title: K2 Extreme Overall Unterzieher, Herren, S
Variant.description: Der K2 Extreme ist der Unterzieher der Wahl für das Tauchen mit Trockenanzug und somit der ultimative Wärmeschutz in kaltem Wasser. Der Unterzieher besticht durch sein modernes und auffälliges Design und dem einteiligen Steamer-Stil. Er besteht aus einem atmungsaktiven und dehnbaren Doppelfleece für maximalen Wärmeschutz. Dazu besitzt er Kompressionspolster an den Schultern, der Brust und den Knien für zusätzlichen Komfort und Schutz. Die großzügigen Hüfttaschen lassen sich mit einem Reißverschluss sichern, und elastische Handgelenkschlaufen und Fußstege verbessern die Passform und verhindern ein Hochrollen beim Anziehen eines Trockenanzugs. Der K2 Extreme hält dich immer zuverlässig warm und trocken. K2 Extreme Overall Unterzieher, Herren
Variant.product_type: Home DE,Kälteschutz,Trockentauchanzüge,K2 Extreme Overall Unterzieher Herren

Variant.title: K2 Condizioni Estreme Sottomuta Intero, S
Variant.description: La sottomuta K2 Extreme, ideale per le immersioni con muta stagna, è il massimo in termini di isolamento termico in acque fredde. Con un design moderno e accattivante e uno stile tipo steamer a un solo pezzo, per il massimo isolamento termico, la sottomuta è realizzata in doppio pile traspirante ed elastico. È dotata di imbottiture di compressione su spalle, petto e ginocchia per garantire comfort e calore. Le spaziose tasche sui fianchi si chiudono con cerniere e i polsini elastici e gli strap sul tallone migliorano la vestibilità e ne evitano la risalita quando si indossa una muta stagna. Puoi fare affidamento su K2 Extreme per essere sempre caldo e asciutto. | K2 Condizioni Estreme Sottomuta Intero, S

Variant.title: K2 Sottomuta Leggera, Top, Uomo, 3XL
Variant.description: La sottomuta K2 LIGHT (leggera) è la scelta perfetta per il isolamento termico in acque temperate, mantenendoti caldo e asciutto durante le immersioni. Values.Value: The undergarment of choice for drysuit diving, the K2 Extreme is the ultimate in cold-water thermal protection. Sporting a modern eye-catching design and one-piece steamer styling, this undergarment is patterned after the Everflex 1.5mm line. For maximum thermal protection, the undersuit is made of a breathable and stretchy dual fleece material. It includes compression padding on the shoulders, chest and knees for both comfort and protection. The roomy hip pockets secure with zippers, and elastic wrist loops and heel straps enhance fit and prevent ride-up when donning a drysuit. The K2 Extreme can be counted on to always keep you warm and dry.

Variant.title: K2 Extreme Overall Unterzieher, Heren, 3XL
Variant.description: Der K2 Extreme ist der Unterzieher der Wahl für das Tauchen mit Trockenanzug und somit der ultimative Wärmeschutz in kaltem Wasser. Der Unterzieher besticht durch sein modernes und auffälliges Design und dem einteiligen Steamer-Stil. Er besteht aus einem atmungsaktiven und dehnbaren Doppelfleece für maximalen Wärmeschutz. Dazu besitzt er Kompressionspolster an den Schultern, der Brust und den Knien für zusätzlichen Komfort und Schutz. Die großzügigen Hüfttaschen lassen sich mit einem Reißverschluss sichern, und elastische Handgelenkschlaufen und Fußstege verbessern die Passform und verhindern ein Hochrollen beim Anziehen eines Trockenanzugs. Der K2 Extreme hält dich immer zuverlässig warm und trocken. K2 Extreme Overall Unterzieher, Heren, 3XL

Con un design moderno e accattivante, la K2 Medium è composta da top a manica lunga e pantaloni che possono essere indossati separatamente in condizioni più miti, oppure insieme per un sistema di isolamento termico completo. Sia i pantaloni sia i top a manica lunga sono realizzati con un materiale felpato HD che è caldo e particolarmente elastico. I polsini elastici del top e gli strap per i talloni dei pantaloni migliorano la vestibilità e ne evitano la risalita quando si indossa una muta stagna. | K2 Pantaloni Sottomuta Medium, Uomo, 3XL

MultiValue.Value: Heavy-duty poly/butyl/poly trilaminate design stands up to years of aggressive diving
Trilaminate fabric blend has been independent laboratory tested and certified as fungous and bacterial resistant.
Seams are stitched, glued, and then double waterproof taped for maximum reliability
Front diagonal BDM metal dry zipper keeps water out and makes self-donning easy
Latex wrist and neck seals are durable, comfortable and efficient at blocking water entry
Neoprene neck collar keeps the hood in place, makes it easier to position the hood when wearing gloves, and helps preserve the latex neck seal
Quality Si-Tech valves mounted on stitched and glued pads ensure efficient and trouble-free airflow control.
Attached semi-rigid dive boots feature soft soles that improve their anti-slip capabilities while enabling you to comfortably walk on rough grounds
Boots include hook & loop straps to improve fit while preventing air from travelling to feet. Also included: Heel cap with fins strap retainer
Two large cargo pockets equipped with D-rings, easy-to-see blue bungee, high-security over-flaps and hook & loop closures
I-Safe straps on both arms offer a secure mounting spot for wrist instruments
Suspender system enhances fit and provides convenient lower suit support between dives
Hood features an air vent system and a hook for securing to the cargo pocket
Includes hood, carry bag, low pressure hose, repair kit, zipper wax and owners manual
Officially certified as fungus and bacteria resistant since 2018

Values.Value: Targeted to advanced divers looking for a quality mid-range fabric drysuit, the Definition Dry is a serious drysuit that’s built to last. It is made with a heavy-duty poly/butyl/poly trilaminate blend plus a stitch-glue-double waterproof taped seam assembly that’s able to withstand the rigors of diving. Though built tough, the Definition Dry is lightweight and offers a number of design features that enable you to achieve a comfortable, streamlined fit.

Variant.title: Definition Dry Heavy-Duty, Herren, 2XLS
Variant.description: Der Definition Dry HD ist ein besonders haltbarer Trockentauchanzug für erfahrene Taucher, die nach einem hochwertigen Textilanzug im mittleren Preissegment suchen. Er ist aus einem neuartigen, strapazierfähigen Poly/Butyl/Poly-Trilaminat gefertigt und verfügt über eine gesteppte, geleimte und doppelt wasserdicht verklebte Nahtkonstruktion, die allen Tauchbedingungen standhält. Trotz seiner Robustheit bietet der Definition Dry HD eine Reihe von Eigenschaften, die für eine bequeme, schlanke Passform sorgen. Der Definition Dry HD wurde 2018 von einem unabhängigen Labor für Textiltests offiziell als pilz- und bakterienresistent zertifiziert. Dies trägt zu einer noch längeren Lebensdauer, sowie zur Minimierung von unangenehmen Gerüchen nach häufigem Einsatz bei. Definition Dry Heavy-Duty, Herren

Variant.title: Definition Dry HD Muta Stagna, Uomo, 2XLS
Variant.description: La Definition Dry, pensata per subacquei esperti interessati a una muta in tessuto di qualità intermedia, è un prodotto di tutto rispetto, destinato a durare nel tempo. Grazie alla combinazione di resistenti tessuti (trilaminato poliestere/butile/poliestere) e alle cuciture incollate non passanti con nastro a doppia tenuta stagna, è un prodotto in grado di resistere alle situazioni di immersione più impegnative. Nonostante la sua robustezza, la muta Definition Dry rimane leggera e presenta numerose caratteristiche che la rendono confortevole e poco ingombrante. | Definition Dry HD Muta Stagna, Uomo, 2XLS

Included is a separate knitted glove liner for additional warmth.

MultiValue.Value: Heat-taped seams create a totally lightweight and comfortable glove.
Printed palm provides a non-slip surface for maintaining a secure grip.
Palm material is not coarse so will not scratch your face when brushing hair away to make a mask seal.
Ultra-flexible neoprene makes easy work of donning and doffing.

Values.Value: Using heat taping instead of traditional stitching transforms the lightweight SEAMLESS 1.5MM glove into an extremely soft, flexible and tactile hand-warmer. By eliminating the stitching you gain in dexterity in the fingers, making it much easier to push dive computer buttons and handle gear at depth. The printed palm is soft while providing a good non-slip surface for easy gripping.

Variant.title: Seamless Handschuhe, 1.5mm, Schwarz, XS
Variant.description: Durch die Verwendung von Verklebung statt der herkömmlichen Nähte wird der leichte SEAMLESS 1.5MM zu einem extrem weichen, flexiblen, haptischen Handwärmer. Durch den Wegfall der Nähte gewinnst du an Fingerbeweglichkeit und kannst Tauchcomputer und Tauchausrüstung unter Wasser leichter bedienen. Die bedruckte Handfläche ist weich und bietet trotzdem eine rutschfeste Oberfläche für sicheren Griff. Seamless Handschuhe, 1.5mm

Variant.title: Seamless Guanti Subacquei, 1,5 mm, Nero, XS
Variant.description: La nastratura a caldo che sostituisce le cuciture tradizionali trasforma il guanto leggero SEAMLESS 1,5 MM in uno scaldamani estremamente morbido, flessibile e tattile. Eliminando le cuciture si incrementa la mobilità delle dita, rendendo molto più facile premere i pulsanti e gestire l'attrezzatura in profondità. Il palmo stampato è morbido e fornisce allo stesso tempo un'ottima superficie anti-scivolo per una facile presa. | Seamless Guanti Subacquei, 1,5 mm, Nero, XS

Values.Value: The ever-popular Tropic 1.5mm dive glove now features a new eye-pleasing material pattern and comes in colors that match SCUBAPRO’s new UPF Collection. Stylish looks aside, this updated tropical glove still features a 1.5mm neoprene back for comfort and warmth, plus an Amara palm to protect against infection-prone finger cuts when grasping barnacle-encrusted dive ladders in tropical waters.

Variant.title: Tropic Handschuhe, 1.5mm, Schwarz, XS
Variant.description: Der beliebte Tropic 1.5 mit Materialmuster in frischen Farben passt perfekt zur UPF-Kollektion. Das Amara-Material an den Handinnenflächen schützt vor infektionsanfälligen Schnittwunden, z.B. beim Ergreifen von mit Seepocken bewachsenen oder angegriffenen Tauchleitern in tropischen Gewässern. Tropic Handschuhe, 1.5mm

Variant.title: Tropic Guanti Subacquei, 1,5 mm, Nero, XS
Variant.description: Gli intramontabili guanti da immersione Tropic 1,5 mm vantano ora un accattivante design del materiale e sono disponibili nei colori che si abbinano alla collezione UPF di SCUBAPRO. Oltre al loro look, questi guanti tropicali sono caratterizzati da un dorso in neoprene da 1,5 mm, per garantire comfort e calore, e da un palmo Amara per proteggere le dita da possibili tagli e conseguenti infezioni derivanti dall’afferrare scale incrostate da cirripedi. | Tropic Guanti Subacquei, 1,5 mm, Nero, XS

Tropic Handschuhe, 1.5mm

Variant.title: Tropic Guanti Subacquei, 1,5 mm, Aegean, XS

Product.Name: RASH RGD TOP LS AEGE. MN S

Values.Value: UPF 50 Rash Guard, Long Sleeve, Men

MultiValue.Value: Stylish skin protection increases comfort during warm water dives and surface fun.
UPF 50 rating blocks 98% of UV radiation.
High quality polyester offers nice hand feel and provides good color fastness – especially in the lighter colors.
Polyester is comfortable yet durable, abrasion-resistant, and it does a good job of retaining its shape after repeated use.
Form-fitting design wears easily under a wetsuit.
Flattering color panels and cut keep you looking good while enjoying excellent UV protection.
High neck line prevents uncomfortable chafing.
Material dries quickly to enhance comfort between dives.
Pattern is well-suited to digital printing technology.
Highly versatile – ideal for divers, snorkelers, paddle boarders, swimmers and other water enthusiasts too.

Values.Value: UPF 50 Long Sleeve Rash Guard, Men, Aegean, S

With a UPF Collection long sleeve RASH GUARD you can look sharp while enjoying solid sun protection. Designed for diving but perfect for all water sports, these stylish long sleeve RASH GUARDS are made from high quality polyester fabric, are form-fitting, comfortable, and dry quickly. They also provide UPF 50 UV protection, which puts them in the “Excellent” UV protection category. Engineered for performance, wear a long sleeve RASH GUARD under a wetsuit at depth or by itself when topside for dependable protection from the sun’s rays. Long sleeve RASH GUARDS are available in a variety of colors, guaranteed to brighten any day on – or in – the water.

Variant.title: UPF 50 Rashguard Langarm, Herren, Aegean, S
Variant.description: Genieße zuverlässigen Sonnenschutz und sehe dabei stylisch aus. Das UPF 50 Rash Guard ist bequem, weich und schnelltrocknend. Das für Taucher entwickelte Kleidungsstück eignet sich auch perfekt für jede Art von Wassersport, trägt sich bequem unter einem Nassanzug oder einzeln und bietet idealen Schutz vor Sonnenstrahlen. Die langärmeligen Rashguards gibt es in unterschiedlichen Farben und sehen großartig aus – vor, nach und während des Tauchgangs. UPF 50 Rashguard Langarm, Herren

Variant.title: Rash Guard a Manica Lunga UPF 50, Uomo, Aegean, S
Variant.description: Con una T-SHIRT PROTETTIVA a manica lunga della collezione UPF puoi avere un look brillante assicurandoti un’efficace protezione solare. Pensate per le immersioni ma perfette per tutti gli sport d’acqua, queste T-SHIRT PROTETTIVE a manica lunga sono realizzate in tessuto di poliestere di alta qualità, sono sagomate e confortevoli e si asciugano rapidamente. Inoltre, offrono una protezione da raggi ultravioletti (UPF 50), che le pone nella categoria “Eccellente” dei prodotti per la protezione dai raggi ultravioletti. Progettata per eccellere, indossa una T-SHIRT PROTETTIVA a manica lunga sotto una muta umida in profondità o da sola in superficie se desideri una protezione efficace contro i raggi solari. Le T-SHIRT PROTETTIVE a manica lunga sono disponibili in vari colori e illumineranno la tua giornata dentro e fuori dall’acqua. | Rash Guard a Manica Lunga UPF 50, Uomo, Aegean, S

Values.Value: Part of SCUBAPRO’s UPF Collection, the new STEAMER provides head-to-toe protection from stings and skin abrasion while at depth, and from the sun (UPF 50) while on the surface. The stylish STEAMER is made from high quality nylon and is designed to fit snug, creating a sleek profile in the water and a form-fitting look on shore. It features convenient thumb loops and foot stirrups for easy donning and to prevent ride-up when worn under a wetsuit. Used as an under-layer or by itself, the stylish STEAMER protects while ensuring that you always look good. Designed to perform, worn to be different, with the new STEAMER and the entire UPF Collection, seriously high performing dive wear just got a whole lot more fun.

Variant.title: UPF 50 Steamer, Herren, Graphit, M
Variant.description: Der neue STEAMER ist Teil der UPF-Kollektion von SCUBAPRO und bietet von oben bis unten Schutz vor Stichen und Hautabschürfungen sowie der Sonne (UPF 50). Der stilvolle STEAMER besteht aus hochwertigem Nylon und liegt eng an, um ein schlankes Profil im Wasser und einen figurbetonten Look an Land zu schaffen. Für ein einfaches Anziehen besitzt er praktische Daumenschlaufen und Fußstege, die ein Hochrollen beim Tragen unter einem Nasstauchanzug verhindern. Der als Unterzieher oder einzeln tragbare STEAMER schützt, während du gut aussiehst. Designt, um zu schützen – Erleben, um anders zu sein. Mit dem neuen STEAMER und der gesamten UPF-Kollektion macht hochleistungsfähige Tauch- und Wassersportbekleidung jetzt noch mehr Spaß. UPF 50 Steamer, Herren

Variant.title: Steamer UPF 50, Uomo, Graphite, M
Variant.description: Parte della collezione UPF di SCUBAPRO, il nuovo STEAMER offre una protezione completa da punture e abrasioni cutanee in immersione, e dai raggi solari (UPF 50) durante la permanenza in superficie. L'elegante STEAMER è realizzato in nylon di alta qualità e pensato per ottenere l’aderenza desiderata, per un profilo slanciato in acqua e un look aderente a riva. Presenta pratici passanti per i pollici e ghette per i piedi per una facile indossabilità e per evitare che possa risalire quando indossato sotto una muta. Utilizzato da solo o come sottomuta, l’elegante STEAMER protegge senza trascurare l’aspetto estetico. Creati per eccellere, indossati per distinguersi: con il nuovo STEAMER e l’intera collezione UPF, l’abbigliamento per immersioni altamente performante è ancora più divertente. | Steamer UPF 50, Uomo, Graphite, M

Values.Value: Hybrid Thermal Long Sleeve Top, Men, S

SCUBAPRO has updated its popular HYBRID line, which includes a thermal long sleeve top, cargo shorts, and a sleeveless hooded vest. The HYBRID THERMAL LONG SLEEVE TOP features smooth-skin 1mm neoprene in the torso area and high-stretch nylon material on the sides, sleeves and collar. On the underside of the nylon panels a microplush interior makes the top warm and cozy. This fleece fabric absorbs less water, which keeps heat against the body, increasing overall warmth. It also dries quickly.This stylish warmer can be worn by itself or as a thermal under-layer beneath a traditional wetsuit. It can also act as a barrier to the sun's rays when snorkeling or swimming.

Product.Name: RASH GRD TOP LS FLAM. WN XS

Values.Value: UPF 50 Rash Guard, Long Sleeve, Women

MultiValue.Value: Stylish skin protection increases comfort during warm water dives and surface fun.
UPF 50 rating blocks 98% of UV radiation.
High quality polyester offers nice hand feel and provides good color fastness – especially in the lighter colors.
Polyester is comfortable yet durable, abrasion-resistant, and it does a good job of retaining its shape after repeated use.
Form-fitting design wears easily under a wetsuit.
Flattering color panels and cut keep you looking good while enjoying excellent UV protection.
High neck line prevents uncomfortable chafing.
Material dries quickly to enhance comfort between dives.
Pattern is well-suited to digital printing technology.
Highly versatile – ideal for divers, snorkelers, paddle boarders, swimmers and other water enthusiasts too.

Values.Value: UPF 50 Long Sleeve Rash Guard, Women, Flamingo, XS

With a UPF Collection long sleeve RASH GUARD you can look sharp while enjoying solid sun protection. Designed for diving but perfect for all water sports, these stylish long sleeve RASH GUARDS are made from high quality polyester fabric, are form-fitting, comfortable, and dry quickly. They also provide UPF 50 UV protection, which puts them in the “Excellent” UV protection category. Engineered for performance, wear a long sleeve RASH GUARD under a wetsuit at depth or by itself when topside for dependable protection from the sun’s rays. Long sleeve RASH GUARDS are available in a variety of colors, guaranteed to brighten any day on – or in – the water.

Variant.title: UPF 50 Rashguard Langarm, Damen, Flamingo, XS
Variant.description: Genieße zuverlässigen Sonnenschutz und sehe dabei stylisch aus. Das UPF 50 Rash Guard ist bequem, weich und schnelltrocknend. Das für Taucher entwickelte Kleidungsstück eignet sich auch perfekt für jede Art von Wassersport, trägt sich bequem unter einem Nassanzug oder einzeln und bietet idealen Schutz vor Sonnenstrahlen. Die langärmeligen Rashguards gibt es in unterschiedlichen Farben und sehen großartig aus – vor, nach und während des Tauchgangs. UPF 50 Rashguard Langarm, Damen

Variant.title: Rash Guard a Manica Lunga UPF 50, Donna, Flamingo, XS
Variant.description: Con una T-SHIRT PROTETTIVA a manica lunga della collezione UPF puoi avere un look brillante assicurandoti un’efficace protezione solare. Pensate per le immersioni ma perfette per tutti gli sport d’acqua, queste T-SHIRT PROTETTIVE a manica lunga sono realizzate in tessuto di poliestere di alta qualità, sono sagomate e confortevoli e si asciugano rapidamente. Inoltre, offrono una protezione da raggi ultravioletti (UPF 50), che le pone nella categoria “Eccellente” dei prodotti per la protezione dai raggi ultravioletti. Progettata per eccellere, indossa una T-SHIRT PROTETTIVA a manica lunga sotto una muta umida in profondità o da sola in superficie se desideri una protezione efficace contro i raggi solari. Le T-SHIRT PROTETTIVE a manica lunga sono disponibili in vari colori e illumineranno la tua giornata dentro e fuori dall’acqua. | Rash Guard a Manica Lunga UPF 50, Donna, Flamingo, XS

14.96 in x 0.39 in | 38 cm x 1 cm

MultiValue.Value: Built with a mix of quality 1mm X-Foam neoprene for warmth and durable nylon for stretch and comfort.
Highly versatile – ideal for divers, snorkelers, paddle boarders, swimmers and other water enthusiasts too.
Unique styling keeps you warm, protected and looking good.
Form-fitting for that sleek hydrodynamic look and feel.

Values.Value: Hybrid Thermal Long Sleeve Top, Women, XS

SCUBAPRO has updated its popular HYBRID line, which includes a thermal long sleeve top, cargo shorts, and a sleeveless hooded vest. The HYBRID THERMAL LONG SLEEVE TOP features smooth-skin 1mm neoprene in the torso area and high-stretch nylon material on the sides, sleeves and collar. On the underside of the nylon panels a microplush interior makes the top warm and cozy. This fleece fabric absorbs less water, which keeps heat against the body, increasing overall warmth. It also dries quickly. A comfortable and flattering zipper is included. This stylish warmer can be worn by itself or as a thermal under-layer beneath a traditional wetsuit. It can also act as a barrier to the sun's rays when snorkeling or swimming.

Variant.title: HYBRID-THERMO-TOP, Damen XS
Variant.description: Bietet hochelastischen Komfort und Wärmeschutz und ist so gut, wie es aussieht. Mit einer Mischung aus hochwertigem 1mm X-Foam Neopren für Wärmeschutz und strapazierfähigem Nylon für Dehnbarkeit und Komfort ist diese Bekleidungslinie sicherlich einzigartig. Stilvoll und perfekt für alle Bedingungen, können sie allein oder unter einem Tauchanzug für zusätzliche Wärme getragen werden. HYBRID-THERMO-TOP, Damen XS

Variant.title: TOP TERMICO Hybrid A MANICA LUNGA, Donna, XS
Variant.description: Offre comoda elasticità e protezione termica, con un aspetto all’altezza della sua funzionalità. Costruita con un mix di neoprene X-Foam da 1 mm per il calore e di nylon resistente per l’elasticità e il comfort, questa famiglia di capi misti è sicuramente unica. Eleganti e perfetti per qualsiasi condizione, possono essere indossati da soli o sotto una muta per un maggiore calore. | TOP TERMICO Hybrid A MANICA LUNGA, Donna, XS

Values.Value: UPF 50 Short Sleeve Rash Guard, Men, Aegean, S

With a UPF Collection short sleeve RASH GUARD you can look sharp while enjoying solid sun protection. Designed for diving but perfect for all water sports, these stylish short sleeve RASH GUARDS are made from high quality polyester fabric, are form-fitting, comfortable, and dry quickly. They also provide UPF 50 UV protection, which puts them in the “Excellent” UV protection category. Engineered for performance, wear a short sleeve RASH GUARD under a wetsuit at depth or by itself when topside for dependable protection from the sun’s rays. Short sleeve RASH GUARDS are available in a variety of colors, guaranteed to brighten any day on – or in – the water.

Variant.title: UPF 50 Rashguard Kurzarm, Herren, Aegean, S
Variant.description: Genieße zuverlässigen Sonnenschutz und sehe dabei stylisch aus. Das UPF 50 Rash Guard ist bequem, weich und schnelltrocknend. Das für Taucher entwickelte Kleidungsstück eignet sich auch perfekt für jede Art von Wassersport, trägt sich bequem unter einem Nassanzug oder einzeln und bietet idealen Schutz vor Sonnenstrahlen. Die kurzärmeligen Rashguards gibt es in unterschiedlichen Farben und sehen großartig aus – vor, nach und während des Tauchgangs. UPF 50 Rashguard Kurzarm, Herren

Variant.title: Rash Guard Manica Corta UPF 50, Uomo, Aegean, S
Variant.description: Con una T-SHIRT PROTETTIVA a manica corta della collezione UPF puoi avere un look brillante assicurandoti un’efficace protezione solare. Pensate per le immersioni ma perfette per tutti gli sport d’acqua, queste T-SHIRT PROTETTIVE a manica corta sono realizzate in tessuto di poliestere di alta qualità, sono sagomate e confortevoli e si asciugano rapidamente. Inoltre, offrono una protezione da raggi ultravioletti (UPF 50), che le pone nella categoria “Eccellente” dei prodotti per la protezione dai raggi ultravioletti. Progettata per eccellere, la T-SHIRT PROTETTIVA a manica corta può essere indossata in immersione sotto una muta umida o da sola in superficie per una protezione efficace contro i raggi solari. Le T-SHIRT PROTETTIVE a manica corta sono disponibili in vari colori e illumineranno la tua giornata dentro e fuori dall’acqua. | Rash Guard Manica Corta UPF 50, Uomo, Aegean, S

Values.Value: UPF 50 Short Sleeve Channel Flow, Men, Aegean, S

Enjoy all-day protection without sacrificing style wearing a comfortable short sleeve CHANNEL FLOW rash guard, available in a choice of colors along with UPF 50 UV protection. Where individuality and high performance meet, the unique channel flow construction of the short sleeve CHANNEL FLOW rash guard features a one-way wicking design that draws moisture away from the body and toward the surface layer where it can evaporate faster. The high quality polyester material and loose fit design enhance comfort and help keep the skin dry. This also allows the fabric itself to dry very quickly. Designed to perform, worn to be different, the short sleeve CHANNEL FLOW rash guard keeps you cozy between dives and always keeps you styling.

Variant.title: UPF 50 Rashguard Channel Flow Kurzarm, Herren, Aegean, S
Variant.description: Genieße mit dem bequemen Rashguard CHANNEL FLOW Kurzarm den ganzen Tag lang Schutz, ohne auf Stil zu verzichten. CHANNEL FLOW Kurzarm ist in verschiedenen Farben mit UPF 50 UV-Schutz erhältlich. Hier paart sich Individualität mit hoher Leistung, und die einzigartige Kanalkonstruktion des CHANNEL FLOW Kurzarm zeichnet sich durch einen Gewebeaufbau aus, der die Feuchtigkeit vom Körper weg und zur Oberflächenschicht leitet, wo sie schneller verdunsten kann. Das hochwertige Polyestermaterial und das luftige Design erhöhen den Komfort und helfen, die Haut trocken zu halten. Dadurch kann auch das Gewebe selbst sehr schnell trocknen. Entwickelt für Leistung, getragen, um anders zu sein – CHANNEL FLOW Kurzarm hält dich zwischen den Tauchgängen auf stylische Art behaglich warm. UPF 50 Rashguard Channel Flow Kurzarm, Herren

Variant.title: Channel Flow a Manica Corta UPF 50, Uomo, Aegean, S
Variant.description: Assicurati una protezione che dura tutto il giorno senza rinunciare allo stile grazie alla comoda t-shirt protettiva CHANNEL FLOW a manica corta, disponibile in una varietà di colori e con protezione UV UPF 50. Values.Value: Part of SCUBAPRO’s UPF Collection, the new STEAMER provides head-to-toe protection from stings and skin abrasion while at depth, and from the sun (UPF 50) while on the surface. The stylish STEAMER is made from high quality nylon and is designed to fit snug, creating a sleek profile in the water and a form-fitting look on shore. It features convenient thumb loops and foot stirrups for easy donning and to prevent ride-up when worn under a wetsuit. Used as an under-layer or by itself, the stylish STEAMER protects while ensuring that you always look good. Designed to perform, worn to be different, with the new STEAMER and the entire UPF Collection, seriously high performing dive wear just got a whole lot more fun.

Variant.title: UPF 50 Steamer, Herren, Graphit, S
Variant.description: Der neue STEAMER ist Teil der UPF-Kollektion von SCUBAPRO und bietet von oben bis unten Schutz vor Stichen und Hautabschürfungen sowie der Sonne (UPF 50). Der stilvolle STEAMER besteht aus hochwertigem Nylon und liegt eng an, um ein schlankes Profil im Wasser und einen figurbetonten Look an Land zu schaffen. Für ein einfaches Anziehen besitzt er praktische Daumenschlaufen und Fußstege, die ein Hochrollen beim Tragen unter einem Nasstauchanzug verhindern. Der als Unterzieher oder einzeln tragbare STEAMER schützt, während du gut aussiehst. Designt, um zu schützen – Erleben, um anders zu sein. Mit dem neuen STEAMER und der gesamten UPF-Kollektion macht hochleistungsfähige Tauch- und Wassersportbekleidung jetzt noch mehr Spaß. UPF 50 Steamer, Herren

Variant.title: Steamer UPF 50, Uomo, Graphite, S
Variant.description: Parte della collezione UPF di SCUBAPRO, il nuovo STEAMER offre una protezione completa da punture e abrasioni cutanee in immersione, e dai raggi solari (UPF 50) durante la permanenza in superficie. Variant.title: UPF 50 Channel-Flow Langarm, Damen, Jewel, M
Variant.description: Genieße mit dem luftigen, figurschmeichelnden und bequemen Rashguard CHANNEL FLOW Langarm den ganzen Tag lang Schutz, ohne auf Stil zu verzichten. CHANNEL FLOW Langarm ist in verschiedenen neuen Farben mit UPF 50 UV-Schutz erhältlich. Hier paart sich Individualität mit hoher Leistung, und die einzigartige Kanalkonstruktion des CHANNEL FLOW zeichnet sich durch einen Gewebeaufbau aus, der die Feuchtigkeit vom Körper weg und zur Oberflächenschicht leitet, wo sie schneller verdunsten kann. Das hochwertige Polyestermaterial und das luftige Design erhöhen den Komfort und helfen, die Haut trocken zu halten. Dadurch kann auch das Gewebe selbst sehr schnell trocknen. Entwickelt für Leistung, getragen, um anders zu sein – CHANNEL FLOW Langarm hält dich zwischen den Tauchgängen auf stylische Art behaglich warm. UPF 50 Channel-Flow Langarm, Damen

Variant.title: Channel Flow Rash Guard con zip UPF 50, Donna, Jewel, M
Variant.description: Elegante e non aderente, la comoda t-shirt protettiva CHANNEL FLOW a manica lunga, disponibile in una varietà di colori e con protezione UV UPF 50, ti assicura una protezione che dura tutto il giorno senza rinunciare allo stile. Dove l'individualità incontra le elevate prestazioni, l'esclusiva struttura a flusso canalizzato della t-shirt protettiva CHANNEL FLOW presenta una trama traspirante che favorisce l’eliminazione dell’umidità corporea verso lo strato superficiale dove può evaporare più velocemente. Il materiale in poliestere e il design non aderente migliorano il comfort e contribuiscono a mantenere la pelle asciutta. Ciò permette al tessuto stesso di asciugarsi rapidamente. Creata per eccellere, indossata per distinguersi, la t-shirt protettiva CHANNEL FLOW a manica lunga ti garantisce comfort e stile tra un'immersione e l'altra. | Channel Flow Rash Guard con zip UPF 50, Donna, Jewel, M

Values.Value: Part of SCUBAPRO’s UPF Collection, the new STEAMER provides head-to-toe protection from stings and skin abrasion while at depth, and from the sun (UPF 50) while on the surface. The stylish STEAMER is made from high quality nylon and is designed to fit snug, creating a sleek profile in the water and a form-fitting look on shore. It features convenient thumb loops and foot stirrups for easy donning and to prevent ride-up when worn under a wetsuit. Used as an under-layer or by itself, the stylish STEAMER protects while ensuring that you always look good. Designed to perform, worn to be different, with the new STEAMER and the entire UPF Collection, seriously high performing dive wear just got a whole lot more fun.

Variant.title: UPF 50 Steamer, Damen, Graphit, XS
Variant.description: Der neue STEAMER ist Teil der UPF-Kollektion von SCUBAPRO und bietet von oben bis unten Schutz vor Stichen und Hautabschürfungen sowie der Sonne (UPF 50). Der stilvolle STEAMER besteht aus hochwertigem Nylon und liegt eng an, um ein schlankes Profil im Wasser und einen figurbetonten Look an Land zu schaffen. Für ein einfaches Anziehen besitzt er praktische Daumenschlaufen und Fußstege, die ein Hochrollen beim Tragen unter einem Nasstauchanzug verhindern. Der als Unterzieher oder einzeln tragbare STEAMER schützt, während du gut aussiehst. Designt, um zu schützen – Erleben, um anders zu sein. Mit dem neuen STEAMER und der gesamten UPF-Kollektion macht hochleistungsfähige Tauch- und Wassersportbekleidung jetzt noch mehr Spaß. UPF 50 Steamer, Damen

Für ein einfaches Anziehen besitzt er praktische Daumenschlaufen und Fußstege, die ein Hochrollen beim Tragen unter einem Nasstauchanzug verhindern. Der als Unterzieher oder einzeln tragbare STEAMER schützt, während du gut aussiehst. Designt, um zu schützen – Erleben, um anders zu sein. Mit dem neuen STEAMER und der gesamten UPF-Kollektion macht hochleistungsfähige Tauch- und Wassersportbekleidung jetzt noch mehr Spaß. UPF 50 Steamer, Damen

Variant.title: Steamer UPF 50, Donna, Graphite, M
Variant.description: Parte della collezione UPF di SCUBAPRO, il nuovo STEAMER offre una protezione completa da punture e abrasioni cutanee in immersione, e dai raggi solari (UPF 50) durante la permanenza in superficie. Garantisce confort e calore nelle immersioni subacquee e, allo stesso tempo, una buona protezione solare durante lo snorkeling e il nuoto in superficie. Il taglio sofisticato ne garantisce la comodità una volta indossato, senza stringere. Il soffice neoprene con cui è stato prodotto è X-Foam, una formula non tossica che rispetta i severissimi standard P.A.H. requisiti di test PAH (Idrocarburi policiclici aromatici). | Rebel Shorty, Ragazzo, 2 mm, Verde, M

Variant.title: Definition Shorty, Herren, 2.5 mm, Gelb/Schwarz, S
Variant.description: Dieser Must-Have Shorty bietet einen überragenden Komfort und höchste Elastizität in tropischen Gewässern. MultiValue.Value: Designed to keep new and casual tropical divers warm and comfortable while diving in moderate to shallow depths.
Also provides good thermal protection for pool training.
Softer and more flexible neoprene makes it easy to put on and take off, maximizes range of motion and improves overall comfort.
Pure Design Concept uses fewer seams and panels for maximum flexibility.
Triathlon cut employs wider panels covering the underarm and back areas that allow unrestricted shoulder movement.
Vertical YKK rear zipper with brass slider offers increased long-term durability and ease of use.
Flat-lock seam construction is comfortable against bare skin.
Made with X-Foam neoprene, a very specific limestone-based neoprene complying with strict PAH and REACH regulations.
Assembled using a solvent-free glue, a 100% green process.
Product logo on the arm includes neoprene thickness for easy identification.
Available in a variety of men's and women's sizes.

Values.Value: This incredibly soft shorty offers lots of warmth, comfort and stretch for casual tropical divers who enjoy diving in moderate to shallow depths. Made from super-soft 2mm neoprene with an inside/outside polyester lining, the shorty features the triathlon cut from Sport steamers that allows for lots of range of motion in the shoulder and armpit areas. Design enhancements include smart exterior styling and colors and a vertical-cut rear zipper. This shorty is easy to put on and take off, is stretchy and comfortable, fits like a second skin and looks good in the process.

Variant.title: Sport Shorty, Herren, 2mm, L
Variant.description: Dieser äußerst weiche Shorty spendet Wärme, Komfort und Stretch für tropische Freizeittaucher in mäßigen bis flachen Tiefen. Der Shorty besteht aus weichem 2-mm-Neopren mit einem Innen- und Außenfutter aus Polyester. Der Triathlon-Schnitt wie bei den SCUBAPRO Sport-Steamern bietet viel Bewegungsfreiheit im Schulter- und Achselbereich. Designupgrades zeigen sich in einem modernen äußeren, verschiedenen Farben und einem vertikalen Rückenreißverschluss. Dieser Shorty ist elastisch, komfortabel und lässt sich einfach an- und ausziehen – er sitzt wie eine zweite Haut und sieht gleichzeitig frisch und modern aus. Sport Shorty, Herren

Variant.title: Sport Shorty, Uomo, 2mm, L
Variant.description: Questo shorty incredibilmente morbido offre una ottima tenuta termica, comfort ed elasticità per i subacquei in acque tropicali che amano le immersioni in profondità da moderate a basse. Realizzato in morbidissimo neoprene da 2 mm con una fodera interna / esterna in poliestere, lo shorty presenta il taglio da triathlon degli steamer sportivi che consente un'ampia libertà di movimento nelle zone delle spalle e delle ascelle. Il design migliorato comprende una nuova colorazione e una cerniera posteriore con taglio verticale. Questo shorty è facile da indossare e da togliere, è elastico e comodo, si adatta come una seconda pelle e ha conferisce un look unico. | Sport Shorty, Uomo, 2mm, L

Diagonal front YKK zipper with KA brass slider is durable, easy to use and makes easy work of donning and doffing.
Anti-abrasion material on shoulders and seat cushion the diver while protecting the shorty from scrapes and scuffs.
Arm logo color varies by size.

Made of strong but stretchable X-Foam neoprene with a tough UV-resistant and chlorine-resistant polyester 2-sided lining, this 2.5mm shorty is perfect for tropical diving or pool training. Anti-abrasion material on the shoulders and seat area protect against chafing BCD straps and non-skid boat seats, greatly extending the life of the shorty.

MultiValue.Value: Designed to keep new and casual tropical divers warm and comfortable while diving in moderate to shallow depths.
Also provides good thermal protection for pool training.
Softer and more flexible neoprene makes it easy to put on and take off, maximizes range of motion and improves overall comfort.
Pure Design Concept uses fewer seams and panels for maximum flexibility.
Triathlon cut employs wider panels covering the underarm and back areas that allow unrestricted shoulder movement.
Vertical YKK rear zipper with brass slider offers increased long-term durability and ease of use.
Flat-lock seam construction is comfortable against bare skin.
Made with X-Foam neoprene, a very specific limestone-based neoprene complying with strict PAH and REACH regulations.
Assembled using a solvent-free glue, a 100% green process.
Product logo on the arm includes neoprene thickness for easy identification.
Available in a variety of men's and women's sizes.

Values.Value: This incredibly soft shorty offers lots of warmth, comfort and stretch for casual tropical divers who enjoy diving in moderate to shallow depths. Made from super-soft 2mm neoprene with an inside/outside polyester lining, the shorty features the triathlon cut from Sport steamers that allows for lots of range of motion in the shoulder and armpit areas. Design enhancements include smart exterior styling and colors and a vertical-cut rear zipper. This shorty is easy to put on and take off, is stretchy and comfortable, fits like a second skin and looks good in the process.

Variant.title: Sport Shorty, Damen, 2mm, 3XL
Variant.description: Dieser äußerst weiche Shorty spendet Wärme, Komfort und Stretch für tropische Freizeittaucher in mäßigen bis flachen Tiefen. Der Shorty besteht aus weichem 2-mm-Neopren mit einem Innen- und Außenfutter aus Polyester. Der Triathlon-Schnitt wie bei den SCUBAPRO Sport-Steamern bietet viel Bewegungsfreiheit im Schulter- und Achselbereich. Designupgrades zeigen sich in einem modernen äußeren, verschiedenen Farben und einem vertikalen Rückenreißverschluss. Dieser Shorty ist elastisch, komfortabel und lässt sich einfach an- und ausziehen – er sitzt wie eine zweite Haut und sieht gleichzeitig frisch und modern aus. Sport Shorty, Damen

Variant.title: Sport Shorty, Donna, 2mm, 3XL
Variant.description: Questo shorty incredibilmente morbido offre una ottima tenuta termica, comfort ed elasticità per i subacquei in acque tropicali che amano le immersioni in profondità da moderate a basse. Realizzato in morbidissimo neoprene da 2 mm con una fodera interna / esterna in poliestere, lo shorty presenta il taglio da triathlon degli steamer sportivi che consente un'ampia libertà di movimento nelle zone delle spalle e delle ascelle. Il design migliorato comprende una nuova colorazione e una cerniera posteriore con taglio verticale. Questo shorty è facile da indossare e da togliere, è elastico e comodo, si adatta come una seconda pelle e ha conferisce un look unico. | Sport Shorty, Donna, 2mm, 3XL

MultiValue.Value: Built with a mix of quality 1mm X-Foam neoprene for warmth and durable nylon for stretch and comfort.
Highly versatile – ideal for divers, snorkelers, paddle boarders, swimmers and other water enthusiasts too.
Unique styling keeps you warm, protected and looking good.
Form-fitting for that sleek hydrodynamic look and feel.
In men's and women's styling and sizing.

Values.Value: SCUBAPRO has updated its popular HYBRID line, which includes a thermal long sleeve top, cargo shorts, and a sleeveless hooded vest. The HYBRID HOODED VEST’s ultra-comfortable neoprene/nylon blend does a great job of protecting your torso and head, two critical areas for minimizing heat loss, providing comfort, warmth and protection where you need it most. On the underside of the nylon panels a microplush interior makes the vest warm and cozy. This fleece fabric absorbs less water, which keeps heat against the body, increasing overall warmth. It also dries quickly. This hooded vest can be worn by itself or layered over a long sleeve thermal rash guard to increase warmth and protection.

Variant.title: TOP MIT KAPUZE HERREN S
Variant.description: Die weiche Weste sorgt für Wärme an Kopf und Oberkörper. Schutz und Wärme, wo man sie am meisten braucht. Mit einer Mischung aus hochwertigem 1mm X-Foam Neopren für Wärmeschutz und strapazierfähigem Nylon für Dehnbarkeit und Komfort ist diese Bekleidungslinie sicherlich einzigartig. Stilvoll und perfekt für alle Bedingungen, können sie allein oder unter einem Tauchanzug für zusätzliche Wärme getragen werden. TOP MIT KAPUZE HERREN S
Variant.product_type: Home DE,Kälteschutz,Nasstauchanzüge,TOP MIT KAPUZE HERREN S

Variant.title: GILET CON CAPPUCCIO, UOMO, S
Variant.description: Morbido e caldo, questo gilet protegge il tronco e la testa. Calore e protezione dove è più necessario. Costruita con un mix di neoprene X-Foam da 1 mm per il calore e di nylon resistente per l’elasticità e il comfort, questa famiglia di capi misti è sicuramente unica. Eleganti e perfetti per qualsiasi condizione, possono essere indossati da soli o sotto una muta per un maggiore calore. | GILET CON CAPPUCCIO, UOMO, S

Values.Value: Search and Rescue Fast Bump Helmet

MultiValue.Value: Vent holes for increased ventilation and water drainage.
Chinstrap Extraction for cold water and full-face mask diving.
Lights can be added to the ARC Rail or with the Ops Core Single Clamp, as well as cameras and other accessories.
The SCUBAPRO SAR FAST Bump Helmet meets BS EN 1385: 2012, Ops-Core FAST Bump Performance Specification PS-1145.
Light, mask, and comfort strap sold separately.

Values.Value: SCUBAPRO Search and Rescue Fast Bump Helmet, Orange, L/XL

The SCUBAPRO SAR FAST Bump Helmet, with its glass-filled nylon shell and high-cut design, is ideal for search and rescue operations on land or in the water. Its rugged construction protects the head in environments where the possibility of blunt force trauma is limited. A molded front NVG shroud interfaces with standard night vision goggles brackets, and a four-position Accessory Rail Connector (ARC) and external side hook and loop provide attachment points for a variety of mission-configured components.

MultiValue.Value: NEW design and pattern improves fit and comfort for warm-water dives.
Made with 3/2mm X-Foam neoprene, a very specific limestone-based neoprene complying with strict PAH and REACH regulations.
100% high-stretch Everflex Nylon outside and NEW interior plush makes donning and doffing super easy and provides excellent comfort.
Assembled using a solvent-free glue, a 100% green process.
Available in a variety of unisex double sizes.

Values.Value: Everflex Diving Hood, 3/2 mm, Black, XS/S

When you need a little extra thermal protection there’s no better add-on to your dive ensemble than a hood. This updated 3mm hood features a new design and pattern, and a new interior plush lining for comfort. The hood is made of 100% high-stretch Everflex Nylon outside lining for maximum flexibility. It’s a welcome addition for warm-water diving. No face seal.

Variant.title: Everflex Kopfhaub, 3mm, XS/S
Variant.description: Wenn du zusätzliche Wärmeisolation benötigst, gibt es keine bessere Ergänzung deiner Tauchausrüstung als eine Kopfhaube. Diese 3-mm-Haube besitzt ein komfortables Design, sowie ein weiches Plüsch-Innenfutter für mehr Komfort. Die Kopfhaube besteht außen zu 100% aus hochelastischem Everflex Nylon für maximale Flexibilität. Sie ist eine willkommene Ergänzung für das Tauchen in warmen Gewässern. Ohne Gesichtsmanschette. Everflex Kopfhaub, 3mm

Variant.title: Everflex, Senza Collare & Senza Tenuta Sul Viso, 3mm, XS/S
Variant.description: Quando ti serve isolamento termico extra, la scelta migliore è aggiungere un cappuccio al tuo completo per immersioni. Questo cappuccio da 3 mm è stato rinnovato nel design e nella struttura, ed è stato anche dotato di un rivestimento interno felpato per migliorarne in comfort. Questo cappuccio è realizzato con un rivestimento Everflex Nylon 100% altamente elastico per una flessibilità massima. Una gradita aggiunta per le immersioni in acque calde. Nessuna tenuta sul viso. | Everflex, Senza Collare & Senza Tenuta Sul Viso, 3mm, XS/S

Values.Value: Everflex Bibbed Diving Hood, 3/2 mm, Black, XS/S

Diving hoods minimize heat loss from the head area, so if you tend to get cold after a time at depth there’s no better fix than to add a hood to your dive suit. This updated 3mm hood with bib is made of 100% high-stretch Everflex Nylon outside for maximum flexibility and durability, with an inside lining of comfortable plush. This new version features a face seal to cut down on water transfer, making it the perfect addition for extended warm-water dives.

Values.Value: Novascotia / Everdry Diving Hood, 6/4 mm, Black, S/M

This is the perfect hood to complement Everdry 4 neoprene drysuits and the NovaScotia semi-dry. It is made of high-stretch 100% Everflex Nylon on the outside, and on the inside a Diamond Span quick-dry fleece liner increases warmth and comfort for those extended cold-water dives. The hood comes with an air vent system, a face seal to minimize water transfer plus a double snap button in back to attach to the snap buttons on NovaScotia and Everdry 4 drysuits to ensure perfect positioning throughout the dive.

Variant.title: NovaScotia / Everdry Kopfhaube 6/4MM S/M
Variant.description: Die perfekte Haube zur Ergänzung von Everdry 4 Neopren-Trockentauchanzügen und des NovaScotia Halbtrockentauchanzugs. Sie besteht außen zu 100% aus hochelastischem Everflex Nylon, das Innenfutter ist aus schnell trocknendem Diamond Span-Fleece und erhöht Wärme und Komfort bei langen Kaltwassertauchgängen. Die Haube besitzt ein Belüftungssystem, eine Gesichtsmanschette für minimales Eindringen von Wasser sowie einen doppelten Druckknopf an der Rückseite, der an den Druckknöpfen von NovaScotia und Everdry 4 Trockentauchanzügen befestigt werden kann, um einen perfekten Sitz während des Tauchgangs zu gewährleisten. NovaScotia / Everdry Kopfhaube 6/4MM

Variant.title: NovaScotia/ Everdry Cappuccio 6/4mm S/M
Variant.description: È il cappuccio perfetto da abbinare alla muta stagna in neoprene Everdry 4 o alla muta semistagna NovaScotia. Il rivestimento esterno è 100% Everflex Nylon, mentre l’interno è in Diamond Span, un materiale felpato ad asciugatura rapida, per aumentare il calore e il comfort per le immersioni prolungate in acque fredde. Il cappuccio è provvisto di un sistema di areazione, di tenuta sul viso per minimizzare la circolazione d’acqua e di due bottoni a pressione sul retro per abbinarlo ai bottoni a pressione delle mute stagne NovaScotia e Everdry 4 e quindi assicurare che rimanga in posizione durante l’immersione. | NovaScotia/ Everdry Cappuccio 6/4mm S/M

Values.Value: Novascotia / Everdry Diving Hood, 6/4 mm, Black, XS/S

This is the perfect hood to complement Everdry 4 neoprene drysuits and the NovaScotia semi-dry. It is made of high-stretch 100% Everflex Nylon on the outside, and on the inside a Diamond Span quick-dry fleece liner increases warmth and comfort for those extended cold-water dives. The hood comes with an air vent system, a face seal to minimize water transfer plus a double snap button in back to attach to the snap buttons on NovaScotia and Everdry 4 drysuits to ensure perfect positioning throughout the dive.

Variant.title: NovaScotia / Everdry Kopfhaube 6/4MM XS/S
Variant.description: Die perfekte Haube zur Ergänzung von Everdry 4 Neopren-Trockentauchanzügen und des NovaScotia Halbtrockentauchanzugs. Sie besteht außen zu 100% aus hochelastischem Everflex Nylon, das Innenfutter ist aus schnell trocknendem Diamond Span-Fleece und erhöht Wärme und Komfort bei langen Kaltwassertauchgängen. Die Haube besitzt ein Belüftungssystem, eine Gesichtsmanschette für minimales Eindringen von Wasser sowie einen doppelten Druckknopf an der Rückseite, der an den Druckknöpfen von NovaScotia und Everdry 4 Trockentauchanzügen befestigt werden kann, um einen perfekten Sitz während des Tauchgangs zu gewährleisten. NovaScotia / Everdry Kopfhaube 6/4MM

Variant.title: NovaScotia/ Everdry Cappuccio 6/4mm XS/S
Variant.description: È il cappuccio perfetto da abbinare alla muta stagna in neoprene Everdry 4 o alla muta semistagna NovaScotia. Il rivestimento esterno è 100% Everflex Nylon, mentre l’interno è in Diamond Span, un materiale felpato ad asciugatura rapida, per aumentare il calore e il comfort per le immersioni prolungate in acque fredde. Il cappuccio è provvisto di un sistema di areazione, di tenuta sul viso per minimizzare la circolazione d’acqua e di due bottoni a pressione sul retro per abbinarlo ai bottoni a pressione delle mute stagne NovaScotia e Everdry 4 e quindi assicurare che rimanga in posizione durante l’immersione. | NovaScotia/ Everdry Cappuccio 6/4mm XS/S

Values.Value: Search and Rescue Fast Bump Helmet

MultiValue.Value: Vent holes for increased ventilation and water drainage.
Chinstrap Extraction for cold water and full-face mask diving.
Lights can be added to the ARC Rail or with the Ops Core Single Clamp, as well as cameras and other accessories.
The SCUBAPRO SAR FAST Bump Helmet meets BS EN 1385: 2012, Ops-Core FAST Bump Performance Specification PS-1145.
Light, mask, and comfort strap sold separately.

Values.Value: SCUBAPRO Search and Rescue Fast Bump Helmet, Red, M/L

The SCUBAPRO SAR FAST Bump Helmet, with its glass-filled nylon shell and high-cut design, is ideal for search and rescue operations on land or in the water. Its rugged construction protects the head in environments where the possibility of blunt force trauma is limited. A molded front NVG shroud interfaces with standard night vision goggles brackets, and a four-position Accessory Rail Connector (ARC) and external side hook and loop provide attachment points for a variety of mission-configured components.

Values.Value: SCUBAPRO Search and Rescue Fast Bump Helmet, Orange, M/L

The SCUBAPRO SAR FAST Bump Helmet, with its glass-filled nylon shell and high-cut design, is ideal for search and rescue operations on land or in the water. Its rugged construction protects the head in environments where the possibility of blunt force trauma is limited. A molded front NVG shroud interfaces with standard night vision goggles brackets, and a four-position Accessory Rail Connector (ARC) and external side hook and loop provide attachment points for a variety of mission-configured components.

Product.Name: SPORT 5.0 STMR G2 BZIP MN S

Values.Value: 55.12 in x 18.11 in x 0.98 in | 140 cm x 46 cm x 2.5 cm
18.11 in x 0.98 in | 46 cm x 2.5 cm

MultiValue.Value: CE certified a Class B dive suit – rated for water temperatures ranging from 50°F/10°C to 64.5°F/18°C.
Designed to keep new divers and casual divers warm and comfortable while diving in moderate to shallow depths.

Made from Surf Foam neoprene, a variation of X-Foam, which is softer and more flexible than Dive Foam neoprene – although less resistant to water compression. This softness and flexibility make Sport suits extremely easy to climb in and out of, maximize range of motion, and radically improve comfort.
Assembled using solvent-free Aqua glue, a 100% green process. Glued and blind-stitched seams keep warmth in and water out.
Pure Design Concept uses fewer seams and panels for maximum flexibility.
Triathlon cut employs wider panels covering the underarm and back areas that allow unrestricted arm and shoulder movement.
Main vertical-cut YKK rear zipper with KA brass slider offers increased long-term durability and ease of use.
Single zippered cuffs on ankles and wrists with YKK KA brass sliders offer durability and comfort plus are easy to use.
The interior is lined with two plush materials that enhance comfort and warmth, dry quickly and provide cushion beneath wrist and ankle zippers.
Abrasion-resistant fabric on shoulders, seat and knees protects against shifting gear or when sitting or kneeling.
High-stretch neoprene is great for hard-to-fit divers who can now enjoy a suit that molds comfortably to the body.
X-Foam: Made from limestone neoprene, petroleum-free, and compliant with strict PAH requirements. SCUBAPRO was the first to offer this, better protecting divers and our oceans.

Values.Value: This new-generation 5mm Sport steamer has been updated with new features and a fresh look. It is a great choice for new divers, casual divers, and first-time suit buyers who enjoy leisurely warmer water diving in moderate to shallow depths. The Sport 5mm is made from super-soft Surf Foam neoprene and features a triathlon cut that allows for lots of range of motion in the shoulder and arm areas for maximum freedom of movement on the boat and in the water. Design enhancements include new exterior styling and colors, a vertical-cut rear zipper, wrist and ankle zippers, and a hood hook on the right hip. This suit is easy to put on and take off, is stretchy and comfortable, fits like a second skin and looks good in the process.

Variant.title: Sport Steamer, Herren, 5mm, Gelb, S
Variant.description: Der Sport 5 mm (Generation 2) bietet eine gute Wärmeisolation optimal für Einsteiger oder Gelegenheitstaucher. Der SPORT ist leicht an- und auszuziehen, sitzt wie eine zweite Haut und sieht super stylisch aus. Aus extrem weichem Neopren, ist er unter Verwendung von lösungsmittelfreiem Kleber gefertigt – einem zu 100% grünem Prozess. Der spezielle Triathlon-Schnitt gibt maximale Bewegungsfreiheit im Schulter- und Armbereich, sei es im Wasser oder auf dem Boot. Der Sport 5mm überzeugt mit tollem Design und auffälligen Farben, einem vertikal geschnittenen Rückenreißverschluss und einem Kapuzenhaken an der rechten Hüfte. Sport Steamer, Herren

Variant.title: Sport Steamer, Uomo, 5mm, Giallo, S
Variant.description: La muta Sport 5mm (2° generazione) è un autentico must per la tenuta termica sia per chi acquista la sua prima muta che per subacquei occasionali. La muta Sport è facile da indossare e da togliere, aderisce alla perfezione come una seconda pelle ed ha un’estetica sempre insuperabile. Realizzata in neoprene ultra-morbido, questa muta è assemblata con colla priva di solventi (Aqua glue), un metodo ecologico al 100%. Il taglio tipo triathlon aumenta la mobilità nelle zone di spalle e braccia, garantendo massima libertà di movimento sia a bordo che nell’acqua. La muta Sport 5 mm si veste di colori con uno stile inconfondibile e presenta una cerniera posteriore dal taglio verticale con un gancio per il cappuccio sul fianco destro. | Sport Steamer, Uomo, 5mm, Giallo, S

Variant.product_type: Home IT,Abbigliamento per Immersioni,Mute Umide,Sport Steamer Uomo 5mm Giallo S

MultiValue.Value: CE certified a Class B dive suit – rated for water temperatures ranging from 50°F/10°C to 64.5°F/18°C.

Abrasion-resistant fabric on shoulders, seat and knees protects against shifting gear or when sitting or kneeling.
High-stretch neoprene is great for hard-to-fit divers who can now enjoy a suit that molds comfortably to the body.

Values.Value: 35.4 in x 2 in | 89.92 cm x 5.08 cm

MultiValue.Value: CE certified a Class A dive suit - - rated for water termperatures ranging from 45ºF (7ºC ) to 54ºF (12ºC).
Rear shoulder-to-shoulder YKK Aquaseal Vislon waterproof main zipper with heavy-duty plastic slider is flexible yet provides an excellent seal against water entry.
Plush interior liner in the arms, legs and shoulder areas increases warmth and stretch.
Double zippered seals on ankles and wrists feature KA brass sliders for durability, water-tightness and ease of use.
Fold-under neck seal is ultra-comfortable and keeps water seepage to a minimum.
Right thigh 3D pocket offers lots of room for carrying extra gear. The hood hook has been moved to the outside of the pocket for added convenience.
Shoulders and kneepads feature both anti-abrasion patterns and extra rubber prints to provide protection while adding a stylish look.
Enhanced spine pad provides a welcomed cushion where the tank hits the diver's back.
I-Safe straps on both arms offer non slip mounting spots for securing wrist instruments.
Made from 100% Everflex neoprene for comfort and durability.
Suits are assembled using a solvent free glue, a 100% green process.

Values.Value: NovaScotia Semi-Dry, w/Hood, Men, 7.5mm, Black, S
Heavy Duty on Shoulder, Knee & Seat

Offering a snug-fitting, flexible dive suit with good thermal properties and minimal water intrusion, the NovaScotia semi-dry is the perfect solution for staying very warm and relatively dry while virtually eliminating hydrodrag, radically improving a diver's ability to move easily through the water. With its 7.6/6.5mm thickness, easy-zip waterproof YKK Aquaseal Vislon zipper, improved plush lining to increase warmth and stretch, and a long list of convenience features, the NovaScotia is the diver's answer to a comfortable, affordable semi-dry suit. Positioned between a traditional wetsuit and a neoprene drysuit, the NovaScotia delivers the best of both worlds in cold water, temperate water, and multi-dive protection.

Variant.title: Novascotia, Inkl. Kopfhaube, Herren, 7.5mm, Schwarz, S
Variant.description: Der Halbtrockentauchanzug NovaScotia 7, 5MM bietet besseren Wärmeschutz als jeder andere Nasstauchanzug auf dem Markt. Er besitzt eine CE-Kennzeichnung als Tauchanzug der Klasse A. Das ist die höchste Bewertung, die ein Anzug dieser Art erhalten kann. Der aus hochwertigem Neopren bestehende, gemäß dem Pure Design Concept entworfene NovaScotia 7, 5MM ist der ultimative Wärmeschutz in kaltem Wasser und bei mehreren Tauchgängen. Novascotia, Inkl. Kopfhaube, Herren

Variant.title: NovaScotia Muta Semi-Stagna Con Cap, 7,5 mm, Uomo, Nero, S
Variant.description: La muta NovaScotia 7.5 mm semi-stagna offre più protezione termica di qualsiasi altra muta umida sul mercato. È certificata CE come muta di Classe A, la classificazione più elevata che una muta di questo tipo possa ottenere. Realizzata in neoprene di qualità e incorporando Pure Design Concept, NovaScotia 7,5 mm offre una protezione termica eccezionale per immersioni multiple e in acque fredde. | NovaScotia Muta Semi-Stagna Con Cap, 7,5 mm, Uomo, Nero, S

Enhanced spine pad provides a welcomed cushion where the tank hits the diver's back.
I-Safe straps on both arms offer non slip mounting spots for securing wrist instruments.
Made from 100% Everflex neoprene for comfort and durability.
Suits are assembled using a solvent free glue, a 100% green process.

Values.Value: NovaScotia Semi-Dry, w/Hood, Women, 7.5mm, Black, XL
Heavy Duty on Shoulder, Knee & Seat

Offering a snug-fitting, flexible dive suit with good thermal properties and minimal water intrusion, the NovaScotia semi-dry is the perfect solution for staying very warm and relatively dry while virtually eliminating hydrodrag, radically improving a diver's ability to move easily through the water. With its 7.6/6.5mm thickness, easy-zip waterproof YKK Aquaseal Vislon zipper, improved plush lining to increase warmth and stretch, and a long list of convenience features, the NovaScotia is the diver's answer to a comfortable, affordable semi-dry suit. Positioned between a traditional wetsuit and a neoprene drysuit, the NovaScotia delivers the best of both worlds in cold water, temperate water, and multi-dive protection.

MultiValue.Value: Suit is assembled using a solvent-free glue, a 100% green process.
Built with the Body Map System, an exclusive manufacturing method that uses special tailoring and material inserts to compensate for the stresses of the human body.
N2S (Nylon 2 Sides) construction delivers the perfect level of warmth and comfort.
Diagonal rear YKK zipper with brass slider offers increased long-term durability and ease of use.
Single zippered seals on ankles and wrists feature YKK brass sliders for durability, water-tightness and ease of use.
Wrist and ankle zippers on women’s suits are extra-long for added convenience.
Abrasion-resistant fabric on shoulders and seat, along with bigger abrasion-resistant printed shoulders, elbow and knee pads, cover more exposed areas and increase long-term durability.
Small neck zipper enhances topside comfort, eliminating the need to re- move the suit between dives.
I-Safe straps on both arms offer non- slip mounting spots for securing wrist instruments.
Made from X-Foam, a petroleum-free, limestone neoprene.
CE certified a Class D dive suit: rated for water temperatures above 72ºF/22ºC.

Values.Value: The Definition 3mm offers a level of warmth and comfort any warm-water diver will love. It is built with SCUBAPRO’s Body Map System, a manufacturing method that uses a 3D cut, special tailoring and material inserts to create a suit that fits like a glove, provides extra stretch where it's needed most, and offers excellent warmth, comfort and durability. Proven N2S (Nylon 2 Sides) construction offers the perfect level of warmth and comfort for warm-water diving. The infrared fleece interior lining reflects body heat to ratchet up warmth even more, plus it's comfortable as can be against the skin. It’s the perfect thermal protection for any diver.

Variant.title: Definition Steamer, Herren, 3mm, Gelb/Schwarz, S
Variant.description: Der Definition 3MM bietet einen Wärme- und Komfortgrad, den jeder Warmwassertaucher lieben wird. Er wird mithilfe der Methode „ Body Map System“ hergestellt, wobei ein 3D-Schnitt, spezielle Nähverfahren und Materialeinsätze Anwendung finden, um einen Anzug zu schaffen, der wie angegossen sitzt, zusätzlichen Stretch bietet und für hervorragenden Wärmeschutz, Komfort und Haltbarkeit sorgt. Der bewährte Aufbau mit N2S (zweiseitiges Nylon) garantiert perfekte Wärme und Komfort für das Tauchen in warmen Gewässern. Dies ist der perfekte Wärmeschutz für jeden Taucher. Definition Steamer, Herren

Variant.title: Definition Steamer, Uomo, 3mm, Giallo/Nero, S
Variant.description: La muta Definition 3 mm garantisce un livello di calore e comfort che tutti i subacquei di acque calde ameranno. Realizzata con il Body Map System di SCUBAPRO, un metodo di produzione che utilizza taglio a 3D, cura dei dettagli e inserti di materiali speciali per creare un indumento dalla perfetta vestibilità con elasticità extra dove è più necessario e in grado di offrire calore, comfort e durabilità eccellenti. La costruzione collaudata in N2S (Nylon 2 Sides) offre il livello perfetto di calore e comfort per le immersioni in acque calde. Il rivestimento interno in pile a infrarossi riflette il calore del corpo per garantire ancora più caldo, oltre a essere piacevole a contatto con la pelle. È perfetto per la protezione termica di qualsiasi subacqueo. | Definition Steamer, Uomo, 3mm, Giallo/Nero, S

MultiValue.Value: CE certified as a Class B dive suit – rated for water temperatures ranging from 50ºF (10ºC) to 64.5ºF (18ºC).
Suit is assembled using a solvent-free glue, a 100% green process.
Ultraspan chest panel and Stretchtec fabric on body, sides, arms and legs work together to produce a highly flexible and snug fit.
Innovative seamless single arm and leg stretch panels, with double zippered seals, make donning and doffing the suit even easier.
Infrared (IR) interior lining on the front and back torso reflects body heat for extra thermal insulation, plus is extremely soft against the skin.
Diagonal rear YKK zipper with brass slider offers increased long-term durability and ease of use.
Spine pad cushions the tank, providing additional comfort during extended dives.
Abrasion-resistant fabric on shoulders and seat, along with new bigger abrasion-resistant printed shoulders, elbow and kneepads, cover more exposed areas and increase long-term durability.
Small neck zipper enhances topside comfort, eliminating the need to remove the suit between dives.
I-Safe straps on both arms offer non-slip mounting spots for securing wrist instruments.
Wrist and ankle zippers on women’s suits are extra-long for added convenience.
Made from X-Foam, a petroleum-free, limestone neoprene.

Values.Value: The Definition 5mm steamer offers more stretch, more comfort and more features. The suit is built with the Body Map System, a manufacturing method that uses a 3D cut, special tailoring and material inserts to create a suit that fits the body like a glove. An Ultraspan chest panel and Stretchtec fabric on the body, sides, arms and legs work together to produce a highly flexible and snug fit, providing extra stretch where it’s needed most. Bigger abrasion-resistant shoulder, knee and elbow pads provide maximum protection. While the new seamless single arm and leg stretch panels with double zippered seals make donning and doffing the suit that much easier. This steamer offers thermal protection well-suited to active temperate-water and warm-water divers.

Variant.title: Definition Steamer, Herren, 5mm, Schwarz/Blau, S
Variant.description: Der Definition 5MM Steamer bietet mehr Stretch, mehr Komfort und mehr Funktionen. Der Anzug wird mithilfe der Methode „Body Map System“ hergestellt, wobei ein 3D-Schnitt, spezielle Nähverfahren und Materialeinsätze Anwendung finden, um einen Anzug zu schaffen, der wie angegossen sitzt. Der Ultraspan-Brustbereich und Stretchtec-Stoff am Oberkörper sowie an den Seiten, Armen und Beinen erzeugen eine hoch flexible und anliegende Passform, die für zusätzlichen Stretch an kritischen Bereichen sorgt. Größere abriebfeste Schulter-, Knie- und Ellenbogenpartien bieten maximalen Schutz. Dazu erleichtern die neuen und nahtlosen Stretch-Partien mit Doppelreißverschluss-Dichtungen an Armen und Beinen das An- und Ausziehen des Anzugs. Definition Steamer, Herren

Variant.title: Definition Steamer, 5 mm, Uomo, Nero/Blu, S
Variant.description: Lo steamer Definition 5 mm offre maggiore elasticità, miglior comfort e nuove funzionalità. La muta è progettata con Body Map System, un metodo di produzione che utilizza taglio a 3D, cura nei dettagli e inserti di materiali speciali per creare un indumento dalla perfetta vestibilità. Un pannello pettorale in Ultraspan e il tessuto Stretchtec su corpo, fianchi, braccia e gambe contribuiscono all'elevata flessibilità e all'ottima vestibilità, garantendo elasticità extra dove è più necessario. La maggiore protezione dall'abrasione presente sulle imbottiture di spalle, ginocchia e gomiti fornisce il massimo dellamassima protezione. Allo stesso tempo, i nuovi pannelli elasticizzati senza cuciture su braccia e gambe con tenute con doppia cerniera rendono la vestizione e la svestizione della muta ancora più facile. Questo steamer offre una protezione termica idonea per le immersioni attive in acque temperate e per immersioni in acque calde. | Definition Steamer, 5 mm, Uomo, Nero/Blu, S

Values.Value: The Definition 3mm offers a level of warmth and comfort any warm-water diver will love. Proven N2S (Nylon 2 Sides) construction offers the perfect level of warmth and comfort for warm-water diving. Definition Steamer, Damen

Variant.title: Definition Steamer, Donna, 3mm, Rosa/Nero, XL
Variant.description: La muta Definition 3 mm garantisce un livello di calore e comfort che tutti i subacquei di acque calde ameranno. Realizzata con il Body Map System di SCUBAPRO, un metodo di produzione che utilizza taglio a 3D, cura dei dettagli e inserti di materiali speciali per creare un indumento dalla perfetta vestibilità con elasticità extra dove è più necessario e in grado di offrire calore, comfort e durabilità eccellenti. La costruzione collaudata in N2S (Nylon 2 Sides) offre il livello perfetto di calore e comfort per le immersioni in acque calde. Variant.title: Definition Steamer, Damen, 5mm, Schwarz/Türkis, XL
Variant.description: Der Definition 5MM Steamer bietet mehr Stretch, mehr Komfort und mehr Funktionen. Variant.title: Definition Steamer, Donna, 5 mm, Nero/Turchese, XL
Variant.description: Lo steamer Definition 5 mm offre maggiore elasticità, miglior comfort e nuove funzionalità. Variant.description: Der Definition 5MM Steamer bietet mehr Stretch, mehr Komfort und mehr Funktionen. Der Ultraspan-Brustbereich und Stretchtec-Stoff am Oberkörper sowie an den Seiten, Armen und Beinen erzeugen eine hoch flexible und anliegende Passform, die für zusätzlichen Stretch an kritischen Bereichen sorgt. Variant.title: Definition Steamer, 5 mm, Uomo, Nero/Blu, XLS

MultiValue.Value: CE certified as a Class A dive suit – rated for water temperatures ranging from 45ºF to 54ºF.
Suit is assembled using a solvent-free glue.
Ultraspan chest panel and Stretchtec fabric on body, sides, arms and legs work together to produce a highly flexible and snug fit.

Infrared (IR) interior lining on front & back torso reflects body heat for extra thermal insulation and is extremely soft against the skin, in combination with silver plush throughout for comfort and warmth
Diagonal rear YKK zipper with brass slider offers increased long-term durability and ease of use.
An innovative seamless single arm and leg stretch panels, with zippered seals, make donning and doffing the suit even easier.
Spine pad cushions the tank, providing additional comfort during extended dives.
Abrasion-resistant fabric on shoulders and seat, along with bigger abrasion-resistant printed shoulder, elbow and knee pads, cover more exposed areas and increase long-term durability.
Small neck zipper enhances topside comfort, eliminating the need to remove the suit between dives.
I-Safe straps on both arms offer non-slip mounting spots for securing wrist instruments.
Made from X-Foam, a petroleum-free, limestone neoprene.
Embossed and colour printed ‘S’ logo on chest for better stretch and cleaner profile.
Size indications printed on wrist seal, including height, weight & clothes size.

MultiValue.Value: Neoprene is lightweight, durable, water repellant and a highly efficient insulator for heat retention.
Assembled using solvent-free glue, a 100% green process.
High-tech plush and fleece lining reduces water flow and provides both comfort and extra warmth.
Design helps block water intrusion to reduce convection.
Provides effective insulation under water as well as at the surface.
A slightly higher neck delivers maximum comfort and protects from BCD chafing.
Thumb holes are provided to prevent ride-up when worn as an under layer
High-stretch neoprene is easy to don and doff and offers excellent range of motion.
Designed to be worn by itself or with Everflex 1.5mm pants, shorts and leggings.

Values.Value: Everflex Long Sleeve Top, Men, 1.5mm, Black, S

When it comes to thermal protection, nothing beats neoprene. SCUBAPRO’s Everflex 1.5mm long sleeve thermal top keeps you warm while providing protection from scrapes and stings. Sporting a new design and high-tech materials ideal for tropical diving, snorkeling or pool training, this long sleeve warmer is made with a special water-repellant, high-stretch Everflex neoprene on the outside and a combination of fleece and plush on the inside. The top offers warmth, comfort and lots of range of motion, dries quickly and is great for layering. Wear it by itself or match it with new Everflex 1.5mm pants, shorts or leggings for a total warm water ensemble.

Variant.title: Everflex Top Langarm, Herren, 1.5mm, Schwarz, S
Variant.description: Die stylischen Everflex 1, 5 mm Neopren-Tops und Leggings von SCUBAPRO halten dich warm und schützen gleichzeitig vor Verletzungen und Schürfungen. Diese auffälligen Tops und Leggings aus High-Tech Materialien und mit neuem Design sind ideal für Tauchen in den Tropen, Schnorcheln oder das Training im Pool. Sie bestehen aus einem speziellen wasserabweisenden, hochelastischen Everflex-Neopren auf der Außenseite und einer Kombination aus Fleece und Plüsch auf der Innenseite. Sie bieten Wärme, Komfort und viel Bewegungsfreiheit, trocknen schnell und eignen sich hervorragend zum überziehen und Layering. Everflex Top Langarm, Herren

Variant.title: Everflex Top A MANICA LUNGA, Uomo, 1.5mm, Nero, S
Variant.description: Gli eleganti capi in neoprene Everflex 1,5 mm di SCUBAPRO tengono al caldo e proteggono da graffi e punture. Caratterizzati da un nuovo design e da materiali high-tech ideali per le immersioni tropicali, lo snorkeling o l’allenamento in piscina, questi accattivanti top e leggings sono realizzati con uno speciale neoprene Everflex idrorepellente e ad alta elasticità all’esterno e una combinazione di pile e felpa all’interno. Offrono calore, comfort e un’ampia libertà di movimento, inoltre si asciugano rapidamente e sono ideali per la stratificazione. | Everflex Top A MANICA LUNGA, Uomo, 1.5mm, Nero, S

Offering a snug-fitting, flexible dive suit with good thermal properties and minimal water intrusion, the NovaScotia semi-dry is the perfect solution for staying very warm and relatively dry while virtually eliminating hydrodrag, radically improving a diver's ability to move easily through the water. With its 7.6/6.5mm thickness, easy-zip waterproof YKK Aquaseal Vislon zipper, improved plush lining to increase warmth and stretch, and a long list of convenience features, the NovaScotia is the diver's answer to a comfortable, affordable semi-dry suit. Positioned between a traditional wetsuit and a neoprene drysuit, the NovaScotia delivers the best of both worlds in cold water, temperate water, and multi-dive protection.

Variant.title: Novascotia, Inkl. Kopfhaube, Herren, 7.5mm, Schwarz, LT
Variant.description: Der Halbtrockentauchanzug NovaScotia 7, 5MM bietet besseren Wärmeschutz als jeder andere Nasstauchanzug auf dem Markt. Er besitzt eine CE-Kennzeichnung als Tauchanzug der Klasse A. Das ist die höchste Bewertung, die ein Anzug dieser Art erhalten kann. Der aus hochwertigem Neopren bestehende, gemäß dem Pure Design Concept entworfene NovaScotia 7, 5MM ist der ultimative Wärmeschutz in kaltem Wasser und bei mehreren Tauchgängen. Novascotia, Inkl. Kopfhaube, Herren

Variant.title: NovaScotia Muta Semi-Stagna Con Cap, 7,5 mm, Uomo, Nero, LT

Realizzata in neoprene di qualità e incorporando Pure Design Concept, NovaScotia 7,5 mm offre una protezione termica eccezionale per immersioni multiple e in acque fredde. | NovaScotia Muta Semi-Stagna Con Cap, 7,5 mm, Uomo, Nero, LT

Diagonal rear YKK zipper with brass slider offers increased long-term durability and ease of use.

I-Safe straps on both arms offer non-slip mounting spots for securing wrist instruments.
Made from X-Foam, a petroleum-free, limestone neoprene.

Variant.title: Definition Steamer, Herren, 7mm, Schwarz/Blau, XLT

Variant.title: Definition Steamer, Uomo, 7mm, XLT

16.93 in x 0.59 in | 43 cm x 1.5 cm

MultiValue.Value: Softer and more flexible neoprene makes it easy to put on and take off, maximizes range of motion and improves overall comfort.
Main vertical-cut YKK rear zipper with KA brass slider offers increase long-term durability and ease of use.
The interior is lined with a plush material that enhances comfort and warmth and dries quickly.
Glued and blind-stitched seams keep warmth in and water out.
Abrasion-resistant fabric on shoulders, seat and knees protects against shifting gear or when sitting or kneeling.
Suits are assembled using a solvent free glue, a 100% green process.

Values.Value: This new-generation, ultra-comfortable 3mm steamer has been added to the Sport suit family. Designed for new divers, casual divers, and first-time suit buyers who enjoy warm water diving in moderate to shallow depths, the Sport 3mm is made from extremely soft and flexible neoprene and features a triathlon cut. This allows for a bigger range of motion in the shoulder and arm areas, delivering maximum freedom of movement on the boat and in the water. The suit features flat-lock stitching, a vertical rear zipper and comfortable plush inside wrists. It is easy to put on and take off, fits like a second skin and looks great.

Variant.title: Sport Steamer, Heren, 3mm, Gelb, S
Variant.description: Dieser extrem komfortable 3 mm Steamer wurde sowohl für Einsteiger als auch Sporttaucher entwickelt und eignet sich perfekt zum Tauchen in wärmeren Gewässern und moderaten Tiefen. Der SPORT 3 ist aus besonders weichem Material gefertigt und verfügt über einen Triathlon-Schnitt, was erhöhte Bewegungsfreiheit im Arm- und Beinbereich ermöglicht. Der Sport 3 wird somit zu einem äußerst komfortablen Anzug, sowohl auf dem Boot als auch im Wasser. Der Anzug hat flache Steppnähte, einenvertikalen Reißverschluss hinten und weiches Innenfutter an Hand- und Fußgelenken. Der SPORT 3 ist äußerst komfortabel an- und auszuziehen, sitzt wie eine zweite Haut und sieht einfach super aus! Sport Steamer, Heren, 3mm

Variant.title: Sport Steamer, Uomo, 3mm, Giallo, S
Variant.description: Questo comodissimo steamer da 3 mm di nuova generazione è stato aggiunto alla famiglia delle mute Sport. Progettato per chi è nuovo nel mondo delle immersioni, per i subacquei occasionali e per chi acquista una muta per la prima volta e si cimenta in immersioni poco profonde, lo Sport 3 mm è realizzato in neoprene estremamente morbido e flessibile e dispone di un taglio tipo triathlon. Quest’ultimo aspetto aumenta la mobilità nelle zone di spalle e braccia, garantendo massima libertà di movimento sia a bordo che nell'acqua. La muta dispone di cuciture, zip verticale e di un comodo tessuto felpato nella parte interna dei polsi. È facile da indossare e da rimuovere, aderisce come una seconda pelle e conferisce un aspetto accattivante. | Sport Steamer, Uomo, 3mm, Giallo, S
