Rear shoulder-to-shoulder YKK Aquaseal Vislon waterproof main zipper with heavy-duty plastic slider is flexible yet provides an excellent seal against water entry.
Plush interior liner in the arms, legs and shoulder areas increases warmth and stretch.
Double zippered seals on ankles and wrists feature KA brass sliders for durability, water-tightness and ease of use.

Shoulders and kneepads feature both anti-abrasion patterns and extra rubber prints to provide protection while adding a stylish look.
Enhanced spine pad provides a welcomed cushion where the tank hits the diver's back.
I-Safe straps on both arms offer non slip mounting spots for securing wrist instruments.
Made from 100% Everflex neoprene for comfort and durability.
Suits are assembled using a solvent free glue, a 100% green process.

Values.Value: NovaScotia Semi-Dry, w/Hood, Men, 7.5mm, Black, LS
Heavy Duty on Shoulder, Knee & Seat

Offering a snug-fitting, flexible dive suit with good thermal properties and minimal water intrusion, the NovaScotia semi-dry is the perfect solution for staying very warm and relatively dry while virtually eliminating hydrodrag, radically improving a diver's ability to move easily through the water. With its 7.6/6.5mm thickness, easy-zip waterproof YKK Aquaseal Vislon zipper, improved plush lining to increase warmth and stretch, and a long list of convenience features, the NovaScotia is the diver's answer to a comfortable, affordable semi-dry suit. Positioned between a traditional wetsuit and a neoprene drysuit, the NovaScotia delivers the best of both worlds in cold water, temperate water, and multi-dive protection.

Variant.title: Novascotia, Inkl. Kopfhaube, Herren, 7.5mm, Schwarz, LS
Variant.description: Der Halbtrockentauchanzug NovaScotia 7, 5MM bietet besseren Wärmeschutz als jeder andere Nasstauchanzug auf dem Markt. Er besitzt eine CE-Kennzeichnung als Tauchanzug der Klasse A. Das ist die höchste Bewertung, die ein Anzug dieser Art erhalten kann. Der aus hochwertigem Neopren bestehende, gemäß dem Pure Design Concept entworfene NovaScotia 7, 5MM ist der ultimative Wärmeschutz in kaltem Wasser und bei mehreren Tauchgängen. Novascotia, Inkl. Kopfhaube, Herren

Variant.title: NovaScotia Muta Semi-Stagna Con Cap, 7,5 mm, Uomo, Nero, LS

È certificata CE come muta di Classe A, la classificazione più elevata che una muta di questo tipo possa ottenere. Realizzata in neoprene di qualità e incorporando Pure Design Concept, NovaScotia 7,5 mm offre una protezione termica eccezionale per immersioni multiple e in acque fredde. | NovaScotia Muta Semi-Stagna Con Cap, 7,5 mm, Uomo, Nero, LS

MultiValue.Value: Neoprene is lightweight, durable, water repellant and a highly efficient insulator for heat retention.
Assembled using solvent-free glue, a 100% green process.
High-tech plush and fleece lining reduces water flow and provides both comfort and extra warmth.
Design helps block water intrusion to reduce convection.
Provides effective insulation under water as well as at the surface.
Form-fitting for that sleek hydrodynamic look and feel.
High-stretch neoprene is easy to don and doff and offers excellent range of motion.
Designed to be worn by itself or with Everflex 1.5mm long sleeve or short sleeve thermal tops.

Values.Value: When it comes to thermal protection, nothing beats neoprene. SCUBAPRO’s Everflex 1.5mm neoprene pants keep you warm while providing protection from scrapes and stings. Sporting a new design and high-tech materials ideal for tropical diving, snorkeling or pool training, these thermal pants are made with a special water-repellant, high-stretch Everflex neoprene on the outside and a combination of fleece and plush on the inside. They offer warmth, comfort and lots of range of motion, plus they dry quickly and are great for layering. Wear a pair with a new Everflex 1.5mm thermal top for a total warm water ensemble.

Variant.title: Everflex Hose, Herren, 1.5mm, Schwarz, M
Variant.description: Die stylischen Everflex 1, 5 mm Neopren-Tops und Leggings von SCUBAPRO halten dich warm und schützen gleichzeitig vor Verletzungen und Schürfungen. Diese auffälligen Tops und Leggings aus High-Tech Materialien und mit neuem Design sind ideal für Tauchen in den Tropen, Schnorcheln oder das Training im Pool. Sie bestehen aus einem speziellen wasserabweisenden, hochelastischen Everflex-Neopren auf der Außenseite und einer Kombination aus Fleece und Plüsch auf der Innenseite. Sie bieten Wärme, Komfort und viel Bewegungsfreiheit, trocknen schnell und eignen sich hervorragend zum überziehen und Layering. Everflex Hose, Herren

Variant.title: Everflex Pantaloni, Uomo, 1.5mm, Nero, M
Variant.description: Gli eleganti capi in neoprene Everflex 1,5 mm di SCUBAPRO tengono al caldo e proteggono da graffi e punture. Caratterizzati da un nuovo design e da materiali high-tech ideali per le immersioni tropicali, lo snorkeling o l’allenamento in piscina, questi accattivanti top e leggings sono realizzati con uno speciale neoprene Everflex idrorepellente e ad alta elasticità all’esterno e una combinazione di pile e felpa all’interno. Offrono calore, comfort e un’ampia libertà di movimento, inoltre si asciugano rapidamente e sono ideali per la stratificazione. | Everflex Pantaloni, Uomo, 1.5mm, Nero, M

Values.Value: This ultra-comfortable 3mm steamer has been added to the Sport suit family. Designed for new divers, casual divers, and first-time suit buyers who enjoy warm water diving in moderate to shallow depths, the Sport 3mm is made from extremely soft and flexible neoprene and features a triathlon cut. This allows for a bigger range of motion in the shoulder and arm areas, delivering maximum freedom of movement on the boat and in the water. The suit features flat-lock stitching, a vertical rear zipper and comfortable plush inside wrists. It is easy to put on and take off, fits like a second skin and looks great.

Variant.title: Sport Steamer, Damen, 3mm, Türkis, 2XL
Variant.description: Dieser extrem komfortable 3 mm Steamer wurde sowohl für Einsteiger als auch Sporttaucher entwickelt und eignet sich perfekt zum Tauchen in wärmeren Gewässern und moderaten Tiefen. Der Sport 3 wird somit zu einem äußerst komfortablen Anzug, sowohl auf dem Boot als auch im Wasser. Der Anzug hat flache Steppnähte, einen vertikalen Reißverschluss hinten und weiches Innenfutter an Hand- und Fußgelenken. Der SPORT 3 ist äußerst komfortabel an- und auszuziehen, sitzt wie eine zweite Haut und sieht einfach super aus! Sport Steamer, Damen

Quest’ultimo aspetto aumenta la mobilità nelle zone di spalle e braccia, garantendo massima libertà di movimento sia a bordo che nell'acqua. Values.Value: NovaScotia Semi-Dry, w/Hood, Men, 7.5mm, Black, XLT
Heavy Duty on Shoulder, Knee & Seat

Offering a snug-fitting, flexible dive suit with good thermal properties and minimal water intrusion, the NovaScotia semi-dry is the perfect solution for staying very warm and relatively dry while virtually eliminating hydrodrag, radically improving a diver's ability to move easily through the water. With its 7.6/6.5mm thickness, easy-zip waterproof YKK Aquaseal Vislon zipper, improved plush lining to increase warmth and stretch, and a long list of convenience features, the NovaScotia is the diver's answer to a comfortable, affordable semi-dry suit. Positioned between a traditional wetsuit and a neoprene drysuit, the NovaScotia delivers the best of both worlds in cold water, temperate water, and multi-dive protection.

Heavy Duty on Shoulder, Knee & Seat

Offering straight-forward styling, Oneflex suits are designed with a triathlon cut that allows for lots of range of motion in the shoulder and arm areas. They are also built using the Pure Design Concept which uses fewer seams and panels for maximum flexibility, and their 2-sided polyester lining is ultra-durable yet stretchy and comfortable. The addition of outside stretch fabric on arms and armpits contribute to making the suits much easier to don and doff while increasing comfort and freedom of movement, design elements much appreciated by beginning divers. The diagonal rear YKK zipper design is familiar to most divers and easy to use.

Values.Value: Heavy Duty on Shoulder, Knee & Seat

Offering straight-forward styling, Oneflex suits are designed with a triathlon cut that allows for lots of range of motion in the shoulder and arm areas. They are also built using the Pure Design Concept which uses fewer seams and panels for maximum flexibility, and their 2-sided polyester lining is ultra-durable yet stretchy and comfortable. The addition of outside stretch fabric on arms and armpits contribute to making the suits much easier to don and doff while increasing comfort and freedom of movement, design elements much appreciated by beginning divers. The diagonal rear YKK zipper design is familiar to most divers and easy to use.

Values.Value: Comfortable and stretchy, Hybrid Cargo Shorts form-fit to your body like you were born wearing a pair. Made from a mix of quality 1mm neoprene and nylon, on the inside a micro-plush lining makes the shorts warm and cozy. This plush lining absorbs less water, increasing overall warmth, plus dries quickly. The updated design features a new adjustable waist belt that replaces the prior drawstring. The belt threads through a series of belt loops and includes an easy-to-use male/female squeeze buckle closure. A new anti-abrasion fabric on the seat panel enhances durability, and the two large cargo pockets are handy for carrying money, sunglasses or other accessories when enjoying a day on the beach or dive boat. Hybrid Cargo Shorts are designed to be worn either by themselves or over a dive suit.

Variant.title: HYBRID-CARGO-SHORT, Damen, 1mm, XS
Variant.description: Die neuen Hybrid-Cargo-Shorts sind elastisch und sind durch ihren körpernahen Schnitt äußerst bequem und angenehm zu tragen. Sie bestehen aus einer Mischung von hochwertigem 1-mm-Neopren und Nylon, das Mikro-Plüschfutter auf der Innenseite macht sie warm und komfortabel. Das Plüschfutter absorbiert weniger Wasser, erhöht so die Wärmeleistung und trocknet schnell. Das überarbeitete Design umfasst einen neuen anpassbaren Gürtel, der den vorherigen Tunnelzug ersetzt. Der Gürtel verläuft durch mehrere Schlaufen und endet in einer einfach zu bedienenden Unisex-Steckschnalle. Ein neues, abriebresistentes Material im Gesäßbereich erhöht die Haltbarkeit; die beiden großen Cargo-Taschen eignen sich perfekt für Geld, Sonnenbrille und andere Gegenstände, wenn du den Tag am Strand oder auf einem Tauchboot verbringst. Die Hybrid-Cargo-Shorts kann einzeln oder über einem Tauchanzug getragen werden. HYBRID-CARGO-SHORT, Damen

Variant.title: Hybrid Cargo Shorts, Donna, 1mm, XS
Variant.description: Comodi ed elastici, i pantaloncini Cargo Hybrid si adattano al tuo corpo perfettamente. Realizzati in un mix di neoprene di qualità da 1 mm e nylon con all’interno una fodera in micro-peluche che rende questi pantaloncini caldi e comodi. La fodera in peluche assorbe meno acqua, aumentando il calore generale e si asciuga rapidamente. Il nuovo design presenta una cintura in vita regolabile che sostituisce la coulisse precedente. La cintura si infila attraverso una serie di passanti per cintura e include una chiusura con fibbia a pressione maschio / femmina di facile utilizzo. Un nuovo tessuto antiabrasione sulla seduta migliora la durata e le due grandi tasche cargo sono utili per trasportare denaro, occhiali da sole o altri accessori quando si gode una giornata in spiaggia o in barca. I pantaloncini Hybrid Cargo sono progettati per essere indossati da soli o sopra una muta da sub, | Hybrid Cargo Shorts, Donna, 1mm, XS

MultiValue.Value: Pure Design Concept uses fewer seams and panels for maximum range of motion.
Multi-thickness panels deliver a combination of warmth and flexibility.

Blue Diamond Span inner fleece lining’s warm and water-draining material enhances cold-water protection. It is combined with a second black lining for improved stretch, also making donning and doffing much easier.
Wrists and ankles feature fuse-cut finished cuffs that are super-stretchy for easy donning and exceptional comfort.
Double blind-stitched outer seams are durable and a glued inner seam provides added comfort.

Seat and shoulder areas are protected by an abrasion resistant outside lining to increase durability and extend the life of the suit. Printed pads on knees and shoulders provide additional abrasion protection.
Vertical rear YKK zipper with brass slider offers increased long-term durability, and the long webbing puller makes it easy to use.
YULEX® dive: Plant-based foam made from FSC-certified-natural rubber. 100 % neoprene-free.
YULEX® dive is specifically formulated to resist wetsuit compression while diving.
Interior & exterior black polyester lining made from recycled plastic bottles.
CE certified as a Class C dive suit – rated for water temperatures ranging from 61ºF (16ºC) to 75.2ºF (24ºC).

Values.Value: Everflex YULEX® Dive Steamer, Men, 3/2mm, S

Everflex YULEX® Dive steamers offer the same award-winning comfort and thermal protection that have made Everflex our best-selling wetsuit. They are designed with SCUBAPRO’S exclusive Pure Design Concept, with just enough multi-thickness panels to guarantee maximum stretch and comfort. They fit comfortably snug and deliver unparalleled freedom of movement. As an alternative to neoprene, Everflex utilizes a plant-based foam, YULEX® dive, made from FSC-certified-natural rubber. YULEX® dive is specifically formulated to resist wetsuit compression while diving and is 100 % neoprene-free.

Variant.title: Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge, Herren, 3/2mm, S
Variant.description: Die Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge bieten den gleichen preisgekrönten Komfort und Wärmeschutz, der Everflex zu unserem meistverkauften Neoprenanzug gemacht hat. Die YULEX® Dive wurde nach dem exklusiven Pure Design Concept von SCUBAPRO entworfen, eine Technik bei der unterschiedlich starke Neoprenpanels zu zusammen gesetzt werden, um maximale Dehnbarkeit und höchsten Komfort zu garantieren. Sie liegen komfortabel eng am Körper und bieten dabei eine einzigartige Bewegungsfreiheit. Als Alternative zu Neopren verwendet Everflex YULEX® dive, einen Schaumstoff auf pflanzlicher Basis, der aus FSC-zertifiziertem Naturkautschuk hergestellt wird. YULEX® dive wurde speziell entwickelt, um der Kompression beim Tauchen zu widerstehen und ist zu 100 % neoprenfrei. Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge, Herren

Variant.title: Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge, Damen, 5/4mm, XS
Variant.description: Die Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge bieten den gleichen preisgekrönten Komfort und Wärmeschutz, der Everflex zu unserem meistverkauften Neoprenanzug gemacht hat. Die YULEX® Dive wurde nach dem exklusiven Pure Design Concept von SCUBAPRO entworfen, eine Technik bei der unterschiedlich starke Neoprenpanels zu zusammen gesetzt werden, um maximale Dehnbarkeit und höchsten Komfort zu garantieren. Sie liegen komfortabel eng am Körper und bieten dabei eine einzigartige Bewegungsfreiheit. Als Alternative zu Neopren verwendet Everflex YULEX® dive, einen Schaumstoff auf pflanzlicher Basis, der aus FSC-zertifiziertem Naturkautschuk hergestellt wird. YULEX® dive wurde speziell entwickelt, um der Kompression beim Tauchen zu widerstehen und ist zu 100 % neoprenfrei. Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge, Damen
Variant.product_type: Home DE,Kälteschutz,Nasstauchanzüge,Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge Damen

Variant.title: Steamer Everflex YULEX® Dive, Donna, 5/4mm, XS
Variant.description: Gli steamer Everflex in YULEX® Dive continuano a offrire le stesse pluripremiate caratteristiche di comfort e protezione termica che li hanno resi la scelta di riferimento per i sub di tutto il mondo. Sono ovviamente realizzati in base all’esclusivo Pure Design Concept di SCUBAPRO, che prevede un abbinamento ottimale di pannelli di spessore multiplo per garantire la massima elasticità e il massimo comfort. Offrono una vestibilità aderente e allo stesso tempo confortevole che permette una libertà di movimento senza eguali. YULEX® dive e una chiuma a base vegetale realizzata con gomma naturale certificata FSC. YULEX® Dive è formulata specificamente per resistere alla compressione della muta durante le immersioni. 100% senza neoprene. | Steamer Everflex YULEX® Dive, Donna, 5/4mm, XS

I-Safe straps on both arms offer non-slip mounting spots for securing wrist instruments.
CE certified as a Class B dive suit – rated for water temperatures ranging from 50ºF (10ºC) to 64.5ºF (18ºC).

Values.Value: Everflex YULEX® Dive steamers offer the same award-winning comfort and thermal protection that have made Everflex our best-selling wetsuit. They fit comfortably snug and deliver unparalleled freedom of movement. As an alternative to neoprene, Everflex utilizes a plant-based foam, YULEX® dive, made from FSC-certified-natural rubber. YULEX® dive is specifically formulated to resist wetsuit compression while diving and is 100 % neoprene-free.

Values.Value: Delivering optimal comfort and flexibility, this lightweight steamer is made with 1mm X-Foam neoprene with an outside super-stretch nylon lining and an inside mix of plush on the front and back of the torso and super-stretch nylon on all other panels. It comes with a diagonal rear zipper with brass slider and abrasion-resistant fabric on the seat and elbows. Shoulders and knees also offer abrasion-resistant fabric reinforced with printed pads. Variant.title: Definition Steamer, Herren, 1mm, Schwarz, S
Variant.description: Dieser leichte Steamer bietet optimalen Komfort und höchste Flexibilität. Das Top besteht aus hochwertigem 1mm X-Foam Neopren mit einem Super-Stretch-Nylon-Futter, am Brust- und Rückenbereich verfügt es über ein Plüsch-Innenfutter. Er ist mit einem diagonalen Reißverschluss mit Messingschlitten und abriebfestem Gewebe an Gesäß und Ellbogen ausgestattet. An Schultern und Knie ist der Anzug mit abriebfeste Materialverstärkungen ausgestattet. Fußschlaufen verhindern das Hochrutschen bei der Verwendung als Unterzieher unter einem dickeren Neoprenanzug. Dieser Steamer bietet den perfekten Ganzkörperschutz für Schwimmbadtraining, Tauchen in warmen Gewässern oder als wärmende Schicht bei allen Wassersportaktivitäten. Definition Steamer, Herren

Variant.title: Definition Steamer, Uomo, 1mm, Nero, S
Variant.description: In grado di offrire un mix ottimale tra comfort e elasticità, questo steamer leggero è realizzato in neoprene X-Foam da 1 mm, con un rivestimento esterno in nylon super-elasticizzato e, all’interno, un tessuto felpato sulla parte anteriore e posteriore del torso e, di nuovo, un nylon super-elasticizzato per tutti gli altri pannelli. È dotato di una cerniera posteriore con cursore in ottone e di un tessuto resistente alle abrasioni sulla seduta e sui gomiti. Anche le spalle e le ginocchia sono dotate di rinforzi stampati realizzati in tessuto resistente all’abrasione. I sottopiedi ne evitano la risalita quando indossato sotto una muta umida più spessa. Questo steamer offre il livello perfetto di protezione su tutto il corpo per gli allenamenti in piscina, per le immersioni in acque calde o come strato aggiuntivo per qualsiasi sport acquatico. | Definition Steamer, Uomo, 1mm, Nero, S

Variant.title: Sport Steamer, Herren, 0.5MM, S
Variant.description: Dieser vielseitige, ultradünne Neoprenanzug kann als Wärmeschutz beim Pooltraining, als Warmwasseranzug oder als Unterzieher unter einem dickeren Neoprenanzug beim Kaltwassertauchen verwendet werden. Der leichte Steamer aus extrem weichem 0, 5 mm Neopren mit elastischem beidseitigem Nylonfutter verfügt über einen vertikalen YKK-Reißverschluss mit Messingschlitten für einfaches An- und Ausziehen. Sport Steamer, Herren

Variant.title: Sport Steamer, Uomo, 0.5MM, S

Realizzato in neoprene estremamente morbido da 0,5 mm e con un rivestimento elasticizzato in Nylon 2 Sides, questo steamer leggero è dotato di una cerniera verticale YKK con cursore in ottone per facilitare la vestizione e la svestizione e di passanti per i piedi per evitarne la risalita quando indossato come strato intermedio. MultiValue.Value: Pure Design Concept uses fewer seams and panels for maximum range of motion.
Multi-thickness panels deliver a combination of warmth and flexibility.

Blue Diamond Span inner fleece lining’s warm and water-draining material enhances cold-water protection. It is combined with a second black lining for improved stretch, also making donning and doffing much easier.
Inner forearm & calf seals with zippered cuffs on ankles and wrists feature YKK brass sliders for durability, watertightness and easy donning
Double blind-stitched outer seams are durable and watertight, and single blind-stitched inner seams are comfortable against bare skin.

Seat and shoulder areas are protected by an abrasion resistant outside lining to increase durability and extend the life of the suit. Printed pads on knees and shoulders provide additional abrasion protection.
Vertical rear YKK zipper with brass slider offers increased long-term durability, and the long webbing puller makes it easy to use.
YULEX® dive: Plant-based foam made from FSC-certified-natural rubber. 100 % neoprene-free.
YULEX® dive is specifically formulated to resist wetsuit compression while diving.
Interior & exterior black polyester lining made from recycled plastic bottles.
I-Safe straps on both arms offer non-slip mounting spots for securing wrist instruments.
CE certified as a Class A dive suit -- rated for water temperatures ranging from 45ºF (7ºC ) to 54ºF (12ºC).

Values.Value: Everflex YULEX® Dive Steamer, Men, 7.5/5.0mm, S

Everflex YULEX® Dive steamers offer the same award-winning comfort and thermal protection that have made Everflex our best-selling wetsuit. They are designed with SCUBAPRO’S exclusive Pure Design Concept, with just enough multi-thickness panels to guarantee maximum stretch and comfort. They fit comfortably snug and deliver unparalleled freedom of movement. As an alternative to neoprene, Everflex utilizes a plant-based foam, YULEX® dive, made from FSC-certified-natural rubber. YULEX® dive is specifically formulated to resist wetsuit compression while diving and is 100 % neoprene-free.

Variant.title: Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge, Herren, 7.5/5.0mm, S
Variant.description: Die Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge bieten den gleichen preisgekrönten Komfort und Wärmeschutz, der Everflex zu unserem meistverkauften Neoprenanzug gemacht hat. Die YULEX® Dive wurde nach dem exklusiven Pure Design Concept von SCUBAPRO entworfen, eine Technik bei der unterschiedlich starke Neoprenpanels zu zusammen gesetzt werden, um maximale Dehnbarkeit und höchsten Komfort zu garantieren. Sie liegen komfortabel eng am Körper und bieten dabei eine einzigartige Bewegungsfreiheit. Als Alternative zu Neopren verwendet Everflex YULEX® dive, einen Schaumstoff auf pflanzlicher Basis, der aus FSC-zertifiziertem Naturkautschuk hergestellt wird. YULEX® dive wurde speziell entwickelt, um der Kompression beim Tauchen zu widerstehen und ist zu 100 % neoprenfrei. Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge, Herren
Variant.product_type: Home DE,Kälteschutz,Nasstauchanzüge,Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge Herren

Variant.title: Steamer Everflex YULEX® Dive, Uomo, 7.5/5.0mm, S

MultiValue.Value: Pure Design Concept uses fewer seams and panels for maximum range of motion.
Multi-thickness panels deliver a combination of warmth and flexibility.

Blue Diamond Span inner fleece lining’s warm and water-draining material enhances cold-water protection. It is combined with a second black lining for improved stretch, also making donning and doffing much easier.
Internal cuff seals with zippered cuffs on ankles and wrists feature YKK brass sliders for durability, watertightness and easy donning.
Double blind-stitched outer seams are durable and watertight, and single blind-stitched inner seams are comfortable against bare skin.

Seat and shoulder areas are protected by an abrasion resistant outside lining to increase durability and extend the life of the suit. Printed pads on knees and shoulders provide additional abrasion protection.
Vertical rear YKK zipper with brass slider offers increased long-term durability, and the long webbing puller makes it easy to use.
YULEX® dive: Plant-based foam made from FSC-certified-natural rubber. 100 % neoprene-free.
YULEX® dive is specifically formulated to resist wetsuit compression while diving.
Interior & exterior black polyester lining made from recycled plastic bottles.
I-Safe straps on both arms offer non-slip mounting spots for securing wrist instruments.
CE certified as a Class A dive suit -- rated for water temperatures ranging from 45ºF (7ºC ) to 54ºF (12ºC).

Values.Value: Everflex YULEX® Dive steamers offer the same award-winning comfort and thermal protection that have made Everflex our best-selling wetsuit. They are designed with SCUBAPRO’S exclusive Pure Design Concept, with just enough multi-thickness panels to guarantee maximum stretch and comfort. They fit comfortably snug and deliver unparalleled freedom of movement. As an alternative to neoprene, Everflex utilizes a plant-based foam, YULEX® dive, made from FSC-certified-natural rubber. YULEX® dive is specifically formulated to resist wetsuit compression while diving and is 100 % neoprene-free.

Variant.title: Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge, Damen, 7.5/5.0mm, XS
Variant.description: Die Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge bieten den gleichen preisgekrönten Komfort und Wärmeschutz, der Everflex zu unserem meistverkauften Neoprenanzug gemacht hat. Die YULEX® Dive wurde nach dem exklusiven Pure Design Concept von SCUBAPRO entworfen, eine Technik bei der unterschiedlich starke Neoprenpanels zu zusammen gesetzt werden, um maximale Dehnbarkeit und höchsten Komfort zu garantieren. Sie liegen komfortabel eng am Körper und bieten dabei eine einzigartige Bewegungsfreiheit. Als Alternative zu Neopren verwendet Everflex YULEX® dive, einen Schaumstoff auf pflanzlicher Basis, der aus FSC-zertifiziertem Naturkautschuk hergestellt wird. YULEX® dive wurde speziell entwickelt, um der Kompression beim Tauchen zu widerstehen und ist zu 100 % neoprenfrei. Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge, Damen
Variant.product_type: Home DE,Kälteschutz,Nasstauchanzüge,Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge Damen

Variant.title: Steamer Everflex YULEX® Dive, Donna, 7.5/5.0mm, XS
Variant.description: Gli steamer Everflex in YULEX® Dive continuano a offrire le stesse pluripremiate caratteristiche di comfort e protezione termica che li hanno resi la scelta di riferimento per i sub di tutto il mondo. Sono ovviamente realizzati in base all’esclusivo Pure Design Concept di SCUBAPRO, che prevede un abbinamento ottimale di pannelli di spessore multiplo per garantire la massima elasticità e il massimo comfort. Offrono una vestibilità aderente e allo stesso tempo confortevole che permette una libertà di movimento senza eguali. YULEX® dive e una chiuma a base vegetale realizzata con gomma naturale certificata FSC. YULEX® Dive è formulata specificamente per resistere alla compressione della muta durante le immersioni. 100% senza neoprene. | Steamer Everflex YULEX® Dive, Donna, 7.5/5.0mm, XS

Die YULEX® Dive wurde nach dem exklusiven Pure Design Concept von SCUBAPRO entworfen, eine Technik bei der unterschiedlich starke Neoprenpanels zu zusammen gesetzt werden, um maximale Dehnbarkeit und höchsten Komfort zu garantieren. Sie liegen komfortabel eng am Körper und bieten dabei eine einzigartige Bewegungsfreiheit. Als Alternative zu Neopren verwendet Everflex YULEX® dive, einen Schaumstoff auf pflanzlicher Basis, der aus FSC-zertifiziertem Naturkautschuk hergestellt wird. YULEX® dive wurde speziell entwickelt, um der Kompression beim Tauchen zu widerstehen und ist zu 100 % neoprenfrei. Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge, Damen
Variant.product_type: Home DE,Kälteschutz,Nasstauchanzüge,Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge Damen

Variant.title: Steamer Everflex YULEX® Dive, Donna, 7.5/5.0mm, M
Variant.description: Gli steamer Everflex in YULEX® Dive continuano a offrire le stesse pluripremiate caratteristiche di comfort e protezione termica che li hanno resi la scelta di riferimento per i sub di tutto il mondo. Sono ovviamente realizzati in base all’esclusivo Pure Design Concept di SCUBAPRO, che prevede un abbinamento ottimale di pannelli di spessore multiplo per garantire la massima elasticità e il massimo comfort. Offrono una vestibilità aderente e allo stesso tempo confortevole che permette una libertà di movimento senza eguali. YULEX® dive e una chiuma a base vegetale realizzata con gomma naturale certificata FSC. YULEX® Dive è formulata specificamente per resistere alla compressione della muta durante le immersioni. 100% senza neoprene. | Steamer Everflex YULEX® Dive, Donna, 7.5/5.0mm, M

MultiValue.Value: Pure Design Concept uses fewer seams and panels for maximum range of motion.
Multi-thickness panels deliver a combination of warmth and flexibility.

Blue Diamond Span inner fleece lining’s warm and water-draining material enhances cold-water protection. It is combined with a second black lining for improved stretch, also making donning and doffing much easier.
Inner forearm & calf seals with zippered cuffs on ankles and wrists feature YKK brass sliders for durability, watertightness and easy donning
Double blind-stitched outer seams are durable and watertight, and single blind-stitched inner seams are comfortable against bare skin.

Seat and shoulder areas are protected by an abrasion resistant outside lining to increase durability and extend the life of the suit. Printed pads on knees and shoulders provide additional abrasion protection.
Vertical rear YKK zipper with brass slider offers increased long-term durability, and the long webbing puller makes it easy to use.
YULEX® dive: Plant-based foam made from FSC-certified-natural rubber. 100 % neoprene-free.
YULEX® dive is specifically formulated to resist wetsuit compression while diving.
Interior & exterior black polyester lining made from recycled plastic bottles.
I-Safe straps on both arms offer non-slip mounting spots for securing wrist instruments.
CE certified as a Class A dive suit -- rated for water temperatures ranging from 45ºF (7ºC ) to 54ºF (12ºC).

Sie liegen komfortabel eng am Körper und bieten dabei eine einzigartige Bewegungsfreiheit. Als Alternative zu Neopren verwendet Everflex YULEX® dive, einen Schaumstoff auf pflanzlicher Basis, der aus FSC-zertifiziertem Naturkautschuk hergestellt wird. YULEX® dive wurde speziell entwickelt, um der Kompression beim Tauchen zu widerstehen und ist zu 100 % neoprenfrei. Everflex YULEX® Dive Anzüge, Damen

MultiValue.Value: Pure Design Concept uses fewer seams and panels for maximum range of motion.
Multi-thickness panels deliver a combination of warmth and flexibility.

Blue Diamond Span inner fleece lining’s warm and water-draining material enhances cold-water protection. It is combined with a second black lining for improved stretch, also making donning and doffing much easier.
Internal cuff seals with zippered cuffs on ankles and wrists feature YKK brass sliders for durability, watertightness and easy donning.
Double blind-stitched outer seams are durable and watertight, and single blind-stitched inner seams are comfortable against bare skin.

Seat and shoulder areas are protected by an abrasion resistant outside lining to increase durability and extend the life of the suit. Printed pads on knees and shoulders provide additional abrasion protection.
Vertical rear YKK zipper with brass slider offers increased long-term durability, and the long webbing puller makes it easy to use.
YULEX® dive: Plant-based foam made from FSC-certified-natural rubber. 100 % neoprene-free.
YULEX® dive is specifically formulated to resist wetsuit compression while diving.
Interior & exterior black polyester lining made from recycled plastic bottles.
I-Safe straps on both arms offer non-slip mounting spots for securing wrist instruments.
CE certified as a Class A dive suit -- rated for water temperatures ranging from 45ºF (7ºC ) to 54ºF (12ºC).

MultiValue.Value: Large volume cargo pockets offer plenty of space for carrying valuables.
hook & loop pocket flaps are easy to open, even while wearing gloves
Large-diameter pocket eyelets drain water fast.
Internal bungees and D-ring inside pockets provide attachment points for accessories.
Small zippered pocket on the exterior of the main pocket flap is a great place for stowing smaller items.
Made with 1mm X-Foam neoprene for warmth and durable nylon for stretch and comfort.
Adjustable waist belt includes an easy-to-use male/female squeeze buckle closure.
Abrasion-resistant fabric on the seat panel provides additional protection.
Form-fitting for that sleek hydrodynamic look and feel.
Highly versatile – ideal for divers, snorkelers, paddle boarders, swimmers and other water enthusiasts too.
Available in both men’s and women’s sizes.

Values.Value: Hybrid Cargo Shorts offer all of the features of Hybrid Cargo Pants, in a short design that maintains function. The form-fitting Hybrid Cargo Shorts are made of quality 1mm X-Foam neoprene and stretchy nylon. On the inside, a micro-plush lining makes the shorts warm and cozy. This plush lining absorbs less water, increasing overall warmth, plus dries quickly. Hybrid Cargo Shorts come with large hook & loop pockets featuring internal bungees and a D-ring, along with large fast-draining eyelets and an additional zippered pocket for stowing small valuables. The shorts come with an adjustable waist belt that threads through a series of belt loops and includes an easy-to-use male/female squeeze buckle closure. Anti-abrasion fabric on the seat panel enhances durability. Designed to be worn either by themselves or over a dive suit, Hybrid Cargo Shorts are perfect for enjoying a day in the water.

Variant.title: Hybrid Cargo Shorts, Herren, 1mm, S
Variant.description: Die körpernahen Hybrid Cargo Shorts sind aus hochwertigem 1mm X-Foam Neopren und dehnbarem Nylon gefertigt. Das Innenfutter aus Mikroplüsch macht die Shorts warm und komfortabel. Dieses Plüschfutter nimmt weniger Wasser auf, was die Gesamtwärmeleistung erhöht, und trocknet schnell. Die Hybrid Cargo Shorts sind mit größeren Klettverschlusstaschen, innenliegenden Bungees und einem D-Ring sowie großen, schnell trocknenden ösen ausgestattet und eine zusätzliche Reißverschlusstasche zum Verstauen kleiner Wertsachen. Die Shorts sind mit einem verstellbaren Taillengürtel ausgestattet, der durch eine Reihe von Gürtelschlaufen geführt wird und über einen einfach zu bedienenden Druckknopfverschluss verfügt. Abriebfestes Gewebe im Gesäßbereich erhöht die Strapazierfähigkeit. Die Hybrid Cargo Shorts können entweder allein oder über einem Tauchanzug getragen werden und eignen sich perfekt für einen Tag im Wasser. Hybrid Cargo Shorts, Herren

Variant.title: Short Cargo Hybrid, Uomo, 1mm, S
Variant.description: Gli short cargo Hybrid sono realizzati in neoprene X-Foam di alta qualità da 1 mm e nylon elasticizzato. Il loro rivestimento interno micro-felpato li rende caldi e confortevoli. Il materiale felpato assorbe meno acqua, aumentando il calore generale, e si asciuga rapidamente. Questi short sono stati dotati di tasche più grandi con chiusura a strap, cordini elastici e un D-ring all’interno, oltre a degli occhielli di grandi dimensioni per l’evacuazione rapida dell’acqua. E non è tutto: c’é un’ulteriore tasca con chiusura a zip per mettere al sicuro i piccoli oggetti di valore. Sono regolabili in vita grazie alla cintura che scorre attraverso una serie di passanti e si chiude con una fibbia a sgancio rapido, pratica sia per uomini che per donne. Rinforzi in tessuto anti-abrasione sulla seduta li rendono ancora più resistenti nel tempo. Progettati per essere indossati da soli o sopra una muta, gli short cargo Hybrid sono perfetti per godersi una giornata sott’acqua. | Short Cargo Hybrid, Uomo, 1mm, S

Variant.title: Hybrid Cargo Shorts, Herren, 1mm, L
Variant.description: Die körpernahen Hybrid Cargo Shorts sind aus hochwertigem 1mm X-Foam Neopren und dehnbarem Nylon gefertigt. Das Innenfutter aus Mikroplüsch macht die Shorts warm und komfortabel. Dieses Plüschfutter nimmt weniger Wasser auf, was die Gesamtwärmeleistung erhöht, und trocknet schnell. Abriebfestes Gewebe im Gesäßbereich erhöht die Strapazierfähigkeit. Variant.title: Hybrid Cargo Shorts, DaHerren, 1mm, M
Variant.description: Die körpernahen Hybrid Cargo Shorts sind aus hochwertigem 1mm X-Foam Neopren und dehnbarem Nylon gefertigt. Das Innenfutter aus Mikroplüsch macht die Shorts warm und komfortabel. Dieses Plüschfutter nimmt weniger Wasser auf, was die Gesamtwärmeleistung erhöht, und trocknet schnell. Die Hybrid Cargo Shorts sind mit größeren Klettverschlusstaschen, innenliegenden Bungees und einem D-Ring sowie großen, schnell trocknenden ösen ausgestattet und eine zusätzliche Reißverschlusstasche zum Verstauen kleiner Wertsachen. Die Shorts sind mit einem verstellbaren Taillengürtel ausgestattet, der durch eine Reihe von Gürtelschlaufen geführt wird und über einen einfach zu bedienenden Druckknopfverschluss verfügt. Abriebfestes Gewebe im Gesäßbereich erhöht die Strapazierfähigkeit. Die Hybrid Cargo Shorts können entweder allein oder über einem Tauchanzug getragen werden und eignen sich perfekt für einen Tag im Wasser. Hybrid Cargo Shorts, DaHerren

Variant.title: Short Cargo Hybrid, Donna, 1mm, M
Variant.description: Gli short cargo Hybrid sono realizzati in neoprene X-Foam di alta qualità da 1 mm e nylon elasticizzato. Il loro rivestimento interno micro-felpato li rende caldi e confortevoli. Il materiale felpato assorbe meno acqua, aumentando il calore generale, e si asciuga rapidamente. Questi short sono stati dotati di tasche più grandi con chiusura a strap, cordini elastici e un D-ring all’interno, oltre a degli occhielli di grandi dimensioni per l’evacuazione rapida dell’acqua. E non è tutto: c’é un’ulteriore tasca con chiusura a zip per mettere al sicuro i piccoli oggetti di valore. Sono regolabili in vita grazie alla cintura che scorre attraverso una serie di passanti e si chiude con una fibbia a sgancio rapido, pratica sia per uomini che per donne. Rinforzi in tessuto anti-abrasione sulla seduta li rendono ancora più resistenti nel tempo. Progettati per essere indossati da soli o sopra una muta, gli short cargo Hybrid sono perfetti per godersi una giornata sott’acqua. | Short Cargo Hybrid, Donna, 1mm, M

Novascotia Search and Rescue Semi-Dry Hooded Dive Suit, Men, 7.5mm

MultiValue.Value: Bright red and yellow colors make the suit easy to see in and out of the water.
CE certified as a Class A dive suit - rated for water temperatures ranging from 46º F (7º C) to 53º F (12ºC).
Made from X-Foam, a petroleum-free limestone neoprene, and is assembled using eco-friendly solvent-free glue.
Pure Design Concept uses fewer seams and panels for maximum flexibility.
Internal stress discs installed at stitch intersections reinforce seams, extending the suit’s working life.
Rear shoulder-to-shoulder YKK Aquaseal Vislon waterproof main zipper with heavy-duty plastic slider is flexible yet provides an excellent seal against water entry.
Plush interior liner in the arms, legs and shoulder areas increases warmth and stretch.
Double zippered seals on ankles and wrists feature brass sliders for durability and ease of use.
Fold-under neck seal is ultra-comfortable and keeps water seepage to a minimum.
Right thigh 3D pocket with hood attachment hook offers lots of room for carrying extra gear.
Shoulders and kneepads feature anti-abrasion patterns to provide protection.
Anti-abrasion material on shoulders and seat cushion the diver while protecting the suit from scrapes and scuffs.

Values.Value: Novascotia Search and Rescue Semi-Dry Hooded Dive Suit, Men, 7.5mm, Red/Yellow, Small

The NovaScotia semi-dry is the perfect solution for staying very warm and relatively dry while virtually eliminating hydrodrag, radically improving a diver’s ability to move easily through the water. With its 7.5/6.5mm thickness, rear-zip waterproof YKK Aquaseal Vislon zipper, improved plush lining to increase warmth and stretch, bright design and a long list of convenience features, the NovaScotia is ready for any mission.

Variant.title: NOVASCOTIA 7.5 SAR Herren S
Variant.description: Der NovaScotia 7, 5 mm Search & Rescue Halbtrockenanzug ist für den professionellen Einsatz gemacht. Die 7, 5/6, 5 mm Stärke des Anzugs, der leicht zu öffnende wasserdichte YKK Aquaseal Vislon-Reißverschluss, die angesetzte Kopfhaube, das verbesserte Weiche Innenfutter und die lange Liste von Merkmalen, einschließlich der gut sichtbaren roten und gelben Farbgebung, machen diesen halbtrockenen Tauchanzug zur perfekten Wahl für kaltes und gemäßigtes Wasser sowie thermischen Schutz bei mehreren Tauchgängen. NOVASCOTIA 7.5 SAR Herren S

Variant.title: NOVASCOTIA 7.5 SAR UOMO S
Variant.description: La NovaScotia 7.5mm Search & Rescue semistagna è pronta all’azione. Lo spessore di 7,5/6,5 mm, la cerniera YKK Aquaseal Vislon impermeabile e facile da chiudere, il cappuccio incluso, la fodera in felpa migliorata e una lunga serie di caratteristiche – tra cui la combinazione cromatica di rosso e giallo ad alta visibilità – fanno di questa muta subacquea semistagna la scelta perfetta per la protezione termica in acque fredde e temperate e per le immersioni ripetute. | NOVASCOTIA 7.5 SAR UOMO S

Novascotia Search and Rescue Semi-Dry Hooded Dive Suit, Men, 7.5mm

MultiValue.Value: Bright red and yellow colors make the suit easy to see in and out of the water.
CE certified as a Class A dive suit - rated for water temperatures ranging from 46º F (7º C) to 53º F (12ºC).
Made from X-Foam, a petroleum-free limestone neoprene, and is assembled using eco-friendly solvent-free glue.
Pure Design Concept uses fewer seams and panels for maximum flexibility.
Internal stress discs installed at stitch intersections reinforce seams, extending the suit’s working life.
Rear shoulder-to-shoulder YKK Aquaseal Vislon waterproof main zipper with heavy-duty plastic slider is flexible yet provides an excellent seal against water entry.
Plush interior liner in the arms, legs and shoulder areas increases warmth and stretch.
Double zippered seals on ankles and wrists feature brass sliders for durability and ease of use.
Fold-under neck seal is ultra-comfortable and keeps water seepage to a minimum.
Right thigh 3D pocket with hood attachment hook offers lots of room for carrying extra gear.
Shoulders and kneepads feature anti-abrasion patterns to provide protection.
Anti-abrasion material on shoulders and seat cushion the diver while protecting the suit from scrapes and scuffs.

Values.Value: Novascotia Search and Rescue Semi-Dry Hooded Dive Suit, Men, 7.5mm, Red/Yellow, X-Large

The NovaScotia semi-dry is the perfect solution for staying very warm and relatively dry while virtually eliminating hydrodrag, radically improving a diver’s ability to move easily through the water. With its 7.5/6.5mm thickness, rear-zip waterproof YKK Aquaseal Vislon zipper, improved plush lining to increase warmth and stretch, bright design and a long list of convenience features, the NovaScotia is ready for any mission.

Product.Name: ONEFLEX 5.0 W POCKT BLK MN S

Values.Value: 59.84 in x 21.65 in x 6.3 in | 152 cm x 55 cm x 16 cm
21.65 in x 6.3 in | 55 cm x 16 cm

MultiValue.Value: All-black design steamers for professional divers working at sea. ​
Pure Design Concept uses fewer seams and panels for maximum flexibility. ​
Triathlon cut employs wider panels covering allowing unrestricted movement. ​
Ultra-durable 2-sided polyester lining provides excellent resistance to heat, UV rays and chlorine, substantially extending the life of the suit, even after repeated use. ​
Diagonal rear YKK zipper with brass slider offers increased long-term durability and ease of use. ​
Single YKK zippers on ankles and wrists feature durable brass sliders and pull tabs, (5.0mm).​
Anti-abrasion fabric on shoulders and seat provide protection and extend the life of the suit.​
Heavy duty knee pads at knees protect this exposed area also for longer lasting.​
Zippered pockets on both legs provide a secure spot for carrying tools or accessories. ​
Made from X-Foam neoprene, a very specific limestone-based neoprene complying with strict PAH and REACH regulations. ​
Suit is assembled using a solvent-free glue. ​

Values.Value: Oneflex Steamer w/Pocket, Men, 5mm, All Black, Small
Heavy Duty on Shoulder, Knee & Seat

The 5 and 3mm Oneflex steamers deliver superb thermal protection. The suits are designed with a triathlon cut that allows for lots of range of motion in the shoulder and arm areas. They are also built using the Pure Design Concept which uses fewer seams and panels for maximum flexibility, and their 2-sided polyester lining is ultra-durable yet stretchy and comfortable.

Pure Design Concept uses fewer seams and panels for maximum flexibility.
Internal stress discs installed at stitch intersections reinforce seams, extending the suit’s working life.
Rear shoulder-to-shoulder YKK Aquaseal Vislon waterproof main zipper with heavy-duty plastic slider is flexible yet provides an excellent seal against water entry.
Plush interior liner in the arms, legs and shoulder areas increases warmth and stretch.
Double zippered seals on ankles and wrists feature brass sliders for durability and ease of use.
Fold-under neck seal is ultra-comfortable and keeps water seepage to a minimum.

Shoulders and kneepads feature anti-abrasion patterns to provide protection.
Size Range: S – XL and MS, LS, XLS.

Oneflex Search and Rescue Hooded Steamer, Men, 5mm

MultiValue.Value: Bright red and yellow colors make the suits easy to see in and out of the water.
Made from X-Foam neoprene, a very specific limestone-based neoprene complyng with strict PAH and REACH regulations.
Suits are assembled using a solvent free glue.
Triathlon cut design employs wider panels covering the underarm and back areas, allowing unrestricted arm and shoulder movement.
Pure Design Concept uses fewer seams and panels for maximum flexibility.
Plush inside and nylon outside deliver the perfect level of warmth and comfort.
Diagonal front YKK zipper with brass slider offers increased long-term durability and ease of use.
Single YKK zippers on ankles and wrists feature durable brass sliders and pull tabs, and the built-in cuff seals are comfortable and easy to use.
Reflective panels and logos on hood, shoulders, forearms and backs of ankles increase visibility.
Anti-abrasion patterns on shoulders, seat and kneepads provide protection and extend the life of the suit.
Zippered 3D utility pocket on the right leg provides a secure spot for carrying tools or accessories.
A hook is positioned on the outside of the pocket for added convenience.

Values.Value: Oneflex Search and Rescue Hooded Steamer, Men, 5mm, Red/Yellow, Small
Heavy Duty on Shoulder, Knee & Seat

The 5mm Oneflex SAR steamer delievers superb thermal protection for professional divers working projects in a variety of water conditions. Featuring a high-visibility red and yellow color scheme, the suits are designed for maximum flexibility and extended bottom times.

SCUBAPRO's best-selling air balanced second stage and its top-performing air balanced piston first stage is a match made in diver heaven. Well-known for its low work of breathing, year after year this combo has consistently ranked as one of the top-performing reg systems on the market. The MK25 EVO first stage lets you enjoy an ultra-fast breathing response, instant delivery of air on demand, great sensitivity and impressive airflow. The S600 delivers smooth and easy inhalation and exhalation while offering efficient user controls, including a powerful purge, an inhalation effort control knob and Venturi Initiated Vacuum Assist (VIVA). Together they provide a steady flow of air, regardless of depth, water temperature, or workload.

Variant.title: MK25 EVO INT/S600
Variant.description: Die sich am besten verkaufende, luftbalancierte zweite Stufe sowie die erste Stufe mit luftbalanciertem Kolben und höchster Atemleistung passen perfekt zusammen und sind der Traum eines jeden Tauchers. Diese Kombo bewährt sich aufgrund ihrer geringen Atemarbeit Jahr für Jahr, was sie zu einem der besten Atemreglersysteme auf dem Markt macht. Mit der ersten Stufe MK25 EVO genießt du ein extrem schnelles Ansprechverhalten, eine sofortige Luftbereitstellung und einen eindrucksvollen Luftstrom. Die S600 ermöglicht ein reibungsloses und einfaches Ein- und Ausatmen und bietet effiziente Steuerelemente, einschließlich einer leistungsstarken Luftdusche, eines Steuerknopfes für den Atemwiderstand und eines Venturianpassungsschalters (VIVA-Schalter). Zusammen sorgen sie ungeachtet von Tiefe, Wassertemperatur und Arbeitslast für einen stabilen Luftstrom. MK25 EVO INT/S600

Variant.title: MK25 EVO/S600 Kit Erogatori, INT
Variant.description: L'unione tra il secondo stadio bilanciato pneumaticamente più venduto di SCUBAPRO e il primo stadio a pistone bilanciato pneumaticamente dalle prestazioni più elevate converte in realtà il sogno di ogni subacqueo. Questa combinazione, ben nota per il ridotto sforzo respiratorio, nel tempo si è aggiudicata il titolo di uno dei migliori sistemi di erogazione sul mercato. MK25 EVO/A700 Carbon BT Dive Regulator System

MultiValue.Value: Handmade carbon fiber front cover, metal casing and metal valve housing (barrel) make for a rugged second stage able to withstand years of aggressive diving.

Metal case construction enables the use of a larger diaphragm inside a compact casing, increasing breathing sensitivity.
DLC Black Tech coating protects from corrosion and scratches and lends a technical look to the regulator.
Air balanced second stage smooths out the inhalation effort when diving at varying depths and supply pressures.
User controls include a diver-adjustable inhalation effort knob and coaxial Venturi-Initiated Vacuum Assist (VIVA) switch.

External intermediate pressure adjustment enables technicians to fine-tune performance quickly and easily.

The premium MK25 EVO/CARBON BLACK TECH is not only the best-breathing reg in SCUBAPRO's line, it's also the leader in advanced design and materials. The A700 CARBON's main casing is full metal to take advantage of the extremely high heat exchange rate that makes it such a great choice for cold-water diving, and its front cover is handmade out of lightweight and durable carbon fiber. The A700 CARBON is teamed with the MK25 EVO, widely considered the gold standard in first stage performance, and finishing off this premium air delivery system is a DLC (Diamond-Like Carbon) Black Tech coating. Put it all together and you have diving's ultimate muscle reg that looks great, is ultra-durable, and delivers the best breathing performance around.

Variant.title: MK25 EVO DIN300/A700 Carbon BT

Das Gehäuse der zweiten Stufe A700 CARBON besteht vollständig aus Metall, um sich die extrem hohe Wärmeleitfähigkeit zunutze zu machen. Das macht sie zur idealen Wahl für Tauchgänge in kaltem Wasser. Ihre Frontabdeckung ist handgefertigt und besteht aus leichter und robuster Kohlenstofffaser. Die Kombination dieser Stufen ergibt einen ultimativen Atemregler, der gut aussieht, extrem strapazierfähig ist und die beste Atemleistung überhaupt bietet. MK25 EVO DIN300/A700 Carbon BT

MK25 EVO/S620 Ti Dive Regulator System, INT
INT (Yoke)~User-friendly clamp-on connection secured by a screw knob (common in the USA).

SCUBAPRO combines its premium high-performance MK25 EVO first stage with its high-performance S620 Ti second stage to create a winning all-purpose, all weather regulator system. The MK25 EVO offers excellent resistance to freezing, superb inhalation sensitivity and instant delivery of air on demand. The S620 Ti embraces the best features of SCUBAPRO's renowned S600 in an upgraded, state-of-the-art design. Smaller and lighter than the S600 but using the same-sized diaphragm, the S620 Ti delivers effortless airflow under all dive conditions. The full titanium inlet tube is ultralight, the large purge button improves water circulation, and the reengineered exhaust tee increases performance while directing bubbles out of the field of view. In all water temperatures, in all dive conditions, this reg system is a winner.

Variant.title: MK25 EVO INT/S620Ti
Variant.description: SCUBAPRO vereint ihre erstklassige erste Stufe mit ihrer neuen, luftbalancierten zweiten Stufe. Die MK 25 EVO bietet einen hervorragenden Vereisungsschutz und ein ausgezeichnetes Ansprechverhalten beim Einatmen. Die S620 Ti vereint die besten Funktionen der bewährten S600 von SCUBAPRO in einem überarbeiteten, topmodernen Design. Die S620 Ti ist kleiner und leichter als die S600, besitzt jedoch eine genauso große Membran und liefert einen mühelosen Luftstrom unter allen Tauchbedingungen. Der komplett aus Titan hergestellte Einlasszylinder ist ultraleicht, der große Luftduschenknopf sorgt für eine bessere Wasserzirkulation und der Blasenabweiser liefert eine höhere Leistung und hält gleichzeitig Luftblasen aus dem Sichtfeld fern. Dieser Atemregler ist bei allen Wassertemperaturen und Tauchbedingungen der absolute Sieger. MK25 EVO INT/S620Ti

Values.Value: MK25 EVO DIN 300/S600;43.021.000 4 MM ALLEN KEY;45.101.180 Manual
MK25 EVO DIN 300/S600 Dive Regulator System
DIN~Compact, streamlined screw-in connection (common in Europe).

SCUBAPRO's best-selling air-balanced second stage and its top-performing air-balanced piston first stage is a match made in diver heaven. Well-known for its low work of breathing, year after year this combo has consistently ranked as one of the top-performing regulator systems on the market. The MK25 EVO first stage lets you enjoy an ultra-fast breathing response, instant delivery of air on demand, great sensitivity and impressive airflow. The S600 delivers smooth and easy inhalation and exhalation while offering efficient user controls, including a powerful purge, an inhalation effort control knob and Venturi Initiated Vacuum Assist (VIVA). Together they provide a steady flow of air, regardless of depth, water temperature, or workload.

Variant.title: MK25 EVO DIN300/S600
Variant.description: Die sich am besten verkaufende luftbalancierte zweite Stufe sowie die erste Stufe mit luftbalanciertem Kolben und höchster Atemleistung passen perfekt zusammen und sind der Traum eines jeden Tauchers. Diese Kombo bewährt sich aufgrund ihrer geringen Atemarbeit Jahr für Jahr, was sie zu einem der besten Atemreglersysteme auf dem Markt macht. Mit der ersten Stufe MK25 EVO genießt du ein extrem schnelles Ansprechverhalten, eine sofortige Luftbereitstellung und einen eindrucksvollen Luftdurchfluss. Die S600 ermöglicht ein reibungsloses und einfaches Ein- und Ausatmen und bietet effiziente Steuerelemente, einschließlich einer leistungsstarken Luftdusche, eines Steuerknopfes für den Atemwiderstand und eines Venturianpassungsschalters (VIVA-Schalter). Zusammen sorgen sie ungeachtet von Tiefe, Wassertemperatur und Arbeitslast für einen stabilen Luftstrom. MK25 EVO DIN300/S600

Variant.title: MK25 EVO DIN 300/S600 Kit Erogatori
Variant.description: L'unione tra il secondo stadio bilanciato pneumaticamente più venduto di SCUBAPRO e il suo primo stadio a pistone bilanciato pneumaticamente dalle prestazioni più elevate converte in realtà il sogno di ogni subacqueo. Questa combinazione, ben nota per il ridotto sforzo respiratorio, nel tempo si è aggiudicata il titolo di uno dei migliori sistemi di erogazione sul mercato. Il primo stadio MK25 EVO ti assicura una risposta velocissima all'inspirazione, un'erogazione immediata di aria su richiesta, un'eccellente sensibilità e un notevole flusso d'aria. S600 garantisce un'inspirazione e un'espirazione semplici e senza sforzo, offrendo allo stesso tempo comandi efficienti tra cui un potente spurgo, un pomolo di controllo dello sforzo inspiratorio e il sistema Venturi Initiated Vacuum Assist (VIVA). Tali funzioni forniscono, insieme, un flusso d'aria continuo, indipendentemente da profondità, temperatura dell'acqua o carico di lavoro. | MK25 EVO DIN 300/S600 Kit Erogatori

Values.Value: MK25 EVO DIN 300/G260;43.021.000 4 MM ALLEN KEY;45.101.180 Manual
MK25 EVO DIN 300/G260 Dive Regulator System
DIN~Compact, streamlined screw-in connection (common in Europe).

When you team SCUBAPRO's flagship first stage with a second stage engineered to excel in harsh conditions, you get a system that any recreational or technical diver can take on any dive, anywhere in the world, and be assured of rock-solid performance and reliability. The MK25 EVO/G260 is just such a system. The MK25 EVO delivers an ultra-fast breathing response, great sensitivity and extra-high airflow, making it the ultimate do-it-all first stage for all water temperatures. The G260 is the most imitated air-balanced second stage of all time. It features metal internal components and a left-right hose attachment option, making it a great choice for tech diving configurations and a consistent top-of-the-line performer.

Variant.title: MK25 EVO DIN300/G260
Variant.description: Wenn du das SCUBAPRO-Flaggschiff der ersten Stufen mit einer zweiten Stufe kombinierst, die für besonders raue Bedingungen entwickelt wurde, erhältst du ein System, das jeder Freizeittaucher oder technische Taucher auf jedem Tauchgang überall auf der Welt nutzen kann und eine felsenfeste Leistung und Zuverlässigkeit garantiert. Der MK25 EVO/G260 ist genau so ein System. Die MK25 EVO liefert ein extrem schnelles Ansprechverhalten und einen sehr hohen Luftstrom, was sie zur ultimativen ersten Stufe für alle Wassertemperaturen macht. Die G260 ist die am meisten nachgeahmte ausbalancierte zweite Stufe aller Zeiten. Sie besitzt interne Metallkomponenten und eine Schlauchbefestigung für links und rechts. Das macht sie zur idealen Wahl für technische Tauchkonfigurationen und zu einem erstklassigen Leistungsträger. MK25 EVO DIN300/G260

Variant.title: MK25 EVO DIN 300/G260 Kit Erogatori
Variant.description: L'unione tra il prestigioso primo stadio di SCUBAPRO e un secondo stadio progettato per eccellere nelle condizioni difficili dà vita a un sistema affidabile per tutti i sub tecnici o amatoriali, in qualsiasi parte del mondo, garantendo affidabilità e prestazioni costanti. Il sistema MK25 EVO/G260 è proprio questo. Assicura una risposta di respirazione velocissima, un'eccellente sensibilità e un flusso d'aria particolarmente elevato, che lo rendono il primo stadio più completo per tutte le temperature dell'acqua. Il sistema G260 è il secondo stadio bilanciato pneumaticamente più imitato di tutti i tempi. È dotato di componenti interni metallici e di un'opzione di attacco della frusta a destra o a sinistra, che ne fanno la soluzione ottimale per le configurazioni di immersioni tecniche e garantiscono prestazioni costanti di massima qualità. | MK25 EVO DIN 300/G260 Kit Erogatori

MK17 EVO 2/S620 Ti Dive Regulator System

MultiValue.Value: Sealed balanced diaphragm design makes for the ultimate compact first stage for cold water or contaminated diving conditions.
Air-balanced diaphragm delivers consistent and effortless airflow, regardless of depth, tank pressure, or breathing rate.
Dry chamber is completely environmentally sealed with a dual diaphragm system that keeps out contaminated water. The rib is designed to enhance heat exchange, making the first stage cold water-proof.
Two opposing high-pressure ports positioned on a 15º angle allow the first stage to be positioned either up or down, plus provide an optimal hose/transmitter layout.
S620Ti second stage's air balanced valve smooths out the inhalation effort at varying depths and supply pressures.
Rugged reinforced technopolymer case and front cover with stainless steel frame looks good plus is able to withstand years of aggressive diving.
Full titanium barrel is rugged, anti-corrosion and lightweight for long-term reliability.
Large diaphragm fits inside a more compact second stage casing for maximum breathing sensitivity.
User controls include an easy-grip diver-adjustable inhalation effort knob and Venturi-Initiated Vacuum Assist (VIVA) lever.
Exclusive compact Hi-Flow mouthpiece is mounted on an enlarged mouthpiece pipe to improve airflow as well as mouth comfort.
CE certified to EN250A European Standards for all diving conditions, including extreme cold water.

Variant.title: MK17 EVO2/S620Ti

Klein und leichte bietet der S620 Ti eine hervorragende Leistung und mühelosen Luftstrom unter allen Tauchbedingungen. MK17 EVO2/S620Ti

Variant.title: MK17 EVO2/S620Ti Kit Erogatori

Values.Value: The FRAMELESS GORILLA has a slightly larger and wider lens than the original Frameless mask, and a slightly larger skirt in a matte finish. Otherwise, it shares the same classic single lens design and long list of comfort and performance features. Like on the original Frameless, the soft silicone skirt on the FRAMELESS GORILLA is comfortable yet durable, and the double-edge seal feels good against the skin. The buckle system is easy to use and allows for quick adjustments. Buckles attach to flexible tabs on the skirt; this optimizes strap angle when dialing in fit. The wide headband spreads the load on the back of the head, greatly enhancing comfort. For divers with larger or wider faces the FRAMELESS GORILLA is an excellent choice.

Variant.title: Frameless Gorilla Maske, Schwarz
Variant.description: Die FRAMELESS GORILLA hat ein etwas größeres und breiteres Glas als die originale Frameless Maske und eine etwas größere Dichtlippe in matter Ausführung. Im übrigen besitzt sie das gleiche klassische Einglas-Design und eine lange Liste von Komfort- und Leistungsmerkmalen. Wie bei der originalen Frameless ist auch bei der FRAMELESS GORILLA die weiche Silikondichtlippe bequem und dennoch langlebig und die doppelseitige Dichtung fühlt sich auf der Haut gut an. Das Schnallensystem ist einfach und schnell zu bedienen. Die Schnallen sind an flexiblen Reitern an der Dichtlippe befestigt; dies optimiert den Gurtwinkel beim Einstellen. Das breite Kopfband verteilt die Last am Hinterkopf und erhöht den Komfort erheblich. Für Taucher mit größerem oder breiterem Gesicht ist die FRAMELESS GORILLA eine ausgezeichnete Wahl. Frameless Gorilla Maske, Schwarz

Variant.title: Gorilla Frameless Maschera, Nero
Variant.description: La FRAMELESS GORILLA ha una lente leggermente più grande e larga rispetto alla maschera Frameless originale, e un facciale leggermente più ampio in finitura opaca. Sotto ogni altro aspetto, presenta lo stesso design monolente e il lungo elenco di prestazioni e comfort. Come nella maschera Frameless originale, il morbido facciale in silicone del modello FRAMELESS GORILLA è confortevole ma durevole, mentre la tenuta con doppio bordo è morbida a contatto con la pelle. Il sistema di fibbia è facile da usare e consente una rapida regolazione. Le fibbie si agganciano alle linguette flessibili sul facciale, ottimizzando l'angolo del cinghiolo per la massima aderenza. L'ampia fascia stringi-testa distribuisce il carico sulla parte posteriore della testa, migliorando notevolmente il comfort. La FRAMELESS GORILLA è una soluzione eccellente per i subacquei con visi più grandi o larghi. | Gorilla Frameless Maschera, Nero

Variant.title: Frameless Maschera, Bianco
Variant.description: FRAMELESS di SCUBAPRO è la maschera senza telaio originale, ed è ancora oggi la migliore. La sua caratteristica forma monolente rettangolare è un classico, e fornisce un eccellente campo visivo sia frontale che periferico. Il morbido facciale in silicone è confortevole ma durevole, mentre la tenuta con doppio bordo è morbida a contatto con la pelle. Il sistema di fibbia è facile da usare e consente una rapida regolazione. Le fibbie si agganciano alle linguette flessibili sul facciale, ottimizzando l'angolo del cinghiolo per la massima aderenza. L'ampia fascia stringi-testa distribuisce il carico sulla parte posteriore della testa, migliorando notevolmente il comfort. Dopo decenni sulla scena delle immersioni, la maschera FRAMELESS originale continua a essere la preferita dei subacquei professionisti in tutto il mondo. | Frameless Maschera, Bianco

MultiValue.Value: Low internal volume enables easy equalizing, a huge plus for freedivers.
Ultra Clear scratch-resistant glass lens delivers distortion-free vision and long-term wear.
Premium supple silicone skirt comfortably fits a range of faces.
Rotating buckles work with a micro-adjustable strap to achieve a comfortable, watertight fit.
Scaled-down size is ideal for smaller divers or those with narrow faces.

Note: As water pressure increases, the bridge between the lenses bends slightly and squeezes the mask tighter to the face. The only noticeable indication of this is a brief change in vision as the eyes need a split second to adjust. However, because of this the Steel Comp is not recommended for scuba diving.
Compatible with SCUBAPRO’s ski goggle-style Comfort Straps and Neoprene Mask Straps.

Values.Value: The ultimate freediving mask, the dual lens STEEL COMP is particularly well-suited to deep diving. It has the lowest possible internal volume so equalizing is easy. Plus, on descents the mask itself compresses, so equalization is not required as often. The skirt is very effective at blocking out light reflection at depth. The soft skirt and rotating buckle system allow for a comfortable, watertight fit on most faces.

Variant.title: Freitauchmaske Steel Comp, Schwarz
Variant.description: Die ultimative Freitauchmaske, die STEEL COMP mit zwei Gläsern, eignet sich besonders gut für das Tieftauchen. Sie hat das geringstmögliche Innenvolumen, so dass der Ausgleich einfach ist. Außerdem komprimiert sich die Maske beim Abtauchen selbst, so dass ein Ausgleich nicht so oft erforderlich ist. Der Maskenkörper blockiert sehr effektiv Lichtreflexionen in der Tiefe. Die weiche Schürze und das drehbare Schnallensystem sorgen für einen bequemen, wasserdichten Sitz auf den meisten Gesichtern. Freitauchmaske Steel Comp, Schwarz

Variant.title: Steel Comp Maschera per Apnea, Nero
Variant.description: La Steel Comp rappresenta l’ultima nel settore delle maschere per apnea: Frameless, a due lenti, è tra le migliori per le immersioni in acque profonde. Il volume interno è stato ridotto al minimo per rendere più agevoli le manovre di compensazione. Inoltre, durante la discesa, la maschera si comprime da sola, così da rendere la compensazione meno frequente. Il facciale nero blocca molto efficacemente il riflesso della luce in profondità. La morbidezza del facciale e il sistema di fibbie ruotanti garantiscono una vestibilità confortevole a tenuta stagna adatta alla maggioranza delle forme di viso. | Steel Comp Maschera per Apnea, Nero

MultiValue.Value: Low internal volume enables easy equalizing, a huge plus for freedivers.
Premium super-soft silicone skirt seals out water and comfortably fits a range of faces.
Ultra Clear scratch-resistant glass lens delivers distortion-free vision and long-term wear.
Easy-adjust rotating buckles work with a micro-adjustable strap to achieve a comfortable, watertight fit.
Compatible with SCUBAPRO’s ski goggle-style Comfort Straps and Neoprene Mask Straps.

Values.Value: The single lens, low volume STEEL PRO offers an expansive view of the underwater world. Perfect for freediving or scuba diving, the frameless design is streamlined and lightweight, and the soft silicone skirt provides a comfortable fit on a range of face shapes. Rotating buckles work with a micro-adjustable strap to maximize water-tightness and the skirt is very effective at blocking out light reflection at depth. The low volume design makes the STEEL PRO a great mask for all types of diving.

Variant.title: Maske Steel Pro, Schwarz
Variant.description: Die STEEL PRO mit einem durchgehenden Glas und geringem Volumen bietet eine umfassende Sicht auf die Unterwasserwelt. Das rahmenlose Design ist stromlinienförmig und leicht und der weiche Silikonrahmen sorgt für eine bequeme Passform für viele Gesichtsformen. Sie eignet sich sowohl perfekt für Apnoe als auch zum Gerätetauchen. Drehbare Schnallen und ein mikroverstellbares Band sorgen für einen bequemen, wasserdichten Sitz, der Maskenkörper verhindert effizient Lichtreflektionen unter Wasser. Das geringe Volumen macht die STEEL PRO zu einer perfekten Maske für alle Arten des Tauchens. Maske Steel Pro, Schwarz

Variant.title: Steel Pro Maschera, Nero
Variant.description: La maschera monovetro a volume ridotto Steel Pro offre un grande campo visivo sul mondo sottomarino. Perfetta sia per l’apnea che per lo scuba diving, il design Frameless è idrodinamico e leggero, mentre il facciale in morbido silicone garantisce una vestibilità confortevole e stagna, adattandosi a una vasta gamma di fisionomie. Le fibbie rotanti lavorano con un cinturino micro-regolabile per massimizzare la tenuta stagna e il facciale è molto efficace nel bloccare il riflesso della luce in profondità. Il design a basso volume rende la STEEL PRO una maschera ideale per tutti i tipi di immersione. | Steel Pro Maschera, Nero

Values.Value: The Trinidad 3 offers the same popular single lens design and lightweight frameless construction as the Trinidad 2. What’s new is the design of the buckle system – the quick-release buckles attach to tabs on the skirt to optimize range of motion when dialing in fit. These buckles are compatible with the new ski goggle-style Comfort Straps. Also new is an exciting range of vivid colors that match Seawing Nova fins and HYDRO PRO BCDs.

Variant.title: Trinidad 3 Maske, Blau
Variant.description: Die Trinidad 3 bietet das gleiche beliebte Einglasdesign und die gleiche leichte, rahmenlose Konstruktion wie die Trinidad 2. Neu ist das Design des Schnallensystems – die Schnellverschlüsse werden an Reitern an der Dichtlippe befestigt, um die Bewegungsfreiheit beim Einstellen zu optimieren. Diese Schnallen passen zu den neuen Comfort Straps im Skibrillen-Stil. Ebenfalls neu ist eine aufregende Auswahl an lebhaften Farben, die zu Seawing Nova Flossen und HYDRO PRO Tarierjackets passen. Trinidad 3 Maske, Blau

Variant.title: Trinidad 3 Maschera, Blu
Variant.description: Trinidad 3 offre lo stesso design apprezzato a lente singola e la stessa procedura costruttiva leggera, priva di telaio, di Trinidad 2. La novità è costituita dal design del sistema di fibbia: le fibbie a sgancio rapido si fissano alle linguette del facciale per ottimizzare la libertà di movimento offrendo un'ottima aderenza. Queste fibbie sono compatibili con i nuovi cinghioli Comfort Strap in stile maschera da sci. Anche l'incredibile gamma di colori nitidi rappresenta una novità, e si abbina alle pinne Seawing Nova e agli equilibratori HYDRO PRO. | Trinidad 3 Maschera, Blu

MultiValue.Value: Frameless single lens design provides an expansive field of view while reducing volume.
Soft silicone skirt uses a double-seal system for a comfortable, leak-proof fit.
Traditional buckles attach to the skirt, enabling the mask to be folded flat for traveling.
Wide headband allows for a comfortable fit against the back of the head.

Values.Value: SCUBAPRO's FRAMELESS is diving's original frameless mask, and it's still the best. Its distinctive rectangular single lens shape is classic, providing an excellent field of view on the periphery as well as straight ahead. The soft silicone skirt is comfortable yet durable, and the double-edge seal feels good against the skin. The buckle system is easy to use and allows for quick adjustments. Buckles attach to flexible tabs on the skirt; this optimizes strap angle when dialing in fit. The wide headband spreads the load on the back of the head, greatly enhancing comfort. After decades on the diving scene, the original FRAMELESS continues to be the mask of choice among professional divers throughout the world.

Variant.title: Frameless Maske, Army Grün
Variant.description: Die FRAMELESS von SCUBAPRO ist die originale rahmenlose Maske im Tauchsport, und sie ist immer noch die beste. Die markante, rechteckige Einglas-Form ist klassisch und bietet ein hervorragendes Sichtfeld sowohl an den Seiten als auch nach vorn. Die weiche Silikonlippe ist bequem und dennoch langlebig und die doppelseitige Dichtung fühlt sich gut auf der Haut an. Das Schnallensystem ist einfach zu bedienen und ermöglicht eine schnelle Anpassung. Die Schnallen werden an flexiblen Reitern an der Dichtlippe befestigt; dies optimiert den Gurtwinkel beim Einstellen. Das breite Kopfband verteilt die Last am Hinterkopf und erhöht den Komfort erheblich. Nach Jahrzehnten im Tauchsport ist die originale FRAMELESS nach wie vor für professionelle Taucher auf der ganzen Welt die Maske der Wahl. Frameless Maske, Army Grün

Variant.title: Frameless Maschera, Verde Militare
Variant.description: FRAMELESS di SCUBAPRO è la maschera senza telaio originale, ed è ancora oggi la migliore. La sua caratteristica forma monolente rettangolare è un classico, e fornisce un eccellente campo visivo sia frontale che periferico. Il morbido facciale in silicone è confortevole ma durevole, mentre la tenuta con doppio bordo è morbida a contatto con la pelle. Il sistema di fibbia è facile da usare e consente una rapida regolazione. Le fibbie si agganciano alle linguette flessibili sul facciale, ottimizzando l'angolo del cinghiolo per la massima aderenza. L'ampia fascia stringi-testa distribuisce il carico sulla parte posteriore della testa, migliorando notevolmente il comfort. Dopo decenni sulla scena delle immersioni, la maschera FRAMELESS originale continua a essere la preferita dei subacquei professionisti in tutto il mondo. | Frameless Maschera, Verde Militare

Values.Value: Synergy Twin Trufit Dive Mask, Black/Silver Mirrored

The SYNERGY TWIN TRUFIT benefits from SCUBAPRO's second-generation Trufit technology. This design approach features a mask skirt with thicker, firmer silicone near the mask frame to provide support and rigidity, and thinner silicone contouring the face for comfort and to ensure a watertight seal. It's an effective combination that delivers a truly unique fit and seal. In addition to comfort, the SYNERGY TWIN TRUFIT's dual lens design is low volume and provides excellent field of view, and its buckle and strap system is easy to use. The rotating buckles attach to tabs on the skirt rather than on the frame. This optimizes strap angle and range of motion when dialing in fit, plus it enables the mask to be folded flat for easy packing.

Variant.title: Synergy Twin, mit Comfort Strap, Schwarz/Silber/Verspiegelt
Variant.description: Die Synergy Twin verfügt bereits über die zweite Generation der Trufit-Technologie, bei der zwei unterschiedliche Silikonarten verarbeitet werden: Ein dickeres, stabiles Silikon entlang dem Maskenahmen und ein dünneres flexibles Silikon, welches das Gesicht umschließt und für einen hohen Tragekomfort und optimalen Sitz sorgt. Diese effiziente Kombination bietet eine bequeme Passform für eine Vielzahl von Gesichtsformen sowie eine zuverlässige Abdichtung gegen das Eindringen von Wasser. Das Zweiglas-Design hat ein geringes Volumen und bietet trotzdem ein breites Sichtfeld. Synergy Twin, mit Comfort Strap, Schwarz/Silber/Verspiegelt

Values.Value: Synergy 2 Twin Trufit Dive Mask, Clear/Blue

Called the most comfortable dive mask on the market, you have to only try on a Synergy 2 Twin Trufit to feel the difference. Its Trufit Technology design incorporates not one but two separate silicone skirts - a thin, soft inner skirt for fit and comfort, and a thicker outer skirt to provide support near the mask frame. This innovative dual skirt design sets it apart from the original Syngery Twin, and has proven to provide an entirely new level of comfort during extended periods under water while ensuring a reliable watertight seal on virtually all face shapes. This low-volume dual lens mask also provides excellent field of view, and the buckle system is easy to use. The mask frame is spray painted for that premium look.

Values.Value: The Zoom is a low volume dual-lens mask that is ideal for all divers, but is especially well-suited to divers who use optical lenses. The mask has a new lens-change system that enables you to switch lenses yourself in less than a minute. Featuring spray-painted sub-frames in colors matching Seawing Nova fins, HYDROS PRO BCDs and the UPF Collection of rash guards, steamers and leggings, the Zoom offers a universal fit and includes an integrated buckle design that is compatible with the Comfort Strap.

Variant.title: Scubapro Zoom Dive Mask
Variant.description: The Zoom is a low volume dual-lens mask that is ideal for all divers, but is especially well-suited to divers who use optical lenses. The mask has a new lens-change system that enables you to switch lenses yourself in less than a minute. Featuring spray-painted sub-frames in colors matching Seawing Nova fins, HYDROS PRO BCDs and the UPF Collection of rash guards, steamers and leggings, the Zoom offers a universal fit and includes an integrated buckle design that is compatible with the Comfort Strap.
