Values.Value: 8.27 in x 7.48 in | 21 cm x 19 cm
8.27 in x 7.48 in x 4.33 in | 21 cm x 19 cm x 11 cm
7.48 in x 4.33 in | 19 cm x 11 cm

MultiValue.Value: Large, single-lens faceplate maximizes field of view. Lens meets latest EN250 standards field of vision requirements.
D-mask shape of the nose pocket allows plenty of room for easy equalization when wearing thick gloves.
Single oro-nasal cavity is comfortable and allows for natural breathing. It also prevents nose piece flooding.

Total gas system redundancy is achievable by connecting two second stages to the FM2 at the same time. Can be adjusted through the second stages’ breathing effort knob setting to switch one second stage to the other in the event of an air supply failure.
Easy-to-operate surface valve lets you breathe fresh air at the surface without wasting tank air, and you can close it just before submerging to test the primary second stage supply.
One-way purge valve located under the chin makes for easy hands-free clearing if needed. When using the mask with positive pressure this valve can also be used to vent the mask.
Lens frame offers a built-in HUD attachment along with threaded metal inserts to attach brackets for lights, cameras and accessories.
Soft silicone skirt includes a double soft seal that saves weight and adapts much better to a range of face sizes and shapes.
Five-arm, fully-adjustable spider strap with new one-hand quick-adjustment buckles maximizes comfort, fit and security.
Strap attachment flanges are located on the skirt, enabling you to apply pull force where it’s needed most, plus leaves room on the frame for attaching accessories.
FM2 is CE Certified with the MK25 EVO / S620Ti Regulator System.
All FM2 parts are replaceable for easier service.

Values.Value: Mask, bag, HUD holder kit, FM2 Manual

SCUBAPRO Full Face Mask (FM2) has been totally redesigned to increase comfort, expand functionality and maximize safety when diving in cold water, wrecks or caves, or in any other technical or professional diving scenario. The new FM2 offers a familiar three-port layout; however, each port fitting is larger to accommodate SCUBAPRO’s latest generation of second stages. The newly designed single lens faceplate is large and has no center post to maximize field of vision. This updated design also features a single rather than dual oro-nasal cavity that’s more comfortable, allows for natural breathing, and prevents nose piece flooding.

Variant.title: Vollgesichtsmaske FM2
Variant.description: Die SCUBAPRO Vollgesichtsmaske (FM2) wurde komplett neu entwickelt, um den Komfort zu erhöhen und die Funktionalität beim Tauchen in kaltem Wasser, in Wracks oder Höhlen sowie in allen anderen technischen oder professionellen Tauchsituationen zu verbessern. Die neu gestaltete, große Einglas-Frontscheibe hat keinen Mittelsteg und maximiert so das Sichtfeld. Dieses überarbeitete Design verfügt außerdem über die vertraute Drei-Anschluss-Anordnung und eine integrierte Mund-Nasen-Kammer, die für mehr Komfort sorgt, natürliches Atmen ermöglicht, und das Eindringen von Wasser in den Nasenbereich verhindert. Vollgesichtsmaske FM2

Variant.title: Maschera Integrale Full Face
Variant.description: La maschera integrale Full Face SCUBAPRO (FM2) è stata completamente ridisegnata per aumentare il comfort e ampliare le funzionalità durante le immersioni in acque fredde, relitti o grotte, o in qualsiasi altro scenario di immersione tecnica o professionale. Il vetro frontale monolente di nuova concezione è ampio e privo di montante centrale per massimizzare il campo visivo. Questo design rinnovato presenta anche una tipica configurazione a tre porte e una cavità oro-nasale unica più confortevole, che consente una respirazione naturale, e impedisce l’allagamento del nasello. | Maschera Integrale Full Face

Values.Value: The single lens, low-volume frameless Ghost mask offers a comfortable fit, a superb field of vision through a durable Ultra Clear lens, and a super-soft silicone skirt that blocks out light reflection – a huge plus for photographers. The mask strap has a push button release and an easy-adjustment lever for easy donning, doffing and length adjusting. The flexible easy-adjust buckles allow for a wide range of strap angles so you can achieve a good fit, plus they enable the mask to be folded flat for packing.

MultiValue.Value: Low internal volume enables easy equalizing, a huge plus for freedivers.
Ultra Clear scratch-resistant glass lens delivers distortion-free vision and long-term wear.
Premium supple silicone skirt comfortably fits a range of faces.
Rotating buckles work with a micro-adjustable strap to achieve a comfortable, watertight fit.
Scaled-down size is ideal for smaller divers or those with narrow faces.

Note: As water pressure increases, the bridge between the lenses bends slightly and squeezes the mask tighter to the face. The only noticeable indication of this is a brief change in vision as the eyes need a split second to adjust. However, because of this the Steel Comp is not recommended for scuba diving.
Compatible with SCUBAPRO’s ski goggle-style Comfort Straps and Neoprene Mask Straps.

Values.Value: The ultimate freediving mask, the dual lens STEEL COMP is particularly well-suited to deep diving. It has the lowest possible internal volume so equalizing is easy. Plus, on descents the mask itself compresses, so equalization is not required as often. The skirt is very effective at blocking out light reflection at depth. The soft skirt and rotating buckle system allow for a comfortable, watertight fit on most faces.

Variant.title: Freitauchmaske Steel Comp, Blau
Variant.description: Die ultimative Freitauchmaske, die STEEL COMP mit zwei Gläsern, eignet sich besonders gut für das Tieftauchen. Sie hat das geringstmögliche Innenvolumen, so dass der Ausgleich einfach ist. Außerdem komprimiert sich die Maske beim Abtauchen selbst, so dass ein Ausgleich nicht so oft erforderlich ist. Der Maskenkörper blockiert sehr effektiv Lichtreflexionen in der Tiefe. Die weiche Schürze und das drehbare Schnallensystem sorgen für einen bequemen, wasserdichten Sitz auf den meisten Gesichtern. Freitauchmaske Steel Comp, Blau

Variant.title: Steel Comp Maschera per Apnea, Blu
Variant.description: La Steel Comp rappresenta l’ultima nel settore delle maschere per apnea: Frameless, a due lenti, è tra le migliori per le immersioni in acque profonde. Il volume interno è stato ridotto al minimo per rendere più agevoli le manovre di compensazione. Inoltre, durante la discesa, la maschera si comprime da sola, così da rendere la compensazione meno frequente. Il facciale nero blocca molto efficacemente il riflesso della luce in profondità. La morbidezza del facciale e il sistema di fibbie ruotanti garantiscono una vestibilità confortevole a tenuta stagna adatta alla maggioranza delle forme di viso. | Steel Comp Maschera per Apnea, Blu

The only noticeable indication of this is a brief change in vision as the eyes need a split second to adjust. However, because of this the Steel Comp is not recommended for scuba diving.
Compatible with SCUBAPRO’s ski goggle-style Comfort Straps and Neoprene Mask Straps.

Values.Value: The ultimate freediving mask, the dual lens STEEL COMP is particularly well-suited to deep diving. It has the lowest possible internal volume so equalizing is easy. Plus, on descents the mask itself compresses, so equalization is not required as often. The skirt is very effective at blocking out light reflection at depth. The soft skirt and rotating buckle system allow for a comfortable, watertight fit on most faces.

Values.Value: The single lens, low volume STEEL PRO offers an expansive view of the underwater world. Perfect for freediving or scuba diving, the frameless design is streamlined and lightweight, and the soft silicone skirt provides a comfortable fit on a range of face shapes. Rotating buckles work with a micro-adjustable strap to maximize water-tightness and the skirt is very effective at blocking out light reflection at depth. The low volume design makes the STEEL PRO a great mask for all types of diving.

Variant.title: Maske Steel Pro, Blau
Variant.description: Die STEEL PRO mit einem durchgehenden Glas und geringem Volumen bietet eine umfassende Sicht auf die Unterwasserwelt. Das rahmenlose Design ist stromlinienförmig und leicht und der weiche Silikonrahmen sorgt für eine bequeme Passform für viele Gesichtsformen. Sie eignet sich sowohl perfekt für Apnoe als auch zum Gerätetauchen. Drehbare Schnallen und ein mikroverstellbares Band sorgen für einen bequemen, wasserdichten Sitz, der Maskenkörper verhindert effizient Lichtreflektionen unter Wasser. Das geringe Volumen macht die STEEL PRO zu einer perfekten Maske für alle Arten des Tauchens. Maske Steel Pro, Blau

Variant.title: Steel Pro Maschera, Blu
Variant.description: La maschera monovetro a volume ridotto Steel Pro offre un grande campo visivo sul mondo sottomarino. Perfetta sia per l’apnea che per lo scuba diving, il design Frameless è idrodinamico e leggero, mentre il facciale in morbido silicone garantisce una vestibilità confortevole e stagna, adattandosi a una vasta gamma di fisionomie. Le fibbie rotanti lavorano con un cinturino micro-regolabile per massimizzare la tenuta stagna e il facciale è molto efficace nel bloccare il riflesso della luce in profondità. Il design a basso volume rende la STEEL PRO una maschera ideale per tutti i tipi di immersione. | Steel Pro Maschera, Blu

MultiValue.Value: Anti-Fog Film helps prevent mask fogging for a clear viewing experience underwater.
Low volume design makes clearing easy.
Universal fit ensures a comfortable, watertight fit.
Equipped with a standard silicone strap.
Available in seven solid mask/skirt colors.
Convenient lens-change system lets you change the lenses yourself in less than a minute.
Optional accessories like a HUD hands-free dive computer mount adapter and optical/bifocal glass lenses are also available.
Do not use toothpaste, harsh or abrasive cleaning agents. When not in use, avoid placing in very high or low temperatures and sunlight. Clean the outside only with clean, cold water and a soft cloth.

Values.Value: The Zoom Lite is a dual-lens mask that offers divers a more comfortable, lightweight experience. It offers all the same features and functions of the standard best-selling Zoom mask, but comes with lightweight, impact-resistant polycarbonate lenses. The lenses are equipped with a replaceable, high-quality Anti-Fog Film that helps to prevent mask fogging. The mask comes with a choice of solid-color frames and skirts and includes an integrated buckle design that is compatible with the Comfort Strap. For divers who use optical lenses, the Zoom Lite features an easy lens-change system that enables you to switch lenses yourself in less than a minute.

Variant.title: Zoom Lite Maske, Blau
Variant.description: Die neue Zweiglasmaske ZOOM Lite bietet Tauchern ein neues leichtes und komfortables Erlebnis. Sie besitzt alle Merkmale und Funktionen der ZOOM-Maske, unserer meistverkauften Maske, ist jedoch anstelle von Glas mit leichten Polycarbonat-Gläsern ausgestattet. Die Gläser sind mit einer austauschbaren, hochwertigen Antibeschlag-Folie ausgestattet, die das Beschlagen der Maske verhindert. Die Maske gibt es mit verschiedenen einfarbigen Rahmen und unterschiedlichen Maskenkörpern und verfügt über das Comfort Strap kompatible Schnallendesign. Für Taucher, die optische Gläser verwenden, verfügt die Zoom Lite über ein auswechselbares Gläsersystem, mit dem du die Gläser easy in weniger als einer Minute selbst und ohne Werkzeug wechseln kannst. Zoom Lite Maske, Blau

Variant.title: Zoom Lite Maschera, Blu
Variant.description: La nuova maschera Zoom Lite a doppia lente offre ai subacquei un'esperienza più comoda e gradevole. Presenta tutte le stesse caratteristiche e le funzioni della maschera Zoom, la nostra maschera più venduta, ma con lenti in policarbonato anziché in vetro per una maggiore leggerezza. Queste lenti sono dotate di un rivestimento antiappannamento sostituibile di alta qualità che aiuta ad evitare l’appannamento della maschera. La maschera è disponibile in una gamma di telai e facciali in tinta unita e include una fibbia integrata compatibile con il sistema Comfort Strap. Per i subacquei che utilizzano lenti ottiche, Zoom Lite è dotata di un semplice sistema di sostituzione delle lenti che consente di cambiare le lenti autonomamente, senza strumenti, in meno di un minuto. | Zoom Lite Maschera, Blu

Presenta tutte le stesse caratteristiche e le funzioni della maschera Zoom, la nostra maschera più venduta, ma con lenti in policarbonato anziché in vetro per una maggiore leggerezza. Queste lenti sono dotate di un rivestimento antiappannamento sostituibile di alta qualità che aiuta ad evitare l’appannamento della maschera. La maschera è disponibile in una gamma di telai e facciali in tinta unita e include una fibbia integrata compatibile con il sistema Comfort Strap. Per i subacquei che utilizzano lenti ottiche, Zoom Lite è dotata di un semplice sistema di sostituzione delle lenti che consente di cambiare le lenti autonomamente, senza strumenti, in meno di un minuto. | Zoom Lite Maschera, Turchese

MultiValue.Value: Anti-Fog Film helps prevent mask fogging for a clear viewing experience underwater.
Low volume design makes clearing easy.
Universal fit ensures a comfortable, watertight fit.
Equipped with a standard silicone strap.
Available in seven solid mask/skirt colors.
Convenient lens-change system lets you change the lenses yourself in less than a minute.
Optional accessories like a HUD hands-free dive computer mount adapter and optical/bifocal glass lenses are also available.
Do not use toothpaste, harsh or abrasive cleaning agents. When not in use, avoid placing in very high or low temperatures and sunlight. Clean the outside only with clean, cold water and a soft cloth.

Values.Value: The Zoom Lite is a dual-lens mask that offers divers a more comfortable, lightweight experience. It offers all the same features and functions of the standard best-selling Zoom mask, but comes with lightweight, impact-resistant polycarbonate lenses. The lenses are equipped with a replaceable, high-quality Anti-Fog Film that helps to prevent mask fogging. The mask comes with a choice of solid-color frames and skirts and includes an integrated buckle design that is compatible with the Comfort Strap. For divers who use optical lenses, the Zoom Lite features an easy lens-change system that enables you to switch lenses yourself in less than a minute.

Variant.title: Zoom Lite Maske, Orange
Variant.description: Die neue Zweiglasmaske ZOOM Lite bietet Tauchern ein neues leichtes und komfortables Erlebnis. Sie besitzt alle Merkmale und Funktionen der ZOOM-Maske, unserer meistverkauften Maske, ist jedoch anstelle von Glas mit leichten Polycarbonat-Gläsern ausgestattet. Die Gläser sind mit einer austauschbaren, hochwertigen Antibeschlag-Folie ausgestattet, die das Beschlagen der Maske verhindert. Die Maske gibt es mit verschiedenen einfarbigen Rahmen und unterschiedlichen Maskenkörpern und verfügt über das Comfort Strap kompatible Schnallendesign. Für Taucher, die optische Gläser verwenden, verfügt die Zoom Lite über ein auswechselbares Gläsersystem, mit dem du die Gläser easy in weniger als einer Minute selbst und ohne Werkzeug wechseln kannst. Zoom Lite Maske, Orange

Product.Name: TWIN JET MAX GRY W/SP STRAP, S

MultiValue.Value: Dual-compound design results in a stiffer blade that increases propulsion and optimizes maneuverability.
Patented split fin propeller technology produces more propulsion with considerably less effort than traditional blades.
Blades are angled to provide symmetrical power, creating a smooth and stable kicking motion that gets you moving without wearing you out.
Drag-reducing vents where foot pocket and blade meet radically decrease drag on both up and down strokes.
Semi-rigid side rails improve stability through the kicking cycle.
Ultra-soft foot pocket provides lots of comfort.
The foot pocket’s extended sole plate allows you to maximize the amount of energy you expend on each kick without wasting energy.
Steel spring straps never need adjusting, making it even easier to don and doff the fin.

Values.Value: Twin Jet Max Fin, Gray, S

A well-designed split fin is fast and maneuverable, enabling you to cover a lot of ground without cramping leg muscles or straining ankles. The TWIN JET MAX features a dual-compound design that offers a slightly stiffer blade with a little more feedback than what you might expect in a flexier fin. Employing what's known as "propeller technology," the distinctive split hydrofoil shape of the TWIN JET MAX blade allows water to flow between and around each of the twin blades, which flex independently to produce propulsion. An extended soleplate provides additional leverage to improve the power transfer from foot to fin. Divers who like a bit more feedback to their kick will love the solid kicking performance and comfort of the TWIN JET MAX.

Variant.title: Twin Jet Max Pinne, Blu, S
Variant.description: Una pinna bilobata ben progettata è veloce e manovrabile e ti consente di percorrere una grande distanza senza crampi ai muscoli delle gambe o sforzare le caviglie. Il modello TWIN JET MAX vanta un design a doppio composito che offre una pala leggermente più rigida con una risposta un po' più accentuata rispetto a quanto ci si aspetti in una pinna più flessibile. Grazie alla "tecnologia a elica", la caratteristica forma a aliscafo bilobato della pala TWIN JET MAX consente il flusso d'acqua tra e attorno a ciascuna delle due pale, che si flettono in modo indipendente per generare spinta. Un'ampia suola fornisce un ulteriore caratteristica che migliora il trasferimento di potenza dal piede alla pinna. I subacquei che desiderano una risposta leggermente maggiore alla loro gambata ameranno le affidabili prestazioni in termini di pinneggiata e il comfort della pinna TWIN JET MAX. | Twin Jet Max Pinne, Blu, S
Variant.google_product_category: Sporting Goods > Outdoor Recreation > Boating & Water Sports > Diving & Snorkeling > Diving & Snorkeling Fins
Variant.product_type: Home IT,Pinne,Twin Jet Max Pinne Blu S

Variant.title: Twin Jet Max Flosse, Mit Spring Straps, Schwarz/Blau, S
Variant.description: Eine gut durchdachte Spaltflosse ist schnell und manövrierbar, und bringt dich ohne Krampf im Bein oder müde Fußgelenke schnell voran. Die TWIN JET MAX besitzt ein Zwei-Komponenten-Design mit einem etwas steiferen Blatt, das etwas mehr Schub erzeugt, als es eine biegsame Flosse sonst tut. Mithilfe der sogenannten „Propellertechnik“ kann das Wasser zwischen den Zwillingsblättern der TWIN JET MAX hindurch und um sie herumfließen. Die gespaltene Hydrofoil-Form ist extrem biegsam, um Schub zu erzeugen. Ein verlängertes Fußteil bietet zusätzliche Hebelwirkung für noch mehr Kraftübertragung vom Fuß zur Flosse. Taucher, die auf der Suche nach einer Flosse mit gutem Vortrieb sind, werden die solide Schlagleistung und den Komfort der TWIN JET MAX lieben. Twin Jet Max Flosse, Mit Spring Straps
Variant.product_type: Home DE,Flossen,Twin Jet Max Flosse Mit Spring Straps

MultiValue.Value: Three-material blade construction optimizes flex to maximize kicking performance.
Drag-reducing vents substantially decrease resistance on both up and down strokes.
Big blade generates a powerful response in the water and improves stability and maneuverability.
Ergonomic full foot pocket molds to your entire foot for total comfort during long dives.
Effective non-skid pattern protects against slips on wet surfaces.
Small sizing is ideal for smaller feet.

Values.Value: Jet Sport Fin, Full Foot, Blue, XS

The JET SPORT FULL FOOT is lightweight yet delivers lots of propulsion, excellent maneuverability, plus it feels oh-so-comfy on bare feet. Its slightly stiff blade is a tri-material design featuring a pair of soft rubber panels framed in semi-stiff plastic and flanked by thin side rails, producing just the right amount of flex. There are also drag-reducing vents between the blade and foot pocket to decrease resistance on both up and down strokes. This combination generates propulsive kicking power, provides good stability and makes efficient work of frog and dolphin kicks. The rubber full foot pocket molds comfortably to your foot, and the non-skid pattern is effective on wet decks. A great choice for finning in the tropics.

Variant.title: Jet Sport Pinne, Scarpetta Completa, Blu, XS
Variant.description: Le JET SPORT A TALLONE CHIUSO sono leggere ma allo stesso tempo offrono una notevole propulsione e un'eccellente manovrabilità, oltre a essere comodissime a contatto con la pelle del piede. La loro pala leggermente rigida è realizzata con un design a tre materiali: una coppia di pannelli in morbida gomma all'interno di un telaio in plastica semi-rigida e affiancati da sottili costolature, che conferiscono la giusta flessibilità. Sono anche presenti aperture anti-attrito tra la pala e la scarpetta, per diminuire la resistenza in tutte le direzioni di pinneggiamento. Questa combinazione genera una spinta propulsiva, fornisce un'ottima stabilità e regala un'efficiente pinneggiata a rana e delfino. La scarpetta con tallone chiuso in gomma aderisce confortevolmente al piede e il rilievo anti-scivolo è efficace sui ponti bagnati. Un'ottima scelta per immergersi ai tropici. | Jet Sport Pinne, Scarpetta Completa, Blu, XS

Variant.title: Jet Sport Flosse Fußteilflossen, Schwarz/Blau, XS
Variant.description: Die JET SPORT FULL FOOT ist leicht und doch antriebsstark, bei exzellenter Manövrierbarkeit und einem sehr bequemen Sitz am nackten Fuß. Values.Value: Jet Sport Fin, Full Foot, Gray, XS

The JET SPORT FULL FOOT is lightweight yet delivers lots of propulsion, excellent maneuverability, plus it feels oh-so-comfy on bare feet. Its slightly stiff blade is a tri-material design featuring a pair of soft rubber panels framed in semi-stiff plastic and flanked by thin side rails, producing just the right amount of flex. There are also drag-reducing vents between the blade and foot pocket to decrease resistance on both up and down strokes. This combination generates propulsive kicking power, provides good stability and makes efficient work of frog and dolphin kicks. The rubber full foot pocket molds comfortably to your foot, and the non-skid pattern is effective on wet decks. A great choice for finning in the tropics.

SCUBAPRO's JET FIN is famous. This distinctive fin design set the standard for power and durability when it was first introduced 50 years ago. Its durable rubber construction and beefy shape can still be seen on dive boats, research vessels and in the world's most remote dive locales. Tech divers, deep divers, military divers, commercial divers and dive instructors, as well as old-school recreational divers, still strap on a pair of JET FINS before hitting the water. There are many imitations, but there is only one JET FIN.

Variant.title: Jet Flosse, Schwarz, M
Variant.description: Die JET FIN von SCUBAPRO ist berühmt. Dieses ausgeprägte Flossendesign setzte, als es vor 50 Jahren auf den Markt kam, den Standard für Kraft und Haltbarkeit. Die haltbare Gummikonstruktion und die bullige Form der Flosse sieht man auch heute noch auf Tauchbooten, Forschungsschiffen und an den entlegendsten Tauchorten. Technische Taucher, Tietaucher, Militärtaucher Berufstaucher und Tauchlehrer sowie Freizeittaucher der alten Schule schlüpfen in JET FINs, bevor sie ins Wasser gehen. Es gibt viele Nachbildungen, aber nur eine JET FIN. Jet Flosse, Schwarz

Variant.title: Jet Pinne con Cinghiolo a Molla, Nero, M
Variant.description: Le pinne JET FIN di SCUBAPRO sono famosissime. Il loro design caratteristico ha imposto uno standard di potenza e resistenza quando sono state introdotte sul mercato, 50 anni fa. La loro robusta struttura in gomma e la forma resistente possono ancora essere viste su barche di supporto, imbarcazioni di ricerca e nei luoghi di immersione più sperduti del mondo. I subacquei tecnici, di profondità, militari, commerciali e gli istruttori, così come i sub amatoriali di vecchia guardia, ancora oggi indossano un paio di JET FINS prima di immergersi. Ci sono tante imitazioni, ma le JET FIN originali sono uniche. | Jet Pinne con Cinghiolo a Molla, Nero, M

MultiValue.Value: Fin excels in both high and low-speed maneuvering, including frog and reverse kicks, and offers improved handling when making small directional adjustments.
Built with a space-age Monprene® elastomer that is virtually indestructible.
Proprietary G4 articulated joint allows the entire blade to pivot and generate thrust.
Wing-shaped blade creates a near-perfect balance of stiffness and flex.
Variable Blade Geometry wing tips arc upwards, providing more power and increasing stability.
Pivot Control Technology ensures that the most efficient 45º angle of attack is maintained no matter how easy or hard you kick.
Marine grade bungee strap is self-adjusting, comfortable, extremely durable, and makes easy work of donning and doffing the fin.
Re-engineered footplate with co-molded Grip Pads provides an improved non-skid grip on wet surfaces.
Red Dot Award for Product Design (2011)
Popular Science Magazine’s “Best of What’s New” (2009)

Values.Value: The Seawing Nova combines classic SCUBAPRO fin technology with the latest innovations in hydrodynamic design. Delivering the power, acceleration, and maneuverability of a blade fin with the kicking comfort and efficiency of a split fin, the unique articulated hinge design enables the entire wing-shaped blade to pivot and generate thrust. This enables you to rocket through open water at top speed, or ease in and out of tight spots in the reef with total control and with little to no ankle or leg strain. You'll be hard-pressed to find a fin that's more comfortable to wear or fun to kick when cruising the underwater world. Offered in lots of colors to mix and match with the rest of your dive gear. Made of durable Monprene®.

Variant.title: Seawing Nova Flosse, Schwarz, S
Variant.description: Die Seawing Nova verbindet die klassische SCUBAPRO Flossentechnologie mit den jüngsten Innovationen in der Hydrodynamik. Neben der Kraft, Beschleuingung und Manövrierbarkeit einer Blattflosse mit dem Schlagkomfort und der Effizienz einer Spaltflosse kann sich das Flossenblatt dank der einzigartigen Verbindungskonstruktion um sich selbst drehen und so Vorschub erzeugen. Damit bewegst du dich schnell durch das Wasser und geschickt durch Engstellen hindurch, ohne Knöchel oder Beine zu belasten. Eine noch bequemere Flosse für die Unterwasserwelt gibt es kaum. Erhältlich in vielen Farben zum Anpassen an deine übrige Ausrüstung. Aus haltbarem Monprene®. Seawing Nova Flosse

Variant.title: Seawing Nova Pinne, Nero, S
Variant.description: Seawing Nova combina la tecnologia delle pinne di tipo classico SCUBAPRO con le più recenti innovazioni nel campo della progettazione idrodinamica. Il design dell'esclusiva cerniera articolata offre la potenza, l'accelerazione e la manovrabilità di una pinna a pala con l'efficienza e il comfort di una pinna bilobata e consente a tutta la pala ad aletta di inclinarsi e generare la spinta. In questo modo potrai sfrecciare in acqua a tutta velocità oppure esplorare agilmente gli stretti passaggi della barriera corallina, senza affaticare caviglie e gambe. Non sarà facile trovare un’altra pinna che offra maggiore comfort e divertimento durante le esplorazioni subacquee. Disponibile in tantissimi colori per abbinarsi alla tua attrezzatura da immersione. Realizzata in resistente Monprene®. | Seawing Nova Pinne, Nero, S

Made of durable Monprene®.

Variant.title: Seawing Nova Flosse, Schwarz, M

Values.Value: The Seawing Nova combines classic SCUBAPRO fin technology with the latest innovations in hydrodynamic design. Delivering the power, acceleration, and maneuverability of a blade fin with the kicking comfort and efficiency of a split fin, the unique articulated hinge design enables the entire wing-shaped blade to pivot and generate thrust. This enables you to rocket through open water at top speed, or ease in and out of tight spots in the reef with total control and with little to no ankle or leg strain. You'll be hard-pressed to find a fin that's more comfortable to wear or fun to kick when cruising the underwater world. Offered in lots of colors to mix and match with the rest of your dive gear. Made of durable Monprene®.

Variant.title: Seawing Nova Flosse, Blau, M
Variant.description: Die Seawing Nova verbindet die klassische SCUBAPRO Flossentechnologie mit den jüngsten Innovationen in der Hydrodynamik. Neben der Kraft, Beschleuingung und Manövrierbarkeit einer Blattflosse mit dem Schlagkomfort und der Effizienz einer Spaltflosse kann sich das Flossenblatt dank der einzigartigen Verbindungskonstruktion um sich selbst drehen und so Vorschub erzeugen. Damit bewegst du dich schnell durch das Wasser und geschickt durch Engstellen hindurch, ohne Knöchel oder Beine zu belasten. Eine noch bequemere Flosse für die Unterwasserwelt gibt es kaum. Erhältlich in vielen Farben zum Anpassen an deine übrige Ausrüstung. Aus haltbarem Monprene®. Seawing Nova Flosse, Blau

Variant.title: Seawing Nova Pinne, Blu, M
Variant.description: Seawing Nova combina la tecnologia delle pinne di tipo classico SCUBAPRO con le più recenti innovazioni nel campo della progettazione idrodinamica. Il design dell'esclusiva cerniera articolata offre la potenza, l'accelerazione e la manovrabilità di una pinna a pala con l'efficienza e il comfort di una pinna bilobata e consente a tutta la pala ad aletta di inclinarsi e generare la spinta. In questo modo potrai sfrecciare in acqua a tutta velocità oppure esplorare agilmente gli stretti passaggi della barriera corallina, senza affaticare caviglie e gambe. Non sarà facile trovare un’altra pinna che offra maggiore comfort e divertimento durante le esplorazioni subacquee. Disponibile in tantissimi colori per abbinarsi alla tua attrezzatura da immersione. Realizzata in resistente Monprene®. | Seawing Nova Pinne, Blu, M

Values.Value: Seawing Nova Gorilla Fin, Orange, S

While virtually identical in appearance to the Seawing Nova, the SEAWING NOVA GORILLA uses a special additive in its compound to provide more stiffness and snap to the blade. This results in more power and control for divers who like a stiffer fin with more "feedback." The stiffer blade also allows for more effective sculling, frog-kicking and back-kicking, which makes it a good choice for tech divers. The fin features a well-engineered footplate with co-molded Grip Pads that improve non-skid footing on slippery boat decks or dive ladders. It also features a self-adjusting heel strap made of marine-grade bungee. A truly unique fin that has earned accolades since its introduction, the SEAWING NOVA GORILLA sets the bar in dive fin design.

This enables you to rocket through open water at top speed, or ease in and out of tight spots in the reef with total control and with little to no ankle or leg strain. You'll be hard-pressed to find a fin that's more comfortable to wear or fun to kick when cruising the underwater world. Offered in lots of colors to mix and match with the rest of your dive gear. Made of durable Monprene®.

Variant.title: Seawing Nova Flosse, Gelb, S
Variant.description: Die Seawing Nova verbindet die klassische SCUBAPRO Flossentechnologie mit den jüngsten Innovationen in der Hydrodynamik. Neben der Kraft, Beschleuingung und Manövrierbarkeit einer Blattflosse mit dem Schlagkomfort und der Effizienz einer Spaltflosse kann sich das Flossenblatt dank der einzigartigen Verbindungskonstruktion um sich selbst drehen und so Vorschub erzeugen. Damit bewegst du dich schnell durch das Wasser und geschickt durch Engstellen hindurch, ohne Knöchel oder Beine zu belasten. Eine noch bequemere Flosse für die Unterwasserwelt gibt es kaum. Variant.title: Seawing Nova Pinne, Giallo, S
Variant.description: Seawing Nova combina la tecnologia delle pinne di tipo classico SCUBAPRO con le più recenti innovazioni nel campo della progettazione idrodinamica. Il design dell'esclusiva cerniera articolata offre la potenza, l'accelerazione e la manovrabilità di una pinna a pala con l'efficienza e il comfort di una pinna bilobata e consente a tutta la pala ad aletta di inclinarsi e generare la spinta. In questo modo potrai sfrecciare in acqua a tutta velocità oppure esplorare agilmente gli stretti passaggi della barriera corallina, senza affaticare caviglie e gambe. Non sarà facile trovare un’altra pinna che offra maggiore comfort e divertimento durante le esplorazioni subacquee. Disponibile in tantissimi colori per abbinarsi alla tua attrezzatura da immersione. Realizzata in resistente Monprene®. | Seawing Nova Pinne, Giallo, S

Values.Value: Jet Fin w/ Spring Heel Strap, Green, M

SCUBAPRO's JET FIN is famous. This distinctive fin design set the standard for power and durability when it was first introduced 50 years ago. Its durable rubber construction and beefy shape can still be seen on dive boats, research vessels and in the world's most remote dive locales. Tech divers, deep divers, military divers, commercial divers and dive instructors, as well as old-school recreational divers, still strap on a pair of JET FINS before hitting the water. There are many imitations, but there is only one JET FIN.

Values.Value: The Seawing Nova combines classic SCUBAPRO fin technology with the latest innovations in hydrodynamic design. Delivering the power, acceleration, and maneuverability of a blade fin with the kicking comfort and efficiency of a split fin, the unique articulated hinge design enables the entire wing-shaped blade to pivot and generate thrust. This enables you to rocket through open water at top speed, or ease in and out of tight spots in the reef with total control and with little to no ankle or leg strain. You'll be hard-pressed to find a fin that's more comfortable to wear or fun to kick when cruising the underwater world. Offered in lots of colors to mix and match with the rest of your dive gear. Made of durable Monprene®.

MultiValue.Value: Lightweight design increases convenience when traveling and comfort and ease of use in the water. (For example, size XS-S weighs 1.0kg/2.2lbs per pair, including bungee straps; M-L weighs 1.2kg/2.6lbs per pair, including bungee straps.)
Barefoot Design features a replaceable self-adjusting bungee heel strap that allows for a versatile fit and makes the fin easy to don and doff. It can also be used when wearing neo socks.
Ultra-strong 100% Monprene® construction avoids problems of delamination, broken blades and torn foot pockets, making it ideal for long-term, heavy-duty use.
25º pre-angled blade with a Central Power Panel provides longitudinal rigidity and creates a channeling effect.
Power Bars on the underside of the rails prevent over-flex to maintain the optimum angle of attack under high load conditions.
In-water performance delivers speed, power, stability and maneuverability with a minimum of effort.
Fins fit easily in IATA carry-on compliant luggage for divers who like to travel fast and light.
Innovative Piggy Back Stack system interlocks one fin blade into the other, creating a snug pairing that makes packing and traveling that much easier.

Values.Value: GO Traveling, GO Diving, GO Snorkeling – with the GO fin. This travel fin combines the fitment benefits of an open heel fin, with the comfort and barefoot freedom of a full foot fin. The GO is lightweight yet virtually indestructible, plus it’s a fast and nimble performer in the water. The replaceable self-adjusting bungee heel strap allows for a versatile fit. The strap also makes it easy to don and doff the fin, and it fits comfortably against a bare heel, although the GO will also accommodate neo socks for divers who prefer a little extra foot protection. It’s also designed to fit easily in IATA carry-on compliant luggage, making it the ideal fin for divers, snorkelers and swimmers who enjoy traveling the world.

Variant.title: Go Travel Flossen, Schwarz, 3XS
Variant.description: GO Traveling, GO Diving, GO Snorkeling – mit der GO Flosse. Die GO Reiseflosse kombiniert die Passformvorteile von Gerätefl ossen mit der Bequemlichkeit und dem Barfußgefühl einer Fußteilflosse. Die GO-Flosse ist leicht, nahezu unzerstörbar und im Wasser ein schneller und wendiger Begleiter. Sie passt problemlos in IATA-konformes Handgepäck und ist damit ideal für jeden, der gerne die Welt bereist. Go Travel Flossen, Schwarz, 3XS

Variant.title: GO Travel Pinne, Nero, 3XS
Variant.description: Goditi i viaggi, le immersioni e lo snorkeling con la pinna GO. Questa pinna da viaggio unisce i vantaggi di adattabilità di una pinna a tallone aperto con la comodità e la libertà di una pinna con tallone chiuso. La pinna GO è leggera ma praticamente indistruttibile, oltre a garantire velocità e agilità nell'acqua. Il cinturino elastico sul tallone autoregolabile e sostituibile consente una vestibilità versatile. Il cinturino la rende anche facile da indossare e da togliere, ed è gradevole a contatto con la pelle del tallone. La pinna GO può anche essere indossata con calzari in neoprene per chi desidera una maggiore protezione del piede. Inoltre, è progettata per poter essere comodamente trasportata nei bagagli a mano, conformemente ai requisiti IATA, ed è dunque perfetta per i subacquei, gli amanti dello snorkeling e i nuotatori che amano viaggiare. | GO Travel Pinne, Nero, 3XS

MultiValue.Value: Built with a space-age Monprene® elastomer that is virtually indestructible. It includes a special additive to enhance stiffness and increase feedback.
Fin excels in both high-speed and low-speed maneuvering, including frog kicks and reverse kicks, and offers improved handling when making small directional adjustments.
Proprietary G4 articulated joint allows the entire blade to pivot and generate thrust.
Wing-shaped blade creates a near-perfect balance of stiffness and flex.
Variable Blade Geometry wing tips arc upwards, providing more power and increasing stability.
Pivot Control Technology ensures that the most efficient 45-degree angle of attack is maintained no matter how easy or hard you kick.
Marine grade bungee strap is self-adjusting, comfortable, extremely durable, and makes easy work of donning and doffing the fin.
Re-engineered footplate with co-molded Grip Pads provides an improved non-skid grip on wet surfaces.

Values.Value: Seawing Nova Gorilla Fin, Olive Green, S

While virtually identical in appearance to the Seawing Nova, the SEAWING NOVA GORILLA uses a special additive in its compound to provide more stiffness and snap to the blade. This results in more power and control for divers who like a stiffer fin with more "feedback." The stiffer blade also allows for more effective sculling, frog-kicking and back-kicking, which makes it a good choice for tech divers. The fin features a well-engineered footplate with co-molded Grip Pads that improve non-skid footing on slippery boat decks or dive ladders. It also features a self-adjusting heel strap made of marine-grade bungee. A truly unique fin that has earned accolades since its introduction, the SEAWING NOVA GORILLA sets the bar in dive fin design.

Variant.title: Seawing Gorilla Flossen, Army Grün, S
Variant.description: Die SEAWING NOVA GORILLA sieht praktisch genauso aus wie die Seawing Nova, besitzt aber einen speziellen Zusatzstoff im Material, der für ein steiferes Blatt sorgt. Taucher, die Wert auf härtere Flossen mit mehr „Feedback“ legen, erhalten dadurch mehr Kraft und Kontrolle und können effizienter rudern. Auch Frosch- und Rückwärtsschläge sind effektiver. Diese Flosse eignet sich für technische Taucher. Sie verfügt über eine durchdachte Fußplatte mit vorgeformten Profilen für Halt auf rutschigen Bootdecks oder Tauchleitern, sowie selbstjustierenden Fersenbändern aus salzwasserbeständigem Gummi. Die SEAWING NOVA GORILLA ist eine wirklich einzigartige Flosse, die seit ihrer Markteinführung schon viel Lob erhalten hat und die Latte im Tauchflossendesign wieder etwas anhebt. Seawing Gorilla Flossen, Army Grün
Variant.product_type: Home DE,Flossen,Seawing Gorilla Flossen Army Grün

Variant.title: Seawing Nova Gorilla Pinne, Verde Oliva, S
Variant.description: Sebbene di aspetto praticamente identico alla pinna Seawing Nova, SEAWING NOVA GORILLA è realizzata con una speciale miscela addizionata che rende la pala più rigida e scattante. Ciò garantisce maggiore potenza e controllo per i subacquei che desiderano una pinna più rigida con una maggiore "risposta". La pala più rigida consente, inoltre, una pinneggiata più efficace, sopratttutto a rana o invertita, il che la rende un'ottima scelta per i subacquei tecnici. La pinna è dotata di suole sapientemente progettate con cuscinetti ergonomici Grip Pad, che migliorano l'aderenza anti-scivolo sui ponti scivolosi delle barche o sulle scalette. È anche provvista di cinturino elastico autoregolabile realizzato con elastico di grado marino. La SEAWING NOVA GORILLA è una pinna davvero unica che si è aggiudicata numerosi riconoscimenti sin dalla sua comparsa, diventando il punto di riferimento nel design delle pinne. | Seawing Nova Gorilla Pinne, Verde Oliva, S

Sie verfügt über eine durchdachte Fußplatte mit vorgeformten Profilen für Halt auf rutschigen Bootdecks oder Tauchleitern, sowie selbstjustierenden Fersenbändern aus salzwasserbeständigem Gummi. Die SEAWING NOVA GORILLA ist eine wirklich einzigartige Flosse, die seit ihrer Markteinführung schon viel Lob erhalten hat und die Latte im Tauchflossendesign wieder etwas anhebt. Seawing Gorilla Flossen, Army Grün

Variant.title: Seawing Nova Gorilla Pinne, Verde Oliva, XL

La SEAWING NOVA GORILLA è una pinna davvero unica che si è aggiudicata numerosi riconoscimenti sin dalla sua comparsa, diventando il punto di riferimento nel design delle pinne. | Seawing Nova Gorilla Pinne, Verde Oliva, XL

Variant.title: GO Travel Pinne, Bianco, XS/S
Variant.description: Goditi i viaggi, le immersioni e lo snorkeling con la pinna GO. Questa pinna da viaggio unisce i vantaggi di adattabilità di una pinna a tallone aperto con la comodità e la libertà di una pinna con tallone chiuso. La pinna GO è leggera ma praticamente indistruttibile, oltre a garantire velocità e agilità nell'acqua. Il cinturino elastico sul tallone autoregolabile e sostituibile consente una vestibilità versatile. Il cinturino la rende anche facile da indossare e da togliere, ed è gradevole a contatto con la pelle del tallone. La pinna GO può anche essere indossata con calzari in neoprene per chi desidera una maggiore protezione del piede. Inoltre, è progettata per poter essere comodamente trasportata nei bagagli a mano, conformemente ai requisiti IATA, ed è dunque perfetta per i subacquei, gli amanti dello snorkeling e i nuotatori che amano viaggiare. | GO Travel Pinne, Bianco, XS/S

MultiValue.Value: Fin excels in both high and low-speed maneuvering, including frog and reverse kicks, and offers improved handling when making small directional adjustments.
Built with a space-age Monprene® elastomer that is virtually indestructible.
Proprietary G4 articulated joint allows the entire blade to pivot and generate thrust.
Wing-shaped blade creates a near-perfect balance of stiffness and flex.
Variable Blade Geometry wing tips arc upwards, providing more power and increasing stability.
Pivot Control Technology ensures that the most efficient 45º angle of attack is maintained no matter how easy or hard you kick.
Marine grade bungee strap is self-adjusting, comfortable, extremely durable, and makes easy work of donning and doffing the fin.
Re-engineered footplate with co-molded Grip Pads provides an improved non-skid grip on wet surfaces.
Red Dot Award for Product Design (2011)
Popular Science Magazine’s “Best of What’s New” (2009)

Values.Value: The Seawing Nova combines classic SCUBAPRO fin technology with the latest innovations in hydrodynamic design. Delivering the power, acceleration, and maneuverability of a blade fin with the kicking comfort and efficiency of a split fin, the unique articulated hinge design enables the entire wing-shaped blade to pivot and generate thrust. This enables you to rocket through open water at top speed, or ease in and out of tight spots in the reef with total control and with little to no ankle or leg strain. You'll be hard-pressed to find a fin that's more comfortable to wear or fun to kick when cruising the underwater world. Offered in lots of colors to mix and match with the rest of your dive gear. Made of durable Monprene®.

Variant.title: Seawing Nova Flossen, Türkis, S
Variant.description: Die Seawing Nova verbindet die klassische SCUBAPRO Flossentechnologie mit den jüngsten Innovationen in der Hydrodynamik. Neben der Kraft, Beschleuingung und Manövrierbarkeit einer Blattflosse mit dem Schlagkomfort und der Effizienz einer Spaltflosse kann sich das Flossenblatt dank der einzigartigen Verbindungskonstruktion um sich selbst drehen und so Vorschub erzeugen. Damit bewegst du dich schnell durch das Wasser und geschickt durch Engstellen hindurch, ohne Knöchel oder Beine zu belasten. Eine noch bequemere Flosse für die Unterwasserwelt gibt es kaum. Erhältlich in vielen Farben zum Anpassen an deine übrige Ausrüstung. Aus haltbarem Monprene®. Seawing Nova Flossen, Türkis

Variant.title: Seawing Nova Pinne, Turchese, S
Variant.description: Seawing Nova combina la tecnologia delle pinne di tipo classico SCUBAPRO con le più recenti innovazioni nel campo della progettazione idrodinamica. Il design dell'esclusiva cerniera articolata offre la potenza, l'accelerazione e la manovrabilità di una pinna a pala con l'efficienza e il comfort di una pinna bilobata e consente a tutta la pala ad aletta di inclinarsi e generare la spinta. In questo modo potrai sfrecciare in acqua a tutta velocità oppure esplorare agilmente gli stretti passaggi della barriera corallina, senza affaticare caviglie e gambe. Non sarà facile trovare un’altra pinna che offra maggiore comfort e divertimento durante le esplorazioni subacquee. Disponibile in tantissimi colori per abbinarsi alla tua attrezzatura da immersione. Realizzata in resistente Monprene®. | Seawing Nova Pinne, Turchese, S

Values.Value: 25.2 in x 10.04 in x 3.35 in | 64 cm x 25.5 cm x 8.5 cm

MultiValue.Value: Fin excels in both high and low-speed maneuvering, including frog and reverse kicks, and offers improved handling when making small directional adjustments.
Built with a space-age Monprene® elastomer that is virtually indestructible.
Proprietary G4 articulated joint allows the entire blade to pivot and generate thrust.
Wing-shaped blade creates a near-perfect balance of stiffness and flex.
Variable Blade Geometry wing tips arc upwards, providing more power and increasing stability.
Pivot Control Technology ensures that the most efficient 45º angle of attack is maintained no matter how easy or hard you kick.
Marine grade bungee strap is self-adjusting, comfortable, extremely durable, and makes easy work of donning and doffing the fin.
Re-engineered footplate with co-molded Grip Pads provides an improved non-skid grip on wet surfaces.
Red Dot Award for Product Design (2011)
Popular Science Magazine’s “Best of What’s New” (2009)

Values.Value: The Seawing Nova combines classic SCUBAPRO fin technology with the latest innovations in hydrodynamic design. Delivering the power, acceleration, and maneuverability of a blade fin with the kicking comfort and efficiency of a split fin, the unique articulated hinge design enables the entire wing-shaped blade to pivot and generate thrust. This enables you to rocket through open water at top speed, or ease in and out of tight spots in the reef with total control and with little to no ankle or leg strain. You'll be hard-pressed to find a fin that's more comfortable to wear or fun to kick when cruising the underwater world. Offered in lots of colors to mix and match with the rest of your dive gear. Made of durable Monprene®.

Variant.title: Seawing Nova Flossen, Türkis, L
Variant.description: Die Seawing Nova verbindet die klassische SCUBAPRO Flossentechnologie mit den jüngsten Innovationen in der Hydrodynamik. Neben der Kraft, Beschleuingung und Manövrierbarkeit einer Blattflosse mit dem Schlagkomfort und der Effizienz einer Spaltflosse kann sich das Flossenblatt dank der einzigartigen Verbindungskonstruktion um sich selbst drehen und so Vorschub erzeugen. Damit bewegst du dich schnell durch das Wasser und geschickt durch Engstellen hindurch, ohne Knöchel oder Beine zu belasten. Eine noch bequemere Flosse für die Unterwasserwelt gibt es kaum. Erhältlich in vielen Farben zum Anpassen an deine übrige Ausrüstung. Aus haltbarem Monprene®. Seawing Nova Flossen, Türkis

Variant.title: Seawing Nova Pinne, Turchese, L
Variant.description: Seawing Nova combina la tecnologia delle pinne di tipo classico SCUBAPRO con le più recenti innovazioni nel campo della progettazione idrodinamica. Il design dell'esclusiva cerniera articolata offre la potenza, l'accelerazione e la manovrabilità di una pinna a pala con l'efficienza e il comfort di una pinna bilobata e consente a tutta la pala ad aletta di inclinarsi e generare la spinta. In questo modo potrai sfrecciare in acqua a tutta velocità oppure esplorare agilmente gli stretti passaggi della barriera corallina, senza affaticare caviglie e gambe. Non sarà facile trovare un’altra pinna che offra maggiore comfort e divertimento durante le esplorazioni subacquee. Disponibile in tantissimi colori per abbinarsi alla tua attrezzatura da immersione. Realizzata in resistente Monprene®. | Seawing Nova Pinne, Turchese, L

Variant.google_product_category: Sporting Goods > Outdoor Recreation > Boating & Water Sports > Swimming > Swimming Fins

MultiValue.Value: Lightweight design increases convenience when traveling and comfort and ease of use in the water.
Open heel “boot-fit” design features a replaceable self-adjusting bungee heel strap that allows for a versatile fit and makes the fin easy to don and doff.
Revised Ergo3 foot pocket is re-profiled for maximum comfort and power transfer.
Ultra-strong 100% Monprene® construction avoids problems of delamination, broken blades and torn foot pockets, making it ideal for long-term, heavy-duty use.
25º pre-angled blade with a Central Power Panel provides longitudinal rigidity and creates a channeling effect for low-effort kicking performance.
Power Bars on the underside of the rails prevent over-flex to maintain the optimum angle of attack under high-load conditions.
In-water performance delivers speed, power, stability and maneuverability with a minimum of effort.
Fins fit easily in IATA carry-on compliant luggage for divers who like to travel the world.
Skegs mounted on blade ends minimize sideslip and maximize stability.
Black and blue fins come with silver skegs, all other colors come with black skegs.
Optional skegs are available in a variety of colors for customization and to color-code sizing.

Values.Value: SCUBAPRO’s GO Sport fin features a “boot-fit” design, enabling divers who wear boots when giant-striding into cold water or negotiating rocky shore entries to benefit from the proven kicking performance of the original Tester’s Choice-awarded “bare-fit” GO fin. Lightweight yet virtually indestructible, this fin is a fast and nimble performer in the water. The blade has been slightly revised from the original; it now provides mounting points to attach skegs that minimize sideslip and maximize stability. The self-adjusting bungee heel strap allows for a versatile fit. The strap also makes it easy to don and doff. The GO Sport is designed to fit in IATA carry-on compliant luggage, making it a great fin for both travel and local diving.

Variant.title: Go Sport Fin, Türkis, M
Variant.description: SCUBAPROs GO SPORT Flosse mit ihrem Boot-Fit-Design ermöglichen es Tauchern, die Stiefel tragen, wenn sie ins kalte Wasser springen oder felsige Eingänge am Ufer verhandeln, von den bewährten Leistungen der originalen GO-Flossen zu profitieren. Deshalb entwickelte SCUBAPRO die GO SPORT, die ein «Boot-Fit»-Design bietet. Diese Version bietet neben den Funktionen und Eigenschaften der Original-GO-Flosse ein überarbeitetes Ergo3-Fußteil, das entsprechend für Füßlinge modifiziert wurde. Das Flossenblatt bietet Vorrichtungen zum Aufsetzen von Skegs. Die kleinen Finnen eignen sich nicht nur zur farblichen Individualisierung der Flosse, sondern minimieren auch die seitliche Abdrift und tragen so zu mehr Stabilität beim Flossenschlag bei. Die Skegs sind in mehreren Farben erhältlich und ermöglichen auch die farbige Größenkennzeichnung im Ausrüstungsverleih. Die GO SPORT ist IATA-konform. Go Sport Fin, Türkis

Variant.title: Go Sport Pinne, Turchese, M
Variant.description: Il design "boot-fit" della pinna Go Sport di SCUBAPRO consente ai subacquei che indossano calzari quando si gettano in acque fredde o si cimentano in approdi su litorali rocciosi di fare affidamento sulle comprovate prestazioni di pinneggiata dell'originale pinna GO "bare-fit" premiata dal Tester's Choice Award. Leggera ma praticamente indistruttibile, questa pinna garantisce velocità e agilità nell'acqua. La pala è stata leggermente modificata rispetto all'originale, per offrire dei punti di fissaggio per le alette skeg che minimizzano le derive e massimizzano la stabilità. Il cinturino elastico sul tallone autoregolabile consente una vestibilità versatile, e rende la pinna facile da indossare e togliere. Le pinne GO Sport sono progettate per trovare posto nel bagaglio a mano conformemente alle disposizioni IATA, rendendole un ottimo prodotto sia per viaggiare che per effettuare immersioni in loco. | Go Sport Pinne, Turchese, M

Deshalb entwickelte SCUBAPRO die GO SPORT, die ein «Boot-Fit»-Design bietet. Diese Version bietet neben den Funktionen und Eigenschaften der Original-GO-Flosse ein überarbeitetes Ergo3-Fußteil, das entsprechend für Füßlinge modifiziert wurde. Das Flossenblatt bietet Vorrichtungen zum Aufsetzen von Skegs. Die kleinen Finnen eignen sich nicht nur zur farblichen Individualisierung der Flosse, sondern minimieren auch die seitliche Abdrift und tragen so zu mehr Stabilität beim Flossenschlag bei. Die Skegs sind in mehreren Farben erhältlich und ermöglichen auch die farbige Größenkennzeichnung im Ausrüstungsverleih. Die GO SPORT ist IATA-konform. Go Sport Fin, Schwarz

Variant.title: Go Sport Pinne, Nero, L
Variant.description: Il design "boot-fit" della pinna Go Sport di SCUBAPRO consente ai subacquei che indossano calzari quando si gettano in acque fredde o si cimentano in approdi su litorali rocciosi di fare affidamento sulle comprovate prestazioni di pinneggiata dell'originale pinna GO "bare-fit" premiata dal Tester's Choice Award. Leggera ma praticamente indistruttibile, questa pinna garantisce velocità e agilità nell'acqua. La pala è stata leggermente modificata rispetto all'originale, per offrire dei punti di fissaggio per le alette skeg che minimizzano le derive e massimizzano la stabilità. Il cinturino elastico sul tallone autoregolabile consente una vestibilità versatile, e rende la pinna facile da indossare e togliere. Le pinne GO Sport sono progettate per trovare posto nel bagaglio a mano conformemente alle disposizioni IATA, rendendole un ottimo prodotto sia per viaggiare che per effettuare immersioni in loco. | Go Sport Pinne, Nero, L

MultiValue.Value: Lightweight design increases convenience when traveling and comfort and ease of use in the water.
Open heel “boot-fit” design features a replaceable self-adjusting bungee heel strap that allows for a versatile fit and makes the fin easy to don and doff.
Revised Ergo3 foot pocket is re-profiled for maximum comfort and power transfer.
Ultra-strong 100% Monprene® construction avoids problems of delamination, broken blades and torn foot pockets, making it ideal for long-term, heavy-duty use.
25º pre-angled blade with a Central Power Panel provides longitudinal rigidity and creates a channeling effect for low-effort kicking performance.
Power Bars on the underside of the rails prevent over-flex to maintain the optimum angle of attack under high-load conditions.
In-water performance delivers speed, power, stability and maneuverability with a minimum of effort.
Fins fit easily in IATA carry-on compliant luggage for divers who like to travel the world.
Skegs mounted on blade ends minimize sideslip and maximize stability.
Black and blue fins come with silver skegs, all other colors come with black skegs.
Optional skegs are available in a variety of colors for customization and to color-code sizing.

Values.Value: SCUBAPRO’s GO Sport fin features a “boot-fit” design, enabling divers who wear boots when giant-striding into cold water or negotiating rocky shore entries to benefit from the proven kicking performance of the original Tester’s Choice-awarded “bare-fit” GO fin. Lightweight yet virtually indestructible, this fin is a fast and nimble performer in the water. The blade has been slightly revised from the original; it now provides mounting points to attach skegs that minimize sideslip and maximize stability. The self-adjusting bungee heel strap allows for a versatile fit. The strap also makes it easy to don and doff. The GO Sport is designed to fit in IATA carry-on compliant luggage, making it a great fin for both travel and local diving.

MultiValue.Value: Lightweight design increases convenience when traveling and comfort and ease of use in the water.
Open heel “boot-fit” design features a replaceable self-adjusting bungee heel strap that allows for a versatile fit and makes the fin easy to don and doff.
Revised Ergo3 foot pocket is re-profiled for maximum comfort and power transfer.
Ultra-strong 100% Monprene® construction avoids problems of delamination, broken blades and torn foot pockets, making it ideal for long-term, heavy-duty use.
25º pre-angled blade with a Central Power Panel provides longitudinal rigidity and creates a channeling effect for low-effort kicking performance.
Power Bars on the underside of the rails prevent over-flex to maintain the optimum angle of attack under high-load conditions.
In-water performance delivers speed, power, stability and maneuverability with a minimum of effort.
Fins fit easily in IATA carry-on compliant luggage for divers who like to travel the world.
Skegs mounted on blade ends minimize sideslip and maximize stability.
Black and blue fins come with silver skegs, all other colors come with black skegs.
Optional skegs are available in a variety of colors for customization and to color-code sizing.

Values.Value: SCUBAPRO’s GO Sport fin features a “boot-fit” design, enabling divers who wear boots when giant-striding into cold water or negotiating rocky shore entries to benefit from the proven kicking performance of the original Tester’s Choice-awarded “bare-fit” GO fin. Lightweight yet virtually indestructible, this fin is a fast and nimble performer in the water. The blade has been slightly revised from the original; it now provides mounting points to attach skegs that minimize sideslip and maximize stability. The self-adjusting bungee heel strap allows for a versatile fit. The strap also makes it easy to don and doff. The GO Sport is designed to fit in IATA carry-on compliant luggage, making it a great fin for both travel and local diving.

Variant.title: Go Sport Fin, Blau, M
Variant.description: SCUBAPROs GO SPORT Flosse mit ihrem Boot-Fit-Design ermöglichen es Tauchern, die Stiefel tragen, wenn sie ins kalte Wasser springen oder felsige Eingänge am Ufer verhandeln, von den bewährten Leistungen der originalen GO-Flossen zu profitieren. Deshalb entwickelte SCUBAPRO die GO SPORT, die ein «Boot-Fit»-Design bietet. Diese Version bietet neben den Funktionen und Eigenschaften der Original-GO-Flosse ein überarbeitetes Ergo3-Fußteil, das entsprechend für Füßlinge modifiziert wurde. Das Flossenblatt bietet Vorrichtungen zum Aufsetzen von Skegs. Die kleinen Finnen eignen sich nicht nur zur farblichen Individualisierung der Flosse, sondern minimieren auch die seitliche Abdrift und tragen so zu mehr Stabilität beim Flossenschlag bei. Die Skegs sind in mehreren Farben erhältlich und ermöglichen auch die farbige Größenkennzeichnung im Ausrüstungsverleih. Die GO SPORT ist IATA-konform. Go Sport Fin, Blau

Variant.title: Go Sport Pinne, Blu, M
Variant.description: Il design "boot-fit" della pinna Go Sport di SCUBAPRO consente ai subacquei che indossano calzari quando si gettano in acque fredde o si cimentano in approdi su litorali rocciosi di fare affidamento sulle comprovate prestazioni di pinneggiata dell'originale pinna GO "bare-fit" premiata dal Tester's Choice Award. Leggera ma praticamente indistruttibile, questa pinna garantisce velocità e agilità nell'acqua. La pala è stata leggermente modificata rispetto all'originale, per offrire dei punti di fissaggio per le alette skeg che minimizzano le derive e massimizzano la stabilità. Il cinturino elastico sul tallone autoregolabile consente una vestibilità versatile, e rende la pinna facile da indossare e togliere. Le pinne GO Sport sono progettate per trovare posto nel bagaglio a mano conformemente alle disposizioni IATA, rendendole un ottimo prodotto sia per viaggiare che per effettuare immersioni in loco. | Go Sport Pinne, Blu, M

Values.Value: GO Travel Fin w/Colored Bungee Strap

MultiValue.Value: Lightweight design increases convenience when traveling and comfort and ease of use in the water. (For example, size XS-S weighs 1.0kg/2.2lbs per pair, including bungee straps; M-L weighs 1.2kg/2.6lbs per pair, including bungee straps.)
Barefoot Design features a replaceable self-adjusting bungee heel strap that allows for a versatile fit and makes the fin easy to don and doff. It can also be used when wearing neo socks.
Ultra-strong 100% Monprene® construction avoids problems of delamination, broken blades and torn foot pockets, making it ideal for long-term, heavy-duty use.
25º pre-angled blade with a Central Power Panel provides longitudinal rigidity and creates a channeling effect.
Power Bars on the underside of the rails prevent over-flex to maintain the optimum angle of attack under high load conditions.
In-water performance delivers speed, power, stability and maneuverability with a minimum of effort.
Fins fit easily in IATA carry-on compliant luggage for divers who like to travel fast and light.
Innovative Piggy Back Stack system interlocks one fin blade into the other, creating a snug pairing that makes packing and traveling that much easier.
3XS fin comes with a purple self-adjusting bungee heel strap and is compatible with any mini GO Bungee Heel Strap.

Values.Value: GO Travel Fin, Black w/Purple Strap, 3XS

GO Traveling, GO Diving, GO Snorkeling – with the GO fin. This travel fin combines the fitment benefits of an open heel fin, with the comfort and barefoot freedom of a full foot fin. The GO is lightweight yet virtually indestructible, plus it’s a fast and nimble performer in the water. The replaceable self-adjusting bungee heel strap allows for a versatile fit. The strap also makes it easy to don and doff the fin, and it fits comfortably against a bare heel, although the GO will also accommodate neo socks for divers who prefer a little extra foot protection. It’s also designed to fit easily in IATA carry-on compliant luggage, making it the ideal fin for divers, snorkelers and swimmers who enjoy traveling the world.

Values.Value: Jet Fin w/ Spring Heel Strap, Blue Camo, M

SCUBAPRO's JET FIN is famous. This distinctive fin design set the standard for power and durability when it was first introduced 50 years ago. Its durable rubber construction and beefy shape can still be seen on dive boats, research vessels and in the world's most remote dive locales. Tech divers, deep divers, military divers, commercial divers and dive instructors, as well as old-school recreational divers, still strap on a pair of JET FINs before hitting the water. JET FINS are available in a range of colors with an adjustable rubber heel strap or a rugged stainless-steel spring strap that lasts forever and makes donning and doffing as easy as can be. There are many imitations, but there is only one JET FIN.

Variant.title: Jet Flosse, Camo blau, M
Variant.description: Die JET FIN von SCUBAPRO ist definitiv legendär. Das unverwechselbare Flossendesign setzte bei seiner Einführung vor 50 Jahren den Standard für Leistung und Haltbarkeit. Die robuste Gummikonstruktion und die starke Form sind auch heute noch zahlreich auf Tauchbooten, Forschungsschiffen und in den entlegensten Tauchgebieten der Welt zu sehen. Bis heute begeistert die JET Fin Techniktaucher, Tieftaucher, Militärtaucher, Berufstaucher, Tauchlehrer und Freizeittaucher. Die JET FIN gibt es in verschiedenen Farben und mit einem robusten Spring-Strap aus Edelstahl, der lange hält und das An- und Ablegen so leicht wie möglich macht. Es gibt viele Kopien, aber es gibt nur eine originale JET FIN. Jet Flosse, Camo blau

MultiValue.Value: Lightweight design increases convenience when traveling and comfort and ease of use in the water.
Open heel “boot-fit” design features a replaceable self-adjusting bungee heel strap that allows for a versatile fit and makes the fin easy to don and doff.
Revised Ergo3 foot pocket is re-profiled for maximum comfort and power transfer.
Ultra-strong 100% Monprene® construction avoids problems of delamination, broken blades and torn foot pockets, making it ideal for long-term, heavy-duty use.
25º pre-angled blade with a Central Power Panel provides longitudinal rigidity and creates a channeling effect for low-effort kicking performance.
Power Bars on the underside of the rails prevent over-flex to maintain the optimum angle of attack under high-load conditions.
In-water performance delivers speed, power, stability and maneuverability with a minimum of effort.
Fins fit easily in IATA carry-on compliant luggage for divers who like to travel the world.
Skegs mounted on blade ends minimize sideslip and maximize stability.
Black and blue fins come with silver skegs, all other colors come with black skegs.
Optional skegs are available in a variety of colors for customization and to color-code sizing.

Values.Value: SCUBAPRO’s GO Sport fin features a “boot-fit” design, enabling divers who wear boots when giant-striding into cold water or negotiating rocky shore entries to benefit from the proven kicking performance of the original Tester’s Choice-awarded “bare-fit” GO fin. Lightweight yet virtually indestructible, this fin is a fast and nimble performer in the water. The blade has been slightly revised from the original; it now provides mounting points to attach skegs that minimize sideslip and maximize stability. The self-adjusting bungee heel strap allows for a versatile fit. The strap also makes it easy to don and doff. The GO Sport is designed to fit in IATA carry-on compliant luggage, making it a great fin for both travel and local diving.

Variant.title: Go Sport Fin, Rosa, XS
Variant.description: SCUBAPROs GO SPORT Flosse mit ihrem Boot-Fit-Design ermöglichen es Tauchern, die Stiefel tragen, wenn sie ins kalte Wasser springen oder felsige Eingänge am Ufer verhandeln, von den bewährten Leistungen der originalen GO-Flossen zu profitieren. Deshalb entwickelte SCUBAPRO die GO SPORT, die ein «Boot-Fit»-Design bietet. Diese Version bietet neben den Funktionen und Eigenschaften der Original-GO-Flosse ein überarbeitetes Ergo3-Fußteil, das entsprechend für Füßlinge modifiziert wurde. Das Flossenblatt bietet Vorrichtungen zum Aufsetzen von Skegs. Die kleinen Finnen eignen sich nicht nur zur farblichen Individualisierung der Flosse, sondern minimieren auch die seitliche Abdrift und tragen so zu mehr Stabilität beim Flossenschlag bei. Die Skegs sind in mehreren Farben erhältlich und ermöglichen auch die farbige Größenkennzeichnung im Ausrüstungsverleih. Die GO SPORT ist IATA-konform. Go Sport Fin, Rosa

Variant.title: Go Sport Pinne, Rosa, XS
Variant.description: Il design "boot-fit" della pinna Go Sport di SCUBAPRO consente ai subacquei che indossano calzari quando si gettano in acque fredde o si cimentano in approdi su litorali rocciosi di fare affidamento sulle comprovate prestazioni di pinneggiata dell'originale pinna GO "bare-fit" premiata dal Tester's Choice Award. Leggera ma praticamente indistruttibile, questa pinna garantisce velocità e agilità nell'acqua. La pala è stata leggermente modificata rispetto all'originale, per offrire dei punti di fissaggio per le alette skeg che minimizzano le derive e massimizzano la stabilità. Il cinturino elastico sul tallone autoregolabile consente una vestibilità versatile, e rende la pinna facile da indossare e togliere. Le pinne GO Sport sono progettate per trovare posto nel bagaglio a mano conformemente alle disposizioni IATA, rendendole un ottimo prodotto sia per viaggiare che per effettuare immersioni in loco. | Go Sport Pinne, Rosa, XS

Variant.title: Go Sport Fin, Rosa, M
Variant.description: SCUBAPROs GO SPORT Flosse mit ihrem Boot-Fit-Design ermöglichen es Tauchern, die Stiefel tragen, wenn sie ins kalte Wasser springen oder felsige Eingänge am Ufer verhandeln, von den bewährten Leistungen der originalen GO-Flossen zu profitieren. Deshalb entwickelte SCUBAPRO die GO SPORT, die ein «Boot-Fit»-Design bietet. Diese Version bietet neben den Funktionen und Eigenschaften der Original-GO-Flosse ein überarbeitetes Ergo3-Fußteil, das entsprechend für Füßlinge modifiziert wurde. Das Flossenblatt bietet Vorrichtungen zum Aufsetzen von Skegs. Die kleinen Finnen eignen sich nicht nur zur farblichen Individualisierung der Flosse, sondern minimieren auch die seitliche Abdrift und tragen so zu mehr Stabilität beim Flossenschlag bei. Die Skegs sind in mehreren Farben erhältlich und ermöglichen auch die farbige Größenkennzeichnung im Ausrüstungsverleih. Die GO SPORT ist IATA-konform. Go Sport Fin, Rosa

Variant.title: Go Sport Pinne, Rosa, M
Variant.description: Il design "boot-fit" della pinna Go Sport di SCUBAPRO consente ai subacquei che indossano calzari quando si gettano in acque fredde o si cimentano in approdi su litorali rocciosi di fare affidamento sulle comprovate prestazioni di pinneggiata dell'originale pinna GO "bare-fit" premiata dal Tester's Choice Award. Leggera ma praticamente indistruttibile, questa pinna garantisce velocità e agilità nell'acqua. MultiValue.Value: Blade’s central panel membrane auto-adjusts the angle of attack based on kicking strength, providing easier kicking when cruising and maximum power when needed.
Innovative blade shape produces more power, more speed and better maneuverability.
Central panel Hydra-loop channels water flow rearwards for increased efficiency and thrust.
Pivot Control Technology ensures that the most efficient 40º to 50º range of angle of attack is maintained.
Twin-tip winglets improve control and maneuverability for excellent frog and alternate kicks.
Blade and foot pocket are molded separately with a durable Socket-Lock Connecting System that allows for easy assembly and disassembly.
Made of premium Monprene for long-lasting durability.
Sold as an open heel set with open heel foot pocket and blade pre-assembled.
Available in five sizes (XS, S, M, L, XL ) and two colors (Black and White).
Full-Foot Footpocket (sold separately) provides opportunity to use in warm water without a dive boot.
Two-piece design for easy transport and versatility.

Values.Value: SCUBAPRO’s 2022 Seawing Supernova represents the next generation of powerful SCUBAPRO fins. Winner of the prestigious, internationally-recognized Red Dot Award for product design, the new Seawing Supernova is a step up from the Seawing Nova in performance, construction, fit and versatility. The flexible Auto-Adjust central panel fine-tunes the angle of attack according to the strength of kick by counter-pivoting, providing a milder angle of attack for comfort when kicking gently, a more aggressive angle of attack when kicking at full strength, and anything in between. When it comes to frog and alternate kicks, the new twin-tip winglets increase control and markedly improve maneuverability. The Seawing Supernova’s innovative two-piece design, with blade and foot pocket molded separately, makes transport easy, and with the optional full foot pocket the fin can be modified to handle any warm-water dive scenario. The Supernova is the go-to fin for avid recreational and professional divers seeking maximum speed, power and kicking control in all diving conditions.

Variant.title: SEAWING SUPERNOVA, SCHWARZ, XS
Variant.description: Die Seawing Supernova von SCUBAPRO repräsentiert die nächste Generation leistungsstarker SCUBAPRO-Flossen. Ausgezeichnet mit dem renommierten, international anerkannten Red Dot Award für Produktdesign ist die Seawing Supernova ihrem Vorgänger in Bezug auf Leistung, Konstruktion, Passform und Vielseitigkeit nochmal einen Schritt voraus. Das flexible Auto-Adjust Central Panel bewirkt die optimale Einstellung des Anstellwinkels entsprechend der Flossenschlagstärke. Bei leichteren Schlägen wird ein geringerer Anstellwinkel für hohen Komfort generiert, bei mittleren bis starken Flossenschlägen dagegen ein stärkerer Winkel für volle Power. Wenn es um alternative Flossenschläge, wie zum Beispiel den Frog-Kick geht, bieten die neuen Twin-Tip-Winglets bessere Kontrolle und sorgen für eine deutlich verbesserte Manövrierfähigkeit. Die innovative zweiteilige Seawing Supernova mit voneinander getrenntem Flossenblatt und Fußteil ist leicht im Transport. Sie kann mit dem optionalen Vollfußteil im Handumdrehen von einer Geräteflosse zur Vollfußflosse für warme Gewässer umgebaut werden. Die Supernova ist die neue essenzielle Hochleistungsflosse für enthusiastische Freizeit- und Profitaucher, die maximale Geschwindigkeit, Kraft und Kontrolle unter allen Tauchbedingungen suchen. SEAWING SUPERNOVA, SCHWARZ

Variant.title: SEAWING SUPERNOVA Pinne, Nero, XS
Variant.description: Seawing Supernova SCUBAPRO fa parte della nuova generazione di pinne SCUBAPRO. Vincitrici del prestigioso premio internazionale di design Red Dot, le Seawing Supernova costituiscono una versione aggiornata e migliorata delle classiche Supernova per quanto riguarda performance, realizzazione, vestibilità e versatilità. Il pannello centrale, flessibile e a regolazione automatica, permette quindi una regolazione di precisione dell’angolo di attacco della pinna in base alla potenza della pinneggiata tramite un’inclinazione di senso contrario, garantendo un angolo di attacco moderato per una nuotata rilassata e uno più aggressivo quando sei alla ricerca di potenza, consentendoti ovviamente tutte le altre opzioni intermedie. Sia per la pinnegiata a rana e che quella alternata, le nuove alette con punta doppia ti garantiranno un maggiore controllo, migliorando notevolmente la manovrabilità delle pinne. Le Seawing Supernova hanno la scarpetta separabile dalla pala, e questo design innovativo in due pezzi ne facilita il trasporto, oltre a consentire al sub di scegliere la scarpetta aperta o chiusa, in modo da adattarsi a qualsiasi scenario di immersione in acque calde. Le Seawing Supernova sono un elemento irrinunciabile per tutti i sub che sono alla ricerca di velocità elevata, potenza e controllo in tutte le condizioni di immersione, sia per i sub amatoriali più appassionati che per quelli professionisti. | SEAWING SUPERNOVA Pinne, Nero, XS

Vincitrici del prestigioso premio internazionale di design Red Dot, le Seawing Supernova costituiscono una versione aggiornata e migliorata delle classiche Supernova per quanto riguarda performance, realizzazione, vestibilità e versatilità. Il pannello centrale, flessibile e a regolazione automatica, permette quindi una regolazione di precisione dell’angolo di attacco della pinna in base alla potenza della pinneggiata tramite un’inclinazione di senso contrario, garantendo un angolo di attacco moderato per una nuotata rilassata e uno più aggressivo quando sei alla ricerca di potenza, consentendoti ovviamente tutte le altre opzioni intermedie. Sia per la pinnegiata a rana e che quella alternata, le nuove alette con punta doppia ti garantiranno un maggiore controllo, migliorando notevolmente la manovrabilità delle pinne. Le Seawing Supernova hanno la scarpetta separabile dalla pala, e questo design innovativo in due pezzi ne facilita il trasporto, oltre a consentire al sub di scegliere la scarpetta aperta o chiusa, in modo da adattarsi a qualsiasi scenario di immersione in acque calde. Le Seawing Supernova sono un elemento irrinunciabile per tutti i sub che sono alla ricerca di velocità elevata, potenza e controllo in tutte le condizioni di immersione, sia per i sub amatoriali più appassionati che per quelli professionisti. | SEAWING SUPERNOVA Pinne, Bianco, XL

SCUBAPRO's innovative two-piece design Modular Fin System, with blade and foot pocket molded separately, allows you to easily switch the foot pocket or blade for different types of diving. The Modular Fin System Full Foot Pocket can be paired with the Seawing Supernova or S-Tek blades for diving without boots in warm water. Simply use the fin’s Socket-Lock Connecting System to switch out the open heel foot pocket with a full foot pocket, reassemble, and you’re ready to hit the water.

Variant.title: MODULAR FIN SYSTEM FULL FOOT FUSSTEIL, SCHWARZ, XS
Variant.description: Das innovative zweiteilige Design der Seawing Supernova, bei dem Flossenblatt und Fußteil aus zwei separaten Teilen bestehen, ermöglicht es, das standardmäßige geräteflossenfussteil gegen ein optionales Vollfußteil aus Monprene® auszutauschen, wenn du Warmwassertauchen möchtest. Am Gelenk des Socket-Lock-Verbindungssystems, kann das Flossenblatt abgenommen werden und das gewünschte Fußteil ganz einfach montiert werden. Und schon bist du bereit für den Sprung ins Wasser. Values.Value: Modular Fin System Full Foot Pocket, White, XL

SCUBAPRO's innovative two-piece design Modular Fin System, with blade and foot pocket molded separately, allows you to easily switch the foot pocket or blade for different types of diving. The Modular Fin System Full Foot Pocket can be paired with the Seawing Supernova or S-Tek blades for diving without boots in warm water. Simply use the fin’s Socket-Lock Connecting System to switch out the open heel foot pocket with a full foot pocket, reassemble, and you’re ready to hit the water.

Variant.title: MODULAR FIN SYSTEM FULL FOOT FUSSTEIL, WEISS, XL
Variant.description: Das innovative zweiteilige Design der Seawing Supernova, bei dem Flossenblatt und Fußteil aus zwei separaten Teilen bestehen, ermöglicht es, das standardmäßige geräteflossenfussteil gegen ein optionales Vollfußteil aus Monprene® auszutauschen, wenn du Warmwassertauchen möchtest. Am Gelenk des Socket-Lock-Verbindungssystems, kann das Flossenblatt abgenommen werden und das gewünschte Fußteil ganz einfach montiert werden. Und schon bist du bereit für den Sprung ins Wasser. MODULAR FIN SYSTEM FULL FOOT FUSSTEIL, WEISS
