S-Tek Fin, Complete Set, Black, XS

A new addition to SCUBAPRO’s S-Tek line of technical diving equipment, the S-Tek Fin is a purpose-built, next-gen technical diving fin providing maximum power when you need it. Constructed of durable Monprene® for maximum durability and designed with an ultra-streamlined profile, the S-Tek Fin’s 30º pre-angled blade requires less deflection to achieve the desired angle of attack for an efficient kick. This allows for a stiffer blade without increasing drag, thereby reducing leg cramps and ankle strain while delivering unbeatable maneuverability and alternate kick performance.

Variant.title: S-TEK FIN, Schwarz, XS
Variant.description: Die S-TEK Fin ist eine Neuentwicklung in der S-TEK Linie von SCUBAPRO. Sie ist eine speziell für das technische Tauchen konzipierte Flosse der nächsten Generation, die maximale Leistung bietet, wenn du sie brauchst. Das 30° vorgewinkelte Flossenblatt der S-TEK Fin ist aus strapazierfähigem Monprene® gefertigt und hat ein extrem schlankes Profil, das weniger Verformung erfordert, um den gewünschten Anstellwinkel für einen effizienten Kick zu erreichen. Dies ermöglicht ein steiferes Blatt, ohne den Widerstand zu erhöhen, wodurch Krämpfe in den Beinen und die Knöchelbelastung reduziert werden, während gleichzeitig eine unschlagbare Manövrierbarkeit und Leistung bei alternativen Kicks geboten wird. Die S-TEK Fin zeichnet sich insbesondere bei Frog-Kicks, Rückwärts-Kicks und Helikopter-Turns aus und erzeugt zudem einen Flutter-Kick mit hohem Drehmoment. S-TEK FIN, Schwarz

Variant.title: Pinne S-Tek Nero, XS
Variant.description: Appena uscite nella linea di prodotti dedicata alle immersioni tecniche S-Tek di SCUBAPRO, le S-Tek sono delle pinne di nuova generazione appositamente progettate per le immersioni tecniche in grado di garantirti la massima potenza proprio quando ne hai bisogno. Costruita in resistente Monprene® per renderla più robusta e progettata con un profilo ultrasnello, la pala pre-angolata a 30º delle pinne S-Tek richiede una flessione minore per ottenere l’angolo di attacco desiderabile per una pinneggiata efficiente. Questo rende la pala più rigida senza aumentarne l’attrito, riducendo quindi il rischio di crampi alle gambe e di affaticamento delle caviglie offrendo, allo stesso tempo, una manovrabilità senza paragoni e una pinneggiata alternata performante. | Pinne S-Tek Nero, XS

Jet Fin w/ Spring Heel Strap

MultiValue.Value: Rubber construction is known for its durability, promising a lifetime of use.
Proven vented design decreases drag on the up stroke and enhances thrust on the down stroke.
Choose from an adjustable rubber heel strap or a self-adjusting stainless steel spring heel strap.
Available in a wide range of colors.

Values.Value: Jet Fin w/ Spring Heel Strap, Dark Blue Camo, M

SCUBAPRO's JET FIN is famous. This distinctive fin design set the standard for power and durability when it was first introduced 50 years ago. Its durable rubber construction and beefy shape can still be seen on dive boats, research vessels and in the world's most remote dive locales. Tech divers, deep divers, military divers, commercial divers and dive instructors, as well as old-school recreational divers, still strap on a pair of JET FINs before hitting the water. JET FINS are available in a range of colors with an adjustable rubber heel strap or a rugged stainless-steel spring strap that lasts forever and makes donning and doffing as easy as can be. There are many imitations, but there is only one JET FIN.

Variant.title: Jet Flosse, Camo Dunkelblau, M
Variant.description: Die JET FIN von SCUBAPRO ist definitiv legendär. Das unverwechselbare Flossendesign setzte bei seiner Einführung vor 50 Jahren den Standard für Leistung und Haltbarkeit. Die robuste Gummikonstruktion und die starke Form sind auch heute noch zahlreich auf Tauchbooten, Forschungsschiffen und in den entlegensten Tauchgebieten der Welt zu sehen. Bis heute begeistert die JET Fin Techniktaucher, Tieftaucher, Militärtaucher, Berufstaucher, Tauchlehrer und Freizeittaucher. Die JET FIN gibt es in verschiedenen Farben und mit einem robusten Spring-Strap aus Edelstahl, der lange hält und das An- und Ablegen so leicht wie möglich macht. Es gibt viele Kopien, aber es gibt nur eine originale JET FIN. Jet Flosse, Camo Dunkelblau

Variant.title: Jet Pinne con Cinghiolo a Molla, Camoflage Blu scuro, M
Variant.description: La JET FIN di SCUBAPRO è famosa. Questa pinna dal design inconfondibile ha stabilito lo standard di potenza e durata quando è stata introdotta per la prima volta 50 anni fa. La sua struttura in gomma resistente e la sua forma robusta sono ancora visibili sulle barche da immersione, sulle navi da ricerca e nei luoghi di immersione più remoti del mondo. I subacquei tecnici, i subacquei profondi, i subacquei militari, i subacquei commerciali e gli istruttori di immersione, così come i subacquei ricreativi della vecchia scuola, indossano ancora un paio di JET FIN prima di entrare in acqua. Le JET FINS sono disponibili in un'ampia gamma di colori e sono dotate di un robusto cinturino a molla in acciaio inossidabile che dura per sempre e facilita al massimo la calzata e la rimozione. Esistono molte imitazioni, ma c'è un solo JET FIN. | Jet Pinne con Cinghiolo a Molla, Camoflage Blu scuro, M

SCUBAPRO's JET FIN is famous. This distinctive fin design set the standard for power and durability when it was first introduced 50 years ago. Its durable rubber construction and beefy shape can still be seen on dive boats, research vessels and in the world's most remote dive locales. Tech divers, deep divers, military divers, commercial divers and dive instructors, as well as old-school recreational divers, still strap on a pair of JET FINs before hitting the water. JET FINS are available in a range of colors with an adjustable rubber heel strap or a rugged stainless-steel spring strap that lasts forever and makes donning and doffing as easy as can be. There are many imitations, but there is only one JET FIN.

MultiValue.Value: Lightweight design increases convenience when traveling and comfort and ease of use in the water. (For example, size XS-S weighs 1.0kg/2.2lbs per pair, including bungee straps; M-L weighs 1.2kg/2.6lbs per pair, including bungee straps.)
Barefoot Design features a replaceable self-adjusting bungee heel strap that allows for a versatile fit and makes the fin easy to don and doff. It can also be used when wearing neo socks.
Ultra-strong 100% Monprene® construction avoids problems of delamination, broken blades and torn foot pockets, making it ideal for long-term, heavy-duty use.
25º pre-angled blade with a Central Power Panel provides longitudinal rigidity and creates a channeling effect.
Power Bars on the underside of the rails prevent over-flex to maintain the optimum angle of attack under high load conditions.
In-water performance delivers speed, power, stability and maneuverability with a minimum of effort.
Fins fit easily in IATA carry-on compliant luggage for divers who like to travel fast and light.
Innovative Piggy Back Stack system interlocks one fin blade into the other, creating a snug pairing that makes packing and traveling that much easier.

Values.Value: GO Traveling, GO Diving, GO Snorkeling – with the GO fin. This travel fin combines the fitment benefits of an open heel fin, with the comfort and barefoot freedom of a full foot fin. The GO is lightweight yet virtually indestructible, plus it’s a fast and nimble performer in the water. The replaceable self-adjusting bungee heel strap allows for a versatile fit. The strap also makes it easy to don and doff the fin, and it fits comfortably against a bare heel, although the GO will also accommodate neo socks for divers who prefer a little extra foot protection. It’s also designed to fit easily in IATA carry-on compliant luggage, making it the ideal fin for divers, snorkelers and swimmers who enjoy traveling the world.

Variant.title: Go Travel Flossen, Blau, 2XS
Variant.description: GO Traveling, GO Diving, GO Snorkeling – mit der GO Flosse. Die GO Reiseflosse kombiniert die Passformvorteile von Gerätefl ossen mit der Bequemlichkeit und dem Barfußgefühl einer Fußteilfl osse. Die GO-Flosse ist leicht, nahezu unzerstörbar und im Wasser ein schneller und wendiger Begleiter. Sie passt problemlos in IATA-konformes Handgepäck und ist damit ideal für jeden, der gerne die Welt bereist. Go Travel Flossen, Blau, 2XS

Variant.title: GO Travel Pinne, BLU, 2XS
Variant.description: Goditi i viaggi, le immersioni e lo snorkeling con la pinna GO. Questa pinna da viaggio unisce i vantaggi di adattabilità di una pinna a tallone aperto con la comodità e la libertà di una pinna con tallone chiuso. La pinna GO è leggera ma praticamente indistruttibile, oltre a garantire velocità e agilità nell'acqua. Il cinturino elastico sul tallone autoregolabile e sostituibile consente una vestibilità versatile. Il cinturino la rende anche facile da indossare e da togliere, ed è gradevole a contatto con la pelle del tallone. La pinna GO può anche essere indossata con calzari in neoprene per chi desidera una maggiore protezione del piede. Inoltre, è progettata per poter essere comodamente trasportata nei bagagli a mano, conformemente ai requisiti IATA, ed è dunque perfetta per i subacquei, gli amanti dello snorkeling e i nuotatori che amano viaggiare. | GO Travel Pinne, BLU, 2XS

Variant.title: GO Travel Pinne, GIALLO, M-L
Variant.description: Goditi i viaggi, le immersioni e lo snorkeling con la pinna GO. Questa pinna da viaggio unisce i vantaggi di adattabilità di una pinna a tallone aperto con la comodità e la libertà di una pinna con tallone chiuso. La pinna GO è leggera ma praticamente indistruttibile, oltre a garantire velocità e agilità nell'acqua. Il cinturino elastico sul tallone autoregolabile e sostituibile consente una vestibilità versatile. Il cinturino la rende anche facile da indossare e da togliere, ed è gradevole a contatto con la pelle del tallone. La pinna GO può anche essere indossata con calzari in neoprene per chi desidera una maggiore protezione del piede. Inoltre, è progettata per poter essere comodamente trasportata nei bagagli a mano, conformemente ai requisiti IATA, ed è dunque perfetta per i subacquei, gli amanti dello snorkeling e i nuotatori che amano viaggiare. | GO Travel Pinne, GIALLO, M-L

MultiValue.Value: Lightweight design increases convenience when traveling and comfort and ease of use in the water. (For example, size XS-S weighs 1.0kg/2.2lbs per pair, including bungee straps; M-L weighs 1.2kg/2.6lbs per pair, including bungee straps.)
Barefoot Design features a replaceable self-adjusting bungee heel strap that allows for a versatile fit and makes the fin easy to don and doff. It can also be used when wearing neo socks.
Ultra-strong 100% Monprene® construction avoids problems of delamination, broken blades and torn foot pockets, making it ideal for long-term, heavy-duty use.
25º pre-angled blade with a Central Power Panel provides longitudinal rigidity and creates a channeling effect.
Power Bars on the underside of the rails prevent over-flex to maintain the optimum angle of attack under high load conditions.
In-water performance delivers speed, power, stability and maneuverability with a minimum of effort.
Fins fit easily in IATA carry-on compliant luggage for divers who like to travel fast and light.
Innovative Piggy Back Stack system interlocks one fin blade into the other, creating a snug pairing that makes packing and traveling that much easier.

Values.Value: GO Traveling, GO Diving, GO Snorkeling – with the GO fin. This travel fin combines the fitment benefits of an open heel fin, with the comfort and barefoot freedom of a full foot fin. The GO is lightweight yet virtually indestructible, plus it’s a fast and nimble performer in the water. The replaceable self-adjusting bungee heel strap allows for a versatile fit. The strap also makes it easy to don and doff the fin, and it fits comfortably against a bare heel, although the GO will also accommodate neo socks for divers who prefer a little extra foot protection. It’s also designed to fit easily in IATA carry-on compliant luggage, making it the ideal fin for divers, snorkelers and swimmers who enjoy traveling the world.

Variant.title: Go Travel Flossen, Pink, 2XS
Variant.description: GO Traveling, GO Diving, GO Snorkeling – mit der GO Flosse. Die GO Reiseflosse kombiniert die Passformvorteile von Gerätefl ossen mit der Bequemlichkeit und dem Barfußgefühl einer Fußteilfl osse. Die GO-Flosse ist leicht, nahezu unzerstörbar und im Wasser ein schneller und wendiger Begleiter. Sie passt problemlos in IATA-konformes Handgepäck und ist damit ideal für jeden, der gerne die Welt bereist. Go Travel Flossen, Pink, 2XS

Variant.title: GO Travel Pinne, ROSA, 2XS
Variant.description: Goditi i viaggi, le immersioni e lo snorkeling con la pinna GO. Questa pinna da viaggio unisce i vantaggi di adattabilità di una pinna a tallone aperto con la comodità e la libertà di una pinna con tallone chiuso. La pinna GO è leggera ma praticamente indistruttibile, oltre a garantire velocità e agilità nell'acqua. Il cinturino elastico sul tallone autoregolabile e sostituibile consente una vestibilità versatile. Il cinturino la rende anche facile da indossare e da togliere, ed è gradevole a contatto con la pelle del tallone. La pinna GO può anche essere indossata con calzari in neoprene per chi desidera una maggiore protezione del piede. Inoltre, è progettata per poter essere comodamente trasportata nei bagagli a mano, conformemente ai requisiti IATA, ed è dunque perfetta per i subacquei, gli amanti dello snorkeling e i nuotatori che amano viaggiare. | GO Travel Pinne, ROSA, 2XS

MultiValue.Value: Open heel foot pocket features a heavy-duty bungee strap that allows for micro-adjustments to accommodate different boot types.
Extended grip pads on open heel foot pockets provide an improved non-skid grip on wet surfaces.
Compatible with the Seawing Supernova blade and S-Tek blade.
Made of premium Monprene for maximum durability.
Sold as a pair. Blade sold separately.
Available in five sizes (XS, S, M, L, XL) and two colors (Black and White).
Includes 1 set of Lock Plates for easy assembly with a compatible blade.

Values.Value: Modular Fin System Boot-Fit Pocket, Black, XS

SCUBAPRO's innovative two-piece design Modular Fin System, with blade and foot pocket molded separately, allows you to easily switch the foot pocket or blade for different types of diving. The Modular Fin System Boot-Fit Pocket is an open heel foot pocket that can be paired with the Seawing Supernova or S-Tek blades. Use the fin’s easy Socket-Lock Connecting System to pair the Boot-Fit Pocket with a blade and you’re ready to hit the water.

Variant.title: MODULAR FIN SYSTEM GERÄTEFLOSSENFUSSTEIL, SCHWARZ, XS
Variant.description: Das innovative zweiteilige Design des modularen Monprene®-Flossensystems, bei dem Flossenblatt und Fußteil aus zwei separaten Teilen bestehen, ermöglicht den einfachen Austausch zwischen einem Füßling- und einem Barfußteil. Am Gelenk des Socket-Lock-Verbindungssystems kann das Flossenblatt abgenommen werden und das gewünschte Fußteil ganz einfach montiert werden. Und schon bist du bereit für den Sprung ins Wasser. MODULAR FIN SYSTEM GERÄTEFLOSSENFUSSTEIL, SCHWARZ
Variant.product_type: Home DE,Flossen,Zubehör,MODULAR FIN SYSTEM GERÄTEFLOSSENFUSSTEIL SCHWARZ

Variant.title: SCARPETTA A TALLON APERTO PER IL MODULAR FIN SYSTEM Nero XS
Variant.description: L’innovativo design in due elementi dello Modular Fin System (MFS) di SCUBAPRO, realizzato in Monprene® di prima qualità per garantirne la durata nel tempo, ha una struttura separata per la scarpetta e per la pala, rendono possibile sostituire una scarpetta a tallone aperto con una scarpetta a tallone chiuso, perfetta per le immersioni senza calzari. Basta smontare il sistema di assemblaggio Socket-Lock Connecting System e montare la scarpetta a tallone chiuso al posto di quella a tallone aperto, e sei pronto per immergerti. | SCARPETTA A TALLON APERTO PER IL MODULAR FIN SYSTEM Nero XS

MultiValue.Value: Clean water blade and vented blade design reduces drag and increases thrust.
Hydra-Loop ramped and reinforced leading edge improves lateral rigidity for improved alternate kicks, plus creates a hydrofoil profile for better thrust.
Removable Stainless Steel Weight Plate System lets you choose between a positively buoyant, neutrally buoyant, or negatively buoyant fin.
Compatible with Seawing Supernova Foot Pockets.
Includes a multi-tool and 1 set of lock plates, a stainless steel weight system and a SCUBAPRO boat bag.

Values.Value: A new addition to SCUBAPRO’s S-Tek line of technical diving equipment, the S-Tek Fin is a purpose-built, next-gen technical diving fin providing maximum power when you need it. Constructed of durable Monprene® and designed with an ultra-streamlined profile, the S-Tek Fin’s 30º pre-angled blade requires less deflection to achieve the desired angle of attack for an efficient kick. This allows for a stiffer blade without increasing drag, thereby reducing leg cramps and ankle strain while delivering unbeatable maneuverability and alternate kick performance. The S-Tek Fin's two-piece design, with blade and foot pocket molded separately, allows you to use the same foot pockets from the Seawing Supernova fin with just the S-Tek blade. Simply disassemble the Supernova's Socket-Lock Connecting system, switch out the Supernova blade for the S-Tek blade, reassemble, and you're ready to hit the water.

Variant.title: S-TEK FLOSSENBLATT MIDI
Variant.description: Das zweiteilige Design der S-TEK Fin, bei dem Flossenblatt und Fußteil getrennt gefertigt werden, machen sie leicht und praktisch für den Transport. Flossenblatt und Fußteil sind separat gegossen und verfügen über ein haltbares Socket-Lock-Verbindungssystem, das eine einfache Montage und Demontage ermöglicht. S-TEK FLOSSENBLATT MIDI

Variant.title: Pala S-Tek Nero Midi
Variant.description: Il design in due parti delle pinne S-Tek, caratterizzato da pala e scarpetta realizzate separatamente, le rende facili da trasportare. La pala e la scarpetta sono realizzate separatamente e unite con il robusto sistema Socket-Lock Connecting System, che facilita le operazioni di montaggio smontaggio. | Pala S-Tek Nero Midi

MultiValue.Value: Innovative blade shape produces more power, more speed and better maneuverability.
Blade’s central panel membrane auto-adjusts the angle of attack based on kicking strength, providing easier kicking when cruising and maximum power when needed.
Pivot Control Technology ensures that the most efficient 40º to 50º range of angle of attack is maintained.
Twin-tip winglets improve control and maneuverability for excellent frog and alternate kicks.
Central panel Hydra-loop channels water flow rearwards for increased efficiency and thrust.
Made of premium Monprene for long-lasting durability.
Includes a SCUBAPRO boat bag, multi-tool and set of Lock Plates for easy assembly with a compatible foot pocket.

Values.Value: SCUBAPRO’s Seawing Supernova Blade represents the next generation of powerful SCUBAPRO fins. Winner of the prestigious, internationally-recognized Red Dot Award for product design, the Seawing Supernova is a step up from the Seawing Nova in performance, construction, fit and versatility. The proven Pivot Control Technology (PCT) works in tandem with the unique Auto-Adjust central panel to always provide the optimal angle of attack for the blade. The PCT hinges pre-set the blade in the 40º to 50º range that is ideal for converting kicks into forward motion. The flexible Auto-Adjust central panel then fine-tunes the angle of attack according to the strength of kick by counterpivoting, providing a milder angle of attack for comfort when kicking gently, a more aggressive angle of attack when kicking at full strength, and anything in between. When it comes to frog and alternate kicks, the new twin-tip winglets increase control and markedly improve maneuverability. Made of premium Monprene for maximum durability, the Seawing Supernova’s innovative two piece design, with blade and foot pocket molded separately, makes transport easy. The Seawing Supernova Blade is the go-to blade for avid recreational and professional divers seeking maximum speed, power and control in all diving conditions. Foot pocket sold separately.

Variant.title: SUPERNOVA FLOSSENBLATT, Blau, MIDI
Variant.description: Das Supernova-Flossenblatt von SCUBAPRO repräsentiert die nächste Generation leistungsstarker SCUBAPRO-Flossen. Ausgezeichnet mit dem renommierten, international anerkannten Red Dot Award für Produktdesign ist die Seawing Supernova ihrem Vorgänger in Bezug auf Leistung, Konstruktion, Passform und Vielseitigkeit nochmal einen Schritt voraus. Die bewährte Pivot Control Technology (PCT) in Kombination mit dem einzigartigen Auto-Adjust Central Panel, schafft immer den optimalen Anstellwinkel für das Flossenblatt. Durch das PCT-Gelenk steht das Blatt in einem 40 bis 50 Grad-Winkel – die ideale Ausrichtung, um den Flossenschlag in eine effiziente Vorwärtsbewegung umzuwandeln. Zusätzlich bewirkt das flexible Auto-Adjust Central Panel die optimale Einstellung des Anstellwinkels entsprechend der Flossenschlagstärke. Bei leichteren Schlägen wird ein geringerer Anstellwinkel für hohen Komfort generiert, bei mittleren bis starken Flossenschlägen dagegen ein stärkerer Winkel für volle Power. Wenn es um alternative Flossenschläge, wie zum Beispiel den Frog-Kick geht, bieten die Twin-Tip-Winglets bessere Kontrolle und sorgen für eine deutlich verbesserte Manövrierfähigkeit. Das Supernova-Flossenblatt ist das essenzielle Hochleistungsblatt für enthusiastische Freizeit- und Profitaucher, die maximale Geschwindigkeit, Kraft und Kontrolle unter allen Tauchbedingungen suchen. SUPERNOVA FLOSSENBLATT, Blau, MIDI

Variant.title: Pala Supernova Blu Midi
Variant.description: La pala Seawing Supernova SCUBAPRO fa parte della generazione di pinne SCUBAPRO. Vincitrici del prestigioso premio internazionale di design Red Dot, le Seawing Supernova costituiscono una versione aggiornata e migliorata delle classiche Supernova per quanto riguarda performance, realizzazione, vestibilità e versatilità. La tecnologia di controllo pivot (PCT) è stata messa a punto per funzionare in sinergia con il modulo di controllo centralizzato a regolazione automatica per garantire sempre un angolo di attacco ottimale della pala. Questo sistema permette di incernierare la pala secondo un angolo preimpostato che va 40º a 50º, ideale per convertire la spinta della pinneggiata in movimento. Il pannello centrale, flessibile e a regolazione automatica, permette quindi una regolazione di precisione dell’angolo di attacco della pinna in base alla potenza della pinneggiata tramite un’inclinazione di senso contrario, garantendo un angolo di attacco moderato per una nuotata rilassata e uno più aggressivo quando sei alla ricerca di potenza, consentendoti ovviamente tutte le altre opzioni intermedie. Sia per la pinnegiata a rana e che quella alternata, le alette con punta doppia ti garantiranno un maggiore controllo, migliorando notevolmente la manovrabilità delle pinne. El innovador diseño en dos piezas de las Seawing Supernova, con la pala y la zona calzante moldeadas de forma separada, facilita el transporte. Realizzate in Monprene® di prima qualità per garantirne la durata nel tempo. La pala Seawing Supernova è un elemento irrinunciabile per tutti i sub che sono alla ricerca di velocità elevata, potenza e controllo in tutte le condizioni di immersione, sia per i sub amatoriali più appassionati che per quelli professionisti. | Pala Supernova Blu Midi

Pivot Control Technology ensures that the most efficient 40º to 50º range of angle of attack is maintained.
Twin-tip winglets improve control and maneuverability for excellent frog and alternate kicks.
Central panel Hydra-loop channels water flow rearwards for increased efficiency and thrust.
Made of premium Monprene for long-lasting durability.
Includes a SCUBAPRO boat bag, multi-tool and set of Lock Plates for easy assembly with a compatible foot pocket.

Values.Value: SCUBAPRO’s Seawing Supernova Blade represents the next generation of powerful SCUBAPRO fins. Winner of the prestigious, internationally-recognized Red Dot Award for product design, the Seawing Supernova is a step up from the Seawing Nova in performance, construction, fit and versatility. The proven Pivot Control Technology (PCT) works in tandem with the unique Auto-Adjust central panel to always provide the optimal angle of attack for the blade. The PCT hinges pre-set the blade in the 40º to 50º range that is ideal for converting kicks into forward motion. The flexible Auto-Adjust central panel then fine-tunes the angle of attack according to the strength of kick by counterpivoting, providing a milder angle of attack for comfort when kicking gently, a more aggressive angle of attack when kicking at full strength, and anything in between. When it comes to frog and alternate kicks, the new twin-tip winglets increase control and markedly improve maneuverability. Made of premium Monprene for maximum durability, the Seawing Supernova’s innovative two piece design, with blade and foot pocket molded separately, makes transport easy. The Seawing Supernova Blade is the go-to blade for avid recreational and professional divers seeking maximum speed, power and control in all diving conditions. Foot pocket sold separately.

Variant.title: SUPERNOVA FLOSSENBLATT, Pink, MIDI
Variant.description: Das Supernova-Flossenblatt von SCUBAPRO repräsentiert die nächste Generation leistungsstarker SCUBAPRO-Flossen. Ausgezeichnet mit dem renommierten, international anerkannten Red Dot Award für Produktdesign ist die Seawing Supernova ihrem Vorgänger in Bezug auf Leistung, Konstruktion, Passform und Vielseitigkeit nochmal einen Schritt voraus. Die bewährte Pivot Control Technology (PCT) in Kombination mit dem einzigartigen Auto-Adjust Central Panel, schafft immer den optimalen Anstellwinkel für das Flossenblatt. Durch das PCT-Gelenk steht das Blatt in einem 40 bis 50 Grad-Winkel – die ideale Ausrichtung, um den Flossenschlag in eine effiziente Vorwärtsbewegung umzuwandeln. Zusätzlich bewirkt das flexible Auto-Adjust Central Panel die optimale Einstellung des Anstellwinkels entsprechend der Flossenschlagstärke. Bei leichteren Schlägen wird ein geringerer Anstellwinkel für hohen Komfort generiert, bei mittleren bis starken Flossenschlägen dagegen ein stärkerer Winkel für volle Power. Wenn es um alternative Flossenschläge, wie zum Beispiel den Frog-Kick geht, bieten die Twin-Tip-Winglets bessere Kontrolle und sorgen für eine deutlich verbesserte Manövrierfähigkeit. Das Supernova-Flossenblatt ist das essenzielle Hochleistungsblatt für enthusiastische Freizeit- und Profitaucher, die maximale Geschwindigkeit, Kraft und Kontrolle unter allen Tauchbedingungen suchen. SUPERNOVA FLOSSENBLATT, Pink, MIDI

Variant.title: Pala Supernova Rosa Midi
Variant.description: La pala Seawing Supernova SCUBAPRO fa parte della generazione di pinne SCUBAPRO. Vincitrici del prestigioso premio internazionale di design Red Dot, le Seawing Supernova costituiscono una versione aggiornata e migliorata delle classiche Supernova per quanto riguarda performance, realizzazione, vestibilità e versatilità. La tecnologia di controllo pivot (PCT) è stata messa a punto per funzionare in sinergia con il modulo di controllo centralizzato a regolazione automatica per garantire sempre un angolo di attacco ottimale della pala. Questo sistema permette di incernierare la pala secondo un angolo preimpostato che va 40º a 50º, ideale per convertire la spinta della pinneggiata in movimento. Il pannello centrale, flessibile e a regolazione automatica, permette quindi una regolazione di precisione dell’angolo di attacco della pinna in base alla potenza della pinneggiata tramite un’inclinazione di senso contrario, garantendo un angolo di attacco moderato per una nuotata rilassata e uno più aggressivo quando sei alla ricerca di potenza, consentendoti ovviamente tutte le altre opzioni intermedie. Sia per la pinnegiata a rana e che quella alternata, le alette con punta doppia ti garantiranno un maggiore controllo, migliorando notevolmente la manovrabilità delle pinne. El innovador diseño en dos piezas de las Seawing Supernova, con la pala y la zona calzante moldeadas de forma separada, facilita el transporte. Realizzate in Monprene® di prima qualità per garantirne la durata nel tempo. La pala Seawing Supernova è un elemento irrinunciabile per tutti i sub che sono alla ricerca di velocità elevata, potenza e controllo in tutte le condizioni di immersione, sia per i sub amatoriali più appassionati che per quelli professionisti. | Pala Supernova Rosa Midi

Pivot Control Technology ensures that the most efficient 40º to 50º range of angle of attack is maintained.
Twin-tip winglets improve control and maneuverability for excellent frog and alternate kicks.
Central panel Hydra-loop channels water flow rearwards for increased efficiency and thrust.
Made of premium Monprene for long-lasting durability.
Includes a SCUBAPRO boat bag, multi-tool and set of Lock Plates for easy assembly with a compatible foot pocket.

Values.Value: SCUBAPRO’s Seawing Supernova Blade represents the next generation of powerful SCUBAPRO fins. Winner of the prestigious, internationally-recognized Red Dot Award for product design, the Seawing Supernova is a step up from the Seawing Nova in performance, construction, fit and versatility. The proven Pivot Control Technology (PCT) works in tandem with the unique Auto-Adjust central panel to always provide the optimal angle of attack for the blade. The PCT hinges pre-set the blade in the 40º to 50º range that is ideal for converting kicks into forward motion. The flexible Auto-Adjust central panel then fine-tunes the angle of attack according to the strength of kick by counterpivoting, providing a milder angle of attack for comfort when kicking gently, a more aggressive angle of attack when kicking at full strength, and anything in between. When it comes to frog and alternate kicks, the new twin-tip winglets increase control and markedly improve maneuverability. Made of premium Monprene for maximum durability, the Seawing Supernova’s innovative two piece design, with blade and foot pocket molded separately, makes transport easy. The Seawing Supernova Blade is the go-to blade for avid recreational and professional divers seeking maximum speed, power and control in all diving conditions. Foot pocket sold separately.

Variant.title: SUPERNOVA FLOSSENBLATT, Türkis, MAXI
Variant.description: Das Supernova-Flossenblatt von SCUBAPRO repräsentiert die nächste Generation leistungsstarker SCUBAPRO-Flossen. Ausgezeichnet mit dem renommierten, international anerkannten Red Dot Award für Produktdesign ist die Seawing Supernova ihrem Vorgänger in Bezug auf Leistung, Konstruktion, Passform und Vielseitigkeit nochmal einen Schritt voraus. Die bewährte Pivot Control Technology (PCT) in Kombination mit dem einzigartigen Auto-Adjust Central Panel, schafft immer den optimalen Anstellwinkel für das Flossenblatt. Durch das PCT-Gelenk steht das Blatt in einem 40 bis 50 Grad-Winkel – die ideale Ausrichtung, um den Flossenschlag in eine effiziente Vorwärtsbewegung umzuwandeln. Zusätzlich bewirkt das flexible Auto-Adjust Central Panel die optimale Einstellung des Anstellwinkels entsprechend der Flossenschlagstärke. Bei leichteren Schlägen wird ein geringerer Anstellwinkel für hohen Komfort generiert, bei mittleren bis starken Flossenschlägen dagegen ein stärkerer Winkel für volle Power. Wenn es um alternative Flossenschläge, wie zum Beispiel den Frog-Kick geht, bieten die Twin-Tip-Winglets bessere Kontrolle und sorgen für eine deutlich verbesserte Manövrierfähigkeit. Das Supernova-Flossenblatt ist das essenzielle Hochleistungsblatt für enthusiastische Freizeit- und Profitaucher, die maximale Geschwindigkeit, Kraft und Kontrolle unter allen Tauchbedingungen suchen. SUPERNOVA FLOSSENBLATT, Türkis, MAXI

Variant.title: Pala Supernova Turchese Maxi
Variant.description: La pala Seawing Supernova SCUBAPRO fa parte della generazione di pinne SCUBAPRO. Vincitrici del prestigioso premio internazionale di design Red Dot, le Seawing Supernova costituiscono una versione aggiornata e migliorata delle classiche Supernova per quanto riguarda performance, realizzazione, vestibilità e versatilità. La tecnologia di controllo pivot (PCT) è stata messa a punto per funzionare in sinergia con il modulo di controllo centralizzato a regolazione automatica per garantire sempre un angolo di attacco ottimale della pala. Questo sistema permette di incernierare la pala secondo un angolo preimpostato che va 40º a 50º, ideale per convertire la spinta della pinneggiata in movimento. Il pannello centrale, flessibile e a regolazione automatica, permette quindi una regolazione di precisione dell’angolo di attacco della pinna in base alla potenza della pinneggiata tramite un’inclinazione di senso contrario, garantendo un angolo di attacco moderato per una nuotata rilassata e uno più aggressivo quando sei alla ricerca di potenza, consentendoti ovviamente tutte le altre opzioni intermedie. Sia per la pinnegiata a rana e che quella alternata, le alette con punta doppia ti garantiranno un maggiore controllo, migliorando notevolmente la manovrabilità delle pinne. El innovador diseño en dos piezas de las Seawing Supernova, con la pala y la zona calzante moldeadas de forma separada, facilita el transporte. Realizzate in Monprene® di prima qualità per garantirne la durata nel tempo. La pala Seawing Supernova è un elemento irrinunciabile per tutti i sub che sono alla ricerca di velocità elevata, potenza e controllo in tutte le condizioni di immersione, sia per i sub amatoriali più appassionati che per quelli professionisti. | Pala Supernova Turchese Maxi

MultiValue.Value: Clean water blade and vented blade design reduces drag and increases thrust.
Hydra-Loop ramped and reinforced leading edge improves lateral rigidity for improved alternate kicks, plus creates a hydrofoil profile for better thrust.
Removable Stainless Steel Weight Plate System lets you choose between a positively buoyant, neutrally buoyant, or negatively buoyant fin.
Compatible with Seawing Supernova Foot Pockets.
Includes a multi-tool and 1 set of lock plates, a stainless steel weight system and a SCUBAPRO boat bag.

Values.Value: A new addition to SCUBAPRO’s S-Tek line of technical diving equipment, the S-Tek Fin is a purpose-built, next-gen technical diving fin providing maximum power when you need it. Constructed of durable Monprene® and designed with an ultra-streamlined profile, the S-Tek Fin’s 30º pre-angled blade requires less deflection to achieve the desired angle of attack for an efficient kick. This allows for a stiffer blade without increasing drag, thereby reducing leg cramps and ankle strain while delivering unbeatable maneuverability and alternate kick performance. The S-Tek Fin's two-piece design, with blade and foot pocket molded separately, allows you to use the same foot pockets from the Seawing Supernova fin with just the S-Tek blade. Simply disassemble the Supernova's Socket-Lock Connecting system, switch out the Supernova blade for the S-Tek blade, reassemble, and you're ready to hit the water.

Variant.title: S-TEK FLOSSENBLATT, ORANGE, MIDI
Variant.description: Das zweiteilige Design der S-TEK Fin, bei dem Flossenblatt und Fußteil getrennt gefertigt werden, machen sie leicht und praktisch für den Transport. Flossenblatt und Fußteil sind separat gegossen und verfügen über ein haltbares Socket-Lock-Verbindungssystem, das eine einfache Montage und Demontage ermöglicht. S-TEK FLOSSENBLATT, ORANGE, MIDI

Variant.title: Pala S-Tek Arancione Midi
Variant.description: Il design in due parti delle pinne S-Tek, caratterizzato da pala e scarpetta realizzate separatamente, le rende facili da trasportare. La pala e la scarpetta sono realizzate separatamente e unite con il robusto sistema Socket-Lock Connecting System, che facilita le operazioni di montaggio smontaggio. | Pala S-Tek Arancione Midi

MultiValue.Value: Lightweight design increases convenience when traveling and comfort and ease of use in the water. (For example, size XS-S weighs 1.0kg/2.2lbs per pair, including bungee straps; M-L weighs 1.2kg/2.6lbs per pair, including bungee straps.)
Barefoot Design features a replaceable self-adjusting bungee heel strap that allows for a versatile fit and makes the fin easy to don and doff. It can also be used when wearing neo socks.
Ultra-strong 100% Monprene® construction avoids problems of delamination, broken blades and torn foot pockets, making it ideal for long-term, heavy-duty use.
25º pre-angled blade with a Central Power Panel provides longitudinal rigidity and creates a channeling effect.
Power Bars on the underside of the rails prevent over-flex to maintain the optimum angle of attack under high load conditions.
In-water performance delivers speed, power, stability and maneuverability with a minimum of effort.
Fins fit easily in IATA carry-on compliant luggage for divers who like to travel fast and light.
Innovative Piggy Back Stack system interlocks one fin blade into the other, creating a snug pairing that makes packing and traveling that much easier.

Values.Value: GO Traveling, GO Diving, GO Snorkeling – with the GO fin. This travel fin combines the fitment benefits of an open heel fin, with the comfort and barefoot freedom of a full foot fin. The GO is lightweight yet virtually indestructible, plus it’s a fast and nimble performer in the water. The replaceable self-adjusting bungee heel strap allows for a versatile fit. The strap also makes it easy to don and doff the fin, and it fits comfortably against a bare heel, although the GO will also accommodate neo socks for divers who prefer a little extra foot protection. It’s also designed to fit easily in IATA carry-on compliant luggage, making it the ideal fin for divers, snorkelers and swimmers who enjoy traveling the world.

MultiValue.Value: Three-material blade construction optimizes flex to maximize kicking performance.

Effective non-skid pattern protects against slips on wet surfaces.

Values.Value: If you're a fan of traditional blade fins, the JET SPORT ADJUSTABLE will definitely impress with its power, acceleration and maneuverability. Lightweight and comfortable, with a big, slightly stiff blade and a soft rubber foot pocket, this fin generates propulsive kicking power, provides good stability and makes efficient work of frog and dolphin kicks. The fin is easy to maneuver too; responsive in turns and able to back you out of tight spots with ease. The rubber foot pocket molds comfortably to your foot, and the strap adjustments and quick-release buckles make donning and doffing the JET SPORT ADJUSTABLE oh-so-easy.

Variant.title: Jet Sport Flosse, Schwarz XS
Variant.description: Falls du herkömmliche Flossen bevorzugst, wird dich die JET SPORT ADJUSTABLE mit ihrer Kraft, Beschleunigung und Manövrierbarkeit überzeugen. Diese Flosse ist leicht und bequem, hat ein etwas härteres Blatt und ein weiches Gummi-Fußteil und erzeugt Vortriebskraft bei guter Stabilität und effizienter Kraftübertragung auch bei Frosch- und Delfinschlägen. Sie ist leicht manövrierbar, reagiert auf Drehungen und bringt dich aus engen Bereichen mit Leichtigkeit heraus. Leggera e confortevole, dotata di una grande pala leggermente rigida e di una scarpetta in morbida gomma, questa pinna genera una spinta propulsiva, fornisce un'ottima stabilità e regala un'efficiente pinneggiata a rana e delfino. La pinna è altresì facile da manovrare, reattiva nelle virate ed efficiente nell'uscita da passaggi stretti con facilità. La scarpetta in gomma aderisce confortevolmente al piede, mentre i cinghioli regolabili e le fibbie a sgancio rapido rendono facilissimo indossare e togliere le pinne JET SPORT REGOLABILI. | JET SPORT Pinne, Turchese M

Values.Value: If you're a fan of traditional blade fins, the JET SPORT ADJUSTABLE will definitely impress with its power, acceleration and maneuverability. Lightweight and comfortable, with a big, slightly stiff blade and a soft rubber foot pocket, this fin generates propulsive kicking power, provides good stability and makes efficient work of frog and dolphin kicks. The fin is easy to maneuver too; responsive in turns and able to back you out of tight spots with ease. The rubber foot pocket molds comfortably to your foot, and the strap adjustments and quick-release buckles make donning and doffing the JET SPORT ADJUSTABLE oh-so-easy.

Variant.title: Jet Sport Flosse, Türkis L
Variant.description: Falls du herkömmliche Flossen bevorzugst, wird dich die JET SPORT ADJUSTABLE mit ihrer Kraft, Beschleunigung und Manövrierbarkeit überzeugen. Diese Flosse ist leicht und bequem, hat ein etwas härteres Blatt und ein weiches Gummi-Fußteil und erzeugt Vortriebskraft bei guter Stabilität und effizienter Kraftübertragung auch bei Frosch- und Delfinschlägen. Sie ist leicht manövrierbar, reagiert auf Drehungen und bringt dich aus engen Bereichen mit Leichtigkeit heraus. Das Gummi-Fußteil schmiegt sich bequem an deinen Fuß an und die Fersenbänder und schnell zu öffnenden Schnallen erleichtern das An- und Ausziehen der JET SPORT ADJUSTABLE sehr. Jet Sport Flosse, Türkis L

22.64 in x 2.76 in | 57.5 cm x 7 cm

MultiValue.Value: Three-material blade construction optimizes flex to maximize kicking performance.
Drag-reducing vents substantially decrease resistance on both up and down strokes.
Big blade generates a powerful response in the water and improves stability and maneuverability.
Ergonomic full foot pocket molds to your entire foot for total comfort during long dives.
Effective non-skid pattern protects against slips on wet surfaces.
Small sizing is ideal for smaller feet.

Values.Value: Jet Sport Fin, Full Foot, Black, XS

The JET SPORT FULL FOOT is lightweight yet delivers lots of propulsion, excellent maneuverability, plus it feels oh-so-comfy on bare feet. Its slightly stiff blade is a tri-material design featuring a pair of soft rubber panels framed in semi-stiff plastic and flanked by thin side rails, producing just the right amount of flex. There are also drag-reducing vents between the blade and foot pocket to decrease resistance on both up and down strokes. This combination generates propulsive kicking power, provides good stability and makes efficient work of frog and dolphin kicks. The rubber full foot pocket molds comfortably to your foot, and the non-skid pattern is effective on wet decks. A great choice for finning in the tropics.

Variant.title: Jet Sport Flosse Fußteilflossen, Schwarz XS
Variant.description: Die JET SPORT FULL FOOT ist leicht und doch antriebsstark, bei exzellenter Manövrierbarkeit und einem sehr bequemen Sitz am nackten Fuß. Ihr etwas härteres Blatt besteht aus drei Materialien – einem Paar weicher Gummiflächen, eingefasst von halbsteifem Kunststoff mit dünnen Seitenrahmen. All dies produziert genau das richtige Maß an Biegsamkeit. Strömungsöffnungen zwischen Blatt und Fußteil reduzieren den Widerstand bei Auf- und Abschlägen. Diese Kombination erzeugt stabile Vortriebskraft, gute Stabilität und setzt Frosch- und Delfinbewegungen effizient um. Das Gummi-Vollfußteil schmiegt sich bequem an deinen Fuß und das Sohlenprofil zahlt sich auf nassen Decks aus. Eine gute Wahl für die Tropen. Jet Sport Flosse Fußteilflossen, Schwarz XS
Variant.product_type: Home DE,Flossen,Jet Sport Flosse Fußteilflossen Schwarz XS

Variant.title: JET SPORT Pinne, Scarpetta Completa, Nero XS
Variant.description: Le JET SPORT A TALLONE CHIUSO sono leggere ma allo stesso tempo offrono una notevole propulsione e un'eccellente manovrabilità, oltre a essere comodissime a contatto con la pelle del piede. La loro pala leggermente rigida è realizzata con un design a tre materiali: una coppia di pannelli in morbida gomma all'interno di un telaio in plastica semi-rigida e affiancati da sottili costolature, che conferiscono la giusta flessibilità. Sono anche presenti aperture anti-attrito tra la pala e la scarpetta, per diminuire la resistenza in tutte le direzioni di pinneggiamento. Questa combinazione genera una spinta propulsiva, fornisce un'ottima stabilità e regala un'efficiente pinneggiata a rana e delfino. La scarpetta con tallone chiuso in gomma aderisce confortevolmente al piede e il rilievo anti-scivolo è efficace sui ponti bagnati. Un'ottima scelta per immergersi ai tropici. | JET SPORT Pinne, Scarpetta Completa, Nero XS

Variant.product_type: Home IT,Pinne,JET SPORT Pinne Scarpetta Completa Nero XS

Diese Kombination erzeugt stabile Vortriebskraft, gute Stabilität und setzt Frosch- und Delfinbewegungen effizient um. Das Gummi-Vollfußteil schmiegt sich bequem an deinen Fuß und das Sohlenprofil zahlt sich auf nassen Decks aus. Eine gute Wahl für die Tropen. Jet Sport Flosse Fußteilflossen, Blau XS

Values.Value: The NEXUS is one of SCUBAPRO's premium snorkels. It features an oval-shaped, large-bore upper barrel that minimizes drag while allowing lots of air to flow. The barrel is fitted with a splashguard-style top to deflect surface water. At the other end there's an angled purge valve designed to divert bubbles out of your line of sight. The rotating mouthpiece can be positioned perfectly for maximum comfort. When breathing off a regulator, the snorkel's corrugated lower section drops out of the way. The NEXUS offers another handy feature: the upper barrel is flexible, so you can fold it for stowage in a BC pocket.

Variant.title: Escape Semi-Dry Snorkel, Trasparente

Values.Value: SCUBAPRO's Apnea or Freediving snorkel easily attaches to your mask strap when being used. When not needed, it can be folded and stowed in an accessory pocket. When it's time to do some surface swimming, it pops right back into shape. Without question, this is a versatile and easy-to-use surface breather.

Variant.title: Apnea Schnorchel, Schwarz
Variant.description: Der Apnoe- oder Freitauchschnorchel von SCUBAPRO lässt sich einfach am Maskenband befestigen. Wird er nicht gebraucht, kann er gefaltet und in einer Zubehörtasche verstaut werden. Sobald er benötigt wird, entfaltet er sich schnell wieder in seine ursprüngliche Form. Das ist ohne Frage ein vielseitiger und einfach zu verwendender Schnorchel. Apnea Schnorchel, Schwarz

Variant.title: Apnea Snorkel, Nero
Variant.description: Lo snorkel Apnea o Freediving di SCUBAPRO si aggancia facilmente alla cinghia della maschera durante l'uso. Si tratta senza dubbio di un respiratore di superficie versatile e facile da usare. | Apnea Snorkel, Nero

MultiValue.Value: Large-bore upper tube with dry top is designed for dry and easy breathing.
Corrugated silicone lower tube allows the mouthpiece to hang out of the way when breathing off a regulator.
Purge valve, positioned at the lowest point, takes care of any water that might enter the airway.
Regulator-style mouthpiece offers good bite tabs for a comfortable fit, ideal for extended snorkeling adventures.
Quick-connect clip makes it easy to attach or remove snorkel from mask strap.

Values.Value: Designed to be the perfect companion to SCUBAPRO's Spectra masks, the restyled SPECTRA DRY is nothing if not the ideal snorkel. Its large-bore upper tube allows plenty of airflow, and its dry top design actually seals the tube when the snorkel is submerged so no clearing is needed upon resurfacing. An efficient purge valve expels any water that might make its way into the airway, preventing that annoying gurgling sensation you get when breathing off a "wet" snorkel. The lower corrugated tube is flexible so when you switch to your regulator the snorkel mouthpiece hangs out of the way.

Variant.title: Spectra Dry Schnorchel, Silber/Schwarz
Variant.description: Passt perfekt zur Maske Spectra. Dieser Schnorchel zeichnet sich durch einen großen Durchmesser und einen hohen Luftdurchfluss aus. Ein Spritzwasserschutz am oberen Ende verhindert das Eindringen von Wasser und hält das Schnorchelrohr trocken. Sollte doch Wasser eindringen, kann dieses über ein Ausblasventil im Mundstück nach draußen befördert werden. Durch den flexiblen Faltenschlauch ist das Mundstück nicht im Weg, wenn der Schnorchel nicht benötigt wird. Spectra Dry Schnorchel, Silber/Schwarz

Variant.title: Spectra Dry Snorkel, Argento
Variant.description: Creato per essere il compagno perfetto delle maschere Spectra di SCUBAPRO, il modello SPECTRA DRY rivisto è semplicemente lo snorkel perfetto. Il tubo superiore a diametro maggiorato favorisce il flusso d’aria, e il design con paraspruzzi sigilla efficacemente il tubo quando sott'acqua, quindi non deve essere svuotato una volta ritornati in superficie. Un'efficace valvola di spurgo espelle l'acqua che può essersi infiltrata nel respiratore, evitando quella fastidiosa sensazione di gorgoglio che si avverte quando nello snorkel è presente acqua. Il tubo inferiore ondulato è flessibile, in modo che il boccaglio possa essere allontanato quando si passa all'erogatore. | Spectra Dry Snorkel, Argento

Values.Value: Designed to be the perfect companion to SCUBAPRO's Spectra masks, the restyled SPECTRA DRY is nothing if not the ideal snorkel. Its large-bore upper tube allows plenty of airflow, and its dry top design actually seals the tube when the snorkel is submerged so no clearing is needed upon resurfacing. An efficient purge valve expels any water that might make its way into the airway, preventing that annoying gurgling sensation you get when breathing off a "wet" snorkel. The lower corrugated tube is flexible so when you switch to your regulator the snorkel mouthpiece hangs out of the way.

Purge valve, positioned at the lowest point, takes care of any water that might enter the airway.
Regulator-style mouthpiece offers good bite tabs for a comfortable fit, ideal for extended snorkeling adventures.
Quick-connect clip makes it easy to attach or remove snorkel from mask strap.

Values.Value: Designed to be the perfect companion to SCUBAPRO's Spectra masks, the restyled SPECTRA DRY is nothing if not the ideal snorkel. Its large-bore upper tube allows plenty of airflow, and its dry top design actually seals the tube when the snorkel is submerged so no clearing is needed upon resurfacing. An efficient purge valve expels any water that might make its way into the airway, preventing that annoying gurgling sensation you get when breathing off a "wet" snorkel. The lower corrugated tube is flexible so when you switch to your regulator the snorkel mouthpiece hangs out of the way.

Values.Value: This snorkel is tops when it comes to breathing comfort and ease of clearing. The large-bore upper tube is rigid for stability and allows plenty of airflow, while the corrugated lower tube can be easily positioned when being used, and hangs out of the way when not being used. Variant.title: Spectra Schnorchel, Türkis/Schwarz
Variant.description: Dieser Schnorchel lässt sich bequem atmen und einfach ausblasen. Das rigide Schnorchelrohr besitzt im oberen Bereich einen großen Durchmesser für einen hohen Luftdurchfluss. Durch den flexiblen Faltenschlauch sitzt das Mundstück perfekt im Mund. Ansonsten hängt es einfach herunter und stört den Taucher nicht. Der halbtrockene Rohraufsatz verhindert das Eindringen von Spritzwasser. über das Ventil im Mundstück lässt sich der Spectra nach dem Auftauchen bequem ausblasen. Spectra Schnorchel, Türkis/Schwarz

Variant.title: Spectra Snorkel, Nero/Turchese
Variant.description: Il meglio in quanto a comfort di respirazione e facilità di svuotamento. Il paraspruzzi consente di evitare l'ingresso di acqua, mentre la valvola di spurgo posizionata nel punto più basso espelle rapidamente l'eventuale acqua infiltratasi. | Spectra Snorkel, Nero/Turchese

If you're a fan of full-sized dive knives you're going to appreciate SCUBAPRO's all-purpose K6. Index finger grip and thumb grip on the spine make for easy one-handed operation.
Highly aggressive serrations can cut through a variety of materials found under water.
Blunted nose protects against puncturing BCD bladders or hoses.
Designed to be worn on the upper chest area of a BCD using a TacWare J-clip (included) that allows instant access to the tool.
Available in either black with a yellow glow-in-the-dark handle or black with a black handle.
Manufactured by LIFELINE Tactical Rescue Tools, 100% made in the USA.

Values.Value: More than a dive knife, the new JAWZ Ti is a versatile, all-in-one multi-purpose rescue tool. Made from Grade 38 ATI 425 ballistic titanium with 316 stainless steel hardware, the tool features two main cutting surfaces with three distinct cutting areas and a heat-injected molded polypropylene thermoplastic handle with pointed breaker. Choose between a flat black or glow-in-the-dark handle for working in low-light conditions. A sheath and TacWare J-clip are included.

Galileo HUD Hands-Free Computer Mask Holder Kit

The Galileo HUD Hands-Free Computer Mask Holder Kit contains a mask mount and zip ties to securely attach a HUD dive computer onto a standard SCUBAPRO dual lens mask. The Mask Holder Kit adapts the following dual lens masks to hold the HUD dive computer: Flux Twin, Scout, Spectra, Spectra Mini, Synergy Twin and Synergy 2 Twin. It is also compatible with the Currents Adult Mask Combo and Ecco Mask Combo Sets.

Values.Value: packaging; barcode sticker; elastic strap; heart rate module

Factoring your heart rate into your decompression calculations helps make diving safer and a lot more fun. A lightweight waterproof ECG (electrocardiogram) transmitter is clipped onto the elastic belt that straps around the chest, directly against the skin. This belt wirelessly transmits your heart rate data to your SCUBAPRO personal dive computer. Data is displayed on the screen, plus is factored into your decompression calculations to create a more personalized dive plan and improve the quality of your diving.

Variant.title: Fascia Cardiofrequenzimetro Digitale
Variant.description: Aggiungere il monitoraggio della frequenza cardiaca nei calcoli di decompressione garantisce immersioni più sicure e molto più divertenti. Un rilevatore ECG (elettrocardiogramma) leggero e impermeabile è agganciato alla fascia pettorale elastica, da indossare a diretto contatto con la pelle. La fascia trasmette in modalità wireless i dati della frequenza cardiaca al computer subacqueo personale SCUBAPRO. I dati sono visualizzati sul display, inoltre vengono inclusi nei calcoli di decompressione per creare un piano di immersione più personalizzato e migliorare la qualità delle immersioni. | Fascia Cardiofrequenzimetro Digitale

Variant.title: Digitaler Herzfrequenz-Brustgurt
Variant.description: Die Berücksichtigung der Herzfrequenz bei der Dekompressionsberechnung macht das Tauchen sicherer und bringt noch mehr Spaß. Ein leichter, wasserdichter EKG-Sender (Elektrokardiogramm) wird an den elastischen Gurt geklippt, der um die Brust geschnallt wird und direkt auf der Haut liegt. Dieser Gurt überträgt deine Herzfrequenzdaten drahtlos an deinen SCUBAPRO Tauchcomputer. Die Daten werden auf dem Display angezeigt und werden in der Dekompressionsberechnung berücksichtigt, um einen individuelleren Tauchplan zu erstellen und die Qualität deiner Tauchgänge zu verbessern. Digitaler Herzfrequenz-Brustgurt

The Släggö Flex Ring is a modular quick-change solution designed to make it easy to replace a broken or torn wrist seal on a drysuit. And now, with the new Oberon Dry Glove system, there’s a convenient and reliable method for attaching virtually any model of dry glove to a Släggö Flex Ring. Developed and manufactured by Si Tech, the Oberon Dry Glove System consists of 13 components per arm, connects to large and medium Släggö Flex Rings, and fits most common dry glove models. Dry gloves not included.

Variant.title: Slaggo Oberon Ring System
Variant.description: Mit dem Oberon Trockentauch-Handschuhsystem gibt es jetzt eine praktische und zuverlässige Methode, um nahezu jedes Modell eines Trockentauch-Handschuhs an einem Släggo Flex Ring zu befestigen. Der Släggo Flex Ring ist eine modulare Schnellwechsel-Lösung, die das Ersetzen einer gerissenen Manschette an einem Trockenanzug erleichtert. Das von Si-Tech entwickelte und hergestellte Oberon Trockentauch-Handschuhsystem besteht aus 13 Komponenten pro Arm und kann mit großen und mittleren Släggo-Flex-Ringen verbunden werden für die meisten gängigen Trockentauch-Handschuhmodelle. Trockentauchhandschuhe nicht inklusive. Slaggo Oberon Ring System

One size fits all for total convenience.
Available in lots of stylish colors.

Compatible mask models: Crystal Vu Plus, Devil, Ghost, Mini Vu, Sardine, Scout, Spectra Trufit, Steel Pro, Steel Comp, Synergy 2, Synergy Mini, Synergy Twin, Synergy 2 Twin, Sub Vu Mini, Trinidad 3, Zoom, and combos: Currents Adult, Mini Vu and Sub Vu

Values.Value: Upgrade your diving or snorkeling mask with a new Comfort Strap. Similar to a ski goggle strap, the Comfort Strap is comfortable, protects hair from being pulled, and attaches quickly and easily to a variety of mask models. Available in lots of stylish colors.

Variant.title: Comfort Strap, Grün

MultiValue.Value: Great for attaching knives, SMBs, lights, Hydros Ninja Pockets and more
Comes with 2 plastic plates and 2 stainless steel screws

Values.Value: Hydros Pro 2 Monorail Multi-Mount Accessory Plate Set

Configure your BCD to meet your needs with the Monorail Multi-Mount Accessory Plate Set. Built for the Hydros Pro 2, it enables you to mount accessories above or below the Monorail and weight pocket. One set is needed for each side of the BCD and is easily mounted to the Monorail system. You can mount the plates on the left, right or both sides, creating a versatile system for attaching a knife, the popular roll-out Ninja Pocket or the Hydros Accessory Bungee Sets that are great for stowing SMBs, lights or other accessories.

Variant.title: Zubehörplatten-Set für das Monorail Multi-Mount-System
Variant.description: Passen Sie Ihr Tarierjacket mit dem Zubehörplatten-Set für das Monorail Multi-Mount-System ganz nach Ihren Bedürfnissen an. Entwickelt für das Hydros Pro 2, ermöglicht es die Befestigung von Zubehör oberhalb oder unterhalb der Monorail und der Bleitasche. Für jede Seite des Tarierjackets wird ein Set benötigt, das sich leicht am Monorail-System befestigen lässt. Die Platten können links, rechts oder auf beiden Seiten angebracht werden und bilden so ein vielseitiges System zur Befestigung eines Messers, der beliebten Ninja-Tasche oder der Hydros Bungee Sets, die sich hervorragend zur Aufbewahrung von Signalbojen, Tauchlampen oder anderem Zubehör eignen. Zubehörplatten-Set für das Monorail Multi-Mount-System
Variant.product_type: Home DE,Zubehör,Zubehörplatten-Set für das Monorail Multi-Mount-System

Variant.title: Kit di Montaggio Accessori Multi-Mount Monorail
Variant.description: Adatta il tuo GAV alle tue esigenze grazie al kit di montaggio accessori Multi-Mount Monorail. Progettato per il modello Hydros Pro 2, questo kit ti consente di montare gli accessori sia al di sopra che al di sotto del sistema Monorail e delle tasche porta-zavorra. È necessario un kit per ciascun lato del GAV; si monta facilmente sul sistema Monorail. Le piastre possono essere montate sul lato destro, sinistro o su entrambi i lati, creando un sistema versatile per fissare un coltello, la popolare tasca arrotolabile Ninja Pocket o i set di cinghie elastiche Hydros per accessori, ideali per riporre un pedagno, una torcia o altri accessori. | Kit di Montaggio Accessori Multi-Mount Monorail

Values.Value: Now any SCUBAPRO BCD, including entry-level BCDs and those with full-sized backpacks, can be retrofitted with a high-quality trim weight system to aid in improving a diver’s swimming position. These innovative trim weight pockets include low-profile, lightweight buckles to secure the weights, special plastic clips to keep the pockets in place on the BCD, plus double rails stitched to the pockets themselves that are designed to slide between the backpack plate and the bladder. When properly installed, the trim weight pockets do not prevent the bladder from inflating properly, and they do not interfere with the tank or tank strap. Each pocket can carry up to 2.2lb/1kg of weight.

Beikorrekter Anbringung der Trimmtaschen kann die Blase ohne Behinderung mit Luft gefüllt werden, Flasche oder Flaschenband sind ebenfalls nicht im Weg. MultiValue.Value: Rugged aluminum body features a rugged matte black finish with blue accents, providing lightweight long-term durability and a high-quality look.
Equipped with a Cree XPG LED. Beam angle: 12º. Extended light head shroud prevents the light beam from blinding other divers.
250 or 300 lumen illumination (rechargeable or disposable); 2700 lux @1m; CCT (correlated color temperature): 4500ºK.
Three modes: 100% power, 50% power and Flash.
Powered by a CR123 battery (rechargeable or disposable – battery and charger not included) with a burn time of up to 1 hour on full power.
New push-button switch on the end of the light is easy to activate when wearing gloves.
Double O-ring seals ensure watertight integrity.
Over-pressure valve releases battery off-gassing – a safety feature not normally found on dive lights of this size.
A depth rating of 492ft/150m ensures worry-free lighting in virtually all diving conditions.

Values.Value: The new Nova 250 is a versatile dive light that can be stored in the smallest BCD pocket. It offers three modes: 100% power, 50% power and Flash, plus is equipped with an over-pressure valve to release battery off-gassing, making it the safest small light on the market. Delivering 250 lumens of illumination, the Nova 250 is powered by a CR123 battery (rechargeable or disposable). The CR123 disposable battery features a shelf life of up to 10 years so you don’t have to worry about it if it stays in your BCD pocket over the winter.

Variant.title: Novalight 250
Variant.description: Die neue Nova 250 ist eine vielseitige Tauchlampe, die auch in die kleinste Jackettasche passt. Sie bietet drei Stufen: 100% Leuchtkraft, 50% Leuchtkraft und eine Blitzfunktion. Sie ist mit einem überdruckventil ausgestattet, durch welches Batteriegase abgelassen werden. Damit ist sie die sicherste kleine Lampe auf dem Markt. Bei einer Lichtstärke von 250 Lumen wird die Nova 250 mit einer CR123A-Batterie (Einweg) betrieben. Durch deren lange Lebensdauer von bis zu zehn Jahren, ist die NOVA 250 eine perfekte Back-Up Lampe, die auch dann noch zuverlässig funktioniert, wenn sie über längere Zeit unbenutzt in der Tasche des Tarierjackets verstaut war. Novalight 250

Variant.title: Nova 250 Torcia
Variant.description: La nuova Nova 250 è una torcia subacquea versatile che può essere facilmente riposta nella tasca più piccola dell’equilibratore. Dispone di tre modalità: potenza 100%, potenza 50% e Flash. È inoltre dotata di una valvola di sovrapressione che rilascia i gas nocivi emessi dalla batteria, rendendola la torcia compatta più sicura sul mercato. Nova 250 offre un’illuminazione di intensità pari a 250 lumen ed è alimentata con una batteria CR123 (ricaricabile o monouso). La batteria CR123 monouso ha una vita utile fino a 10 anni, perciò può rimanere nella tasca dell’equilibratore durante l’inverno. | Nova 250 Torcia

MultiValue.Value: Rugged matte black aluminum body with blue accents offers a stealthy tech look while providing lightweight, long-term durability.
850 lumen illumination. 17,000 lux @1m. CCT (correlated color temperature): 4200ºK.
Equipped with a Cree XPL LED. Beam angle: 8º.
Double O-ring seals ensure watertight integrity.
Powered by 3 standard C-sized rechargeable or disposable alkaline batteries (rechargeable or disposable – battery and charger not included) with a burn time of approximately 7 hours.
Easy twist-on/twist-off activation allows for trouble-free operation, even when wearing thick gloves.
Extended light head shroud prevents the light beam from blinding other divers.
Over-pressure valve releases battery off-gassing – a safety feature not normally found on dive lights at this price point.
A depth rating of 1000ft/300m ensures worry-free lighting in virtually all diving conditions.

Values.Value: In underwater lighting where performance, reliability and simplicity are the keys to success, nothing beats the no-nonsense Nova 850 Tec. This rugged single-mode dive light delivers intense 850 lumen illumination with a focused beam, ideal for lighting up those dark compartments in wrecks and hidden crevices in deep-water reefs. The light is machined from heavy-duty aluminum so is both lightweight and built to last. It is also easy to use, with simple twist-on/twist-off activation. The light comes with a convenient attachment point for attaching a bolt snap – usually with a short length of cave line – so it can be securely clipped to a D-ring when not being used. Divers looking for simple yet serious underwater illumination for night dives as well as day dives will find the Nova 850 Tec a smart choice.

Variant.title: Nova 850 Tec
Variant.description: Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Benutzerfreundlichkeit sind bei der Unterwasserbeleuchtung der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Hier ist die neue Nova 850 Tec bei Weitem unschlagbar. Diese stabile Single-Modus Tauchlampe liefert eine intensive Lichtstärke von 850 Lumen mit fokussiertem Strahl, was sie ideal für das Ausleuchten dunkler Bereiche in Wracks oder verdeckten Felsspalten macht. Die Lampe besteht aus einem hochstabilen Aluminiumgehäuse und ist daher sowohl leicht als auch haltbar. Dank des einfachen Drehreglers zum Ein- und Ausschalten ist sie leicht zu bedienen. Die Lampe bietet einen praktischen Befestigungspunkt für einen Karabinerhaken (z.B. mit einer kurzen Leine), damit sie sicher am D-Ring befestigt werden kann. Taucher, die nach einer einfachen und dennoch starken Unterwasserbeleuchtung für Nacht- und Tagtauchgänge suchen, treffen mit der Nova 850 Tec eine intelligente Wahl. Nova 850 Tec

Variant.title: Nova 850 Tec
Variant.description: Nell'illuminazione subacquea dove le prestazioni, l'affidabilità e la semplicità sono le chiavi del successo, niente batte Nova 850 Tec. Questa robusta torcia per immersioni offre un'intensa illuminazione a 850 lumen con un fascio focalizzato, ideale per illuminare quei compartimenti bui nei relitti e nelle fessure nascoste nelle barriere coralline in acque profonde. La torcia è realizzata in alluminio resistente, rendendola sia leggera che durevole. Facile da usare, con una semplice attivazione twist-on / twist-off. Nova 850 Tec è dotata di uno comodo punto di attacco per un bullone a scatto in modo da poter essere saldamente fissata ad un anello D ring quando non viene utilizzata. Coloro che cercano un'illuminazione subacquea semplice ma seria per immersioni notturne e diurne troveranno in Nova 850 Tec una scelta intelligente. | Nova 850 Tec

Values.Value: Heavy-Duty Dive Boot, 6.5mm, Black, L, US 9/EU 42/UK 8

If you have ever suffered from cold feet or found yourself stumbling over sharp rocks as you made your way down to the beach, you'll appreciate the HEAVY-DUTY 6.5MM dive boot. Built to handle the tough stuff, with a reinforced toe and heel and a substantial molded rubber sole, the HEAVY-DUTY 6.5MM is both durable and comfortable, making it the ideal wetsuit boot for cold water and harsh conditions. A Diamond Span interior enhances comfort plus improves warmth.

Variant.title: Delta Short Füssling, 3mm, Schwarz, XS

MultiValue.Value: Divers looking to enjoy some additional foot protection will want a couple pairs in their dive bags.
Textured sole provides a non-slip surface for walking on wet boat decks.
2.5mm thickness is ideal for wearing inside full foot fins.
Great for freedivers too, and also for small divers (the three smallest sizes are designed to fit the smallest of feet).

Values.Value: Hybrid Dive Sock, 2.5mm, Black, Rebel, S

The hybrid sock is made of soft 2.5mm neoprene with a textured sole that provides a bit of non-slip protection. Featuring a plush interior lining for warmth and comfort, you can wear the Hybrid sock inside your dive boot for added warmth, as a liner inside a full foot fin, or by itself to kick around on a chilly boat deck. Whichever you choose, your feet will love you for it.

Variant.title: Hybrid Rebel Socken, 2.5mm, Schwarz, S
Variant.description: Die Hybrid-Socks für Kinder sind aus 2, 5 mm starkem Neopren gefertigt und mit einem warmen Plüschfutter ausgestattet. Sie lassen sich zusätzlich zu deinem Füßling tragen oder als Socke in deiner Fußteilflosse, wenn das Wasser kühler wird, oder um eine bessere Passform zu erreichen. Aber auch zum Herumlaufen auf dem kalten Bootsdeck sind die Hybrid Socks durch ihre strukturierte Sohle gut geeignet. Was auch immer du damit tust, deine Füße werden dich für die Socken lieben. Hybrid Rebel Socken, 2.5mm

Variant.title: Hybrid Calzini Subacquei, 2,5 mm, Nero, Rebel, S
Variant.description: I calzini Hybrid per ragazzo sono realizzati in soffice neoprene da 2,5 mm e sono provvisti di una suola ruvida in grado di fornire una leggera protezione anti-scivolo. Felpati all’interno per garantire calore e comfort, possono essere indossati all’interno dei calzari se si desidera stare ancora più caldi, come strato protettivo all’interno delle pinne con scarpetta, o anche da soli, in caso di freddo, mentre ci si trova sul ponte. Qualunque sia la vostra scelta, i vostri piedi ve ne saranno grati. | Hybrid Calzini Subacquei, 2,5 mm, Nero, Rebel, S

Values.Value: The ultra-comfortable DELTA 3MM SHORT BOOT is designed for tropical diving and snorkeling. Low-cut and lightweight, with just the right amount of protection, it slips on and off without the need for a zipper. It's the perfect footwear for diving in warm water with adjustable fins.

Variant.title: Delta Short Füssling, 3mm, Schwarz, 2XS
Variant.description: Diese komfortablen 3 mm Füßlinge sind ideal für Tauchgänge und Schnorcheltouren in tropischen Gewässern. Sie zeichnen sich durch ihren knöchelhohen Schnitt, ein geringes Gewicht und dem richtige Maß an Wärmeschutz aus. Zum An- und Auszuziehen ist kein Reißverschluss nötig. Der perfekte Füßling für Warmwassertauchgänge mit Geräteflossen. Delta Short Füssling, 3mm

MultiValue.Value: 5mm N2S (Nylon 2 Sides) construction delivers comfort and durability.
New version offers an improved fit and easier wear with a revised ankle and a contoured top.
Sturdy outsole and rubberized armor provide excellent protection on top and bottom and increase comfort when traversing rocky shorelines.
Reinforced toe and heel caps extend boot life. The heel cap includes a fin strap keeper.
YKK zipper is fitted with a gusset to cut down on water seepage, and secures with a hook‑and‑loop tab.
High-quality anti-slip tread is non-marking, a feature boat owners always appreciate.
Made from X-Foam, a petroleum-free, limestone neoprene.

Values.Value: The popular Delta 5mm dive boot maintains its sturdy but flexible outsole and rubberized protective armor, yet still feels very light on the foot. A revised ankle diameter and new contoured top improve fit and make sliding the YKK zipper up and down even easier. The full cut design creates a comfortable, cramp-free fit, even for wide-shaped feet. The reinforcement on the top of the foot provides both cushion and protection against the edge of the fin pocket. The boot’s anti-slip tread is non-marking, a feature boat owners always appreciate. Offering lots of protection and comfort, the next time you're diving cold water or traversing rocky shorelines, you'll be glad to be wearing your Deltas.

Variant.title: Delta Dive Boot, 5mm, Schwarz, 3XS
Variant.description: Unser meistverkaufter Füßling, der Delta 5.0 besitzt eine robuste und dennoch flexible Außensohle sowie eine gummierte Schicht und ist dabei sehr leicht. Ein überarbeiteter Fußgelenkdurchmesser und eine neue, konturierte Oberfläche verbessern die Passform und machen das Bedienen des YKK-Reißverschlusses noch einfacher. Ein Vollschnitt sorgt auch bei breiten Füßen für einen bequemen und krampflosen Sitz. Der verstärkte Zehenbereich schützt gegen Abrieb durch die Flosse. Die rutschfeste Sohle des Füßlings hinterlässt zur Freude von Bootsbesitzern keine Spuren. Bei so viel Schutz und Komfort wirst du bei deinem nächsten Kalttwassertauchgang oder auf felsigen Stränden froh sein, deine Deltas anzuhaben. Delta Dive Boot, 5mm

Variant.title: Delta Calzari, 5 mm, Nero, 3XS
Variant.description: I famosi calzari Delta 5 mm per immersione mantengono una suola esterna robusta ma flessibile e un rinforzo resistente in gomma, pur conservando la loro caratteristica leggerezza. Un diametro della caviglia rivisitato e una parte superiore con una modellazione migliorano la vestibilità e rendono ancor più semplice lo scorrimento della zip YKK. Il taglio completo crea una comoda vestibilità senza il rischio di crampi, anche per piedi a pianta larga. Il rinforzo sulla parte superiore del piede fornisce imbottitura e resiste alle abrasioni causate dal bordo della scarpetta della pinna. Il battistrada antiscivolo dei calzari non lascia tracce, caratteristica che i proprietari di barca apprezzano sempre. Grazie alla loro notevole resistenza e comodità, alla prossima immersione in acque fredde o durante l’attraversamento dei litorali rocciosi, sarai entusiasta di indossare le tue Delta. | Delta Calzari, 5 mm, Nero, 3XS

Ein Vollschnitt sorgt auch bei breiten Füßen für einen bequemen und krampflosen Sitz. Der verstärkte Zehenbereich schützt gegen Abrieb durch die Flosse. Die rutschfeste Sohle des Füßlings hinterlässt zur Freude von Bootsbesitzern keine Spuren. Bei so viel Schutz und Komfort wirst du bei deinem nächsten Kalttwassertauchgang oder auf felsigen Stränden froh sein, deine Deltas anzuhaben. Delta Dive Boot, 5mm

Variant.title: Delta Calzari, 5 mm, Nero, 2XS
Variant.description: I famosi calzari Delta 5 mm per immersione mantengono una suola esterna robusta ma flessibile e un rinforzo resistente in gomma, pur conservando la loro caratteristica leggerezza. Un diametro della caviglia rivisitato e una parte superiore con una modellazione migliorano la vestibilità e rendono ancor più semplice lo scorrimento della zip YKK. Il taglio completo crea una comoda vestibilità senza il rischio di crampi, anche per piedi a pianta larga. Il rinforzo sulla parte superiore del piede fornisce imbottitura e resiste alle abrasioni causate dal bordo della scarpetta della pinna. Il battistrada antiscivolo dei calzari non lascia tracce, caratteristica che i proprietari di barca apprezzano sempre. Grazie alla loro notevole resistenza e comodità, alla prossima immersione in acque fredde o durante l’attraversamento dei litorali rocciosi, sarai entusiasta di indossare le tue Delta. | Delta Calzari, 5 mm, Nero, 2XS

MultiValue.Value: Easy to don and doff, this sock is great footwear for freedivers too, and also for small divers (the three smallest sizes are designed to fit the smallest of divers).
Included: a reusable fabric boot bag for transport and storage.
Made of 100% high-stretch Everflex Nylon outside and a plush interior lining for warmth and comfort.

Values.Value: The new Hybrid Sock is made of soft 2.5mm neoprene with a textured sole that provides a bit of non-slip protection for walking on wet boat decks. Featuring 100% high-stretch Everflex Nylon outside and a plush interior lining for warmth and comfort, you can wear the Hybrid sock inside your dive boot for added warmth, as a liner inside a full foot fin, or by itself to walk around on a chilly boat deck. Whichever you choose, your feet will love you for it.

Variant.title: Hybrid Socks 2.5, Schwarz 3XS/2XS
Variant.description: Der Hybrid Sock besteht aus 2, 5 mm dickem, weichem Neopren und einer texturierten Sohle, die leichten Griffigkeit beim Gehen auf nassen Bootsdecks bietet. Die Hybrid Sock mit 100% hochelastischem Everflex Nylon außen und Plüschfutter innen sorgt für Wärme und Komfort in einem Füßling oder einer Vollfußflosse oder kann allein als Rutschschutz getragen werden. Hybrid Socks 2.5, Schwarz 3XS/2XS

Variant.title: Hybrid Socks 2.5 Calzari, Nero, 3XS/2XS
Variant.description: I calzari Hybrid Sock sono realizzati in morbido neoprene da 2,5 mm e sono provvisti di una suola ruvida in grado di fornire una leggera protezione antiscivolo per camminare sui ponti umidi delle barche. Dotati di un rivestimento esterno in Everflex Nylon 100% altamente elastico e felpati all’interno per garantire calore e comfort, possono essere indossati all’interno di calzari rigidi se si desidera stare ancora più caldi, come strato protettivo all’interno delle pinne con scarpetta, o anche da soli, in caso di freddo, mentre ci si trova sul ponte. | Hybrid Socks 2.5 Calzari, Nero, 3XS/2XS

Dotati di un rivestimento esterno in Everflex Nylon 100% altamente elastico e felpati all’interno per garantire calore e comfort, possono essere indossati all’interno di calzari rigidi se si desidera stare ancora più caldi, come strato protettivo all’interno delle pinne con scarpetta, o anche da soli, in caso di freddo, mentre ci si trova sul ponte. | Hybrid Socks 2.5 Calzari, Nero, XS/S

Values.Value: The new Hybrid Sock is made of soft 2.5mm neoprene with a textured sole that provides a bit of non-slip protection for walking on wet boat decks. Featuring 100% high-stretch Everflex Nylon outside and a plush interior lining for warmth and comfort, you can wear the Hybrid sock inside your dive boot for added warmth, as a liner inside a full foot fin, or by itself to walk around on a chilly boat deck. Whichever you choose, your feet will love you for it.
