MultiValue.Value: Innovative arch design provides a level of support and comfort not often found in dive boots.
Boot’s 5mm neoprene, laminated on the outside with super-stretch nylon, is so pliable that donning and doffing is easy without the need of a zipper.
No-zip design includes webbing puller loops in front and back to aid in donning.
Diamond Span interior improves warmth and comfort and dries fast.
Heel cap includes a molded fin strap keeper to eliminate strap slippage
The outside of the toe box is cushioned and protected against abrasion.
Made with X-Foam neoprene, a very specific limestone-based neoprene complying with strict PAH and REACH regulations.

Values.Value: The Everflex Arch Boot just might be the most comfortable dive boot you’ve ever slipped your foot into. Featuring an innovative arch design that closely matches the foot’s natural anatomy, the boot’s foot pocket is cut wide, creating a cramp-free fit, even for wide-shaped feet. While the boot offers 5mm of thermal protection throughout most of the boot, in the upper ankle area the neoprene is a bit thinner to prevent bulkiness where it overlaps the wetsuit leg. The Diamond Span inner lining is super comfortable and dries fast.

Variant.title: Everflex Arch Boot, 5mm, 2XS, Schwarz
Variant.description: Der Everflex Arch Boot ist vielleicht der bequemste Füßling, den du je getragen hast. Mit seiner innovativen Fußform, die der natürlichen Anatomie des Fußes entspricht, ist der Fußbereich weit geschnitten und sorgt so für eine angenehme, nicht enge Passform und beugt selbst bei breit geformten Füßen Krämpfen vor. Das Diamond Span Innenfutter ist superbequem und trocknet schnell. Für 2022 kommt der Everflex Arch Boot neu in grau-schwarz und mit neuem Logo. Everflex Arch Boot, 5mm

Variant.title: Everflex Arch Calzari, 5 mm, Nero, 2XS
Variant.description: I Everflex Arch Boot da 5 mm diventeranno i calzari più comodi che tu ti sia mai messo ai pedi. Dotata di un design innovativo per l'arco plantare pensato per adattarsi alla morfologia naturale del piede, la scarpetta ha un taglio ampio, per evitare crampi anche ai piedi più larghi. Il rivestimento interno Diamond Span è estremamente confortevole e caldo, oltre ad asciugarsi velocemente. | Everflex Arch Calzari, 5 mm, Nero, 2XS

This new feature automatically engages speed and course control simultaneously, meaning anglers no longer need to depend on drift socks, kicker motors, or manual operation to control speed over water – even in the heaviest wind and current.

The most-trusted navigation system in fishing. Terrova uses GPS to control your trolling motor with unrivaled features that keep you on the fish. Set Spot-Lock, record paths, control speed and steering, and more. Minn Kota makes boat positioning and control automatic, and you can take command from the easy-to-read LCD screen of Terrova's wireless remote.

Minn Kota motors come standard with everything you need to connect to select Humminbird fish finders. Link and control your trolling motor, shallow water anchor and fish finder through the One-Boat Network App on Apple® or Android™ devices.

Spot-Lock will hold you in place with unparalleled GPS accuracy. Spot-Lock gives you the power to stay right on top of any productive fishing spot, without touching your trolling motor. With the built-in heading sensor, you can use Jog to move your Spot-Lock location five feet in any direction.

This new feature automatically engages speed and course control simultaneously, meaning anglers no longer need to depend on drift socks, kicker motors, or manual operation to control speed over water – even in the heaviest wind and current.

Check battery power levels while the motor is in use, real-time “time until empty” display monitor, with a notification when battery power is reduced to 20% to prompt users to enter Eco Mode which can reduce current draw to extend battery life.

Provides up to 5 times longer run time on a single battery charge. These variable speed trolling motors let you dial in your exact speed, and they deliver only as much power as you need, helping to conserve your battery for a full day of fishing.

Low profile design offers two steering options: Heel/toe pedal and left/right steering buttons, plus a user-programable button to keep the most used features a tap away, including: mark a waypoint, engage AutoPilot, or deploy or retract Minn Kota shallow water anchors. Includes 18' cord.
With a transducer built right into the motor, you get crystal clear Humminbird® MEGA Side Imaging and a clean protected look.
At the core of your Minn Kota trolling motor is an indestructible composite shaft, now made even stronger with carbon-fiber. It's a Minn Kota exclusive, and we guarantee it for life.

Easy-to-read illuminated directional indicator built right into the motor head tells you right where you’re headed - in any conditions.

Provides up to 5 times longer run time on a single battery charge. These variable speed trolling motors let you dial in your exact speed, and they deliver only as much power as you need, helping to conserve your battery for a full day of fishing.

Fall-away ramps will effortlessly slide your trolling motor into the water with the push of a lever.

MultiValue.Value: Control Talon from anywhere on the boat using your choice of options: Control Panel, Wireless Remote, Foot Switch, i-Pilot or i-Pilot Link Remote, One-Boat Network Mobile App or right from the Humminbird fish finder
Separate anchoring modes for Rough Water (heavy wind and chop), Soft Bottom (muddy or silted bottom), and standard (normal anchoring)
Illuminate the boat transom any time of day — or night. Includes two colors (white and blue) and each has three brightness intensity settings
Lets you control stow, deploy, anchoring modes, multiple Talon selection and work light; comes standard with one wireless remote
Control Talon from your mobile device using the One-Boat Network App (iOS or Android) and easily update software
Keeps Talon out of the way of your fishing lines
Built-in floating suspension keeps your boat anchored down even in rough water, enabling your boat to move up or down without affecting the anchor
Automatically deploy or retract your Talon with the push of a button; no need to hold the button down
Talon includes a mounting bracket that allows for up and down adjustments to fit any transom, 30 degrees of pivoting and easy removal
Alerts you when trying to take off while Talon is deployed
Keeps Talon safe from the corrosive effects of saltwater

Values.Value: Red/Black 10' Talon Shallow Water Anchor; Mounting and Assembly Hardware; Remote with Lanyard and Mounted Holder; User Manual and Installation Guide

When you find the right fishing spot time is critical. You can’t wait to anchor, can’t wait to cast, and can’t be bothered to move until you get what you came for. That’s why we designed every inch of Talon to hold you in place effortlessly and relentlessly – every time out. Talon is also the first and only shallow water anchor available in lengths up to 15 feet.

MultiValue.Value: This revolutionary anchoring technology continuously monitors anchoring force and adjusts to keep you pinned to the bottom
On Active Anchoring enabled models, this anchoring mode automatically senses bottom composition and hardness to deliver the right amount of anchoring force every time
A wider profile, heavy duty reinforced pivot points and extruded aluminum design will keep Raptor on the water in the harshest conditions
We designed Raptor with increased retraction force to ensure spike removal in all bottom types.

Control Raptor from anywhere on the boat using your choice of options: Wireless Remote, Foot Switch, i-Pilot or i-Pilot Link Remote, One-Boat Network Mobile App or right from the Humminbird fish finder.

Separate anchoring modes for Rough Water (heavy wind and chop), Soft Bottom (muddy or silted bottom), standard (normal anchoring), and Auto-Bottom Mode on Active Anchoring equipped models which automatically delivers the ideal anchoring force by sensing bottom hardness
Automatically deploy or retract your Raptor with the push of a button; no need to hold the button down
Keeps Raptor safe from the corrosive effects of saltwater
Raptor shallow water anchors with and without active anchoring cannot be paired to one-another.

Raptor 8 ft. - Black with Active Anchoring

Raptor keeps working to hold you more reliably than any other anchor, especially in rough conditions. It knows where you’re anchoring, what’s happening to your boat, and what to do next. It reads the bottom, senses the anchoring force and reacts automatically to keep you locked down until the moment you’re ready to change spots. Legendary Minn Kota durability and innovative anchoring technology make Raptor the only hydraulic anchor that can call itself relentless.

Control Raptor from anywhere on the boat using your choice of options: Wireless Remote, Foot Switch, i-Pilot or i-Pilot Link Remote, One-Boat Network Mobile App or right from the Humminbird fish finder.

Separate anchoring modes for Rough Water (heavy wind and chop), Soft Bottom (muddy or silted bottom), standard (normal anchoring), and Auto-Bottom Mode on Active Anchoring equipped models which automatically delivers the ideal anchoring force by sensing bottom hardness
Automatically deploy or retract your Raptor with the push of a button; no need to hold the button down
Keeps Raptor safe from the corrosive effects of saltwater
Raptor shallow water anchors with and without active anchoring cannot be paired to one-another.

Values.Value: Pre-wired Anchor Winch with 44 inch 10AWG Lead Wire with Battery Ring Terminals and Wire Connectors; Pre-spooled with 100 feet of 800-lb test nylon rope; Mounting Hardware; Remote Mountable Anchor Davit; Owner’s Manual

Automatically raise and lower your anchor at the touch of a button. DeckHand 40 has a 40-lb anchor capacity (anchor not included). Pre-spooled with 100 feet of 800-lb test nylon rope. Universal davit can be mounted at base of DeckHand or in remote position on boat deck. Davit also stows anchor horizontally to eliminate anchor swing. Anchor shackle allows for quick changes between anchors. A special anti-drag system senses the bottom to allow for controlled drifting. Runs on 12-volt battery (not included). Remote accessory (sold separately) allows for 25' corded remote operation. DH 40 is designed to work with anchors weighing at least 20 lbs and not more than 40 lbs.

MultiValue.Value: Unlock more fish, more structure, and unprecedented underwater clarity with with Side Imaging® and Down Imaging®, providing views up to 400 feet below and out to either side of your boat. See and stay on the fish with Dual Spectrum CHIRP sonar– providing exceptional 2D sonar with superior target separation.

Minn Kota® trolling motors, fish finders, maps, sonar, and shallow water anchors all work together for one purpose—fishing. The Minn Kota system seamlessly integrates what your fish finder sees with what your trolling motor does, turning sonar and mapping data into automated and precise boat positioning so you can stay focused on fishing.
Getting to your favorite spot is easier than ever. Just draw a course with your finger and the motor automatically takes you where you want to go.
Avoid shallow water and protect your equipment—this feature detects depth changes, alerts you immediately, and if necessary, automatically engages Spot-Lock® and deploys your shallow water anchors.

From innovative navigation features to precise boat positioning, built-in connectivity let's you wirelessly manage compatible gear seamlessly across your Minn Kota® system. Simplify the set up and use of your integrated system without complex rigging or cables—keeping everything connected, cleaner, and more organized.

Never miss a thing with the incredible detail of sonar and chart images. Plus, the high-resolution touchscreen not only responds instantly in wet conditions—it makes it easy to see the sharpest images even in rain, high sun, or when wearing polarized lenses.

Manage your boat on or off the water, for total command of your Minn Kota® fish finder, waypoints, trolling motor, and shallow water anchors right at your fingertips. Sync the app to your fish finder to help you scout, group, sort, and edit waypoints with ease.

Zero in on where the fish are. Navigate over 13,000 inland lakes and coastal waterways in the United States and Canada safely and with confidence. Tools like 1 ft. contours and depth and shallow water highlights help you traverse waters with certainty.

From innovative navigation features to precise boat positioning, built-in connectivity let’s you wirelessly manage compatible gear seamlessly across your Minn Kota® system. Simplify the set up and use of your integrated system without complex rigging or cables—keeping everything connected, cleaner, and more organized.

Simplify your software updates by downloading over Wi-Fi, offering a faster solution than physical SD cards or Bluetooth. Simply connect your Minn Kota fish finder to Wi-Fi, download updates on your fish finder, then push them through to networked fish finders, trolling motors, and advanced sonar.

Product.Name: DSC133 GRN1 BLV CWB ASE U5

MultiValue.Value: A wide middle bench seat gives kids a secure, comfortable spot in the boat and makes outings easier and more enjoyable for the entire family.
A wide, flat-bottom hull provides dependable stability whether you're paddling with passengers, fishing, or hauling gear.
Built with Old Town’s ultra durable three layer polyethylene, delivering long lasting strength, impact resistance, and reliability through seasons of heavy use.
Designed to adapt to your adventure: row it, paddle it, or add a small motor to tackle greater distances with ease and flexibility.
Ample room and high load capacity make it easy to carry coolers, tackle, camping supplies, or a day’s worth of equipment without compromising performance.
A stable, efficient hull shape offers smooth tracking and predictable control, helping you move quietly through calm lakes or winding rivers.
Wide beam and steady feel create an ideal platform for casting, landing, or outfitting with your favorite on water accessories.

Values.Value: The Discovery 133 is a versatile sporting canoe with an assortment of unique features. Paddle it tandem from the bow and stern web seats, pole it solo, or row it effortlessly from the center oar sockets. You can even outfit it with Old Town's motor mount and a small outboard, making remote fishing spots just minutes away. As your needs vary, the patented Discovery 133 is a dependable choice for strength, flexibility, and lightweight manageability. With our 3-layer hull construction and a keeled design, and featuring a wide beam for rock solid stability and exceptional carrying capacity, the Discovery 133 is well-suited as a fishing and hunting boat, and could be equally useful as an outdoor photographer's workboat.

Values.Value: The Twin Heron is a truly unique tandem kayak that also performs well when paddled solo. The Auto Trim Hull is designed to prevent the bow from popping up when seated solo in the stern seat. You can also completely remove the front seat making it perfect for your dog to ride along or easy access to your gear. The Twin Heron comes standard with four flush-mount rod holders, making tandem fishing trips even easier! The Twin Heron is a great option for the outdoors family looking for a versatile tandem kayak.

MultiValue.Value: Ultra-stable DoubleU Hull glides quietly through water while providing a stable and comfortable stand-up fishing platform.
Award-winning PDL® Drive that offers instant forward and reverse propulsion.
The PDL® Drive comes with 5-year warranty coverage, is easy to operate and maintain, and is saltwater-ready.
Adjustable and breathable, UV-resistant materials let you dial in the perfect seating position for all-day comfort.
Two 18" tracks provide easy, accessible mounting options for fish finders, rod holders, and more.

Ocean Kayak Malibu Pedal T - Horizon

Tandem kayaking made easier with the Ocean Kayak Malibu Pedal T. Designed based on our legendary Malibu models, the Malibu Pedal T is a spacious and comfortable tandem pedal kayak equipped with two forward-and-reverse pedal drives. Capable of navigating a variety of waterbodies, both passengers can pedal without worrying about being in-sync while the rear passenger easily steers the craft using an intuitive rudder control situated beside the stern passenger seat. Featuring breathable and adjustable framed seats, keeping you high and dry and comfortable for hours on the water. Equipped with cupholders, accessory tracks, rod holders, and ample gear storage, the Malibu Pedal T is ready for any outing for years to come.

Designed for anything from freshwater lakes and rivers to saltwater, the Malibu ePDL+ 120 is ready for any adventure you want to embark on. Just hop in and start pedaling to explore new places with confidence for hours.

For the angler who aspires to fish with no limits, the Sportsman PDL® 120 Pro is a compact, pedal-driven boat that moves like a bike on water so you can get to more fishing spots with ease and speed. The award-winning PDL® Drive provides anglers with instant forward and reverse pedaling and seamless steering with an intuitive rudder control right by your side. The Sportsman Pro line is equipped with superior rod and tackle management, offering more space and storage options that rival big bass boats and allow each angler the freedom to customize their craft the way they want. The PDL® 120 Pro delivers a feature-rich kayak fishing platform that is easy to transport and maneuver on-and-off the water.

If summer vibes were a kayak, the Sonata 106 MK would be it! The Sonata 106 MK is easy to maneuver like a kayak but fully motorized like a boat with built-in wireless Bluetooth speakers. Be the source of entertainment with your friends during your next trip by wirelessly connecting your phone to enjoy your favorite music, podcast, or e-book. Turn on the LED cockpit lighting to keep the party going as the sun starts to set. Cruise, party, or fish 'til sundown with the Sonata 106 MK.

Values.Value: The Malone Axis™ Angler package combines the Truck Bed Extender with the Axis™ Roller for optimum ease when loading and unloading cargo. Cam style load straps firmly secure your cargo. Sentry™ Tie-downs and a DOT approved rear Safety Flag is included. The Axis™ is made of heavy duty steel with a thick layer of powder coating to resist corrosion. It can be used in either the vertical position to create a "rear of vehicle" load bar, or, the horizontal position to extend the bed of the truck. The 42" long Roller fits within the Axis™ framework and has a rubber coated surface for scuff resistant transit. The system requires a 2" receiver and has multiple settings to adjust both height and width.

MultiValue.Value: With AutoChart’s generated contours, you’ll have access to all the detail and features of Humminbird LakeMaster charts including: Depth Highlight, Water Level Offset, Shallow Water Highlight, Importing and Exporting of waypoints, and i-Pilot Link functionality.

Record sonar data after inserting a blank SD card into your Humminbird. - Import your recordings into the AutoChart PC program and convert your survey into a lake map. - Export your map onto the Zero Lines Map Card (included) to display on any compatible Humminbird.
Zero Line card - Included with the AutoChart PC software is a 32 GB map card loaded with Zero Lines (shorelines) for millions of water bodies in North America (excluding Alaska).

With these Zero Lines, you can begin creating your own detailed maps of any fishing spot, even where contour coverage doesn’t exist. Once your map is created, you can view the contours on a compatible Humminbird fish finder by loading them onto a Zero Lines Map Card.

Humminbird AutoChart enables you to use Minn Kota® i-Pilot® Link™ after you create contours with the revolutionary AutoChart PC Software. The i-Pilot Link’s innovative Follow the Contour feature directs the trolling motor to follow a specific depth contour. The chosen contour line can be followed in either direction, or stay a set distance from that contour or shoreline with Contour Offset. Go to minnkotamotors.com for more information.
Don’t want to wait for the retail package? Purchase the digital-only version and receive it today at chartselect.humminbird.com - Remember, you must have a 32GB (or higher) SD card.
AutoChart is optional for select XPLORE, APEX, SOLIX, HELIX, ONIX, ION, 1100, 900, 800, and 600 Series models. Compatibility subject to change without notice.
512 MB RAM*, 10 GB Free hard drive, Windows XP (sp3 or greater), DVD-ROM Drive. *1024 MB RAM Recommended

MultiValue.Value: SmartStrike provides LakeMaster depth contours and includes features such as Depth Highlight, Shallow Water Highlight and Water Level Offset, while also providing predictive fish information based on your specific conditions.

SmartStrike takes you straight to the action by showing you where the fish should be biting on any of the High Definition lakes of your choice. Based on search parameters like season, time of day, temperature and targeted fish species, SmartStrike highlights areas of the lake map where your prey is most likely to be located - before you even wet a line.

New High-Definition lake map data available for the following lakes: Brady Branch Reservoir, Caddo, DeQueen (AR), Eufaula (OK), Grand Lake of the Cherokees, Livingston, Nacodgoches, Norfork, Robert S Kerr, Skiatook, Tawakoni and more.
Can be used with Minn Kota i-Pilot Link, allowing you to “Follow” a selected depth contour line, delivering precise, automatic boat control.
Scrollable lake list allows you to view and research lakes from your Humminbird fish finder.
SmartStrike full search functionality is exclusive to High-Definition waters only and GPS-equipped APEX, SOLIX, HELIX, ONIX and ION units.
Includes micro SD card with full size adapter and water Resistant SD card carrying case.
Opened packages are not eligible for return.

Values.Value: One (1) 30 inch length transducer Y cable allows both a Side Imaging and a 2D transducer to beconnected to one Humminbird unit for high speed depth and sonar performance
14 M ID SIDB Y - SOLIX / APEX Side Imaging & 2D Splitter Cable

The 14 M ID SIDB Y cable allows for the installation of a separate 2D transducer paired with a Humminbird MEGA Imaging or non-MEGA Imaging transducer and connect both transducers to a single Humminbird control head. This y-cable provides the ability to install a separate high-speed Humminbird 2D transducer for high-speed depth reading and sonar performance. Alternatively, this cable can also be used to add an accessory Airmar® 2D transducer to a Humminbird control head that also has a Side or Down Imaging transducer connected at the same time. This cable supports Transducer ID for automatic recognition and easy setup of Airmar® accessory transducers.

14 M ID SILR Y - SOLIX / APEX Side Imaging Left-Right Splitter Cable

The 14 M ID SILR Y cable allows for two Side Imaging transducers to be connected to into a single sonar input on a Humminbird chartplotter. This y-cable utilizes the two Side Imaging transducer to act as independent port and starboard Side Imaging sonar sources when boat hulls and transducer obstructions require separate transducers for a clear picture on each side of the vessel. This rigging cable provides the ability to install a separate high-speed Humminbird 2D transducer for high-speed depth reading and sonar performance. Alternatively, this cable can also be used to add an accessory Airmar® 2D transducer to a Humminbird control head that also has a Side or Down Imaging transducer connected at the same time. This cable supports Transducer ID for automatic recognition and easy setup of Airmar® accessory transducers.

When paired with MEGA 360® Imaging, the heading sensor data enables precise waypoint marking and display. Waypoints appear accurately on the MEGA 360® sonar view, allowing anglers to navigate back to specific targets or structures with confidence.
This Humminbird NMEA 2000 device can be connected to a conventional NMEA 2000 network or connected directly to a compatible NMEA 2000 capable fish finder with the Direct NMEA 2000 cable (included)

Provides accurate, real-time heading data, allowing the chart view to display a dynamic heading line and rotate the boat icon to reflect actual bow direction—even when stationary or drifting. This improves situational awareness, especially in Heads Up mode.

When you mark a waypoint (e.g., where you saw fish or structure), the heading sensor allows the chart to correctly orient in the direction of that point relative to the boat, enabling you to return to it more accurately.

A heading sensor enhances Minn Kota® Autopilot™ and Drift Modes by providing accurate boat orientation, enabling more precise and responsive navigation adjustments on Humminbird® Chart Views while fishing.
When trolling at low speeds, the heading sensor gives accurate directional data, allowing you to maintain consistent trolling lines and cover water efficiently.
Dual-band GPS receiver with WAAS/EGNOS capability
View your track & speed, mark waypoints, navigate and more
Mount on any flat surface or 1” x 14 thread
This NMEA 2000 accessory is compatible with the following Humminbird® fish finders: APEX Series, XPLORE Series, SOLIX Series, and HELIX G4N Models.
Advanced GPS compass and heading sensor reads true direction while sitting still or moving

This item has three cables. The cable connected to the receiver is 70" long, the power cable is 54" and the Y cable in total length is around 15" long. The power cable side of the Y is 9" long and the NMEA2000 side of the Y is 9" long.

Fortrex bow-mount MEGA 360 Imaging transducer with attached power cable and transducer cable, 10' SOLIX transducer cable, 10' HELIX transducer adapter cable, 10' MEGA 360 power cable, easy to mount MEGA 360 Imaging - Fortrex mounting bracket (Minn Kota Fortrex trolling motor sold separately)
The high-frequency beam of MEGA Imaging CHIRPs across the megahertz range to reveal the world below in picture-like detail all the way around your boat.

Use MEGA 360 Imaging without sacrificing boat control. Whether trolling or using Spot-Lock, MEGA 360 Imaging is independently mounted, so your sonar picture remains unchanged as the trolling motor turns.

Pick from two operation modes for this transducer; MEGA 360 Imaging or Side Imaging. This allows you to view a MEGA 360 Imaging view or use this transducer as a MEGA Side Imaging sonar source by selecting the Side Imaging operation mode.
Mark waypoints directly on your MEGA 360 Imaging screen and watch them update as your boat position changes, making it easy to find and then cast to fish and structure.
Utilize optional range rings to show you the distance of targets from your boat, for a better understanding of exactly where the fish are.
View MEGA 360 Imaging alongside your choice of multiple sonar and map technologies for a complete understanding of your surroundings.
MEGA 360 Imaging allows you to customize sweep speed, viewing area, display information, sonar zoom and color palette to your specific fishing situation and preferences.
Compatible HELIX models can share the MEGA 360 Imaging view via One Boat Network to HELIX G2N and newer models with software version 2.180 or later.
Compatible SOLIX and APEX models can share the MEGA 360 Imaging view to all other SOLIX or APEX models on the One Boat Network.

MultiValue.Value: Supported devices may include DSC VHF, Heading Sensors, GPS, and AIS devices. Your Humminbird control head manual should be referenced to confirm which devices are supported.
The HHGPS cable is used to connect a RS-232 and NMEA 0183 devices to the GPS/NMEA port on a 300, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900, 1100, or HELIX Series products with GPS.
This HHGPS cable requires a RS-232 or NMEA 0183 cable from the NMEA0183 device’s manufacture to complete the connection to the Humminbird control head.
Humminbird 700, 800, 900, 1100, HELIX 8, HELIX 9, HELIX 10, HELIX 12, HELIX 15 control heads can supply power to the connected device.
Humminbird 300, 500, 600, HELIX 5, and HELIX 7 control heads do not supply power therefore the connected device must be externally powered.
The HHGPS Connection Kit Includes: NMEA connection cable and detailed instructions.
Note: this cable should not be used on an APEX, SOLIX, ONIX or ION unit. For APEX, SOLIX, ONIX and ION Series, a AS GPS NMEA should be used.

Values.Value: Radar Dome; 32.8 ft Data Cable; Mounting Hardware

The HB 2124 is our Humminbird CHIRP Radar that features CHIRP pulse compression, setting a new standard for compact solid-state radar. It delivers superior radar imaging on both long and extremely short ranges. This translates to better situational awareness in low-visibility conditions and helps identify floating obstacles and structures for clues to where gamefish are located. In addition, track weather, hazards and other vessels with amazing definition for navigational safety.

ICE AS GPS HS - ICE GPS Receiver with Heading Sensor

The ICE AS GPS HS is a precision GPS receiver with heading sensor designed specifically for ICE fishing. An internal compass also provides constant heading displayed on your Humminbird chart screen, even while sitting still, making it easy to understand exactly where you are in correlation to the GPS chart.
